jobs.title: Social Media Strategist (Pro Bono)
jobs.excerpt: Professors Without Borders (PROWIBO) is an international charity dedicated to improving access to quality higher education worldwide.
jobs.description:
Professors Without Borders (PROWIBO) is an international charity dedicated to improving access to quality higher education worldwide. Inspired by the model of Doctors Without Borders, we deploy volunteer educators to partner institutions across the Global South. Our work contributes directly to UN Sustainable Development Goal 4: Quality Education.

Operating in over 16 countries and with a growing online community of 8,000+ followers, PROWIBO delivers teaching, mentoring, and capacity-building programmes that expand opportunities for students often overlooked by mainstream systems.

The Role

We are seeking a volunteer Social Media Strategist to shape the next phase of PROWIBO’s digital presence.

This is a voluntary, pro bono role suited to an experienced communications professional who wishes to use their skills for global impact. You will lead our social media strategy, help us tell powerful human stories, and grow our international reach.

This is a hands-on leadership role with scope to introduce new tools, workflows, and ideas, while guiding a small team of volunteer contributors.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and deliver a cross-platform content strategy aligned with PROWIBO’s mission.

  • Manage and grow our presence on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and X.

  • Create engaging, original content that highlights our impact and stories.

  • Mentor and support a small team of volunteer social media contributors.

  • Introduce systems for planning, scheduling, and tracking performance.

  • Monitor trends and strengthen engagement with online communities.

  • Report on progress and adjust strategies based on insights.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience managing brand or nonprofit social media.

  • Strong track record in content strategy, audience growth, and storytelling.

  • Proficiency with scheduling tools, analytics, and basic design tools.

  • Experience mentoring or managing junior colleagues or volunteers.

  • Excellent writing and editing skills.

  • Strong organisational and project management abilities.

  • Alignment with PROWIBO’s mission and values.

What We Offer (Voluntary Role)

  • A leadership opportunity to shape the digital voice of an international nonprofit.

  • A meaningful volunteer experience aligned with UN SDGs.

  • Flexible, remote role with global visibility.

  • Opportunity to mentor and build capacity in a small team.

  • Belonging to a diverse network of educators and changemakers.

Commitment

This is a volunteer position. Hours are flexible, and we are mindful of professional and personal commitments. The aim is to contribute skills with impact, without an excessive time burden.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About the JobAs a Full-Stack Engineer at Splitero, you will play a crucial role in architecting, developing, and maintaining our software from marketing through origination.
jobs.description:
About the Job

As a Full-Stack Engineer at Splitero, you will play a crucial role in architecting, developing, and maintaining our software from marketing through origination. Your expertise in modern back-end technologies, cloud computing, and the full software development lifecycle will be essential in delivering high-quality solutions in a fintech and proptech ecosystem. You will work closely with product, engineering, and QA teams to ensure our software meets the highest standards of functionality and performance while we scale our operations to meet team and organization goals. As an individual contributor, you will be able to balance pace with perfection and understand tradeoffs in how you deliver your work.

  • Design and implement scalable and efficient back-end systems using Node, JavaScript, and TypeScript. Develop APIs and services that support robust application functionality.
  • Utilize PostgreSQL to design and manage databases, ensuring data integrity and optimizing performance across a Heroku Connect/Salesforce-based data infrastructure.
  • Develop and deploy serverless applications using AWS Lambda and IaC platforms such as Terraform and AWS CDK.
  • Work with AI technologies for both your day-to-day role as an engineer and also for new product implementations, leveraging APIs with major AI platforms
  • Collaborate with front-end developers to integrate back-end services with a modern React ecosystem (, Tailwind, Vercel, etc), ensuring a seamless and responsive user experience.
  • Participate in all stages of the software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design to implementation, testing, and deployment.
  • Work closely with product managers and QA teams to gather requirements, identify issues, and deliver high-quality software solutions.
  • Maintain a high level of attention to detail, ensuring that software is reliable, efficient, and meets established standards and specifications.
  • Stay current with industry trends and technologies, recommending improvements and adopting best practices for software development and cloud computing.

The salary range for this position is $140,000 - $155,000. Within the range, individual pay is determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

About You

  • 4-6 years of experience as a full-stack engineer with a strong focus on back-end technologies
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript for front-end and back-end development
  • Strong experience with Node.js for building server-side applications
  • Expertise in PostgreSQL (or similar) and database design
  • Experience with cloud computing platforms, specifically AWS Lambda
  • Extensive experience working with Claude Code (or similar) to build tools and workflows that accelerate the development lifecycle; not just individual chat use or vibe coding
  • Hands-on experience working with Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation
  • Experience implementing and working with modern analytics tools for event tracking and reporting (Mixpanel, Posthog, Google Analytics, etc)
  • Strong experience working with testing and quality engineering tools such as Playwright, Jest, and/or Mocha
  • Solid understanding of modern cloud computing pipelines and the full software development lifecycle
  • Proven experience working directly with product and QA teams to ensure high-quality software delivery
  • Experience with Heroku Connect and Salesforce platforms is a plus
  • Candidates must be located in the United States. Working timezone in PST or MST preferred.
  • Ability to break down complex technical problems and deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Effective communication skills and a track record of collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Desire to participate in fast-paced early-stage startup
  • Adaptability: Embraces changing circumstances with resiliency and positivity
  • Team-Oriented: Prioritizes collaboration, inclusivity, and teammate support

About Us

Millions of homeowners in today’s economy are sitting on substantial home equity they are unable to access due to rising interest rates and strict qualification requirements of traditional lenders. That means millions of homeowners can’t convert their hard-earned equity into cash to pay off debt, start a home renovation, or pad their retirement to better their lives.

Splitero co-founders Michael Gifford and David Zvaifler witnessed the problem firsthand throughout their real estate careers. They set out to create a win-win product that could help those homeowners access their home equity but not make monthly payments like traditional financing options. And thus, Splitero was born.

As part of our team, you will join our quest to revolutionize the real estate industry while helping families in need. We offer a suite of benefits designed to help you thrive in all areas of life.

  • OneTeam Culture - We foster a culture of transparency, innovation, and inclusivity, where every voice is heard and every team member is valued. We believe in celebrating our successes, doing the right thing, and helping each other so we grow as a team and as individuals.
  • Generous Resources - We want to ensure you are set up to do your best work. In addition to a solid tech stack, and access to any WeWork location, you will receive a monthly cell and internet stipend.
  • Premium Healthcare - We offer comprehensive healthcare plans for you and your family, which employees are eligible for on their first day.
  • Flexible PTO and Parental Leave - We offer a generous PTO and encourage employees to take time off to recharge. We're proud to offer a parental leave policy that allows you to welcome your new addition without worry.

We are a workforce composed of individuals with diverse backgrounds, abilities, minds, and identities. In keeping with our commitment to inclusion, we will ensure that people with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. jobs.description:
Job Title: HEDIS Auditor Trainee
Job Types: Part-time, Seasonal.

Candidates must be able to commit to 20-40 hours per week during training and throughout the entire HEDIS season

Shift Hours: Applicant should be available to work from 6 AM to 6 PM EST.

This is a remote position available to candidates located within the United States. Applicants must be eligible to work in the United States.

Pay Structure:

  • The training pay rate is $25 per hour
  • Post Training completion, the pay rate increases to $30 per hour

HEDIS Auditor Trainee – Onshore

Remote position, reporting to HEDIS QA Manager during training phase.

HEDIS auditor trainee is responsible for learning and applying the concepts of HEDIS based on HEDIS Technical Specifications and client guidance as portrayed in Advantmed training material.

This role involves training on HEDIS measures, which includes all recorded measure trainings, recorded demo records to ensure an understanding on how to abstract in the tool, any recorded supplemental training, supplemental and measure training assessments, and test records in the training portal.

This role is a prerequisite for the auditor position where you will be providing knowledge transfer of the information you learned during training, to abstractors during their training phase and during the live season.

  • Must acquire a base score of 97.5% overall.
  • Complete all training in the defined timeline.
  • Must attempt all training as scheduled in the HEDIS training planner which will be provided on Day 1 of your training or communicate to HEDIS Manager with any changes in schedule.
  • Must have a professional attitude and willingness to learn.

Requirements

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 2 years/seasons of experience in HEDIS Abstraction / Review
  • Medical Coder Certification: CPC, CCS, RHIT, RHIA through AAPC or AHIMA OR
  • Licensed Nurse: LPN, LVN, RN with an active license

jobs.title: Claims Examiner, Liability - MSI
jobs.excerpt: Why MSI?  We thrive on solving challenges.  As a leading MGA, MSI combines deep underwriting expertise with insurer and reinsurer risk capacity to create specialized insurance solutions that empower distribution partners to meet customers’ unique needs.
jobs.description:
Why MSI? We thrive on solving challenges.


As a leading MGA, MSI combines deep underwriting expertise with insurer and reinsurer risk capacity to create specialized insurance solutions that empower distribution partners to meet customers’ unique needs.


We have a passion for crafting solutions for the important risks facing individuals and businesses. We offer an expanding suite of products – from fully-digital embedded renters coverage to high-value homeowners insurance to sophisticated commercial coverages, such as cyber liability and habitational property – delivered through agents, brokers, wholesalers and other brand partners.


Our partners and customers count on us to deliver exceptional service through a dedicated team that makes rapid resolutions a priority. We simplify the insurance experience through our advanced technology platform that supports every phase of the policy lifecycle. Since its founding in 2015, MSI has grown to offer a wide range of insurance products across commercial, specialty, and personal lines and has reached over $1 billion of in-force premium in its nationwide portfolio.


Bring on your challenges and let us show you how we build insurance better.


As we expand our in-house renters claims handling capabilities, we’re seeking a Claims Examiner who is excited to be part of a growing team where renters claims experience is highly valued.


MSI handles third-party claims involving bodily injury and property damage under various homeowner’s insurance policies and renter’s insurance policies nationwide. We are looking for an experienced individual to join our Liability Claims Team as a Claims Examiner focused on Renters Liability Claims. The Claims Examiner will be managing insurance claims for our policyholders with low to moderate severity and complexity. The Claims Examiner must have the experience and technical knowledge to manage a caseload from inception to resolution while providing our customers and business partners with superior service at all times. The ability to build relationships and communicate effectively is a key factor in succeeding in this role. Having a strategic vision coupled with tactical execution to deliver results aligned with goals and objectives is critical to the overall success of this position. The Claims Examiner must be able to work with little to minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment. Previous renters' liability claim handling was a plus but not required.


PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Directly handles third-party bodily injury and property damage claims involving low to moderate complexity from initial assignment through to resolution of claim, including negotiating settlements.
  • Evaluates and analyzes insurance policies to make coverage determinations.
  • Drafts Reservation of Rights letters and coverage disclaimers as warranted.
  • Makes prompt contact with policyholders, claimants, and other appropriate parties to gather information, take recorded statements, and conduct thorough investigations.
  • Investigates claims to determine validity and the potential for liability against insureds.
  • Evaluates damages (both bodily injuries and property damages) to determine potential exposures and sets appropriate reserves.
  • Works a claim load efficiently and independently with little to no supervision.
  • Sets timely file reserves in compliance with the company’s reserving philosophy and continues to evaluate pending reserves throughout the life of the claim.
  • Manage defense counsel, which includes assisting in claim strategy, evaluating potential exposure, reviewing invoices, and attending mediations and settlement conferences as necessary.
  • Engages experts, as needed, to assist in the evaluation of the claim and monitors experts and vendors’ performance while controlling expenses.
  • Drafts reports for large losses and reports to leadership as required.
  • Evaluates, negotiates, and determines settlement values in settlement of claims.
  • Communicates with all interested parties throughout the life of the claim, including proactively discussing coverage decisions, the need for additional information, and settlement amounts with interested parties.
  • Establishes and maintains an organized diary system to ensure all claims are appropriately handled in a timely manner.
  • Adheres to all state/local regulations, including the NJ/PA Unfair Claims Practices and Guidelines.
  • Handles all claims in accordance with best practices and provides best-in-class customer service to insureds, agents, claimants, and business partners.
  • Responsible for monitoring and completing assigned claims inventory.
  • Acquires and maintains multiple state adjuster’s licenses and maintains continuing education requirements.
  • Develops and maintains relationships with external and internal stakeholders.
  • Identifies questionable risks, red flags, and fraud indicators and alerts the Special Investigation Unit when applicable.
  • Identifies opportunities for subrogation and ensures recovery interests are protected.
  • Acts as a mentor for less experienced Claims Examiners.
  • Updates and maintains well drafted claim file notes with proper documentation throughout the life of the file.
  • Assists with special projects when required.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

  • Ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and provide superior customer service over the phone and through written correspondence.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Strong writing skills.
  • Excellent analytical, investigative, and negotiation skills.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office, Teams, Word, Excel, and various other computer skills with the ability to learn and utilize new computer systems and other technologies.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
  • 5+ years of casualty claims adjusting experience
  • First-Party Property experience is a plus
  • Insurance designations preferred
  • Must have a State Adjuster License(s) (California, Florida, and Texas licenses are desirable) with willingness to expand licenses as needed

jobs.excerpt: AHEAD builds platforms for digital business.  By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
jobs.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.

The Director of Client Operations is responsible for the strategic leadership, organizational design, and financial stewardship of the Client Operations function within an assigned region. Reporting to the VP of Operations and aligned to the EVP of Sales, this leader ensures operational rigor, forecasting discipline, and margin protection across their regional sales segment.

In addition to regional accountability, each Director partners closely with peer Directors to ensure consistent governance standards, coverage models, and operational practices across the broader Client Operations organization. This role balances regional ownership with enterprise-wide functional alignment to support scalable growth and financial discipline.

Duties / Responsibilities

    Regional Leadership & Organizational Design

    • Lead and develop Senior Managers and Managers within the assigned region

    • Design and continuously refine regional coverage models aligned to revenue growth and segment complexity

    • Evaluate span-of-control, workload distribution, and structural alignment

    • Drive succession planning and leadership bench development

    • Partner with regional Sales Leadership to ensure operational alignment and execution readiness

    • Lead during periods of Financial Close, End of Month/Quarter/Year. Marshalling resources to achieve results during high stress, time constraint periods.

    Operational Governance, Forecast Discipline & Salesforce Integrity

    • Establish and maintain regional quote-to-cash governance standards aligned to enterprise frameworks

    • Ensure disciplined Salesforce hygiene standards are consistently reinforced across teams

    • Own regional oversight of month-end Salesforce activities, including opportunity updates, stage accuracy, close date integrity, and required documentation compliance

    • Ensure forecasting cadence and pipeline validation processes are consistently executed by Managers

    • Identify systemic forecast volatility, revenue timing risks, or margin exposure trends within the region

    • Escalate material operational or financial risks to leadership

    • Monitor recurring booking errors, documentation gaps, or process inefficiencies and drive structural corrective action

    • Sponsor regional and enterprise workflow improvements and system enhancements to increase scalability and execution consistency

    Sales Partnership & Cross-Functional Alignment

    • Serve as the senior Client Operations partner to regional Sales Leadership, including Managing Directors and EVP alignment

    • Maintain regular cadence with Sales Leadership regarding pipeline health, forecasting discipline, coverage effectiveness, and operational readiness

    • Provide structured operational insights to support Sales in achieving financial objectives

    • Oversee resolution of high-impact escalations related to opportunity management, forecasting integrity, booking compliance, product delivery coordination, AP/AR exposure, and revenue recognition considerations

    • Partner closely with Finance to ensure margin protection, compliance with revenue recognition standards, and financial stability

    • Partner with Alliances to interpret OEM, distributor, and partner program structures and translate program requirements into scalable operational processes and governance standards

    • Ensure partner program incentives, rebates, special pricing agreements, and funding mechanisms are operationalized in alignment with internal booking policies, margin guidelines, and revenue recognition standards

    • Partner with peer Directors to ensure consistent Client Operations standards and escalation frameworks across regions

    • *Other job duties as assigned

Education and Experience

    • Bachelor’s degree required

    • 7+ years in Sales Operations, Client Operations, Finance, or Sales Support

    • 4+ years people leadership experience preferred

    • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives or transformation efforts

    • Experience in technology reseller strongly preferred

    • Organizational design and capacity planning expertise

    • Polished presentation and communication skills suitable for senior sales leadership engagement

    • Strong business and financial acumen

jobs.excerpt: Every enterprise field sales team runs on a CRM or ERP that a partner implemented.
jobs.description:
Every enterprise field sales team runs on a CRM or ERP that a partner implemented. Too often, those systems never reflect what actually happens in the field. Donna closes that gap, and partners choose Donna because it makes the technology they implement actually get used. That is why partnerships sit at the core of how we grow.

As our first Partnership Manager in the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland), you’ll own that motion locally. You won’t start from scratch. You’ll build on an existing partner network, grow it, and win the systems integrators and technology partners who will carry Donna into the CRM and ERP projects of enterprise field sales teams. Then you’ll close deals with them, side by side.

You’ll report to our Head of Partnerships and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product and our GTM engineer, with a real say in how our partner program takes shape as Donna scales across Europe.

What you'll be doing

  • Source new partners. This is a big part of the job. Hunt for and win new systems integrators across the SAP, Salesforce and MS Dynamics ecosystems, and build a partner pipeline the way a sales team builds a customer pipeline.

  • Grow the partnerships we already have. Broaden the relationships with our existing partners. Attend events together, get more joint pipeline, and more live deals out of the partners already in place.

  • Onboard and enable partners. You’ll set Donna up in each partner’s own environment so they can demo it and run pilots themselves. You’ll also train their teams on Donna’s value and how to pitch it, supported by playbooks and joint messaging.

  • Close deals with partners. Co-sell through deal registration and joint account plans, and work with Sales and Solution Engineering to take partner deals to signature.

  • Go to market jointly. Build joint business plans with Tier 1 partners and a lighter program for Tier 2. That includes joint campaigns, webinars and events, and a presence at key conferences.

  • Automate and report. Use Claude and other AI tools to run campaigns and reporting, keep HubSpot accurate (with Donna doing some of the heavy lifting 🙋‍♀️), and feed partner insights back to Product and Sales.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in a commercial or partnership role in B2B SaaS or AI, with a track record of closing deals through partners.

  • Experience in co-selling with systems integrators or consultancies. SAP, Salesforce or Microsoft ecosystem experience is a big plus.

  • Native German and fluent English.

  • A builder who enjoys opening doors, is credible with executives and frontline sales teams, and who owns theirtargets, deals and calendar.

  • Hands-on with AI tools (like Claude), HubSpot and marketing automation, so you can set up and run campaigns yourself

  • Self-driven and at home working remotely, with regular trips to Ghent. Willing to travel regularly to conferences, partner events.

What success looks like

  • First 90 days: You know every existing partner in the region, you have a clear Tier 1 and Tier 2 plan, and your first partner-sourced opportunities are (getting) converted.

  • First 6 months: Your Tier 1 partners run joint business plans with certified consultants, new integrators have been signed and onboarded, and partners deliver a repeatable stream of sourced and influenced deals in the region.

What you can expect

  • A category in the making. Field AI is a new category of enterprise software, and you’ll define how it reaches the market in your region. The partner program you build becomes the blueprint for every region that follows.

  • Enterprise-grade partners and customers. You’ll work with leading systems integrators across the SAP, Salesforce and Microsoft ecosystems, bringing Donna to global companies in manufacturing, medtech, consumer goods, energy and more.

  • Room to grow as we scale. We’re a team of 40+, growing quickly across Europe and the US. As partnerships grow, so will your scope and your team.

  • People who have done this before. Our founders have built and exited enterprise software companies twice, and our leadership team has scaled fast-growing SaaS companies from the inside. You’ll work side by side with our Head of Partnerships and GTM leadership.

  • Remote in Germany, international by default. You’ll work remotely, with a German office on the way, alongside colleagues, partners and customers in Ghent, across Europe and in New York.

  • Rewards that reflect the stakes. A competitive salary and equity through our ESOP, so everyone shares in what we build.

  • A team that invests in itself. An annual company retreat and regular team events that bring the whole team together.

Highlights

Grow our partner network as Donna’s first Partnership Manager in DACH: win integrators across the SAP, Salesforce & Dynamics ecosystems and co-sell with them side by side.

jobs.description:
SaaS Revenue & Financial Analyst — Flosum

About Flosum

Flosum is a Salesforce-native platform company delivering enterprise-grade DevOps, data protection, and security solutions to some of the world's largest organizations. Our product portfolio spans Cloud DevOps, Data Migrator, Data Masking, Data Backup, Org Security, Cloud Trust Center, and Sandbox Synchronization — all built natively on the Salesforce platform. We serve enterprise customers across technology, energy, financial services, healthcare, and federal government. Flosum is a growth-stage company operating with the intensity and speed of a startup backed by the discipline of a mature operator.

The Role

We're hiring a SaaS Revenue & Financial Analyst who will own the measurement layer of our entire business. You will be the person who knows every number — ARR, net retention, expansion, churn, pipeline conversion, cost of acquisition, gross margin by product line, services margin, cash flow, and everything in between. You'll work across Salesforce (our CRM and billing system of record) and QuickBooks (our financial system) to build a unified, always-current picture of company performance.

This is not a reporting role. This is an analytical role where you connect revenue operations data to financial outcomes and surface the insights that drive decisions at the CEO level.

What You'll Own

You will build and maintain our SaaS metrics infrastructure — ARR waterfall, cohort retention analysis, revenue recognition schedules, deferred revenue tracking, and unit economics by segment. You will reconcile Salesforce bookings data against QuickBooks revenue entries and ensure we have a single source of truth across both systems. You will produce monthly and quarterly financial and revenue packages for leadership, including variance analysis against plan. You will model scenarios for pricing changes, product bundling, geographic expansion, and headcount investment. You will monitor pipeline health and translate pipeline data into revenue forecasts with documented assumptions. You will own the data integrity between our CRM and accounting systems, flagging discrepancies before they compound. You will support board-level and investor-level reporting with clean, defensible metrics.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

You have three-plus years of experience in SaaS financial analysis, revenue operations, or FP&A at a B2B software company. You are deeply proficient in Salesforce — not as a user, but as someone who understands opportunity objects, product schedules, contract structures, and reporting at a data level. You are equally proficient in QuickBooks Online, including chart of accounts design, revenue categorization, journal entries, and reconciliation workflows. You understand ASC 606 revenue recognition principles and can apply them to a multi-product SaaS business with annual and multi-year contracts. You can build financial models from scratch in Excel or Google Sheets — not from templates, from logic. You think in terms of cohorts, not just totals. You understand the difference between bookings, billings, and revenue, and you can explain why each matters. You are precise, skeptical of your own numbers, and obsessive about data integrity.

Preferred

Experience at a company with a mix of subscription revenue and professional services. Familiarity with Salesforce CPQ or native Salesforce quoting and contract objects. Exposure to investor or board reporting at a growth-stage company. Experience with Marketo or HubSpot data as it relates to CAC and attribution modeling.

Why Flosum

You'll report directly into the CEO's operating rhythm. Your work will not sit in a queue — it will shape hiring plans, product investment, and go-to-market strategy in real time. Flosum is building the definitive platform for Salesforce lifecycle management, and we need someone who can measure every dimension of that growth with precision.

OVERVIEW:

The Affiliate Program Lead will be responsible for developing and growing Quartile’s TikTok Shop affiliate creator network across multiple client brands.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands the TikTok Shop affiliate ecosystem, knows how to identify and recruit high-potential creators, and can build lasting relationships that translate into product sales.

You’ll work closely with our TikTok Shop Strategists to connect the right creators with the right brands, execute targeted outreach campaigns, support creator activations, and continuously improve affiliate performance.

As our TikTok Shop business grows, this position will have the opportunity to develop processes, establish best practices, and eventually build and lead a dedicated affiliate team.

We’re looking for someone who wants to build something, not simply maintain an existing program.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 2–3+ years of experience in affiliate marketing, influencer marketing, creator partnerships, or social commerce.
  • Hands-on experience working within the TikTok Shop affiliate ecosystem.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify, recruit, and engage creators for product-based affiliate campaigns.
  • Understanding of how TikTok Shop affiliate content, product tagging, commissions, and creator relationships contribute to sales.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build authentic creator relationships.
  • Experience managing multiple campaigns, creator lists, or brand partnerships simultaneously.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing ongoing outreach and follow-up activity.
  • Comfortable using data and performance metrics to evaluate creator opportunities and improve results.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-moving, remote environment.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Existing relationships within the TikTok Shop affiliate creator community.
  • Experience using TikTok Shop Seller Center, Affiliate Center, or affiliate management platforms.
  • Familiarity with creator discovery and management tools such as Cruva, FastMoss, Kalodata, or similar platforms.
  • Experience managing creator sampling programs and affiliate commission-based partnerships.
  • Understanding of TikTok Shop GMV, creator conversion performance, and shoppable content strategies.
  • Experience implementing workflows, automation, or AI-powered tools to improve operational efficiency.
  • Previous experience developing or scaling an affiliate or creator community program.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Affiliate Recruitment & Creator Network Development

  • Identify, research, and recruit TikTok Shop affiliates who align with our clients’ products, categories, and target audiences.
  • Build and maintain a growing network of high-performing TikTok Shop creators across multiple consumer product categories.
  • Execute targeted affiliate outreach campaigns, including personalized invitations, follow-ups, and creator reactivation.
  • Identify emerging creators with strong sales potential, as well as established affiliates with proven conversion performance.
  • Develop relationships with creators that encourage repeat collaborations and long-term brand partnerships.
  • Help expand Quartile’s reputation as a trusted partner within the TikTok Shop creator community.

Creator Relationships & Activation

  • Serve as a primary relationship contact for affiliate creators participating in Quartile-managed brand programs.

  • Support creator onboarding and engagement through TikTok Shop messaging, creator communities, and affiliate communication platforms.
  • Encourage creators to produce high-quality, shoppable content and continue promoting products that demonstrate strong conversion potential.
  • Build relationships with top-performing affiliates and identify opportunities to expand successful partnerships.

Affiliate Campaign Execution & Performance

  • Execute affiliate recruitment initiatives aligned with each brand’s growth strategy and priority products.
  • Support product sampling campaigns through creator targeting, recruitment, and follow-up communications.
  • Track outreach effectiveness, creator participation, content publication, and resulting affiliate sales.
  • Identify high-performing creators and content trends to inform future recruitment and engagement efforts.
  • Partner with Strategists to identify opportunities for creator reactivation, additional product collaborations, and sustained affiliate activity.
  • Continuously test and improve outreach messaging, creator targeting, and engagement approaches.

Program Development & Cross-Functional Collaboration

This role focuses on the front half of the customer journey for Property Care: how pipeline is generated, forecasted, and converted, and how customers are handed off into Onboarding. As the Property Care sales team ramps and an outbound motion for trades customers is built from scratch, this role will provide the analytics, planning, and operating cadence that leaders rely on. You will also partner with Product, Marketing, RevOps, and Customer Success to keep the experience consistent from first touch through go-live.


What You'll Do

Pipeline Analytics and Forecasting

  • Use SQL / Tableau to build data sets and dashboards that give Sales, Onboarding, and GTM leadership a single view of pipeline health and its leading indicators

  • Own pipeline reporting and forecasting for Property Care Sales (coverage, conversion, velocity, forecast accuracy), and run the weekly and monthly forecast reviews with senior leadership

  • Partner with Sales leadership, Product, and Marketing to articulate the Property Care value story for each segment and trade, grounded in customer data and ROI analysis

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Vulnerability Management Lead to join our Team. This person will be responsible for overseeing and advancing the organization’s vulnerability management program to identify, assess, prioritize, and drive remediation of security vulnerabilities across enterprise infrastructure, applications, cloud environments, and systems. This role provides strategic and technical leadership in vulnerability identification, risk-based prioritization, remediation coordination, and continuous monitoring to reduce the organization’s attack surface and overall cybersecurity risk. The Vulnerability Management Lead partners closely with security operations, infrastructure, cloud, application development, and business teams to establish effective remediation processes, enforce security standards, and improve vulnerability management maturity. The role also drives automation, reporting, and performance measurement while providing actionable risk insights to technical teams and senior leadership to support informed decision-making and strengthen the organization’s overall security posture.

Work Location: This is a remote position, but candidate must be willing to work during the hours of 8am - 5pm EST

What You Will Do:

  • Lead vulnerability management activities across enterprise infrastructure, applications, and cloud environments, ensuring vulnerabilities are identified, assessed, prioritized, tracked, and remediated in accordance with organizational security requirements.
  • Manage and maintain Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), tracking remediation progress, documenting security findings, and coordinating with stakeholders to ensure timely closure of identified weaknesses.
  • Support Authorization to Operate (ATO) processes by providing vulnerability assessment results, remediation evidence, risk assessments, and supporting documentation required for security authorization and compliance activities.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and management reports to communicate vulnerability trends, remediation status, risk exposure, compliance posture, and program effectiveness to technical teams and senior leadership.
  • Collaborate with Information System Owners (ISOs), Information System Security Officers (ISSOs), compliance teams, and engineering stakeholders to coordinate remediation efforts, resolve technical challenges, and ensure alignment with security policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Administer, maintain, and optimize vulnerability management tools, including Tenable and Aqua Security (AquaSec), to improve vulnerability visibility, assessment coverage, and remediation workflows.
  • Support the integration of vulnerability management data with the Continuous Diagnostics and Mitigation (CDM) program and associated tools to improve enterprise-wide visibility, reporting, and continuous monitoring capabilities.
  • Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics, such as vulnerability remediation timelines, risk reduction, overdue findings, and remediation compliance, to drive accountability and continuous program improvement.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust level clearance
  • Bachelors Degree and 12 years of experience, a Masters Degree and 10 years of experience, an Associates Degree and 14 years, or a High School Diploma or equivalent and 16 years of experience
  • One (or more) of the following certifications: GCIH, CISSP, CISM or CRISC
  • Demonstrated experience managing vulnerability management programs, including vulnerability identification, risk-based prioritization, remediation tracking, and reporting.
  • Experience developing, maintaining, and tracking Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms) to support vulnerability remediation and security compliance.
  • Working knowledge of continuous monitoring processes, security control assessments, and Authorization to Operate (ATO) support activities.
  • Experience using vulnerability management tools such as Tenable and cloud security platforms such as Aqua Security to identify, assess, and track security vulnerabilities.
  • Familiarity with Continuous Diagnostics and Mitigation (CDM) programs, tool integrations, and enterprise vulnerability reporting requirements.
  • Experience developing dashboards, metrics, and reports to communicate vulnerability trends, remediation progress, risk exposure, and compliance status.
  • Ability to coordinate remediation activities with Information System Owners (ISOs), Information System Security Officers (ISSOs), compliance teams, and engineering stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity policies, security assessment processes, and applicable regulatory and compliance requirements.

Target Salary Range

$104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

jobs.excerpt: About Redesign Group The Redesign Group is a global technology and cybersecurity Solution Provider leveraging design thinking, interdependent subject matter expertise, and emerging technology solutions to help organizations achieve meaningful transformation.
jobs.description:
About Redesign Group

The Redesign Group is a global technology and cybersecurity Solution Provider leveraging design thinking, interdependent subject matter expertise, and emerging technology solutions to help organizations achieve meaningful transformation. Our globally diverse team members, partnerships with strategic technology manufacturers, and cybersecurity services position us to be a business partner that’s ready for what’s next.

We live by our core values of operating in the service of others, being problem solvers, and focusing on long term partnerships. You’ll excel at Redesign if you thrive in a rewarding environment that moves quickly, challenges you to grow and fosters collaboration. We seek candidates with a hands-on customer-first approach, robust interpersonal and communication skills, strong work ethic and excellent time management. While teamwork is expected, the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment is crucial.

Job Description
The Redesign Group is seeking a Solution Engineer with a specialty and obsession with Palo Alto Networks and the products within the Palo Alto family. We are looking for an engineer who has developed genuine depth across the product family and who is prepared to serve as the senior technical authority for Palo Alto delivery at Redesign.

This position also carries a practice development mandate. The Solution Engineer will advance the maturity of the Redesign Palo Alto practice through the development of delivery standards and reference architectures, the training and mentorship of fellow engineers, the creation of new service offerings, and the achievement of partner level certifications that support the firm's standing within the Palo Alto Networks partner ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Implementation and Delivery

  • Design, implement, and migrate Palo Alto Networks solutions for enterprise and data center customers, encompassing PA Series hardware next generation firewalls, VM Series and CN Series software firewalls, Cloud NGFW, and centralized management through Panorama and Strata Cloud Manager.
  • Deploy and optimize the broader Palo Alto product family, including Cloud Delivered Security Services (Advanced Threat Prevention, Advanced WildFire, Advanced URL Filtering, and Advanced DNS Security), Enterprise Data Loss Prevention, IoT and OT Security, GlobalProtect, SSL and TLS decryption, and the App ID, User ID, Content ID, and Device ID technologies.
  • Execute data center scale implementations, including high availability configurations, multiple virtual systems, virtual wire and Layer 3 deployments, zone based segmentation, dynamic routing integration, and east to west inspection across virtualized and containerized workloads.
  • Lead migrations from legacy and competitive firewall platforms to Palo Alto Networks, including rule base conversion, policy optimization, cutover planning, and documented rollback procedures.
  • Extend engagements into adjacent portfolio areas as customer requirements dictate, including Prisma Access and Prisma SD WAN for secure access service edge outcomes, and the Cortex platform for security operations integration.

Project and Customer Ownership

  • Assume end to end ownership of assigned projects, covering scope definition, design documentation, build, test planning, implementation, validation, and knowledge transfer.
  • Own project timelines and milestones, managing schedules proactively, escalating risk in advance of impact, and maintaining delivery commitments with limited oversight.
  • Serve as the primary customer facing technical lead, conducting design workshops and technical discovery sessions, presenting recommendations to both engineering teams and executive stakeholders, and translating business and security requirements into defensible Palo Alto architectures.
  • Produce complete engagement documentation, including high level and low level designs, as built records, validation and test results, and operational runbooks suitable for customer handover.
  • Support pre sales activity as required, contributing to scoping, level of effort estimation, bill of materials validation, and technical responses to customer inquiries.

Practice Maturity and Development

  • Advance the maturity of the Redesign Palo Alto practice through the development of delivery standards, reference architectures, deployment templates, configuration baselines, and repeatable service offerings.
  • Train and mentor Redesign engineers across Palo Alto technologies, delivering internal enablement sessions and maintaining lab environments that support hands on skill development.
  • Develop new Palo Alto based service offerings as the vendor portfolio evolves, with particular attention to opportunities beyond the firewall in secure access service edge, cloud security, and security operations.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of delivery methodology by capturing lessons learned from each engagement and incorporating them into practice standards.

Partner Certification and Ecosystem Engagement

  • Achieve and maintain Palo Alto Networks partner level certifications in support of Redesign's NextWave partner standing and specialization attainment.
  • Establish and maintain working relationships with Palo Alto Networks systems engineers, channel teams, and distribution partners.
  • Monitor PAN OS releases, new product introductions, end of life announcements, and portfolio changes, communicating relevant developments to the practice and to customers.

Required Experience and Background
You will bring hands on delivery experience with the Palo Alto Networks platform:

  • A minimum of five years of experience in network security engineering, including at least three years with Palo Alto Networks as the primary platform. Partner, reseller, MSSP, or consulting experience is strongly preferred.
  • A demonstrated record of multiple full lifecycle Palo Alto Networks deployments in enterprise and data center environments.
  • Comprehensive PAN OS proficiency, including security and NAT policy, decryption, App ID and User ID, threat prevention tuning, high availability design, upgrades, and command line troubleshooting.
  • Experience administering Panorama at scale, including templates, device groups, and policy hierarchy. Familiarity with Strata Cloud Manager is expected.
  • Strong underlying data center networking fundamentals, including BGP and OSPF, VLAN and VRF design, and virtualization platforms such as VMware vSphere, NSX, and Kubernetes.
  • Demonstrated migration experience from Cisco, Check Point, Fortinet, and Juniper, improving the rule base rather than copying it.
  • Proven customer facing capability, including presenting and defending designs to experienced network and security teams.
  • Evidence of sustained professional investment in the platform, such as a home lab, active certification pursuit, or community participation.
  • Palo Alto Networks Certifications, Current Role Based Program
    Palo Alto Networks transitioned to a role based certification framework during 2024 and 2025, comprising four levels (Foundational, Professional, Specialist, and Architect) across the Network Security, Security Operations, and Cloud Security tracks. Credentials at the Specialist level or above are strongly preferred.
  • Palo Alto Networks Certifications, Legacy Program
    Candidates holding the retired product coded credentials are encouraged to apply. These certifications remain credible evidence of platform depth, and Redesign will support transition to the current framework.

Complementary Technical Qualifications

  • Networking certification at the CCNP Security, CCNP Enterprise, or CCIE level, or equivalent demonstrated routing and switching expertise.
  • Security certification such as CISSP, GIAC credentials including GCFW, GCIA, or GSEC, or CompTIA Security Plus.
  • Cloud certification at the associate level or relevant to VM Series, Cloud NGFW, and Prisma Cloud deployments.
  • Automation and application programming interface proficiency, such as the PAN OS APIs, Python, Ansible, or Terraform.
  • Working familiarity with compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, NIST 800 53, or CMMC.
  • Prior experience within a NextWave partner organization.

Professional Qualifications

  • Strong technical writing ability, producing design documentation and as built records that customer operations teams can use directly.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or delivering formal technical training.
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Demonstrated experience is weighted more heavily than formal education.

Benefits

We offer a comprehensive benefits package which may include:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match (annual dollar cap applied)
  • Flexible time off plan
  • 15 paid holidays
  • Sick leave (amount varies by state requirements and is at least the minimum required by any state)
  • Short-term and long-term disability
  • Life insurance
  • Paid parental leave

We’re an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We consider qualified candidates without regard to any legally protected status. This role is subject to applicable employment laws based on work location. In compliance with pay transparency laws, the compensation range for this role is included, with final pay based on experience, skills, and location. We participate in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process—just let us know how we can help.

Customers are no longer asking whether AI works—they’re asking what it will change about how they operate. As an AI Success Architect, you’ll help enterprise customers answer that question and turn Asana’s AI capabilities into measurable business results. You’ll own the post-sales relationship for a portfolio of ~50 enterprise accounts, acting as a strategic advisor with accountability for AI adoption, consumption, and commercial outcomes. In this advisory role, you’ll diagnose where AI changes how work gets done and guide the organizational change that makes it stick.

This role can either be fully remote depending on which US state you live in, or based in our Chicago office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. If based in-office: The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

  • Serve as the trusted advisor and point of accountability for a portfolio of enterprise accounts across the customer lifecycle.

  • Build joint success plans that connect strategic customer goals to measurable results, leading business reviews focused on outcomes and value rather than just usage.

  • Diagnose customer workflows and map them to Asana’s AI capabilities (AI Studio, AI Teammates, and integrations built on the Model Context Protocol, or MCP) to replace manual effort and accelerate decision-making.

  • Assess how customers structure their work in Asana, guiding them to establish habits and governance that supply AI models with rich, consistent context.

  • Lead change management and enablement programs that build internal champions and ensure long-term, sustained adoption.

  • Track AI consumption and adoption against clear baselines and 30/60/90-day benchmarks, translating usage data into a compelling business story.

  • Identify expansion readiness for new AI use cases, products, or broader deployments, initiating conversations and partnering with the account team once validated.

  • Monitor account health, engagement, and sentiment to proactively mitigate risks well ahead of renewals.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, and Sales, while sharing structured customer insights with Product and Customer Success leadership.

About you

  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

  • Comfort discussing pricing, ROI, and commercial outcomes with senior executives, ideally within consumption-based models.

  • Strong competency in change management and program management across concurrent, long-term initiatives.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Method is a global design and engineering consultancy founded in 1999.
jobs.description:
Method is a global design and engineering consultancy founded in 1999. We believe that innovation should be meaningful, beautiful, and human. We craft practical, powerful digital experiences that improve lives and transform businesses. Our teams [based in New York, Charlotte, Atlanta, Tokyo, London, Bengaluru, and remote] work with a wide range of organizations in many industries, including Healthcare, Financial Services, Retail, Automotive, Aviation, and Professional Services.

Method is part of Hitachi Digital, a digital product engineering company. Hitachi Digital integrates experience design and complex engineering to help our clients imagine what’s possible and accelerate their transition into tomorrow’s digital businesses. Hitachi Digital is a Hitachi Group Company.

We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer to join our team working with a client in the energy sector. Our client is a non-profit organization that plans for and coordinates the electrical grid across its region. It doesn’t own any part of the grid. Our team builds the software that helps them make the best decisions they can about how that grid grows.

This is a complicated domain, and the software is more complicated still. You will crunch large volumes of planning data, build and secure APIs, and work through authentication and access across many systems. The people you build for are electrical engineers, not software engineers, so much of the job is translation. You’ll need to understand what they’re asking, go to them with your own questions, and turn the answers into working software.

You don’t need to arrive knowing how transmission planning works. You do need to want to find out. The people who do well here watch the YouTube videos, ask the LLMs, read the documentation, and come back with better questions. If Ohm’s Law makes you curious rather than nervous, that’s a good sign.

From a technology side, the client is building APIs with Java and Spring Boot, with some existing code in Python and front ends in React and TypeScript. Java is the core of the work, but we care more about how you learn than what you already know. Use AI to write code where it helps, provided you can read it, validate it, and stand behind it. Method has a core value centered on learning, so if you wonder if you’re qualified (or need to learn one of the tech stacks), please apply and we can decide together if this opportunity is a good fit for you.

At Method, we strive to work in a collaborative and supportive environment, and we look for people who can work flexibly and enjoy working as part of a team. In this role, you will be part of a small, dedicated team contributing to the day-to-day delivery of a key work stream, working alongside engineers in parallel workstreams to keep cross-team dependencies aligned. Strategic thinking and creative problem solving are key skills to have at Method, as well as the love of continuously learning and sharing knowledge.

Travel for team and client meetings may be required, typically up to 15%.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain APIs and back-end services in Java and Spring Boot that support the client’s transmission planning work.
  • Process, validate, and move large volumes of grid and planning data between systems, including batch job orchestration.
  • Design and implement security, authentication, and access control across services.
  • Own CI/CD pipelines, environments, and deployments, and keep systems observable through logging and metrics.
  • Work directly with the client’s electrical engineers to understand their problems, ask the questions that matter, and translate domain needs into technical requirements.
  • Work problems through on your own first, then bring options and a recommendation to the team.
  • Help the team prioritize when there is more to build than time to build it, and be clear about the trade-offs.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to raise delivery speed, and review and test what they produce before it ships.
  • Mentor teammates and share what you learn about the domain so the whole team gets sharper.

Qualifications

You will succeed in this role if you have:

  • 6+ years of experience building back-end systems and APIs, with Java and Spring Boot strongly preferred.
  • A track record of learning new languages, codebases, and domains quickly and becoming productive in them.
  • Curiosity about how complex systems work, shown in what you’ve chosen to learn on your own.
  • Strong problem-solving skills. You figure things out yourself first, and you know when to ask.
  • Strong communication skills, including explaining technical ideas to experts from other fields and drawing out what they need.
  • Comfort reaching out to the client directly, without waiting for someone to do it for you.
  • Broad technical range across APIs, data, security, and infrastructure, rather than depth in a single layer.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful principles, with experience using OpenAPI standards, Swagger, and Postman to design, document, and test APIs.
  • Experience with API security, authentication, and authorization (e.g., OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, role-based access control).
  • Experience working with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle) and data-heavy workloads.
  • DevOps experience, including CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), cloud platforms, logging, and metrics.
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools, with the judgment to validate their output.
  • Experience in agile development methodologies and tools for version control (i.e., Git, Bitbucket), continuous integration, and deployment.
  • Experience leading pieces of work and mentoring other engineers.

Beneficial Qualities

  • Experience in the energy or utility industry
  • Familiarity with power systems or electrical grid concepts such as transmission planning, power flow, or generation interconnection
  • Proficiency with Python
  • Experience with React and TypeScript for building user interfaces that consume APIs
  • Experience with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Work well with others
  • You love the journey as much as the destination

Why Method?

We look for individuals who are smart, kind and brave. Curious people with a natural ability to think on their feet, learn fast, and develop points-of-view for a constantly changing world find Method an exciting place to work. Our employees are excited to collaborate with dispersed and diverse teams that bring together the best in thinking and making. We champion the ability to listen, and believe that critique and dissonance lead to better outcomes. We believe everyone has the capacity to lead and look for proactive individuals who can take and give direction, lead by example, enjoy the making as much as they do the thinking, especially at senior and leadership levels.

We believe in work/life balance. Seriously. We offer a ton of competitive perks, including:

  • Continuing education opportunities
  • Flexible PTO and work-from-home policies
  • 401K matching
  • Health, Dental and Vision benefits, starting on day 1
  • Company lunches, company outings, along with a lot of snacks
  • Health and wellness programs
  • Other location specific perks (just ask!)

Next Steps

If Method sounds like the place for you, please submit an application. Also, let us know if you have a presence online with a portfolio, GitHub, Dribbble or other platform.

For information on how we process your personal data please see Privacy.

If you are a California resident, more details on how we process your personal information can be found in the CCPA Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer (Benelux)
jobs.excerpt: Lateral stands for technology excellence.  We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses.
jobs.description:
Lateral stands for technology excellence.

We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality.

Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.

We do things differently at Lateral

Our mission is simple: design and build great products.
What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’s the way we work:

We Have A Bias For Action & Results.

We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results - not the effort - speak for themselves.

We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality

Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to

We Care Deeply.

We care about our work and about each other. Care Is A Competitive Advantage.

Every detail matters. Every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default.

We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do

Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way.

We Keep Improving

The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning.

We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection.

We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto

We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around.

We Take Ownership
Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior Frontend Engineer at Lateral, you will:

  • Craft delightful digital experiences: Design, implement, and maintain front-end features using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript. You’ll create reusable UI components and craft polished, responsive interfaces with a focus on quality

  • Collaborate & communicate: Work closely with designers, back-end developers, and product managers in an asynchronous workflow. You’ll regularly communicate with clients to clarify requirements, demo features, and ensure we’re building the right thing.

  • Lead and take ownership: As a senior member, you’ll drive projects from concept to completion. That means making technical decisions, outlining implementation plans, and seeing them through deployment. You’ll have the freedom to introduce new ideas and best practices that raise the bar for our front-end, whether it’s improving our build process or adopting an innovative UI approach – all justified by real benefit to the team and product.

  • Optimize, Iterate & improve: Involve yourself in brainstorming and technical discussions. Ensure our apps are fast, accessible, and reliable. You’ll profile and improve page load times, refine animations, and tackle browser-specific quirks so that every user gets a smooth experience. When issues arise, you’ll dive in to debug and fix them, striving for robust solutions that scale (and writing tests to prevent regressions

  • Mentor and learn: Guide and mentor junior developers by sharing your expertise and providing constructive feedback. At the same time, stay curious and keep up with industry trends, frameworks, and standards. You’ll be encouraged to continuously learn and bring in knowledge, evaluating new technologies thoughtfully to see if they can enhance our product or developer experience (we love learning, but avoid “innovation for innovation’s sake”). In short, you’ll help shape a culture of excellence, ownership, and growth on the team.

Example Projects You May Join:

  • Large scale B2B2C Commerce Platform: Help build a responsive, mobile-first experience for an international e-commerce client. For example, you might lead a dynamic multi-faceted search or a smooth checkout flow

  • Develop from scratch an application: Collaborate with a senior backend engineer/architect to build a modern application. You’ll be involved in everything from crafting components to API definition.

  • Real-Time Medical Dashboard: Develop front-end features for a real-time analytics dashboard for a pet healthcare client. You might use libraries like AGCharts to visualize large data sets, implement live updates via websockets, and ensure the interface remains highly performant and user-friendly.

Whatever the challenge, you’ll be building software that changes lives and moves industries forward.

How we measure success in this role

In the first two weeks

  • You've set up your development environment and tools.

  • You’ve pushed your first meaningful contribution (bugfix, UI tweak, or minor feature).

  • You’re familiar with our async workflows and communication style.

  • You’ve participated in your first client sync and started understanding the project's context.

In the first 3 months:

  • You’ve led development on a significant feature or initiative.

  • You’ve actively mentored a teammate or shared knowledge through code review or documentation.

  • You’ve authored or contributed to architectural decisions and design documents.

  • You’ve established trust with clients through clear communication and technical guidance.

  • You’ve improved performance, code structure, or tooling in meaningful ways.

After 3 months:

  • You’re recognized as a technical leader in your project or team.

  • You’ve initiated a broader improvement across projects (e.g., shared component library, new testing standard).

  • You’re frequently unblocking teammates, elevating code quality, and proactively identifying risks.

  • You balance speed and quality, delivering with care and clarity.

We measure success through:

  • The impact and scope of your technical contributions.

  • Your ability to lead initiatives, mentor others, and improve team practices.

  • Code quality, performance, and maintainability.

  • Positive feedback from peers, clients, and design/engineering leadership.

  • Your growth mindset, communication skills, and influence on team culture.

What We’re Looking For

We are seeking for team members who are both highly technical and deeply care about their craft and how the work gets done. You must bring:

  • 7+ years of professional front-end development experience building digital applications. Experience with modern Javascript libraries and tooling (e.g. React, npm, webpack...). Fluency in CSS and first-principles understanding front end technologies.

  • Proven ability tocraft, polish, delight, sweat the details.
    You have an eye for design and UX. Pixel-perfect isn’t just a phrase to you – you care about creating beautiful, intuitive interfaces that make users happy. An understanding of design principles and attention to details like accessibility and responsive layout is important.

  • Quality and reliability
    You take pride in building high-quality software. You’re diligent about testing and documentation, and you proactively debug issues before they become problems. ￼ Performance and browser compatibility matter to you – you know how to make a web app fast and handle the quirks of different environments ￼. Ultimately, you balance speed of delivery with maintainability, ensuring the code you ship today won’t be tech debt tomorrow.

  • Self-driven and accountable: You’re comfortable managing your own projects and time without heavy oversight. When you take on a task, we can count on you to see it through with a sense of ownership. You’re a proactive problem solver who can break down complex problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion. We trust our team members to be “managers of one” who take initiative and deliver results

  • Great communication and empathy are a must. You enjoy working closely with others, be it in pair programming, brainstorming with designers, or reviewing a teammate’s code. You can explain technical concepts clearly, listen to alternate viewpoints, and work together to find the best solutions. Our culture is about being kind, open, and constructive, so we’re looking for someone who lifts others up and thrives in a friendly, collaborative environment.

  • Remote work skills: Self-motivated and disciplined in a remote environment. You can manage your time, collaborate asynchronously, and aren’t afraid to ask questions or offer help across time zones.

Bonus points for:

  • Demonstrating craft

  • Design /delight sensibility

  • AI & Gen AI experience/tooling

  • Understanding Backend concepts

  • CSR/SSR

  • DevOps experience (continuous integration, hosting, etc.)

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.

  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.

    We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours.

  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work.

  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace

  • A Culture of Excellence: We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.

  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.

  • Distributed work isn’t your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.

  • Feedback doesn't excite you. We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.

  • Change makes you uncomfortable. We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process

01. Your work
Show us the work that reflects you at your best. We’ll look at depth, design thinking, and the logic behind your choices.

02. Lateral team fit
You’ll speak with our Talent team about your career direction, your motivators, and our plans ahead.

03. Work trial

You’ll tackle a take-home challenge that mirrors what we actually do.

04.Engineering deep dive
A collaborative session with our engineers.

05. Project fit
An interview focussed on prioritization, collaboration across disciplines, and how you handle the "messy middle".
