Principal Analytics Engineer - Global Reporting & Analytics


About the Team

The Global Reporting and Analytics team sits within the Clinical Solutions Platform organization. We turn client data and usage into validated, reusable, enterprise-grade reporting — building the capabilities the business needs to deliver customer value and growth. We go beyond usage dashboards, running impact and outcomes analyses that connect product usage to real value for clinicians, and we work problem-first, partnering closely with product, marketing, and account management teams to give our people the data-driven insights they need to create better experiences for our customers, faster.


About the Role

As Principal Analytics Engineer, you'll be the technical lead within the Global Reporting and Analytics team, reporting to the Director of Global Reporting and Analytics, and owning technical execution from discovery to production. You'll work closely with both our analytics team and our engineering/development partners, providing the technical depth and context each side needs from the other.

You bring strong software engineering depth, deep comfort with SQL and Snowflake, and a genuine affinity for analytics — with the curiosity to build real fluency in our analytics domain over time, to the point where you can represent it confidently and independently in technical conversations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary technical liaison between the analytics team and engineering/development partners — translating analytics needs into clear requirements, specifications, and development tickets.
  • Provide hands-on technical depth for the team: deep Snowflake fluency (data engineering experience a plus), excellent SQL, and code review across SQL, Python, and JavaScript (Highcharts), contributing code directly where useful.
  • Coach and mentor analysts on technical concepts and coding, building technical fluency and elevating capability across the team over time.
  • Champion opportunities to bring more coding, automation, and AI tooling into the analytics team's work — prototyping new approaches and driving innovation in how the team operates.
  • Explore how AI could shape the next generation of our reporting — new kinds of insights and experiences we could offer customers and stakeholders.
  • Act as a technical thought partner as new products, features, and initiatives are planned across the business — helping ensure analytics needs are considered from the start.
  • Contribute to the technical design of our reporting and analytics platform — data model choices, performance trade-offs, and level of detail — and help determine how reporting and AI-enabled work should integrate with broader enterprise systems, partnering with engineering on execution.
  • Contribute to improving data quality, alerting for potential issues, and regression testing to catch problems before they reach production.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise non-negotiables: security, compliance, data governance, data residency, PHI/PII handling, and central technology infrastructure standards.

Requirements

  • Engineering experience: 10+ years in software engineering, with experience in data engineering or building analytics data pipelines.
  • Education: BS in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent; advanced degree preferred.
  • Snowflake: Deep, hands-on experience with Snowflake; data engineering experience with Snowflake strongly preferred.
  • Languages: Excellent SQL, strong Python, strong comfort with JSON, and working knowledge of JavaScript.
  • Data modeling: Strong grounding in data modeling concepts, comfortable making and explaining recommendations on structure, performance trade-offs, and level of detail in reporting.
  • BI platforms: Working familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau — enough to engage confidently in analytics discussions and help identify opportunities to move calculations and data manipulation upstream, out of the BI layer. Hands-on Tableau experience is a plus.
  • AI & tooling: Comfortable using AI to accelerate coding and everyday work. Experience creating reusable tools or workflows that help scale technical knowledge across a team is a plus.
  • AI / LLM familiarity: Working knowledge of concepts like LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, and retrieval-augmented approaches — enough to lead a project in this space, representing the analytics needs and collaborating with architecture and engineering partners on design and implementation.
  • Communication & mentoring: Exceptional at explaining technical concepts to audiences with a wide range of technical backgrounds, and comfortable coaching less technical colleagues with patience and care — a distinguishing strength for this role.
  • Leadership and delivery management: Plans and sequences work, manages scope, dependencies, and priorities, removes blockers, and drives delivery to keep innovation and reporting modernization moving.

Work in a Way That Works for You
We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Para nós, a evolução é constante e acontece de gente para gente: usamos nossa inquietude para antecipar tendências e transformar o crescimento real da tecnologia.

🤖IH + IA (Inteligência Humana + Inteligência Artificial): Acreditamos que a tecnologia potencializa, mas as pessoas direcionam. Aqui, a IA nos dá escala e eficiência, enquanto a nossa Inteligência Humana traz a estratégia, o contexto e o cuidado. 🫂Pluralidade e Pertencimento: A diversidade é o que nos torna potentes. Promovemos a inclusão e o pertencimento de forma ativa, garantindo que a TOTVS seja um lugar onde você pode ser quem você é. Nossa expertise é humana e viva: acolhemos as diferenças para empoderar negócios dentro e fora da empresa. Conheça nossos grupos abaixo:

♿ Valorizamos a diversidade em nosso time, e desde 2017 nosso coletivo RDSum lidera ações afirmativas para inclusão, acolhimento e equidade de pessoas com deficiência na RD.

✊🏾 Valorizamos a inclusão racial e apoiamos iniciativas de enfrentamento ao racismo estrutural. Desde 2017, nosso coletivo Preto no Preto lidera ações afirmativas antirracistas de conscientização e equidade racial!

👩🏽‍💻Valorizamos e apoiamos a profissional mulher e mãe: somos uma das melhores empresas do país para mulheres trabalharem (ranking GPTW) e temos os grupos SER e Tech Ladies destinados ao empoderamento feminino.

🔒Alerta de segurança

Nossas oportunidades de emprego são divulgadas exclusivamente em nosso Trabalhe Conosco e espelhadas somente em nossas páginas oficiais da TOTVS no LinkedIn, Glassdoor e Indeed. A participação em nossos processos seletivos é 100% gratuita e nossas comunicações são enviadas apenas pelos domínios @rdstation.com, @totvs.com.br ou @carreiras.totvs.com.br.

Não solicitamos nenhum tipo de pagamento ou compra de cursos para sua participação. Caso você tenha recebido qualquer contato suspeito, reporte para nossa equipe.

Seu desafio no time:O time de Product Design da RD Station está vivendo um momento estratégico de evolução. Como Designer de Interação Pleno, você atuará na construção da visão de experiência do RD Station Conversas, com autonomia para simplificar jornadas complexas, fortalecer a influência de Design na squad e criar experiências rápidas e resolutivas para operações de atendimento.

Você será responsável por arquitetar experiências para funcionalidades essenciais do produto, eliminando atritos críticos na rotina das pessoas usuárias e contribuindo para a evolução do roadmap. Esperamos que você proponha visões de UI e UX para os domínios, equilibrando necessidades do negócio, excelência em experiência e priorização de débitos técnicos de Design.

Também fará parte do desafio fortalecer jornadas essenciais para o sucesso das pessoas clientes, reduzir pontos de atrito na percepção de valor do produto e reforçar a proposta de valor de recursos estratégicos. O sucesso da sua atuação será percebido pela melhoria da experiência, refletida em indicadores como NPS, redução de tickets relacionados a dificuldades de uso, identificação de oportunidades e aumento da adoção de funcionalidades do domínio.

Suas principais entregas:

  • Liderar o processo de Design, adaptando as etapas de Discovery e Delivery às necessidades da squad e promovendo a melhoria contínua dos métodos de trabalho;
  • Colaborar com Product Managers e Engenharia na estruturação de hipóteses e na influência do roadmap, priorizando usabilidade, redução de complexidade e evolução da experiência;
  • Propor soluções Lean e iterativas, utilizando aprendizados de testes e pesquisas para evoluir rapidamente da exploração à entrega final;
  • Conectar métricas de uso, adoção, engajamento e conversão às decisões de Design, acompanhando o impacto das soluções em produção;
  • Facilitar o alinhamento entre áreas técnicas e não técnicas, conduzindo pesquisas, workshops e discussões que apoiem decisões compartilhadas e fortaleçam a cultura de pesquisa.

Perfil que buscamos:

  • Atuação como Product Designer, com domínio de Figma e de ferramentas de prototipagem;
  • Conhecimento em pesquisa estratégica, análise de dados, pesquisas de usabilidade e benchmark de produtos;
  • Experiência com arquitetura de informação para sistemas complexos, mapeamento de jornadas e Service Design;
  • Capacidade de transformar problemas ambíguos em soluções viáveis, utilizando pensamento Lean, visão sistêmica e autonomia no dia a dia;
  • Habilidade de comunicar e defender decisões de Design com base em dados, negociar entregas e colaborar com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.

Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Experiência com produtos voltados para atendimento, comunicação, dados ou integrações;
  • Conhecimento sobre como produtos digitais são desenvolvidos e como decisões de Design impactam a arquitetura técnica;
  • Experiência na facilitação de workshops e dinâmicas colaborativas com diferentes áreas;
  • Vivência na condução de pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas em parceria com áreas como Customer Success e Vendas;
  • Interesse por tecnologia, inteligência artificial e aprendizado contínuo.

Etapas do processo seletivo:

Obs: Podem ter etapas complementares e/ou alterações, de acordo com a necessidade do processo.

jobs.excerpt: Partner One is a fast-growing investment group that acquires and operates industry leading software companies.
jobs.description:
Partner One is a fast-growing investment group that acquires and operates industry leading software companies. Our mission is to build strong, sustainable organizations by empowering exceptional people and driving operational excellence across our portfolio. We maintain a decentralized model that allows each business unit to operate with agility while being supported by a global shared services infrastructure.

Description

We are seeking a Business Unit Controller to oversee the financial operations and performance of one or more software business units within the Partner One group. This role will serve as a strategic finance partner to business leadership and report directly to the CFO, playing a key role in ensuring accurate financial reporting, operational efficiency, and data-driven decision-making. The ideal candidate is hands-on, analytical, and results-oriented, with deep experience in accounting, financial planning, and operational finance within the software industry and complex, multi-entity environments. You will work closely with the CFO and senior leadership to drive financial performance, ensure operational excellence, and contribute to Partner One’s continued global growth and success.

Responsibilities

  • An Ideal candidate that can move comfortably between big picture ideas, and the tactics and action steps needed to flawlessly execute them.
  • Oversee all accounting and financial reporting activities for the assigned business unit(s), ensuring compliance with Partner One policies and relevant accounting standards (US GAAP).
  • Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual closing processes, including revenue recognition, accruals, reconciliations, and preparation of financial statements.
  • Monitor performance of the business unit(s) against targets, providing detailed variance analyses and insights to drive informed business decisions.
  • Develop and maintain key financial and operational metrics, including ARR, churn, deferred revenue, and EBITDA.
  • Partner with business leaders and the CFO to embed a cost-conscious culture focused on accountability, transparency, and value-driven decision-making.
  • Strengthen internal controls, streamline accounting workflows, and ensure financial integrity across systems and processes.
  • Collaborate with centralized finance teams (payroll, tax, treasury, AP/AR) to support efficient end-to-end operations.
  • Contribute to M&A integration efforts, including purchase accounting, opening balance sheets, and system transitions.
  • Manage audits, statutory filings, and compliance with local and international financial regulations.
  • Prioritize mentorship, team building, and coaching to local finance and accounting personnel

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (CPA or equivalent professional designation preferred).
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in accounting or financial management, with at least 3 years in the software industry or a complex, multi-entity corporate environment.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS financial metrics and revenue recognition principles.
  • Proven experience with financial reporting, consolidation, budgeting, and analysis.
  • Proficiency in accounting systems such as Sage Intacct or NetSuite, and strong Excel and financial modeling skills.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote, and international work environment.
  • An ideal candidate must have demonstrated success in building teams and developing staff.
  • A candidate who is obsessed with process improvement, automation, and finding efficiencies in on-going operations

The estimated compensation range for this role is $110,000–$140,000 USD. Actual compensation will be based on the candidate’s country of residence, local market benchmarks, and relevant experience. Where required by local law, region‑specific pay ranges will be provided automatically on job boards or shared directly with applicants

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job:

We are seeking a highly skilled DevOps Specialist to architect, implement, and maintain end-to-end CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, with a strong focus on test-driven deployment, automated release management, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.

The ideal candidate will containerize services using Docker, manage build, compilation, and publishing workflows for JavaScript, TypeScript, and C++ packages, and design robust multi-language build pipelines leveraging CMake or similar build tools.

The role also includes automating build, tagging, and publication processes across web, desktop, and mobile platforms to ensure consistent and traceable releases. Deep expertise in Linux system administration, networking, and IaC tools is essential to deliver

scalable, secure, and highly available deployments.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, architecture, and management of CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions (and similar tools), ensuring fast, reliable, and reproducible software delivery.

  • Implement and enforce test-driven deployment systems, integrating automated testing, validation, and monitoring to maintain code quality and accelerate feedback cycles.

  • Containerize applications and microservices with Docker, optimize image builds, and manage deployment pipelines for distributed environments.

  • Oversee the build, packaging, and publishing lifecycle for JavaScript, TypeScript, and C++ packages, including versioning, semantic tagging, and NPM or internal registry publication.

  • Develop and maintain cross-platform build pipelines using CMake or equivalent tools, ensuring consistent compilation and release workflows across web, desktop, and mobile.

  • Automate end-to-end release processes, including tagging, building, signing, and distributing mobile, web, and desktop applications.

  • Define and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to provision and maintain reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure environments.

  • Collaborate closely with development, QA, and operations teams to troubleshoot deployment issues, optimize performance, and improve release reliability.

  • Continuously improve observability and feedback loops, leveraging monitoring and alerting systems to maintain operational excellence.

Requirements

Mandatory:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience architecting and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent tools at scale in a production environment.

  • Strong proficiency in test-driven deployment methodologies, including writing and maintaining automated test suites for integration and end-to-end validation.

  • Expertise in containerization technologies such as Docker, including image creation, registry management, and basic orchestration patterns.

  • Experience managing package lifecycles for JavaScript and TypeScript, including versioning, compilation, semantic tagging, and publishing workflows to NPM.

  • In-depth knowledge of C++ build systems, specifically CMake, with proven experience optimizing native build and deployment pipelines.

  • Advanced Linux system administration and networking skills, including shell scripting, package management, performance troubleshooting, firewalls, and VPN configuration.

  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in globally distributed teams.

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, AWS CDK or AWS CloudFormation.

  • Experience with mobile CI/CD automation, including build, tagging, and publication for iOS and Android applications

  • Advanced knowledge of release management practices, including automated versioning, signing, and artifact distribution.

Preferred:

  • Exposure to observability and monitoring systems, leveraging tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK for deployment health tracking.

  • Experience working in high-availability, security-sensitive environments, especially in fintech, blockchain, or distributed systems contexts.

  • Experience deploying and managing blockchain-based applications.

  • Exposure to AI/ML pipelines, including automated model training, evaluation, and deployment using frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.excerpt: About Us We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability.
jobs.description:
About Us

We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead. 

Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!

Description

Bueno (BUilt ENvironment Optimization) is a division of Copeland and a leader in Smart Building Analytics. The Bueno Platform and services connect to building equipment to identify issues, reduce energy consumption and optimize operations, helping businesses decarbonize their buildings.

At Bueno, listening and caring about our clients and partners is at the heart of what we do. We work in a complex ecosystem of stakeholders, incentives and constraints, and we give our teams the knowledge, tools and supportive environment to bring their true selves to work every day.


The Bueno and Verdant Partnership

Verdant by Copeland is a plug-and-play energy management offering that combines occupancy and thermal sensing, network connectivity and real-time analytics to cut heating and cooling waste in vacant rooms and shared spaces while preserving guest comfort. It serves hotels, senior living, student housing and multifamily properties, with more than 7,000 installed properties in North America (Copeland). Bueno and Verdant are building a joint offering for the hotel and hospitality market. This hire is the dedicated Customer Success lead for that partnership: the person who makes sure it works for hospitality customers, for Verdant's teams and for Bueno.


This role owns the success of Bueno's partnership with Verdant, another Copeland entity, and the hotel and hospitality customers that partnership serves. You will turn the Bueno Platform into a measurable part of how hotel owners, operators and management companies cut energy use, avoid equipment failures and hit sustainability targets, and you will be the day-to-day bridge between Bueno and Verdant teams.

As the Senior Customer Success Manager, you will:

  • Own the Verdant Partnership: Act as the primary Bueno counterpart for Verdant. Build a joint success plan, run regular working sessions with Verdant leadership, sales and delivery teams, and keep both organizations aligned on priorities, pipeline, deployments and outcomes.
  • Build Strong Hospitality Relationships: Develop trusted relationships with hotel owners, asset managers, management companies and brand-level stakeholders, as well as general managers, chief engineers and facilities teams on property. Understand each group's goals, from guest comfort and operating cost to brand sustainability standards, and position Bueno as part of the solution.
  • Create Seamless Onboarding Experiences: Lead onboarding of new hospitality portfolios and properties, working with sales, product, services and Verdant to move from signed agreement to live, valuable analytics quickly and with minimal disruption to hotel operations.
  • Deliver Tailored Services and Support: Understand each property's equipment, operations and occupancy patterns, and deliver engineering analysis and reporting that solves real problems, such as HVAC and refrigeration faults, guest-room and central-plant energy waste, kitchen and cold-storage performance, and comfort complaints.
  • Plan for Customer and Partner Success: Develop and execute success plans aligned with client and partner objectives. Identify adoption, expansion and cross-sell opportunities across portfolios, hand them to the account management team, and consistently demonstrate the value delivered.
  • Provide Responsive Issue Support: Serve as the escalation point for client and partner questions and issues beyond what our monitoring and support teams handle, and work across Bueno and Verdant to resolve them promptly.
  • Empower with Training and Education: Train property engineering teams, operators and Verdant staff on Bueno's features and best practices so insights turn into action on site.
  • Advocate with Customer Feedback: Gather feedback from hospitality clients and Verdant, and bring hospitality-specific requirements and pain points to account management and product teams to shape the roadmap and the joint offering.
  • Track and Report Performance: Monitor adoption (MAU), retention (NRR), satisfaction (NPS), realized energy savings and partnership health. Prepare reports and executive summaries for Bueno and Verdant leadership.
  • Help Scale Bueno in the US: Improve tools and processes, build repeatable playbooks for hospitality and partner-led deployments, and take on new responsibilities as the team grows.

Required education, experiences & skills:

  • 5+ years in customer success, account management or client-facing delivery for B2B software or services, ideally in the hospitality, hotel, commercial real estate or building technology space
  • 3+ years managing complex, multi-level stakeholder relationships, including executives, operators and technical teams
  • Experience managing or growing a strategic partnership or channel relationship, including working across organizations that have different priorities and ways of working
  • Working knowledge of HVAC, refrigeration and other building systems, energy efficiency, energy calculations, and measurement and verification (M&V)
  • Strong understanding of the built environment and building services, and how commercial buildings are operated and maintained
  • Strong ability to work in cross-functional remote teams
  • Excellent project and task management skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, including executive-level presentations
  • Demonstrated proactiveness and ability to self-manage
  • Must be authorized to work full time in the US
  • The ability to travel up to 20%

Highly Desired

We will give strong preference to candidates with hotel and hospitality experience, including:

  • Direct experience working with hotel owners, operators, management companies or brands, and an understanding of how decisions are made across ownership, management and property levels
  • Familiarity with hotel operations and engineering, including central plants, guest-room HVAC, kitchens and cold storage, laundry and pools, and the trade-off between energy savings and guest comfort
  • Knowledge of hospitality sustainability and energy programs, such as brand ESG commitments, benchmarking and certification schemes (for example ENERGY STAR, LEED or Green Key), and utility and decarbonization reporting
  • Experience with hospitality technology such as building management systems, guest-room management systems and property management systems
  • Experience selling or delivering energy services, efficiency or smart building solutions through a partner, such as an OEM, service provider or technology alliance
  • Experience in rapidly scaling, mission-driven teams where you have built processes and playbooks from scratch
  • Experience in analytics and data modeling, and technical expertise with refrigeration systems

Remote Work Arrangement:

This role is fully remote. As a remote colleague, you may be required to travel to a Copeland site regularly to collaborate with your team or customers as needed. Copeland is committed to fostering a productive and connected culture, so you will have the opportunity to work with your team and leader to understand your team operating principles to collaborate effectively.

Our compensation philosophy is simple: we pay a competitive base salary, within the local market in which we operate, and reward performance during our annual merit review process. The salary/pay range for this role is $95,000-$171,000 annually, commensurate with the skills, talent, capabilities, and experience each candidate brings to a role.


Our Commitment to Our People

Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.

Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal - to make the world a better place. We invest in the end-to-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally.

Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs: medical insurance plans, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) and more. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave, vacation and holiday leave. 

Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team!

Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging

At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland.

Work Authorization

Copeland will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1 with OPT or CPT, H-1, H-2, L-1, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Copeland is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. jobs.excerpt: Our MissionAt Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life.
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

About our team:

Cortex XCOR is Palo Alto Networks' observability platform optimized for containerized environments. It optimizes costs, reduces data complexity by up to 89%, and enables faster issue remediation for industry leaders like DoorDash, Affirm, and Zillow.


XCOR Digital Experience Monitoring (DEM) directly connects end-user experience insights with underlying backend observability, answering a question infrastructure dashboards cannot: are my users having a good experience? A slow service stops being a one dimensional chart and becomes a representation of a slow path through checkout: from the user who experienced it, to the service, the deploy, and the query responsible. By integrating synthetic and real-user data into the broader service stack, XCOR allows teams, from SREs to executives, to trace user-impacting issues from symptom to root cause seamlessly.

DEM has two sides. Real user monitoring tells you what your customers experienced on their device, their network, their browser, in the moment it mattered. Synthetic monitoring tells you whether the journeys you care most about work right now, tested deliberately and continuously, from the places your customers are, whether or not anyone happens to be using them.


Job Summary

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to own synthetic monitoring for Cortex XCOR. You will translate front-end testing requirements from SREs and frontend developers (browser click-paths, multi-step API journeys, and underlying protocol checks) into a unified product that can be defined as code and executed globally or within customer networks.


In collaboration with the RUM team, you will unify synthetic and real-user monitoring data so that synthetic failures seamlessly correlate with affected user cohorts.


This is an early-stage build role where you will drive the core decisions defining the product.

Qualifications

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct primary research with SREs, front-end developers, and platform teams to understand current journey-testing workflows and pain points.
  • Maintain close contact with customers, design partners, and field teams through discovery calls and interviews.
  • Participate in sales calls where synthetic coverage is critical, gathering feedback to inform roadmap prioritization.
  • Partner with engineers and technical stakeholders to articulate, scope, and deliver one coherent product.
  • Build on XCOR's industry-leading observability platform so that synthetic results arrive as OpenTelemetry-native signals and correlate with the metrics, traces, and logs teams already have.
  • Own the execution model: how tests are scheduled, where they run, what a customer is charged for, and how they keep control of it.
  • Partner with the RUM product team to integrate synthetic and real user data into unified customer workflows.
  • Set KPIs to articulate and measure intended value and impact for customers.
  • Own the roadmap end to end: build it, sequence it, communicate it, and keep the team and the business aligned on its evolution.
  • Lead across teams to ensure cohesive features and workflows are seamless across the platform.
  • Partner with product marketing on positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy.

What you will achieve

You are joining while the product is still being designed. That is the point of the role, and it sets the pace.

In your first 30 days, you will analyze the market, engage in active design discussions, meet with customers, and identify key gaps to establish ownership of the product strategy.

Within six months, you will establish a competitive product offering, defining key performance metrics, addressing critical competitive gaps, and delivering a sequenced plan for the team to build against.

This suits someone who is energized by an empty page and a short runway, and who can hold a strong opinion about a product that does not exist yet.


Qualifications

You'll need:

  • 10+ years of experience as a product manager, with deep knowledge of enterprise software.
  • Experience with monitoring, testing, or developer infrastructure products such as synthetic monitoring, end-to-end browser testing, API testing, or CI/CD tooling.
  • Working knowledge of how modern web applications are tested end to end: browser automation (Playwright, Selenium, Cypress), HTTP and API testing, and the protocol layer underneath (DNS, TCP, TLS).
  • A track record of taking a product from zero to one
  • The presence to carry this in the room. You'll present to the customer's senior leadership and to our own executives, and be the one answering the hard questions.
  • A history of shipping with agile processes and tight feedback loops.
  • An obsession with getting the little details right.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI in the Product Development Lifecycle for everything from document writing to prototyping while ensuring your own thoughts and ideas are well represented in content. Agents are used to reduce toil, not as a replacement for critical thinking skills.

Helpful, not required:

  • Familiarity with observability in general, OpenTelemetry specifically and how telemetry data is collected, correlated, and stored.
  • Experience building AI Native products with knowledge around building and/or maintaining MCP server(s).
  • Familiarity with the digital experience monitoring category and how real user and synthetic data get used together. Core Web Vitals, user journeys, JavaScript exceptions and what each one can and cannot tell you.
  • Comfort with test-as-code and infrastructure-as-code workflows, and with the CI/CD pipelines engineering teams run them in.
  • Experience building and operating software as a service, including the unit economics of running customer workloads.
  • Experience with design-led product development principles and best practices

Location

US - Remote

Compensation Disclosure

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

$176,800.00 - $286,000.00/yr

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at .

We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

Although this role does not perform the technical build directly, it applies strong knowledge of healthcare revenue cycle operations and data integration concepts—including file feeds, interfaces, APIs, data pipelines, validation, and production readiness—to challenge assumptions, influence decisions, and deliver measurable client and operational outcomes.

Collaboration - Works cooperatively within teams and partners with others, both internally and externally as needed, to achieve success; focuses on the results of the team, not the achievements of one person. It's "All for One and One for All."

Accountability - Accepts personal responsibility and/or consequences of failure and successes, delivering on commitments and refocusing effort when needed.


Developing Trust - Gains others' confidence by acting with integrity and following through on commitments; treats others and their ideas with respect and supports them in the face of challenges.

ffs.

Develop and manage integrated technical program roadmaps, milestone plans, release schedules, status dashboards, and governance routines that align cross-project scope, sequencing, resources, deliverables, timelines, and expected outcomes.

Establish and lead program governance, operating rhythms, stakeholder forums, and executive steering updates; document decisions and action items and ensure accountable owners complete commitments within agreed timelines.

jobs.excerpt: Work Flexibility: Remote or Hybrid or OnsiteIt's Time to Join Stryker!
jobs.description:
Work Flexibility: Remote or Hybrid or Onsite

It's Time to Join Stryker!


Location: Weston, FL (Preferred) | Kalamazoo, MI (Considered) | Remote/Hybrid Flexibility Subject to Approval


Are you passionate about designing intuitive, high-quality software experiences that make a meaningful impact? Join Stryker's Mako Robotics team and help shape the user interfaces that support robotic-assisted orthopedic surgery.


As a Staff level User Interface and Experience Designer, you'll play a key role in developing the software experiences used in Mako's hip replacement applications. You'll combine strong visual and interaction design expertise with hands-on technical execution, translating complex workflows into intuitive interfaces and detailed, production-ready design specifications.


This is an opportunity to contribute to both current and next-generation Mako technologies. You'll help deliver critical UI designs for existing applications while collaborating across engineering, product development, and design teams to influence the future of robotic-assisted surgery.


You'll join a collaborative, geographically distributed team that values creativity, attention to detail, technical excellence, and the ability to take ownership of your work.


What You Will Do

User Interface Design & Development

  • Design and develop intuitive, visually consistent software interfaces for Mako robotic-assisted surgery applications, with an initial focus on Total Hip Arthroplasty (THA).
  • Create high-fidelity interface designs, screen layouts, interactive prototypes, and reusable UI components using Figma and established design systems.
  • Translate complex clinical workflows, product requirements, and user needs into clear, functional, and accessible software experiences.
  • Apply visual and interaction design principles, including typography, color, layout, navigation, messaging, component states, and user feedback.
  • Develop detailed, production-ready UI specifications that accurately communicate design intent to software development teams.
  • Create and manage design assets, component libraries, naming conventions, documentation, and version-controlled design deliverables.

User Experience & Product Development

  • Contribute to the development of next-generation Mako applications through workflow analysis, concept exploration, prototyping, and iterative design.
  • Collaborate with UX researchers, product owners, and cross-functional teams to incorporate user feedback, clinical insights, and usability considerations into design solutions.
  • Support design reviews, usability evaluations, and voice-of-customer activities to refine interfaces and improve the overall user experience.
  • Balance user needs, technical feasibility, design consistency, and product requirements throughout the development process.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Design Ownership

  • Partner closely with software engineers, scrum teams, product owners, systems engineers, and other designers to support successful implementation of UI designs.
  • Collaborate with design teams across Mako's hip, knee, and shoulder applications to maintain consistency within shared software platforms and design systems.
  • Independently manage assigned design activities, proactively resolve challenges, and drive deliverables from concept through implementation.
  • Communicate design decisions, technical specifications, and recommendations clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of design processes, documentation standards, tools, and team practices.
  • Support applicable medical device design controls, usability, and quality requirements throughout product development.

What You Will Need


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in User Interface Design, User Experience Design, Interaction Design, Industrial Design, Graphic Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience is required.
  • 4 or more years of professional experience in UI/UX design, software product design, interaction design, or a closely related field is required.
  • Proficiency with Figma, including experience working with shared design systems, component libraries, and high-fidelity interface designs is required.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Illustrator and Photoshop is required.

Preferred Qualifications (You do not need to all of these)

  • Experience designing software interfaces, creating interactive prototypes, and applying established visual and interaction design principles.
  • A portfolio or representative work samples demonstrating relevant user interface design capabilities.
  • Experience developing detailed UI specifications, design documentation, component definitions, and production-ready assets for software development teams.
  • Strong visual design, graphic design, and illustration skills, including creating instructional graphics, icons, and informational illustrations.
  • Experience with complex software applications, technical systems, or products requiring highly detailed and consistent user interfaces.
  • Experience with 3D modeling or rendering tools such as KeyShot, SolidWorks, or similar applications.
  • Experience designing software for medical devices, surgical systems, robotics, or other regulated or safety-critical industries.
  • Familiarity with usability engineering, accessibility principles, human factors, and user-centered design methodologies.
  • Experience collaborating with software development teams in Agile or Scrum environments.
  • Understanding of software development practices and how UI designs are translated into functional applications.
  • Experience collaborating across distributed teams and working independently within a matrixed organization.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, proactive communication, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

The Opportunity:

CACI’s EITaaS Program is a Department of the Air Force (DAF) initiative, which includes the Air Force and Space Force. EITaaS will transform the Dept. of the Air Force IT services from an in-house, base-centric delivery model to an advanced enterprise service delivery model. CACI will provide an enhanced IT management system, IT storefront, enterprise help desk, local field services, and life cycle support for end-user devices.

CACI’s innovative approach to enterprise technology infuses contemporary technologies with industry best practices to deliver commercial-style services that will improve customer experience and productivity for the Dept. of the Air Force’s global workforce. CACI and its partners will equip Airmen and Guardians with state-of-the-art services and automated capabilities that enable access to the tools they need to perform their mission efficiently and effectively when they need it, where they need it.

Responsibilities:

The Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) and Mobility Administrator will serve on the Mobility and Remote Access Services (MRAS) team to support the DAF in operating, sustaining, and improving enterprise Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) and mobility capabilities. The administrator will support the delivery of secure remote access and virtual desktop services, including Azure Virtual Desktop and Microsoft Intune, for the EITaaS program, and users across 187 bases.

Working with the Team Lead and engineering teams, the AVD and Mobility Administrator will also support the transition of new capabilities from engineering into operations, including operational hand-off and post-deployment monitoring.

More About the Role:

  • Responsible for working with Team Lead in administrating and maintaining Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) and Mobile Device Management (MDM) technologies based on Azure Virtual Desktop and Microsoft Intune.
  • Support project activities and client contact that addresses the operational transition, deployment, and retirement services.
  • Support the execution of PowerShell scripts and other deployment capabilities to automate Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) functionality and operations.
  • Triage and troubleshoot AVD and mobility user and system issues, providing remediation steps to resolve them.
  • Support Windows Zero Touch Implementation (ZTI) processes for AVD solutions.
  • Support the management and maintenance of Azure AVD resources and OS images; deploy monthly OS and application patches to existing AVD VMs.
  • Assist in monitoring AVD resources to ensure sufficient virtual resources are available for DAF users (shutting down over provisioned resources and startup up new resources when insufficient resources are available).
  • Act as a Purebred agent when requested.
  • Use the government’s ITSM tool to track customer service requests and trouble incident tickets, manage one or more associated operational ticket queue(s), develop and report performance metrics, and support ticket reviews as requested.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Ability to obtain/maintain secret clearance.
  • 10+ Years of relevant experience (Bachelor’s Degree in applicable field may be substituted for 5 years of experience).
  • Current certification for Security+ or any of CISSP, CCNA, or CCNP
  • Experience installing and supporting Windows client systems and mobile devices.
  • Ability to execute documented detailed technical processes.
  • Good Windows Operating System problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Experience with Azure compute and storage resources.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and clients.
  • Exhibits strong customer service skills and can effectively communicate with end-users to understand and address their technical concerns.
  • Displays a willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies.

Desired:

  • Experience supporting Windows computers and users in an enterprise environment.
  • Familiarity with MS Intune for managing mobile platforms.
  • Experience with STIG Windows security controls.
  • Experience creating technical documentation.
  • Experience creating and executing PowerShell scripts.
  • Experience with managing Active Directory domain or Entra ID user and computer objects.
  • DoD background, primarily USAF, preferred, especially when related to IT professional services for the Air Force.
-

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$75,200-$158,100

jobs.title: Internationaal Product Support medewerker
jobs.excerpt: Heb jij affiniteit met- en een passie voor agrotechniek en ben jij op zoek naar een avontuurlijke baan?
jobs.description:
Heb jij affiniteit met- en een passie voor agrotechniek en ben jij op zoek naar een avontuurlijke baan? In ons team is ruimte voor een Product Support medewerker. In deze functie reis je de wereld over, verricht je technische werkzaamheden en werk je aan de nieuwste landbouwmachines, die vaak nog op de markt moeten komen. Ook vind je het leuk om opgedane kennis te delen en word je ingezet om bijvoorbeeld operators in het veld op te leiden of door technische trainingen te verzorgen op locatie.

Gaat dit over jou?

Draag jij met jouw technische expertise graag bij aan de ontwikkelingen in de sector? Als Product Support medewerker zet je jouw technische kennis niet alleen praktisch in, maar word je ook ingezet op projecten om je kennis over te dragen. Je maakt onderdeel uit van ons team die bestaat uit technisch specialisten met allen een passie voor landbouw en werktuigbouwkunde. Je voert wereldwijd maatwerkprojecten uit voor fabrikanten en dealers van landbouwmachines, akkerbouwbedrijven en startups, gericht op technische ondersteuning en advies.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Technische ondersteuning
    Je voert technische werkzaamheden uit aan met name nieuwe landbouwvoertuigen, waaronder tractoren, maaidorsers en hakselaars

  • Technische problemen oplossen
    Met je technische expertise diagnosticeer je problemen en los je ze op, zodat de machine optimaal presteert

  • Inbedrijfstelling en testen
    Ook projecten als het inbedrijfstellen, testen in het veld en het verzorgen van demo-tours van nieuwe machines op locatie behoren tot je werkzaamheden

  • Project management
    De opdrachten zijn divers en bestaan uit werkzaamheden aan een breed scala aan machines. Je houdt overzicht in het project en je werkt samen met externe teams en klanten om de beste resultaten te bereiken.

  • Kennis overdracht
    Je wordt ook ingezet op projecten om bijvoorbeeld operators te trainen of om technische trainingen te verzorgen op locatie bij dealers in het buitenland.

  • Training en ontwikkeling
    Je neemt regelmatig deel aan interne en externe trainingen, zodat je op de hoogte blijft van de technische ontwikkelingen in de agrarische sector

Requirements

Wie ben jij?

Je hebt brede technische kennis en een passie voor de agrarische sector. Je houdt van avontuur en afwisseling in je werkzaamheden en je bent bereid om te reizen en langere periodes van huis te zijn (in ieder geval een paar weken aaneengesloten). Je hebt lef, ziet wat er moet gebeuren en je vindt het leuk om opgedane kennis over te dragen.

  • Ervaring
    Bij voorkeur heb je een afgeronde Mbo niveau 4 of Hbo-opleiding in de agrarische/technische richting

  • Talenkennis
    Je hebt goede beheersing van in ieder geval de Engelse taal is vereist; kennis van meerdere talen is een plus.

  • Werkethiek
    Je kunt je houden aan de protocollen zoals deze in andere landen op de werkvloer gelden

  • Competenties
    Je bent zelfstandig en je hebt een groot verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en je denkt in mogelijkheden

Wat bieden wij jou?

Wij bieden jou een unieke kans om de wereld rond te reizen, nieuwe uitdagingen aan te gaan in een diversiteit aan projecten. In de functie Product Support medewerker heb je de mogelijkheid om je te specialiseren in werkzaamheden.

  • Een salaris tussen de €2.500,- en €3.800,- bruto per maand op basis van een 40-urige werkweek, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring

  • Bovenop je salaris ontvang je een dagvergoeding wanneer je in het buitenland verblijft en uiteraard worden werk gerelateerde onkosten vergoed.

  • Een contract op basis van een bepaald aantal projecturen op jaarbasis.

  • Trainingen gericht op de ontwikkelingen in de sector.

  • Scholingsbudget om je persoonlijk verder te kunnen ontwikkelen

HuizingHarvest heeft alles in huis voor een avontuurlijke carrière in de agrotechniek. We kijken er naar uit om een toegewijde Product Support medewerker te verwelkomen in ons internationale team. Let’s make it work!

Kennismaken?

Spreekt de functie Product Support medewerker bij HuizingHarvest jou aan? Wij maken graag kennis met je. Bel of WhatsApp Erik Kramer +31 (0)6 255 63 999 of stuur een e-mail .

jobs.excerpt: 1.  Role SummaryThe Chief Experience Officer (CXO) is responsible for developing and executing the organization's overall experience strategy across customer, client, employee, and stakeholder touchpoints.
jobs.description:
1. Role Summary

The Chief Experience Officer (CXO) is responsible for developing and executing the organization's overall experience strategy across customer, client, employee, and stakeholder touchpoints. The role focuses on building a customer-centric culture, improving service quality, strengthening customer relationships, and ensuring consistent, seamless, and positive experiences across all insurance and investment products and services.

The CXO will lead customer experience (CX), service delivery, customer engagement, and experience transformation initiatives. The position will work closely with business, operations, technology, sales, marketing, claims, underwriting, and investment teams to improve satisfaction, loyalty, retention, and long-term business performance.

2. Key Responsibilities

Customer Experience Strategy

  • Develop and implement an enterprise-wide customer experience strategy aligned with the organization's business objectives.
  • Establish a customer-first culture across insurance, investment, and financial service operations.
  • Define customer experience standards, service principles, and performance benchmarks.
  • Identify opportunities to differentiate the organization through superior customer service and engagement.

Customer Journey Management

  • Map and optimize end-to-end customer journeys across product discovery, onboarding, policy issuance, premium payments, claims, renewals, investment services, and account management.
  • Identify service gaps, customer pain points, and process inefficiencies.
  • Simplify customer interactions and reduce friction across digital and traditional service channels.
  • Ensure consistent experiences across branches, call centres, websites, mobile applications, and relationship management teams.

Customer Satisfaction and Retention

  • Develop initiatives to improve customer satisfaction, loyalty, retention, and lifetime value.
  • Monitor customer feedback, complaints, service requests, and customer sentiment.
  • Establish customer feedback mechanisms, including surveys, NPS, CSAT, and customer interviews.
  • Lead initiatives to reduce customer attrition and improve policy renewal and investment account retention rates.

Digital Experience and Innovation

  • Collaborate with technology and digital teams to improve online platforms, mobile applications, customer portals, and self-service solutions.
  • Drive digital adoption and improve accessibility of insurance and investment services.
  • Leverage customer analytics, automation, AI, and CRM platforms to personalize customer interactions.
  • Champion innovative solutions that improve customer convenience and operational efficiency.

Customer Service and Relationship Management

  • Oversee customer service standards and service excellence initiatives.
  • Ensure timely resolution of customer inquiries, complaints, claims-related concerns, and investment service requests.
  • Strengthen relationship management practices for individual, corporate, institutional, and high-net-worth clients.
  • Establish service-level agreements (SLAs) and escalation procedures across customer-facing departments.

Employee Experience and Organizational Culture

  • Develop initiatives that improve employee engagement and internal service culture.
  • Promote collaboration between departments to deliver consistent customer experiences.
  • Support employee training and development in customer service, communication, relationship management, and service excellence.
  • Align employee experience initiatives with customer experience objectives.

Governance, Risk and Compliance

  • Ensure customer experience practices comply with applicable insurance, investment, consumer protection, data privacy, and financial services regulations.
  • Work with compliance and risk teams to address customer-related regulatory concerns.
  • Promote transparent communication, fair treatment, responsible product information, and ethical customer engagement.
  • Establish processes for monitoring and resolving customer complaints and service-related risks.

Leadership and Performance Management

  • Lead and develop customer experience, customer service, and service transformation teams.
  • Establish departmental objectives, budgets, KPIs, and performance management frameworks.
  • Present customer experience performance reports and strategic recommendations to the CEO and Board.
  • Collaborate with senior executives to integrate customer experience priorities into business strategy.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, Management, Customer Experience, or a related field.
  • Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA) or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 10–15+ years of progressive experience in customer experience, customer service, operations, client relationship management, or business transformation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior leadership or executive management position.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, wealth management, financial services, or other regulated service industries.
  • Demonstrated success in developing and implementing customer experience strategies.
  • Strong knowledge of customer journey mapping, CRM platforms, customer analytics, NPS, CSAT, and service quality management.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and large-scale service improvement initiatives.
  • Strong strategic thinking, communication, stakeholder management, and leadership capabilities.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT).

- Net Promoter Score (NPS).

  • Customer retention and policy renewal rates.
  • Customer attrition and churn reduction.
  • Customer complaint resolution time and satisfaction.

- First Contact Resolution (FCR) rate.

  • Digital channel adoption and self-service utilization.
  • Customer onboarding and service turnaround time.
  • Customer lifetime value and relationship growth.
  • Employee engagement and service culture improvement.
  • Compliance with customer service standards and regulatory requirements.

  • Assist with sandbox management, change tracking, deployment preparation, release validation, and production support activities.
  • Follow Salesforce development, security, testing, data governance, and release management best practices.
  • Help ensure Salesforce remains scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of Salesforce workflows, governance standards, data standards, and user experience.
  • Work independently on assigned tasks while seeking guidance from senior team members when appropriate.

  • Location: Remote
  • Travel Requirements: Minimal 0-20%
  • Working Hours: Standard

  • Security clearance requirement: Eligibility to obtain a US Security clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant technical experience.
  • 2+ years of experience supporting Salesforce administration, Salesforce development, business applications, CRM systems, or enterprise workflow automation.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce configuration, including standard and custom objects, fields, page layouts, record types, validation rules, flows, reports, dashboards, profiles, permission sets, and user administration.

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I certification.

  • Experience supporting a new Salesforce org implementation, migration, or major CRM transformation.

jobs.excerpt: Role Overview We’re looking for a Staff DevOps Engineer to own the infrastructure, delivery pipelines, and reliability tooling behind our exchange and trading platform.
jobs.description:
Role Overview


We’re looking for a Staff DevOps Engineer to own the infrastructure, delivery pipelines, and reliability tooling behind our exchange and trading platform. You’ll build and run the cloud foundation that keeps a low-latency, regulated, always-on market available, and make it faster and safer for engineers to ship. You’ll work closely with backend, security, and compliance partners, and you’ll have real ownership from day one.

What You’ll Own

  • Design, build, and operate our AWS infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) across production, staging, and development environments.
  • Run and scale our Kubernetes platform, including cluster upgrades, autoscaling, networking, and cost management.
  • Own CI/CD end to end: fast, reliable build, test, and deploy pipelines with safe rollout strategies (canary, blue/green) and quick rollback.
  • Build observability for the exchange: metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards, and actionable alerting tied to SLOs for latency and availability.
  • Operate and tune supporting infrastructure for our event-driven systems, including Kafka, databases, caches, and WebSocket edge services.
  • Participate in on-call, lead incident response, and run blameless postmortems that lead to durable fixes.
  • Partner with security and compliance on access controls, secrets management, audit logging, vulnerability management, and disaster recovery that meet CFTC-regulated expectations.
  • Plan capacity and performance testing ahead of high-volume sports events, and automate away toil.
  • Document runbooks and share knowledge so the whole engineering team can operate with confidence.

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering experience running production systems at scale
  • Deep hands-on expertise with AWS (or equivalent), including networking, IAM, compute, and managed data services
  • Strong Kubernetes and Docker experience in production, including cluster operations and troubleshooting
  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform strongly preferred) and configuration management, with GitOps-style workflows
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines at scale (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, or similar)
  • Strong observability skills: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, or comparable tooling, plus SLO-driven alerting
  • Solid scripting or programming ability in Go or Python (Go preferred) and comfort with Linux and networking fundamentals
  • Experience operating Kafka, SQL and NoSQL databases, and low-latency, real-time services in production
  • Experience with incident management, on-call, and blameless postmortems
  • Working knowledge of security best practices: secrets management, least-privilege access, vulnerability scanning, and audit logging
  • Experience in trading, exchange, fintech, or other high-throughput regulated systems is strongly preferred
  • Strong communicator who can explain complex tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Proactive, growth-focused, and highly adaptable with a strong sense of ownership
Nice to Have
  • Experience in prediction markets, sports betting, or regulated exchanges (CFTC or similar)
  • Familiarity with risk, fraud, KYC/AML, or settlement systems
  • Experience scaling a team through hiring and growth in a startup environment

Why Join Us!

Compensation & Ownership
  • Competitive compensation aligned to role and market
  • Equity opportunities so you share in what we’re building
  • A clear connection between impact and reward
Health & Wellbeing
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Flexible time off built on trust and accountability
  • A culture that respects your time and avoids unnecessary meetings
Remote & Flexible Work
  • Fully remote within the U.S.
  • Flexibility to work in the way that helps you do your best work
The Role
  • Own the cloud infrastructure, delivery pipelines, and reliability tooling behind the real-time, high-throughput systems at the core of America’s first sports-native, CFTC-regulated prediction market
  • Take on a hands-on technical leadership role with real influence over architecture, platform standards, and how engineering ships and operates software safely at speed
  • Help scale a live, regulated exchange as prediction markets grow into America’s next great asset class

jobs.description:
As a Recruiter (Level 2), you will play a hands-on operational role in supporting US recruitment delivery through candidate sourcing support, screening coordination, recruitment workflow execution, and compliance-focused process management. This role is expected to operate with higher independence than Level 1 and contribute to smoother recruitment throughput across multiple requisitions.

You will be responsible for supporting the end-to-end recruitment cycle by maintaining candidate pipelines, coordinating hiring stages, ensuring documentation readiness, and partnering closely with recruiters and leads on process execution. The role requires strong system proficiency, sound process judgment, and the ability to manage multiple recruitment activities in parallel.

Your mission is to strengthen operational reliability, improve candidate stage movement, and contribute to a high-quality recruitment support model through speed, accuracy, and process discipline.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Recruitment Operations & Workflow Execution

  • Requisition Coordination: Support active requisitions by maintaining candidate pipelines and ensuring recruitment stages progress on time.
  • Candidate Screening Support: Conduct initial profile validations or basic screening coordination where applicable, based on defined hiring criteria.
  • Interview Process Management: Coordinate interview stages from scheduling through feedback closure, ensuring no delay in candidate progression.
  • Priority Handling: Identify urgent roles, aging candidates, or delayed workflow items and bring them to recruiter attention proactively.
  • Stakeholder Coordination: Work with recruiters, leads, and hiring teams to maintain visibility on pending actions and bottlenecks.

2. Full-Lifecycle Recruitment & Workflow Expertise

  • Pipeline Management: Manage candidate stage movement in Workday or ATS systems from application review through offer or handoff stages.
  • Resume Review Support: Assist in identifying aligned profiles based on role criteria, location, shift fit, and work authorization requirements.
  • Workflow Accuracy: Ensure all movement across recruitment stages is accurately reflected in systems and trackers.
  • Candidate Experience Support: Maintain timely updates and structured follow-up to prevent candidate drop-off.
  • Turnaround Ownership: Ensure scheduling, documentation, and recruiter support tasks are completed within service-level expectations.

3. Pre-Hire, BGV & Compliance Oversight

  • Documentation Verification: Validate that required pre-employment documents are complete before next-stage processing.
  • Compliance Tracking: Ensure background verification, consent forms, and mandatory compliance steps are initiated and tracked correctly.
  • Vendor Coordination Support: Where applicable, coordinate with background check partners or internal teams for status follow-up.
  • Exception Management: Highlight missing, incorrect, or delayed compliance items and ensure they are resolved within defined timelines.
  • Policy Compliance: Ensure recruitment process execution adheres to internal policy, audit standards, and client-specific requirements.

4. Onboarding & Candidate Transition Support

  • Offer-to-Onboarding Handoff: Support smooth transition from offer release to onboarding initiation by ensuring records are updated and complete.
  • Candidate Query Handling: Respond to candidate queries related to joining steps, pending documents, or timeline expectations.
  • Cross-Functional Support: Coordinate with onboarding, HR operations, and recruitment leadership on case-specific issues that may impact joining.
  • Readiness Monitoring: Track onboarding readiness and escalate risks related to delays or candidate drop-off.
  • Employee Support Coordination: Support resolution of first-level issues related to pre-joining process steps.

5. Quality Governance & Reporting

  • Operational Reporting: Maintain daily and weekly recruitment reports, candidate trackers, and open action dashboards.
  • Quality Checks: Review records for data gaps, incorrect stage movement, or documentation errors before final submission or handoff.
  • Trend Identification: Identify repeated workflow issues, scheduling delays, or compliance slippages and escalate them for resolution.
  • Process Improvement Support: Suggest improvements in coordination, tracker usage, or documentation flow to improve efficiency.
  • Knowledge Adherence: Follow defined SOPs, quality guidelines, and reporting formats consistently.

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Experience: 1– 3 years of experience in US recruitment operations, talent acquisition support, HR shared services, or hiring coordination.
  • Availability to work U.S. business hours and follow the U.S. holiday calendar.
  • System Knowledge: Hands-on working knowledge of Workday, ATS platforms, Excel-based trackers, and Outlook/calendar coordination.
  • Operational Strength: Good understanding of recruitment stages, documentation control, and coordination-heavy workflows.
  • Communication (English and Spanish): Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to support candidate and stakeholder interactions confidently.
  • Execution Capability: Ability to manage multiple requisitions and high-volume support activity in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

Core Competencies

  • Recruitment Workflow Management: Strong understanding of hiring stages, process sequencing, and candidate lifecycle movement.
  • System Accuracy: Ability to maintain clean, reliable data across ATS, Workday, and recruitment trackers.
  • Analytical Attention: Identifies delays, missing information, or workflow risks before they impact delivery.
  • Process Accountability: Takes ownership of assigned requisitions, candidate actions, and pending closures.
  • Compliance Orientation: Maintains strict adherence to hiring documentation and verification requirements.
  • Stakeholder Responsiveness: Partners effectively with recruiters, onboarding teams, and internal functions to close actions quickly.
  • Candidate Focus: Supports timely communication and structured follow-up to protect candidate experience.
  • Adaptability: Works effectively in fast-paced, changing recruitment environments with competing priorities.

Job Description - Mid-Market Account Executive
