jobs.excerpt: POSITION SUMMARY: With direct supervision, the Billing Assistant performs a variety of routine billing and data entry functions.
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY: With direct supervision, the Billing Assistant performs a variety of routine billing and data entry functions. The incumbent is responsible for the timely and accurate entry of new and updated customer contracts into the Company’s systems. The Billing Assistant properly prepares accurate and timely bills to customers based on service contract terms.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Enters new and updated customer contracts into system and updates existing customer contracts as needed.

  • Compares data entered to source documentation for accuracy and completeness.

  • Scans source documents as PDFs into the document storage system.

  • Ensures accurate and complete data is entered appropriately, makes corrections when needed.

  • May gather and summarize supplemental billing information to accommodate customer billing requirements.

  • May transmit digital customer billing invoices to customers and/or upload billing information into customer payment platform.

  • Ensure all billing-related documents are properly stored and accessible in accordance with company policies.

  • Performs other non-essential duties as assigned or may be necessary.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to work in a high volume environment.

  • Ability to check accuracy and spot errors in billing information.

  • Knowledge of basic computer functions.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel.

  • Eagerness to learn new skills, adapt to new systems and processes, and possess a positive in a fast-passed environment.

  • Willingness to learn and assist in resolving simple billing issues and discrepancies.

  • Good verbal and written communication skills.

  • Ability to work well within a team, following directions and offering support where needed.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • 0 - 2 years of experience in entering, maintaining, and validating service and billing data and preparing customer invoices.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).


RECENT RECOGNITION

  • Barron’s 100 Most Sustainable Companies
  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
  • Great Place to Work
  • Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global

  • 10+ years of relevant product development experience, with progressive responsibility in robotics, electromechanical systems, or medical devices.
  • Prior experience in orthopedic joints, surgical robotics, or related implant/robotics systems.
  • Demonstrated experience defining system architecture and making high-impact engineering trade-offs for multi-disciplinary programs.
  • Hands-on experience with mechanism design, actuation, sensors, embedded controls, and system-level integration.
  • Strong software/controls familiarity (e.g., ROS, real-time control frameworks, C/C++, Python, MATLAB/Simulink).
  • Experience with model-based design, system simulation, motion planning, and/or kinematics/dynamics analysis.
  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional teams and managing third-party engineering partners or contract manufacturers.
  • Experience with DFMEA, tolerance analysis, GD&T, and supplier quality management.
  • Strong communication skills and experience presenting technical strategy and status to senior leadership and business stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated customer-facing experience (VoC, clinical stakeholder engagement, technical support for launches).

jobs.excerpt: The QA Lead Engineer provides strategic technical leadership for quality assurance efforts, ensuring the reliability, security, and compliance of scalable healthcare SaaS applications.
jobs.description:
The QA Lead Engineer provides strategic technical leadership for quality assurance efforts, ensuring the reliability, security, and compliance of scalable healthcare SaaS applications. This role architects and drives the implementation of advanced testing frameworks, automation solutions, and process improvements. The QA Lead Engineer collaborates with cross-functional teams, mentors QA engineers, and champions quality strategy and best practices to deliver high-quality software aligned with clinical workflows and regulatory standards.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Quality Strategy, Test Planning & Execution

  • Define and execute comprehensive QA strategies, standards, and best practices for functional, regression, integration, and performance testing.

  • Architect, implement, and maintain advanced automated test suites for web, API, and cloud-based applications using frameworks such as xUnit, WebDriver IO, Playwright, Jasmine, or similar.

  • Lead code reviews and provide technical feedback to development and QA team members.

  • Oversee the development and refinement of quality assurance processes and documentation.

2. Automation, CI/CD & Process Optimization

  • Design and optimize automated testing solutions integrated with CI/CD pipelines to support rapid and reliable software delivery.

  • Monitor and report on test results, defects, and quality metrics, driving improvements based on data and trends.

  • Evaluate, select, and implement new testing tools and technologies to enhance efficiency and coverage across teams.

3. Healthcare Compliance & Secure Testing

  • Ensure QA practices adhere to healthcare standards (HIPAA, HL7, FHIR) and secure coding guidelines.

  • Validate interoperability and data integrity for systems integrating with EHRs and clinical platforms.

  • Champion compliance and data protection throughout the QA process.

4. Agile Leadership, Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Lead and participate in agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.

  • Mentor and coach QA engineers, fostering technical growth and best practices.

  • Collaborate closely with Product Management, Development, and other functional teams to evaluate, develop, and maintain product features for Provation products.

  • Promote strong communication and teamwork across product, QA, and clinical teams.

5. Problem Solving, Process Improvement & Continuous Learning

  • Apply advanced analytical thinking to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex issues.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to process enhancements across the QA organization.

  • Stay current with industry trends, testing tools, and methodologies, and share insights with the team.

Required Qualifications:

Education & Experience Guidelines

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.

  • 5-8 years of relevant work experience

  • Experience with advanced test automation, cloud platforms (Azure, AWS), and healthcare compliance.

  • Proven experience leading QA teams or initiatives.

  • Occasional travel may be required.

Other Preferred Knowledge, Skills, Abilities or Certifications:

  • Testing Tools: xUnit, WebDriver IO, Playwright, Jasmine.

  • Cloud Platforms: Azure, AWS familiarity; certification is a plus.

  • Healthcare Standards: HIPAA, HL7, FHIR.

  • Version Control & Collaboration Tools: Git, GitHub, Jira.

  • Agile Development: Familiarity with Agile or Scrum methodologies.

  • Certifications: ISTQB, CSTE, or similar QA certifications.

  • Experience mentoring or leading QA engineers and driving quality strategy.

The Strategic Solutions & Story Architecture Lead partners with Business Development, Proposal Management, Clinical Operations, Medical, Biometrics, and Subject Matter Experts to shape compelling customer-facing narratives for clinical development opportunities. The role acts as the story architect for priority pursuits, translating complex scientific, operational, and commercial inputs into a clear, differentiated storyline that connects the sponsor's challenge, the proposed solution, and the organization's value.

This role owns the narrative architecture of bid defense presentations and other strategic pursuit materials. jobs.description:
Help protected areas across Latin America turn data into conservation impact

EarthRanger is used by more than 1,000 protected areas and conservation programs worldwide, and Latin America is growing fast. National park agencies, NGOs, and community-run reserves from Argentina and Brazil to Costa Rica and Honduras rely on EarthRanger to see what is happening across their landscapes in real time: ranger patrols, wildlife tracking, sensors, and field reports brought together on one map.Setting up a site is a first step. The real work is helping a team go from having EarthRanger to relying on it every day to plan patrols, respond to incidents, and show results to the people who fund and govern their work. That is this job.

What will you do?

Help sites succeed, not just get set up

  • Work with protected areas and conservation organizations across Latin America to understand their conservation goals and shape how they use EarthRanger to reach them.
  • Own a set of sites in the region that were set up but never became active, and bring them into daily use. This is a first-year goal we will define with you.
  • Follow up with sites after onboarding, spot where adoption has stalled, and coach teams through the next step: better patrol coverage, cleaner reporting, smarter use of alerts and analysis.
  • Act as the regional voice of the user, feeding what sites need back to our product, documentation, and training teams.

Support and troubleshoot

  • Be a first point of contact for user questions and field issues from the region, resolving them through our ticketing system and keeping clear records. Expect roughly half your time here at the start, shifting toward site success work as you build relationships and the region's self-serve resources grow.
  • Configure and maintain EarthRanger sites: users, event types, patrol types, maps, and integrations with trackers and sensors.
  • Know when a problem needs an engineer, and hand it over with the detail they need.

Train and enable

  • Deliver EarthRanger training to rangers, biologists, analysts, and managers, from one-on-one coaching to multi-day workshops, in Spanish and English.
  • Help build and translate training materials, help-center articles, and short videos for the region.

Support national and multi-site deployments

  • Contribute to large rollouts across many protected areas: scoping, planning, data standards, and follow-through with government and NGO partners.
  • Track your projects and communicate status, risks, and decisions clearly to partners and the internal team.

What we are looking for

Required

  • A conservation foundation. Either hands-on work in conservation or protected areas (ranger, biologist, park or reserve staff, NGO field or program staff), or a demonstrated commitment to conservation through study, volunteering, or community projects combined with experience supporting people who use software.
  • Fluent in spoken and written Spanish and English.
  • A track record of helping others succeed with a tool, a process, or a program: training, support, extension work, community engagement, or teaching.
  • Comfortable learning web and mobile software and explaining it to people who are not, and open to using AI tools every day for drafting, translating, troubleshooting, and learning. You do not need to be a programmer.
  • A self-motivated remote professional with strong time-management skills: able to balance multiple projects simultaneously, structure their own daily schedule, meet deadlines, communicate proactively, and ask for help when needed.
  • Able to travel within Latin America less than 10% of the year.

Bonus

  • Portuguese.
  • Hands-on experience as a user of EarthRanger or SMART. Many sites in the region are moving from SMART to EarthRanger, and knowing how patrol and monitoring data are collected in practice helps a great deal.
  • Experience with GPS trackers, camera traps, or other field monitoring technology.
  • GIS skills (QGIS, ArcGIS) and comfort working with spatial data.
  • Experience working with government agencies or on multi-site, national-scale programs.
  • Experience facilitating workshops or building training materials.
  • Familiarity with data concepts such as spreadsheets, CSV exports, JSON, or APIs, used for troubleshooting rather than coding.

You'll help leading financial institutions and other clients adopt AI in meaningful ways. You'll work directly with clients, engineers, and AI specialists to turn emerging technology into measurable business outcomes. If you enjoy teaching, facilitating, influencing, and helping people embrace new ways of working, we'd love to talk.

The Role

Digible is hiring a Senior Manager, Product Design to define what Product Design is at Digible. This is a player/coach role: roughly three-quarters of your time doing hands-on design across our pods as a shared design resource, and a quarter building the design function — managing and growing our Product Designer, and establishing our design principles, design ops, design system, design career ladder, and design job descriptions from first principles.

Above all, we're looking for an expert in designing data, analytics, and intelligence products: someone who takes dense performance data and makes it engaging, delightful, trustworthy, and AI-forward, so customers want to open it, understand it on their own, and act on it.

You'll be the most senior design voice in the company, partnering with product managers, engineers, agency leaders and leadership to make design a durable competitive advantage — in a company where reporting clarity, customer experience, operational excellence, data storytelling, and trust are the product. You'll lead AI transformation for the design practice, and you'll set the foundations (and the bar) that every future design hire builds on. You'll report to the VP of Product.

We're a small product org inside a profitable, bootstrapped company — nine years successful before the recent AI wave, and now in the middle of an AI transformation, reinventing how an established company operates and thrives in the AI era. Profitability and bootstrapping mean you'll work on real customer and business problems, not a search for product/market fit, with a direct line to an accessible leadership team. Organizations with…

  • 📅 4-day Workweek: we work Mon–Thu, so every weekend is a long weekend

  • 📈 Fast Growth: this isn't a turnaround — 371% three-year growth per the 2025 Inc. 5000 (No. 1,165)
  • 🥾 Bootstrapped Profitability: we control our own destiny, with no investor or burn pressure

What You'll Do:

  • 🎨 Hands-On Design: carry real design work across pods as our shared, senior design resource (~75%)

  • 🧱 Build the Infrastructure: develop, lead, and iterate on our design system and design ops — grounded in best practices — so a small team ships like a big one
  • ✨ AI-Native Function: define what an AI-native design practice looks like, build it into how we work, and lead AI transformation for design at Digible
  • 📡 Design Thought Leadership: be the company's design trend expert — educate the team and leadership on where design and AI are heading

How Success Will Be Measured:

Business Metrics

  • Product CSAT: product design becomes a measurable driver of customer sentiment and satisfaction
  • Data Engagement: customers open, understand, and act on our data on their own, not only when an account manager walks them through it

Function Metrics

No Grupo Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.

Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Processos/Negócios para atuar em um Centro de Excelência de Automação Inteligente que atende um cliente multinacional norte-americano. A pessoa vai trabalhar direto com as áreas de negócio do cliente nos EUA: levantar processos, desenhar soluções de automação com RPA e Inteligência Artificial e acompanhar cada iniciativa da descoberta até a entrada em produção.

  • Conduzir entrevistas, workshops e walkthroughs com stakeholders do cliente, em inglês;
  • Mapear e documentar processos AS-IS e desenhar o TO-BE em BPMN;
  • Elaborar documentação de automação (PDD) e especificações de requisitos;
  • Levantar regras de negócio, exceções e critérios de decisão;
  • Fazer o mapeamento de dados entre sistemas e definir a fonte autorizada de cada informação;
  • Avaliar a viabilidade e o potencial de ROI de novas oportunidades de automação;
  • Apoiar os testes: preparação de massa de dados, definição de cenários e validação com o negócio;
  • Atuar como ponte entre a área de negócio e o time técnico de desenvolvimento;
  • Manter a governança e a atualização da documentação dos processos.

O que precisamos que você tenha de conhecimento:

  • Inglês fluente (C1 ou superior) para conduzir reuniões e produzir documentação formal;
  • Experiência como Analista de Processos, de Negócios ou Business Analyst;
  • Domínio de modelagem BPMN e levantamento de requisitos;
  • Experiência em projetos de RPA ou automação de processos;
  • Boa capacidade analítica e lógica para estruturar regras de negócio;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em horário com sobreposição ao fuso dos EUA﻿.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento de UiPath ou Power Automate
  • Experiência com projetos de IA generativa, agentes ou Document Understanding
  • Vivência com ERPs (Oracle ou similares)
  • SQL básico, Excel avançado, Jira, Confluence e SharePoint
  • Certificações CBAP/CCBA, CBPP/BPM CBOK ou UiPath Business Analyst

Competências comportamentais

  • Autonomia e proatividade na condução de stakeholders
  • Comunicação clara, oral e escrita
  • Organização para conduzir várias frentes ao mesmo tempo
  • Facilidade para traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos

Informações adicionais

🍛 Vale-alimentação ou vale-refeição;

👨🏼‍🎓 Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

📚 Academia Stefanini — plataforma com cursos on-line, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

🗣 Mentoring;

💉 Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

🏥 Assistência médica;

🦷 Assistência odontológica;

💰 Clube de vantagens e descontos nos melhores estabelecimentos;

🛫 Clube de viagens;

🐶 Convênio para pets.

jobs.excerpt: Job Role This is an opportunity to combine commercial ambition with social purpose.
jobs.description:
Job Role

This is an opportunity to combine commercial ambition with social purpose. You’ll help shape Seetec’s growth across London, build partnerships around local needs and work across specialist teams to turn insight into practical public-service solutions.

As our Regional Business Development Lead, you’ll take ownership of the London growth plan, building a balanced pipeline and converting opportunities into contracted revenue. Reporting to the Head of Business Development, you’ll connect with commissioners, funders and partners to understand local priorities, identify unmet needs and shape commercially viable solutions. Working with our operational, Bid, Finance, Commercial and Marketing teams, you’ll help take opportunities from early engagement through procurement and successful handover

In return for your dedication, knowledge, and commitment, we’re offering a competitive salary range £55,000 to £65,000 p.a. (dependent on experience) with these great benefits:

  • 25 days annual leave + Bank Holidays + Birthday Day off (with the opportunity to buy additional days)
  • 2 Volunteer Days
  • Pension - 5% Employee 5% Employer
  • Healthcare Cash Plan, incl. 3 x salary life assurance
  • Annual Salary Increase in line with national average
  • Refer A Friend Scheme
  • Free access to BenefitHub – an online portal with access to a wide range of retail discounts, cycle to work scheme and additional voluntary benefits

There’s also the opportunity to progress your career!

Interested? There’s an easy to apply route below to upload your CV! If you need any further information, talk to our experienced Internal Recruitment Team on 01702 595200.

Seetec is an employee-owned organisation and we continually pride ourselves on our sense of community, both in the incredible work we do throughout UK and Ireland, and internally within our 2,500-strong team. People are at the front, centre and heart of every service we provide and each decision we make.

Location: Remote

Hours: 37 hours a week.

Closing Date: 18 November 2026

Key Responsibilities

•Generate, qualify and convert opportunities to deliver sustainable revenue growth across London.
•Build influential relationships with London boroughs, the Greater London Authority, central government, NHS bodies, funders, prime contractors and voluntary, community and social enterprise organisations.
•Use market, policy and funding intelligence to identify service gaps and shape opportunities ahead of procurement.
•Develop compelling propositions, expressions of interest, presentations and pitches that respond to commissioner needs.
•Build partnerships that strengthen Seetec’s local reach, delivery capability and competitive position.
•Provide evidence-based bid/no-bid recommendations, maintain accurate CRM records and support forecasting and governance.
•Work collaboratively with colleagues to shape deliverable solutions and ensure effective handovers to bid and mobilisation teams.

Skills and Experience

Essential

•Strong knowledge of London’s commissioning and funding landscape, with established relationships with commissioners and London boroughs, alongside experience building relationships with partners and local stakeholders.
•Demonstrable experience in business development, sales, partnerships or growth within public-sector or publicly funded markets.
•A demonstrable track record of originating, developing and converting opportunities into contracted revenue.
•Good understanding of public sector commissioning, procurement and funding, ideally across employability, skills, justice, health or related public services.
•Experience of market engagement, consultative selling, opportunity qualification, proposition development and partnership building.
•Experience of shaping opportunities upstream of procurement, identifying unmet need and developing routes to market.
•Strong commercial awareness, with the ability to consider strategic fit, viability, risk, value and return on investment.

Additional Information

Seetec is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of young people and vulnerable adults and expects all staff to share and uphold this commitment in conjunction with the requirements of the Prevent Duty and the positive promotion of modern British values.

Dependent on the role applying to you may be required to process a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS/DS) check. Seetec support the recruitment of ex- offenders and will not discriminate in any way. Our full policy statement of “Ex-Offenders” can be found on our website under “About us”.

Seetec is an equal opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, or pregnancy and maternity.

jobs.title: Brand Advocacy Program Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Welcome to the Table.  At Sur La Table, community, culinary joy, and celebration are at the heart of who we are.
jobs.description:
Welcome to the Table. At Sur La Table, community, culinary joy, and celebration are at the heart of who we are. From monthly spotlights to the Golden Whisk awards and cooking class perks, our culture blends recognition with hands-on experiences. New team members are welcomed with care and inspired by wellness events, inclusive stories, and a personal touch that makes you feel right at home.

Reports to: Social Media Manager

Location: Remote (US + Canada)

About the Role

    Sur La Table is building The Kitchen Table, a brand ambassador program powered by Duel, and needs someone to operate and grow it from the ground up. As Customer Advocacy Program Specialist, you will be the hands-on, day-to-day operator of the platform — walking advocates through onboarding, building and managing challenges, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring every creator feels supported from first login to first payout.

    In your first 6–12 months, success means advocates are activating smoothly, challenge completion rates are climbing, and you have established repeatable processes for onboarding, campaign execution, and reporting that the Social Media Manager can build on.

    This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.

What You'll Do

    Program Operations

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for advocates getting started on Duel (and additional platforms as the program expands), walking them step-by-step through account creation and store setup.
  • Build, update, QA, and maintain advocate challenges in the platform, ensuring instructions are clear and aligned with program goals.
  • Monitor advocate progression through tiers and identify where members are getting stuck.
  • Keep the program calendar organized across promos, seasonal moments, campaigns, and food holidays.
  • Maintain organized records of challenge status, launch dates, submissions, performance, and follow-ups.
  • Learn the Duel platform deeply and become the day-to-day operator of the software.

    • Challenge Strategy & Campaign Execution

  • Partner with the Social Media Manager to translate marketing priorities into engaging advocate challenges.
  • Support campaign planning and execution for product launches, seasonal moments, promotions, contests, and brand initiatives.
  • Write and refresh challenge copy, prompts, and instructions that are clear, motivating, and social-first.
  • Prioritize challenges that drive affiliate link usage and revenue-driving behavior.
  • Monitor which challenge types drive the strongest engagement, content quality, link usage, and tier progression.

    • Social Media & Content Support

  • Create clear examples, prompts, and best practices that guide advocates toward stronger, platform-native content.
  • Review advocate submissions through both an operational and social lens — checking compliance, link inclusion, and potential reuse across organic social, paid, email, site, or other brand channels.
  • Surface standout UGC to cross-functional teams for potential reuse across marketing channels.
  • Stay aware of social trends and content formats that could inspire stronger advocate participation.

    • Community Engagement & Advocate Activation

  • Support advocate activation by moving members from sign-up to first challenge, first post, first affiliate link, and first revenue-driving action.
  • Monitor community health including engagement, retention, challenge completion, and tier movement.
  • Gather recurring advocate feedback and share opportunities to improve the program experience.
  • Build momentum through timely challenges, recognition opportunities, and clear next steps for advocates.

    • Reporting, Optimization & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Support weekly and monthly reporting for the Social Media Manager, identifying trends, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Use data and advocate behavior to recommend updates to challenges, communications, and program flow.
  • Work closely with Social, Brand Marketing, CRM, Ecommerce, and the Duel team to support program execution and share advocate insights.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in social media marketing, influencer marketing, creator programs, community management, advocacy marketing, affiliate marketing, or a related role.
  • Understanding of major social platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube Shorts, and Facebook.
  • Basic project management skills with the ability to manage calendars, timelines, campaigns, and multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • Experience writing or supporting social-first content prompts, briefs, captions, community prompts, creator challenges, or UGC requests.
  • Highly organized and systems-oriented, able to manage a high volume of individual advocate relationships at once.
  • Comfortable with support/ticketing tools and CRM-style tracking.
  • Willingness to adopt AI-powered workflows as the team's tools evolve.

Why Join

    The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.

  • Real Ownership from Day One: Duel is brand new to Sur La Table. You will shape how thousands of advocates experience the program — a rare level of responsibility that gives you direct influence over its growth and direction.
  • Skill Building & Career Growth: You will develop expertise in advocacy marketing, platform operations, and cross-channel content strategy while working hands-on with tools and workflows that are shaping the future of creator marketing.
  • Visible Impact: You will partner directly with the Social Media Manager and Brand team on a program that is core to Sur La Table's growth strategy this year — real input and real results you can point to.
  • Competitive Benefits (US): Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.
  • Competitive Benefits (Canada): Paid time off policies, RRSP match, medical, dental, and vision coverage, a variety of supplemental benefit options, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.

Interview Process

    1. Recruiter Screen - A 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for.
    2. Hiring Manager Interview - Conversation with the Social Media Manager focused on your experience with advocacy or creator programs, platform operations, and how you approach advocate support.
    3. Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible.
    4. Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate.

    Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly.

Please Note

  • Part of our interview process is a mandatory in-person interview with someone on our team prior to an offer. Candidates that are unwilling or unable to meet for an in-person interview will be removed from consideration immediately.

CSC Generation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to any characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation during the application process, contact .

Employment is contingent on a background check, including verification of prior employment dates.

This posting is for an existing vacancy. This position is not open to and cannot be filled by a B.C. Resident.

The Associate Director, Site Reliability Engineering leads the planning, design, and engineering of enterprise-level operational excellence, transformation and application onboarding across business and IT areas: Insurance and Data

The role leads teams responsible for proactive application and platform support, including digital, enrollment, health, data, Contact Center, cloud infrastructure, and BPO/vendor-supported services. The Associate Director establishes clear operational accountability and ensures teams identify and mitigate service risks before they result in business impact.

jobs.excerpt: The Company We are a leading global company committed to bettering lives through cannabis.
jobs.description:
The Company


We are a leading global company committed to bettering lives through cannabis.

At Canopy Growth, quality, consistency and trust guide everything we grow, make and deliver. From cultivation to consumer, we take a long-term view, with the ambition to help set the standard for the industry.

We're looking for principled, driven people who want to do meaningful work and help shape what comes next. We invest in our people, support their growth and value the different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives they bring.

We believe the best of this industry is still ahead - and we intend to lead it there. Come join us.

The Opportunity


Canopy Growth is seeking a highly analytical and collaborative Sales & Operations Planning Manager, (S&OP) to support and strengthen the company's S&OP process.


Reporting to the Head of S&OP, this role will facilitate key planning reviews, support inventory and business performance objectives, and partner closely with teams across Commercial, Finance, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Procurement, Manufacturing, Cultivation, and Inventory Management.

The successful candidate will develop a deep understanding of how these functions work together to achieve business objectives and help drive greater alignment, accountability, and decision-making across the organization.


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex business challenges, connecting information across multiple functions, and translating insights into actionable recommendations that improve service, inventory performance, operational execution, and overall business results.

Responsibilities

S&OP Leadership & Governance

  • Facilitate the monthly S&OP process, including Portfolio Review, Demand Review, and Supply Review meetings.
  • Coordinate planning activities across Commercial, Finance, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Procurement, Manufacturing, Cultivation, and Inventory Management teams.
  • Consolidate key assumptions, risks, opportunities, and action plans into a clear view of business performance.
  • Ensure decisions and action items from each review are documented, communicated, and tracked to completion.
  • Prepare and coordinate materials that support Executive S&OP discussions and executive decision-making.
  • Escalate business risks, inventory concerns, supply constraints, and cross-functional issues as appropriate.
  • Support the Head of S&OP in aligning operational plans, inventory strategies, and financial objectives.

Business Analysis & Decision Support

  • Develop and maintain scenario planning models to support business decision-making and trade-off discussions.
  • Analyze the operational and financial impacts of planning decisions and identify associated risks and opportunities.
  • Analyze inventory performance and recommend actions to support inventory, service level, freshness, and working capital objectives.
  • Monitor and report on key performance indicators, including forecast accuracy, inventory health, service levels, capacity utilization, and supply chain performance.
  • Provide data-driven insights andrecommendations to support Executive S&OP and broader business discussions.

Business Performance and Continuous Improvement

  • Develop a strong understanding of end-to-end business processes and how decisions across functions impact overall business performance.
  • Identify process gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities to improve operational execution, inventory performance, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Lead and support initiatives that improve planning processes, operational performance, and cross-functional effectiveness.
  • Analyze business performance trends and recommend actions to address root causes and improve outcomes.
  • Promote best practices, accountability, and continuous improvement throughout the S&OP process.

Cross-Functional Collaboration


  • Build strong relationships across all functional areas of the business.
  • Facilitate alignment among stakeholders with competing priorities.
  • Influence outcomes through effective communication and data-driven analysis.
  • Serve as a trusted business partner to leaders across Commercial, Finance, Supply Chain, and Operations.

Experience


  • Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in Supply Chain, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Management, S&OP, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience working within both Demand Planning and Supply Planning environments.
  • Strong understanding of forecasting, inventory management, capacity planning, production planning, and supply chain operations.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional processes and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Experience supporting senior leadership through analysis, business insights, and recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify process improvement opportunities and drive change across multiple functional areas.
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, communication, and facilitation skills.

Other Details


This is a full-time position based remotely within Canada.


Benefits - extended health and dental coverage, paid vacation and participation in our employer-supported retirement savings program.


Salary - $95,000- $110,000


We appreciate your interest, and promise to review all applications, but we will only be contacting those who best fit the requirements.

We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. If you require accommodation, please notify your Talent Acquisition Partner. Please note, the chosen applicant will be required to successfully complete background and reference checks.

Recruitment Process: All applications for this role are reviewed manually; no AI-based screening or ranking tools are used.

jobs.description:
About 2hourglass

2hourglass is a fast, mobile window and door glass repair company based in Pennsylvania. Our technicians go to the customer's home or business and fix broken glass, foggy (failed-seal) glass and window hardware on site, often the same or next day. About 80% of our work is residential and 20% commercial.

Our promise is in the name: speed and certainty. Customers send a photo, get a price, and we fix the one window they need. We don't push them to replace five. That approach has earned us roughly 1,300 five-star Google reviews.

Our biggest opportunity is the homeowners who don't know their window can be repaired at all, so they live with it. Our new website is live. Over the next 6–12 months we're improving its conversion, sharpening our Google and Facebook ads, and launching email and SMS follow-up. Over the next 2–3 years we want a marketing machine that runs without depending on the founder. This role is the first step toward that.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a results-driven, hands-on person to join our team. The role is remote, part-time, and headquartered in Pennsylvania (US Eastern time).

The role

As our Marketing Coordinator, you'll plan, coordinate and carry out our marketing across the website, Google Ads, Facebook/Meta, email, SMS and reviews. You'll be our first and only in-house marketing person.

You'll work directly with the founder. He sets the strategy and big-picture goals; you own the day-to-day execution and keep projects moving. We also work with an outside marketing coach, so you'll have a clear plan and support.

Hours

Starts at 20 hours/week, with potential to grow toward full-time

Location

Remote; overlap with US Eastern business hours required

Reports to

Founder

Pay

[$25–35/hour] depending on experience

You'll need to organize, plan and structure your own workload. We don't have the time or the inclination to micromanage. You'll get a lot of freedom and a lot of responsibility.

What you'll do

  1. Website performance and metrics (top priority). Our new website is live. Track how it and our Google Ads landing pages perform (traffic, bounce rate, calls and quote requests) and make the adjustments the numbers call for: copy, offers, reviews and calls to action. Keep each county and service page current and working.
  2. Paid ads coordination. Support our Google Ads (people ready to book now) and Facebook/Meta ads (people who don't know repair is possible). Brief and manage ad creative, and work with any outside agency or freelancer.
  3. Content and social media. Plan and run a content calendar that teaches homeowners their broken, foggy or sticking windows can be repaired. Create, schedule and post content, reply to comments, and repurpose content across channels.
  4. Copywriting. Write and edit copy for the website, ads, emails, SMS and social posts in a clear, friendly, local-business voice.
  5. Email, SMS and CRM. Build and manage welcome, follow-up and reactivation campaigns in our CRM (Close). Re-engage stalled leads and past customers.
  6. Reviews and social proof. Turn our ~1,300 five-star Google reviews into marketing assets. Keep our Google Business Profile active and fresh.
  7. Offers and referrals. Help launch and promote a low-cost entry offer and simple referral and repeat-customer programs.
  8. Tracking and reporting. Maintain a weekly marketing dashboard: leads by source, cost per lead and per job, landing-page performance and ad return. Flag what's working and what isn't.
  9. Project management. Create and keep project timelines, manage freelancers and vendors, and make sure campaigns ship on time.
  10. Coordination with the team. Work with the founder and office team so marketing, lead follow-up and scheduling stay aligned.

Your first 90 days

By day 90, we should see clearly which marketing produces booked jobs, and the website should be converting better than at your start.

Timeframe

What success looks like

Days 1–30

You know our services, customers, brand and tools (Close CRM, website, ad accounts). Our weekly marketing dashboard is up to date. Stalled leads from Facebook have been followed up.

Days 31–60

You've set a baseline for website and landing-page conversion and made a first round of data-driven adjustments, such as stronger use of our reviews and the "send a photo, get a price" offer. A content calendar is running on Facebook.

Days 61–90

Website and landing-page conversion has improved against the day-30 baseline. Welcome and reactivation email/SMS sequences are live. The entry offer and a referral program are launched. You present a monthly results report to the founder.

What we're looking for

The six non-negotiables

  • Copywriting. You'll write for the web, ads, email, SMS and social media. Your writing must be excellent, and we'll ask for samples.
  • Tech-savvy. You don't need to be a technical expert, but you pick up new tools fast: CRMs, website builders, ad platforms, email tools and AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity.
  • Project management. You set deadlines, keep them, and move several projects forward at once.
  • Self-starter. Goals will be clear. Often it'll be up to you to decide what needs to happen, when and how, and then do it without being chased.
  • Teachable and coachable. We do marketing differently, and there's a lot to learn on the job. We hire mainly on attitude.
  • Leadership potential. You'll start as our only marketer. As you hit goals, we expect this role to grow into leading a small marketing team.

Nice to have

  • Experience marketing a local or home-services business (trades, cleaning, HVAC, roofing, real estate)

  • Experience with Close or a similar CRM, and with email/SMS automations

Perks of the job

  • Real ownership: your work goes live fast and you'll see its impact on booked jobs

jobs.excerpt: About the role We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the product direction for the AI & Query Platform team, the team responsible for advancing Nucleus’s AI and query capabilities.
jobs.description:
About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the product direction for the AI & Query Platform team, the team responsible for advancing Nucleus’s AI and query capabilities.

This role sits at the intersection of AI, data, analytics, and cybersecurity. You’ll own products that change how users interact with security data, from querying and exploring complex datasets to using natural language and AI agents to accomplish increasingly sophisticated agentic workflows.

You’ll work closely with engineering and design to determine what we build, why we build it, and how foundational capabilities become intuitive, valuable customer experiences.

What you’ll own

  • Product strategy and roadmap for the AI & Query Platform team.

  • The evolution of our query and data exploration capabilities.

  • AI-powered experiences and agent capabilities.

  • Core AI platform capabilities to be reused across the broader Nucleus platform.

  • Discovery and prioritization of new AI, analytics, and data-driven customer use cases.

  • Product requirements and tradeoffs across usability, performance, reliability, flexibility, and technical complexity.

  • Early-access and customer feedback programs that help us validate new capabilities before broader rollout.

  • Success measures for AI and query capabilities and the feedback loops needed to continuously improve them.

What you’ll do

  • Develop a deep understanding of how security teams work with vulnerability and exposure data and identify opportunities where AI and better data interaction can fundamentally improve those workflows.

  • Partner closely with engineers on APIs, datasets, schemas, query capabilities, agent tools, and other platform primitives.

  • Translate technical capabilities into product experiences customers can understand and use.

  • Take ambiguous ideas from discovery through definition, validation, delivery, and adoption.

  • Determine when we should build a specific customer experience versus a reusable platform capability.

  • Define and evaluate the quality of AI-powered experiences, including cases where traditional deterministic acceptance criteria aren’t sufficient.

  • Work directly with customers and internal teams to understand problems, validate solutions, and prioritize investments.

  • Maintain a clear roadmap while adapting quickly as AI technology, customer expectations, and the cybersecurity market evolve.

  • Communicate product direction and tradeoffs clearly across engineering, design, go-to-market teams, and leadership.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with meaningful ownership of a technical B2B or enterprise software product.

  • Experience shipping AI/LLM-powered, data, analytics, search, query, developer-platform, or similarly technical products.

  • Strong technical fluency. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable working closely with engineers on APIs, schemas, datasets, query behavior, integrations, and system capabilities.

  • Experience taking technically sophisticated capabilities and turning them into intuitive product experiences.

  • Strong product judgment and the ability to prioritize based on customer value rather than technical novelty.

  • Experience operating in ambiguous problem spaces where both the technology and customer expectations are changing quickly.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and an ability to explain complex technical concepts simply.

  • A demonstrated ability to work directly with customers and translate customer problems into product opportunities.

We’d be especially excited if you have

  • Experience building AI agents, copilots, natural-language interfaces, or LLM-powered enterprise applications.

  • Experience with SQL, query languages, analytics platforms, search products, or data visualization.

  • Experience building platform functionality consumed by multiple product teams.

  • Experience defining evaluation or quality frameworks for nondeterministic AI functionality.

  • Familiarity with modern agent concepts such as tool or function calling, retrieval, context management, agent orchestration, or MCP.

  • Cybersecurity, vulnerability management, exposure management, or security analytics experience.

A candid note about the role

This role will get technical. You won’t be expected to write production code, but you will regularly work with engineers on datasets, schemas, APIs, query behavior, agent tools, and AI system behavior. You should enjoy getting into those details while remaining focused on the customer problem we’re solving.

Why You Should Be Excited

  • 100% company-paid health, dental, vision, life, and short-term disability insurance options
  • Generous 401k contribution (not a match)
  • Flexible PTO + 10 company holidays
  • Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed startup
  • Fantastic company culture
  • Work on a truly unique, market- defining product

Additional Information
At Nucleus we are committed to achieving excellence in our field by combining diversity, collaboration, teamwork, and pride in our work. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability.

For that to work, getting into these assets has to be simple, fast and affordable. Our goal is to give every Tether Wallet user the best option to exchange any local currency or token into USDT and XAUT, wherever they are.

In this role, you will define and own the strategy for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT across our target markets. You will work hand in hand with our expansion teams to map the payment landscape in each market: which payment methods people actually use, which card schemes and bank rails dominate, and which on-ramp and swap providers can serve them. Based on that, you will identify the best partner for each market and bring them on board as a service partner of Tether Wallet.

This role sits at the intersection of product, payments and partnerships. jobs.description:
About Improvado

Improvado is a marketing data and AI analytics platform for enterprise brands and agencies. We connect 500+ marketing and sales data sources, normalize them through a governed data model, and put an AI agent on top so marketing teams can ask questions of their own data without going through BI or IT.

What we sell: extraction and 500+ connectors; data transformation (SQL and dbt-compatible); Marketing Data Governance — taxonomy, naming, data-quality rules; warehouse and storage; dashboards; AI agent and MCP access to live marketing data; DECS, data engineering as a service on a 2 to 4 week SLA.

Who buys it:

  • Economic buyers: CMO, VP Marketing, VP Demand Gen, agency COO and ops leadership
  • Technical evaluators: VP or Director of Marketing Analytics, marketing analysts, data engineering, sometimes IT and security
  • Segments: enterprise brands, mid-market, agencies
  • Verticals: pharma and healthcare, financial services, retail and eCommerce, gaming, agencies

Why this role, now

  • Our messaging is not aligned. Positioning, web, sales pitch, product and content each carry a different version of what Improvado is. The market categorizes us as "marketing ETL" while we position as an AI marketing analytics platform. That gap costs us deal quality and price.
  • The category is crowded and moving fast. Battlecards exist but decay, and nobody owns keeping them true.
  • Attribution, incrementality and causal measurement is where deals are won and lost — and it is the hardest thing to argue credibly without hand-waving.
  • Analyst firms are a silent blocker. When an enterprise buyer asks Gartner or Forrester about Improvado, there is no briefed narrative waiting for them.

You would not start from a blank page. We already have a positioning registry, roughly 11 documented buyer personas, a pain-point and value-prop library, competitor intel reports and about 10 battlecards. They are inconsistent and under-used. Your first job is to make one version true and make people use it.

What you'll own

  • Positioning and messaging. Core positioning, category framing and message hierarchy across ICPs and personas. ICP and persona documentation that is used, not filed. The messaging layer of new product and feature launches, including the internal rollout that makes the field able to sell it.
  • Competitive intelligence and win/loss. A structured win/loss interview program with quarterly readouts. Living battlecards. Monitoring competitor positioning, pricing and product moves, and driving our counter-positioning.
  • Sales enablement. The core pitch narrative, demo storyline and objection-handling framework. The messaging components of new-rep onboarding. A standing weekly cadence with Sales leadership — not quarterly check-ins. Direct support on competitive and enterprise deals: RFPs, security and technical evaluations, displacement plays.
  • Market and analyst relations. The Improvado narrative for Gartner, Forrester and category influencers, so that a buyer's analyst call becomes an accelerator rather than a blocker. Feeding structured market and buyer insight back into product prioritization.

What we're looking for

  • 4 to 8 years in product marketing, or an equivalent blend of product marketing with marketing analytics, marketing or data ops, sales engineering, analytics consulting, or product management on a data product.
  • Category fluency in marketing data and measurement: attribution models, incrementality testing, MMM, data governance and taxonomy, warehouses and ETL/ELT — including where each is honestly weak.
  • B2B SaaS sold to marketing or data buyers. Marketing analytics, martech, measurement, CDP, BI and data-infrastructure vendors are the reference profile.
  • Proof you have shipped, not just documented: positioning that changed the website and the pitch, battlecards reps actually opened, a win/loss program that survived past its second quarter.
  • Writing that survives contact with a skeptical technical buyer — claim and evidence, not adjective stacking.

This is a unique opportunity to work directly with EDB’s senior Finance leadership, with high visibility and a genuine position of influence over critical functions.

The ideal candidate is a controls-minded treasury and tax professional who has personally run payment, banking and indirect tax operations for a multi-entity, multi-currency business, takes ownership without needing direction, and keeps a lean function accurate, secure and audit-ready.

What your impact will be:

Payment Controls & Treasury Operations

  • Oversee the approval workflow for payments across global bank accounts, ensuring payments are in compliance with approval limits, segregation of duties and company policy.
  • Own the payment request process, escalate unusual or out-of-policy requests, and work with banks and internal stakeholders to resolve rejected, delayed or failed payments.
  • Maintain the payment approval matrices and authority limits.
  • Schedule and execute debt service payments, including interest, repayments and agency fees.
  • Support the bank reconciliations process, resolve treasury-related queries, and support internal and external audit requests related to treasury controls.

Bank Administration & Access Controls

  • Process user access updates for bank portals and treasury systems based on leadership approvals, applying role-based permissions on the principle of least privilege.
  • Remove access promptly for leavers and role changes, and perform periodic user access reviews across all banking platforms.
  • Partner with Legal to add or remove authorized signatories, preparing and tracking board resolutions, incumbency certificates and bank mandates.
  • Own day-to-day bank KYC and AML requirements, including account openings, periodic refreshes and lender requests, partnering with Legal on entity documentation.
  • Maintain an up-to-date signatory register across all entities, accounts and banks.

Cash Management & Investments

  • Partner with FP&A on the consolidated 13-week cash flow forecast, reviewing bank data feeds for accuracy and providing insight on cash positioning, timing and opportunities to optimize liquidity.
  • Coordinate intercompany funding across EDB’s global entities, assessing entity-level cash needs, executing funding movements and maintaining the funding log, working with regional accounting teams.
  • Execute approved short-term cash investments, including money market and deposit activity, monitoring yields, liquidity and counterparty exposure.
  • Prepare regular treasury reporting for senior leadership, covering cash position, liquidity, investments and bank counterparty exposure.
  • Champion automation and AI to continuously improve treasury and tax processes, documentation and controls.

Tax Operations

  • Prepare data and coordinate filings for US sales and use tax, including returns, nexus monitoring and new state registrations, and support indirect tax compliance globally.
  • Prepare corporate income tax estimates, and execute and track tax payments, including withholding tax on cross-border payments.
  • Coordinate R&D tax credit claims with our external advisors, gathering qualifying payroll, contractor and project data from Engineering and People.
  • Serve as the primary operational contact for our external tax providers, managing data requests and deadlines, and helping us use them more efficiently.
  • Support intercompany settlements in line with our transfer pricing policy.
  • Take a leading role on indirect tax matters for acquisitions and integrations, and support ad hoc tax and transfer pricing projects.

What you will bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in treasury, tax or a closely related finance role in a multi-entity, multi-currency environment.
  • Strong understanding of payment controls, segregation of duties and user access governance.
  • Experience preparing bank documentation (KYC, mandates, incumbency certificates, signatory changes) across multiple banking partners and jurisdictions.
  • Familiarity with cross-border payments, withholding tax, intercompany settlements and short-term cash investments.
  • Advanced Excel skills; experience with Avalara & NetSuite strongly preferred
  • Experience in a high-growth or private-equity-backed technology company strongly preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting or a related discipline

What will give you an edge:

  • Hands-on experience overseeing payment approval workflows and administering multi-bank portals; CitiDirect or comparable platforms a plus.
  • Hands-on experience with US sales and use tax compliance, including multi-state registrations and filings; exposure to global indirect tax (VAT/GST) a plus.
  • Experience with Pigment or a comparable planning tool a plus.
  • Professional qualification in treasury (AMCT or CTP), tax (CTA, or IPT’s CMI in sales and use tax) or accounting (CPA, ACA, ACCA or CIMA), completed or in progress, a plus.

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. This is the most-trafficked real estate in the product. From the moment a subscriber opens the app to the moment they complete their order, every screen they touch — the home screen, search, menu, collections, product detail pages, and cart — falls within this role's remit. You'll own the product vision, roadmap, and execution across all of it.

You'll work closely with Design, Engineering, Data Science, and Merchandising to make the discovery experience feel effortless, personal, and exciting.

What You'll Do

Elevate the UX

Navigate the Frontend/Intelligence Seam

Drive Measurable Business Impact

  • Reduce checkout abandonment and cart-to-order friction.

jobs.description:
About Fortellar

We are a boutique IT consulting and business process outsourcing organization supporting mid to enterprise-level organizations. We are a small, but mighty, team of experts who know how to stretch, adapt, and put on any hat required in the moment to make our clients successful and enable Fortellar’s growth. Keys to success at Fortellar include:

  • Collaboration: You demonstrate excellence in remote collaboration across your Fortellar and client teams.
  • Growth Mindset: You embrace personal growth and are always learning new things to support your team, your clients, and your personal goals.
  • Client Success: You have a passion for your client’s success – you don’t just deliver to the contract you ensure that your client’s goals and needs are met.
  • Humanity First: Honest and transparency are your natural instincts – your actions speak louder than your words and your team members love working with you.
  • Entrepreneurial: You find a way to get it done, no matter what the challenges or seeming blockers are in front of you
Job Description Summary

The Sr. Security Engineer, Identity & Endpoint designs, deploys, and operates identity, privileged access, vulnerability, endpoint, and device trust controls for Fortellar's clients, with primary assignment to large-scale, multi-workstream security remediation engagements. The role typically carries the largest and most dependency-critical share of such a program: the conditional access design this engineer produces is what gates device-compliance enforcement, and that sequence is commonly the longest critical path in the delivery plan. Engagements involve hybrid identity estates spanning Microsoft Entra ID and on-premises Active Directory joined by directory synchronization, managed workstation and Windows Server estates, Microsoft Intune, and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

This is a hands-on engineering role with direct client exposure. The engineer is accountable for changes capable of denying access to the client's entire workforce, and is expected to exercise the judgment to pilot, stage, and where necessary halt a rollout, and to explain that decision to client stakeholders directly. The role requires deep Microsoft identity and endpoint expertise, disciplined change management, strong verbal and written communication, and the professional presence to represent Fortellar credibly in front of client technical staff and executives, both in person and virtually.

Must be able to travel 10% - 20% to client sites

Identity and Privileged Access Engineering
  • Design and enforce phishing-resistant multifactor authentication for administrators and multifactor authentication for the full user population, using modern authentication methods (e.g., FIDO2 security keys, Windows Hello for Business, passkeys).
  • Reduce privileged directory role membership to a justified minimum, remove dormant and stale accounts from sensitive groups, and produce the privileged-overlap map between Microsoft Entra ID and on-premises Active Directory.
  • Remediate domain-dominance exposure, including krbtgt account rotation, removal of delegation from privileged accounts, and migration of the directory synchronization connector onto a dedicated least-privilege identity.
  • Redesign Conditional Access around defined user and administrator personas and apply role-based access control, recognizing that this design is a prerequisite for device trust enforcement elsewhere in the program.
  • Implement Privileged Identity Management with just-in-time elevation, and enforce sign-in frequency and non-persistent administrator sessions.
  • Evaluate, select, deploy, and operate privileged access management and identity governance capability, and establish quarterly access recertification as a sustainable business-as-usual process.
Vulnerability, Endpoint, and Asset Management
  • Remediate, as emergency change, the recommendations carrying published exploit code and observed exploitation in the wild, working within the client's emergency change authority.
  • Author and publish a vulnerability management procedure and a workstation patch service level matching the standard already operating for servers.
  • Deploy Windows Autopatch and Microsoft Intune update rings, and reconcile the Active Directory, Intune, and Defender device populations into a single authoritative asset inventory.
  • Complete application dependency mapping, then retire legacy authentication protocols and enforce LDAP server signing and channel binding, sequencing the work so that dependency discovery precedes enforcement.
  • Deploy security baselines in staged waves across the managed endpoint estate and remove or formally risk-accept end-of-support systems and software.
  • Close local administrator credential management gaps across the estate and operate certificate lifecycle management with expiry alerting and unauthorized-software detection.
  • Review exposure score, remediation activity, and threat intelligence on a defined cadence, prioritizing by exploit availability and observed threat activity rather than by severity score alone.
Device Trust and Mobile Device Management
  • Enforce the client's ratified bring-your-own-device position, including restriction of corporate content synchronization to managed devices.
  • Deploy Microsoft Intune application protection policies across the Microsoft 365 mobile applications and execute the mobile application and device management plan across a previously unmanaged mobile estate.
  • Harden connected software-as-a-service applications, including multifactor authentication enforcement and session timeout configuration.
  • Require a compliant or hybrid-joined device through Conditional Access, enable remote wipe for devices holding organizational data, and apply session controls for unmanaged browsers.
  • Establish the device attestation cycle within joiner, mover, and leaver processes, and report on unmanaged access attempts on a defined cadence.
Change Management and Operational Safety
  • Design and operate pilot rings and staged rollouts for every change capable of denying user or administrator access, with documented rollback and tested break-glass accounts.
  • Prepare, submit, and present change records to the client's change process, including risk, blast radius, validation steps, and backout plan.
  • Execute change during scheduled maintenance windows, including evenings and weekends where the change cannot safely be made during business hours.
  • Halt or defer a rollout where validation is incomplete and communicate that decision and its schedule consequence to the engagement lead and the client without delay.
Experience and Education
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security or a related field
  • Preferred certifications: SC-300, MD-102, AZ-500, SC-100 or CISSP
  • 8+ years in infrastructure or security engineering, including 5+ years in hybrid identity (Entra ID and on-premises AD)
  • 4+ years deploying Microsoft Intune and Defender for Endpoint at enterprise scale
  • Proven experience designing Conditional Access, phishing-resistant MFA and Privileged Identity Management for 1,000+ users
  • 3+ years in a client-facing consulting role, presenting to technical and executive stakeholders
  • Track record of leading high-risk changes through formal change management, using pilots, staged rollouts and rollback plans

This role is open only to candidates who currently live and are authorized to work in the United States. Applications must be submitted from within the U.S. Applications submitted from a location that does not match the candidate’s stated location will not be considered.

About OSS

Oxbridge Summer Scholars(OSS) runs two-week residential summer and winter programmes in Oxford and Cambridge colleges for students aged 14 to 18. Students explore their chosen stream, build university-study skills and experience Oxbridge life through rigorous lectures, seminars and tutorials. Each student writes an essay and receives detailed individual feedback from a subject specialist; the strongest essays earn Excellence Awards.

Role Purpose

We are seeking a Law, Politics & International Relations Academic Consultant to join our team. This is a subject-matter specialist who provides expert academic input into the OSS Science, Innovation & Technology Stream. This stream focuses specifically on Law, Politics, International Relations and Philosophy.

Working alongside the Academic Curriculum Manager and Head of Programme, the Consultant supports the development, review and continuous improvement of Stream content. The Consultant does not own curriculum development; their role is to provide specialist expertise, quality assurance and assessment support to ensure that the programme reflects appropriate academic standards, current developments and expectations relevant to pre-university study.

A key responsibility is to assess student essays and provide detailed, individualised academic feedback, contributing to both the educational value of the programme and the quality of the student experience.

Engagement

Location: Fully remote. No travel to Oxford or Cambridge is required.

  • Outside programme dates: Up to 10 hours per week, on an on-demand basis, depending on programme development requirements.

  • During programme dates and the following week: Up to 30 hours in total, primarily dedicated to student essay assessment and feedback. Essay submission deadlines and expected workload will be communicated in advance.

OSS Programme Dates for 2026/27

  • December 6-19, 2026

  • July 4-17, 2027

  • July 18-31, 2027

  • August 1-14, 2027

Responsibilities

1. Subject-Matter Consultation & Content Development

  • Provide expert advice to the Academic Curriculum Manager and Head of Programme on the academic content of the Law, Politics & International Relations Stream.

  • Advise on appropriate topics, concepts, theories, cases, debates and current developments across law, politics and international relations.

  • Recommend subject-specific approaches and academic skills that would be valuable for students preparing for university-level study.

  • Review proposed content and suggest improvements where specialist expertise would strengthen the programme.

2. Academic Quality Assurance

  • Review selected lectures, seminars, tutorials, learning materials and other academic content from a subject-specialist perspective.

  • Check content for academic accuracy, relevance, appropriate depth and level.

  • Identify gaps, inaccuracies or areas requiring clarification or further development.

  • Support the Academic Curriculum Manager and Head of Programme in maintaining a high and consistent academic standard across the Stream.

3. Essay & Assessment Framework

  • Provide subject-specific input into the development of essay questions and prompts.

  • Advise on the academic skills and competencies students should demonstrate, including critical analysis, construction of arguments, evaluation of competing perspectives, use of evidence and clear academic reasoning.

  • Contribute to Stream-specific assessment criteria and feedback guidelines.

  • Help establish a clear standard for strong pre-university academic work within the Stream.

4. Essay Assessment & Individualised Feedback

  • Assess student essays according to the agreed Stream-specific criteria.

  • Within 24 hours of the essay submission deadline (2pm on Wednesday of the second week for each programme), review all essays and nominate those that merit an Excellence Award. Expected workload will be communicated in advance.

  • Provide detailed, constructive and individualised written feedback, highlighting strengths, areas for development and practical recommendations for improvement. Return this within five working days of the programme finishing.

  • Maintain consistency in applying the agreed assessment criteria across students and programme intakes.

For example, our first July programme next year runs 4-17 July 2027. Students must submit their essay by 2pm (UK time) on Wednesday 14 July. Consultants complete a first review of essays, nominating those that merit an Excellence Award, by 2pm on Thursday 15 July. Their full written feedback for each essay is due by 5pm Friday 23 July.

5. Programme Improvement & Collaboration

  • Identify recurring strengths, challenges or learning needs emerging from student work and share relevant observations with the Academic Curriculum Manager.

  • Collaborate with Academic Consultants from other Streams to improve OSS's overall essay assessment and feedback process.

  • Contribute subject-specific recommendations to the continuous improvement of the Programme.

What we’re looking for

Essential

  • Deep subject knowledge in at least one area covered by the stream, with a broad grasp of adjacent areas.

  • Excellent written communication, with the ability to give detailed, individual feedback that is encouraging but honest.

Desirable

  • Experience teaching, lecturing, supervising or assessing students at university or sixth-form level.

  • Experience marking written work against set criteria and giving clear, constructive feedback.

  • Active research, publications or industry experience that brings real-world perspective to the stream.
