Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We are looking for Developer Productivity Engineer to help QVAC application teams develop, review, test, and deliver reliable software with less friction. Your focus will be our desktop and mobile applications and their shared runtime, AI harness, and skills packages. You will build and maintain developer tools, integrate AI agents into engineering workflows, and improve code quality and delivery automation.

This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape the tooling roadmap. You will work with engineers to identify useful improvements and own them from implementation through adoption and ongoing support. Success means shorter feedback loops, dependable automation, and tools that developers trust and use.

Responsibilities

  • Evaluate, integrate, and maintain developer tools and AI agents, including the repository guidance and integrations they need to work effectively.

  • Build and operate agents in CI and scheduled workflows that investigate failures, propose fixes, and give engineers evidence they can act on.

  • Improve automated pull request reviews, evaluating finding accuracy and reducing noise for reviewers.

  • Develop code quality scripts and checks for complexity, function and file size, dependency cycles, and performance regressions. Work with package owners on practical thresholds and targeted refactoring.

  • Improve development environments, testing, and build and release workflows so engineers and agents can verify changes reliably.

  • Prioritize improvements with engineering teams, support adoption through documentation and onboarding, and measure effectiveness, reliability, and operating costs.

Example projects include agents that investigate CI failures, diagnose compatibility and performance regressions, and flag changes that affect package interfaces or architecture. You will choose and refine these workflows with the engineers who use them.

Requirements

  • Experience building and maintaining developer tools or engineering automation used by others, with strong JavaScript/TypeScript and skills.

  • Hands-on experience using and integrating AI coding tools or agents, with sound judgment about their limitations, output validation, and human review.

  • Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, and systematic debugging of build, test, or integration failures.

  • A strong approach to code quality: maintainable code, useful automated checks, and refactoring that preserves behavior.

  • Ability to work independently, collaborate with engineers, and communicate clearly in English within a remote, globally distributed team.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

DSP Engineer


Build audio technology that brings better sound to more people.

At Bose, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth. As a DSP Engineer, you’ll help bring that belief to life - developing audio technologies that enable our brands and partners around the world to deliver distinctive listening experiences.

If you enjoy exploring how sound works, solving practical engineering problems, and turning algorithms into working technology, this is an opportunity to grow your skills while contributing to audio experiences that reach beyond Bose products.

You’ll join our engineering team, helping develop signal processing algorithms that can work across a wide range of products and platforms. From noise reduction and voice pickup to spatial audio and speech enhancement, your work will help make audio clearer, more immersive, and more useful.

You’ll collaborate with senior DSP engineers, software and platform teams, and external partners to take algorithms from development through integration and testing. Along the way, you’ll learn how to make audio technologies robust, portable, and efficient across different hardware and software environments - with ownership of meaningful technical deliverables.


What You’ll Do

jobs.excerpt: Our MissionOur mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS.
jobs.description:
Our Mission

Our mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS. Come be part of remarkable.

Overview

How you can make a difference

As a Principal Cloud Security Engineer, Product Security, you provide technical leadership for the security of the cloud environments that host HealthEquity's products and platforms. Reporting to the VP, Head of Product Security, you design the posture management, policy-as-code guardrails, and automated controls that keep misconfigured and overexposed resources out of production across our environments.

You combine hands-on cloud engineering with sound architectural judgment. You define cloud security standards and reference architectures, build preventive and detective controls as code, and work with product and platform engineering teams so that secure patterns are the default path rather than a late-stage review. Your application security and threat modeling background keeps those controls tied to how HealthEquity's products are built and how they could be attacked.

The standards, guardrails, and automation you establish reduce public attack surface, shorten the time from detection to remediation, and let engineering teams deliver securely with less manual effort, in support of HealthEquity's responsibility to protect member data.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead the architecture and ongoing evolution of cloud security posture management across a large multi-subscription estate, using CNAPP/CSPM tooling to surface public exposure, misconfiguration, and risk, and driving prioritized remediation with product and platform teams.
  • Design and build policy-as-code preventive guardrails, including service control policies, Azure Policy, and infrastructure-as-code validation in CI/CD, that block non-compliant infrastructure before it reaches production while applying defense-in-depth.
  • Own the security architecture for cloud landing zones and account and subscription provisioning, so that newly created environments inherit security baselines, guardrails, and logging by default.
  • Build event-driven auto-remediation that enforces security and compliance baselines at scale, and define when automated action is appropriate and when human review is required.
  • Lead network exposure reduction for customer-facing applications, including web application firewall rule management, tighter security group and network security group ingress, and a move toward private connectivity.
  • Define and evolve the IAM strategy for Azure, AWS, and GCP including federated identity, standardized SSO, least privilege, conditional access, and reduction of standing privilege.
  • Lead threat modeling and architecture reviews for high-risk, cloud-hosted products and migrations, and scope and coordinate third-party penetration tests and audits, translating findings into prioritized remediation plans for engineering and executive stakeholders.
  • Partner with Application Security and Vulnerability Management to build code scanning, secret detection, dependency analysis, and software supply chain controls into developer workflows and release gates, and support external researcher and bug bounty programs through scope, triage, and remediation SLAs.
  • Establish security guardrails, governance requirements, and secure-adoption policy for AI services and AI-enabled development tooling in cloud environments, including managed model guardrails and Model Context Protocol (MCP) security.
  • Set technical direction, identify systemic risks, recommend strategic improvements, and mentor and guide security engineers while driving the evolution of team tools, practices, standards, and automation capabilities.

What you will need to be successful

This role requires deep, hands-on experience securing production cloud environments at enterprise scale, combined with the architectural judgment that comes from an application security background and the ability to provide technical leadership across teams.

Cloud Security Engineering Expertise

  • Extensive experience architecting, building, and operating cloud security controls in production AWS and Azure environments, including multi-account and multi-subscription estates.
  • Deep experience with CNAPP/CSPM platforms for posture management, exposure and attack-surface management, and risk-based prioritization of findings.
  • Advanced proficiency with policy-as-code and preventive guardrails, such as SCPs, AWS Config rules, CloudFormation Guard, Azure Policy, and security validation of infrastructure-as-code (CloudFormation, CDK) within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS and Azure native security services, including Control Tower, Organizations, Security Hub, GuardDuty, Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, and cloud WAF and firewall services.
  • Experience designing and operating event-driven automated remediation and detection that enforces security baselines across a cloud estate.
  • Strong understanding of cloud network security, including security groups and NSGs, WAF, API gateways, and private connectivity patterns.
  • Proficiency in Python, PowerShell, and Bash for security automation and tooling.

Identity, Application & AI Security Expertise

  • Advanced knowledge of cloud identity and access management, including federated identity, SSO, SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, least privilege, and conditional access.
  • Strong foundation in application security, including threat modeling (STRIDE, attack trees), architectural security reviews, secure code review, OWASP Top 10, and CWE Top 25.
  • Experience building vulnerability management and software supply chain programs, including SAST, secret scanning, software composition analysis, and triage and prioritization workflows that give developers actionable feedback.
  • Working knowledge of the security risks of AI and LLM technologies, including model guardrails, MCP, and AI-assisted development tools, and the controls needed to adopt them safely.
  • Hands-on understanding of penetration testing and offensive security findings sufficient to scope engagements, evaluate results, and drive remediation.

Experience & Background

  • 12+ years of experience in cloud security, security engineering, application security, or a closely related discipline, including significant time securing production cloud environments.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting, delivering, and operating security solutions with broad organizational impact across a large cloud estate and many development teams.
  • Experience serving as a technical lead and mentoring engineers, and leading initiatives across cross-functional engineering and security teams without relying on direct authority.
  • Ability to influence technical direction and clearly explain complex risks, tradeoffs, and findings to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leaders.
  • Exceptional judgment in balancing security requirements with engineering practicality, business needs, and long-term platform strategy.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience defining and scaling security capabilities within CI/CD pipelines and developer workflows.
  • Experience designing and operating a bug bounty or vulnerability disclosure program.
  • Experience in healthcare, financial services, or another highly regulated industry.
  • Strong working knowledge of HIPAA, SOC 2, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, or similar regulatory and security frameworks.
  • Relevant industry certifications such as AWS Certified Security - Specialty, Microsoft Azure security certifications, CCSP, CISSP, or comparable credentials.

This is a remote position.

Salary Range

$159000.00 To $210500.00 / year

Benefits & Perks

The actual compensation offer is determined based on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and work location. This position will be eligible for performance-based incentives and restricted stock units as part of the total compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision
  • HSA contribution and match
  • Dependent care FSA match
  • Uncapped paid time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) match
  • Personal and healthcare financial literacy programs
  • Ongoing education & tuition assistance
  • Gym and fitness reimbursement
  • Wellness program incentives

jobs.excerpt: Die VGL Publishing AG betreibt seit 2014 mit Vergleich.
jobs.description:
Die VGL Publishing AG betreibt seit 2014 mit Vergleich.org, eines der führenden Vergleichs- und Ratgeberportale in Deutschland, sowie weitere Portfolio-Seiten.
Jeden Monat helfen wir mehreren Millionen Menschen, gute Kaufentscheidungen zu treffen: mit Produktvergleichen, Tests, Produktdetailseiten und Ratgebern.
Die Suche verändert sich gerade so stark wie seit Jahren nicht. Google baut AI Overviews ein, und immer mehr Menschen fragen ChatGPT, Gemini oder Claude, bevor sie etwas kaufen. Wir finden das spannend, denn wer jetzt verlässlich die besten Antworten liefert, wird zur ersten Adresse für Menschen und KI-Suchen. Genau daran wollen wir mit dir arbeiten.
In dieser Rolle bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson für alle SEO- und GEO-Themen und berichtest direkt an das Management. Du verantwortest, dass Vergleich.orgund unsere weiteren Portfolio-Seiten in der klassischen Suche und in KI-Antworten gefunden, zitiert und geklickt werden. Du steuerst unsere SEO-Agentur und hast dabei viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Wächst der Bereich, baust du dein eigenes Team auf.

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze dazu, auf welchen SEO-Erfolg du am stolzesten bist und warum. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Verantwortung: Du verantwortest SEO und GEO bei vergleich.org und unseren weiteren Portfolio-Seiten und berichtest direkt an das Management.
  • Strategie: Du entwickelst unsere Strategie für Google-Suche und KI-Suchen weiter und setzt sie mit Redaktion, Produkt und Entwicklung um.
  • Seitenarchitektur und technisches SEO: Du verantwortest Struktur, Indexierung und interne Verlinkung einer Website mit sehr vielen URLs und unterschiedlichen Content-Formaten. Kannibalisierung erkennst und löst du.
  • GEO: Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Inhalte in KI-Antworten als Quelle genannt und verlinkt werden, und machst diese Sichtbarkeit messbar.
  • Wachstum: Du steigerst Sichtbarkeit, Klicks und vor allem die Weiterleitungen zu unseren Partnershops aus der organischen Suche.
  • Analyse und Tests: Du analysierst Entwicklungen datenbasiert, setzt SEO-Tests auf und leitest klare Prioritäten ab.
  • Qualität: Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Inhalte Googles Anforderungen an hilfreiche Inhalte mit echter Erfahrung und Expertise erfüllen.
  • KI im Arbeitsalltag: Du baust KI-gestützte Abläufe für Analyse, Content und Qualitätssicherung auf.
  • Agentur und Freelancer: Du gibst die Richtung vor, steuerst die Zusammenarbeit und prüfst die Ergebnisse.

Deine Profil

  • Mindestens 5 JahreSEO-Erfahrung, idealerweise auf großen Content-, Vergleichs-, Affiliate- oder E-Commerce-Seiten
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge beim Wachstum organischer Reichweite, gerne auch beim Wiederaufbau nach Core-Updates
  • Starke Skills im technischen und redaktionellen SEO: Indexierung, Crawling, strukturierte Daten, Informationsarchitektur
  • Ein fundiertes Verständnis davon, wie KI-Suchen ihre Quellen auswählen, und Lust, das systematisch zu testen
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Daten (Search Console, GA4, SISTRIX, Screaming Frog, Sheets), SQL oder Python sind ein Plus
  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Agenturen, Führungserfahrung ist ein Plus
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch, priorisierst nach Wirkung und setzt Dinge pragmatisch durch
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau, sehr gutes Englisch

Das Bieten Wir

  • Echte Verantwortung und kurze Wege zum Management-Team: Entscheidungen fallen in Tagen statt Monaten
  • Ein profitables Unternehmen mit über 12 Jahren Erfolg, das mit der Suche von morgen weiterwachsen will
  • Ein kollegiales Team, das dich offen empfängt, und regelmäßigeFeedbackgespräche für deine Weiterentwicklung
  • Hybrid oder komplett remote, flexible Urlaubsplanung, modernes Equipment und auf Wunsch ein Platz im Loft-Büro in Berlin-Kreuzberg mit kostenlosen Getränken und Snacks
  • Budget für Weiterbildung, Konferenzen und Tools
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge und zusätzlich 50 € pro Monat als steuerfreier Sachbezug.

Sales Director Western Canada

Location: Western Canada – remote, with regular travel

Employment Type: Full Time | Remote

Why Build Your Career with Prysmian?

Your work at Prysmian helps power and connect the world.

When you join Prysmian, you become part of a global team whose work touches millions of lives every day. You’ll help support the energy and digital infrastructure that keeps communities, businesses, and industries moving forward.


The Sales Director Western Canada is the senior commercial leader responsible for expanding Prysmian’s business across Western Canada, defining and delivering the regional go-to-market approach and developing strategic relationships to convert market intelligence into profitable sales growth for Prysmian’s wire and cable solutions.

The role works across key industrial and infrastructure markets, including utilities, mining, oil and gas, transportation and major infrastructure. It engages EPCs, engineering firms, OEMs, contractors, distributors and end-users from the earliest project stages through specification, bid, negotiation and execution.

What You’ll Bring

Experience and Qualifications

  • Degree or diploma in Electrical Engineering, Industrial Technology, Business or a related field; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered.
  • Approximately 15 or more years of progressive experience in technical sales, project business development, strategic accounts or commercial leadership within wire and cable, electrical products or industrial solutions.

  • Established network of relevant industry contacts in Western Canada.
  • Strong understanding of technical specifications, project sales cycles, pricing, margin management, and value-based selling.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop account strategies, lead complex negotiations, and convert market intelligence into business growth.
  • Proven people-leadership experience, including leading, coaching and developing sales professionals and application engineering resources across a multi-province region.

Leadership Capabilities

  • Commercial & strategic — Connects market insight, customer priorities and financial outcomes.
  • Customer leadership — Builds credibility and long-term relationships at senior and technical levels.
  • Entrepreneurial drive — Finds new projects, applications, customers and business models.
  • Technical-commercial judgment — Balances specifications, value proposition, pricing and execution risk.
  • People leadership — Leads, coaches and develops sales and application engineering talent while aligning cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Execution discipline — Creates focus, tracks commitments and acts quickly when performance is off plan.

Additional Requirements

  • Strong organization and prioritization skills to manage a complex pipeline, multiple projects and reporting deadlines.
  • Proficiency with CRM, project-tracking, reporting and virtual collaboration tools, including Microsoft Teams.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across Western Canada for customer visits, site meetings and industry events, typically 25–50%.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-management skills.

What You’ll Do

The Sales Director Western Canada is the senior commercial leader responsible for expanding Prysmian’s business across the region and leading the regional sales team and application engineering capability. The position defines and executes the regional go-to-market approach, develops strategic end-user, contractor and channel partner (distributor) relationships, and creates and converts early market and project intelligence into profitable sales growth for Prysmian’s wire and cable solutions.

Sales & Technical Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach and develop the Western Canada sales team and application engineer, setting clear priorities, accountabilities and performance expectations.
  • Partnering with the engineering team to align resources around the highest-value customers, projects and market opportunities, ensuring strong technical-commercial coordination.
  • Build team capability through regular coaching, performance management, development planning and disciplined sales-management routines.
  • Collaborate with and contribute to the country organization in terms of insights and alignment of activities.
  • Create a collaborative, accountable culture that connects customer insight, technical expertise and commercial execution.

Regional Strategy & Go-to-Market

  • Lead market assessment and define the go-to-market strategy by sector, product, application, customer and channel across Western Canada.
  • Translate Canadian commercial priorities into practical regional account, channel and project-development plans.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with key players in the industry to ensure access to market intelligence and new opportunities in the region.
  • Identify new markets, applications, channels and business models, and develop the action plans required to capture them.

Project Business Development

  • Identify and pursue major project opportunities with EPCs, engineering firms, OEMs, contractors, distributors and end users in line with a coherent long-term go-to-market strategy.
  • Build early visibility of future projects in order to influence product specifications to secure demand through the channel.
  • Develop and maintain a qualified project pipeline, with clear priorities, ownership, milestones, risks and next actions.
  • Lead or support strategic bids, technical-commercial proposals and negotiations in collaboration with the appropriate internal teams.

Strategic Accounts & Relationship Leadership

  • Build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers, engineering teams, procurement leaders and project stakeholders.
  • Develop tailored business-development plans for priority customers and coordinate local, national, regional and international key-account activity.
  • Guide account managers toward a consistent commercial policy while adapting the value proposition and engagement plan to each strategic customer.
  • Collaborate with distributors to maximize market coverage, project access and sales conversion.

Product Positioning, Pricing & Value Proposition

  • Provide commercial direction on product positioning and pricing by sector, channel, product and application, in partnership with Product Management.
  • Contribute market intelligence and industry trends to support the creation of new products and solutions.
  • Develop compelling value propositions that connect Prysmian’s technical solutions, service capabilities and total delivered value to customer needs.

Market Intelligence & Opportunity Development

  • Monitor customer investment plans, major projects, competitor activity, market trends and changes in channels or specifications.
  • Develop and use management tools that strengthen market intelligence, opportunity tracking, pricing decisions and commercial forecasting.
  • Convert market insights into clear recommendations for product, marketing, operations and commercial teams.

  • Drive achievement of revenue, contribution margin, project-win and market-development objectives.
  • Monitor performance by sector, customer, channel, product and application; identify gaps and recommend corrective action.

Measures of Success

  • Revenue and contribution margin from targeted projects and strategic accounts.

  • Quality, timeliness, and accuracy of market intelligence and early project awareness.

You’ll have the opportunity to make an impact, build strong partnerships, and grow your career in a business that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.


Total Rewards Designed for You

We believe great people deserve great rewards. That’s why Prysmian offers a total rewards package designed to support your financial, physical, and personal well-being now and as your career grows.

You will have the opportunity to:

  • Build, test, and enhance Agentforce Agents, workflows, and automations, supporting intelligent customer-facing and internal experiences

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience, including Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWCs), and JavaScript
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce's Apex language and coding patterns/best practices
  • Strong foundation in overall software development principles, including programming fundamentals and object-oriented programming (OOP)
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD processes and source tracking with Git
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with third-party systems via REST APIs
  • Experience building solutions on Salesforce Data 360
  • Experience building Agentforce agents, workflows, and automations
  • Demonstrated curiosity about, and hands-on experimentation with, AI technologies beyond core Salesforce (LLM APIs, agent frameworks, emerging tooling)
  • Strong ability to learn and acquire new technical skills quickly to solve business problems
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Data 360 capabilities, including unstructured DMOs, retrievers, search indexes, RAG, and identity resolution
  • Experience with Agentforce Agent Script (next gen authoring)
  • Relevant certifications such as Salesforce Platform Developer I/II, Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant, Salesforce Agentforce Specialist, or Claude Certified Architect

  • Experience prototyping with LLM providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.), vector databases, or agent orchestration frameworks outside the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Experience across additional Salesforce Clouds (Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, Experience Cloud, etc.)
  • Understanding of Salesforce's Enhanced Chat and Omni-channel
  • Experience with Amazon Connect or other telephony platforms
  • Experience writing, testing, and deploying AWS Lambda functions
  • Proficiency in using Claude Code or similar AI coding agents

What can you expect in the interview process?

What’s it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?

So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients.
  • Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9-5 isn’t possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done
  • Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it’s a no-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. Our executive team holds town halls & company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small.
  • Celebrate Often: We take our work seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Whether it is an arm wrestling contest, costume party, or ugly holiday sweaters our teams love to have fun. And while we work hard, we don’t forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together.

jobs.description:
About Brello Health

Brello Health is AHG's direct-to-consumer women's telehealth brand, delivering personalized, outcomes-driven care to patients nationwide. As one of AHG's fastest-growing brands, Brello operates with the speed and focus of a standalone company while drawing on the infrastructure, compliance, and resources of the broader group. Position Overview

This is a high-trust, high-leverage role supporting the Chief Executive Officer of Brello Health. The CEO's stakeholders span the Brello leadership team, clinical and commercial operators, marketing and growth partners, and the broader Allia Health Group executive team, all competing for the same finite calendar.

Your job is to make that work. You will control access to the CEO's time, decide what reaches her/him and what does not, keep the leadership team and its commitments moving, and ensure that nothing important falls through the cracks as Brello scales.

This role suits someone who is comfortable saying no on behalf of an executive, who moves before being asked, and who wants to grow their scope over time.

Key Responsibilities

Gatekeeping and Access

  • Own the CEO's calendar end to end, including scheduling, prioritization, conflict resolution, and rescheduling
  • Decide what earns a meeting, what can be resolved asynchronously, and what should be redirected to another owner, and communicate those decisions directly to requesters
  • Protect uninterrupted blocks for strategic work, and defend them under pressure
  • Triage inbound from the leadership team, internal teams, vendors, and external partners; escalate what is genuinely urgent and hold the rest
  • Prepare daily briefs, agendas, and pre-reads so the CEO walks into every meeting ready

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Serve as the operating link between the CEO and the Brello leadership team, including clinical operations, marketing, growth, and customer experience
  • Track commitments and requests across functions so that competing priorities surface early rather than at the deadline
  • Act as a professional, discreet point of contact between the CEO and internal teams, vendors, and external partners
  • Build working relationships with the assistants and operators supporting other brand and AHG corporate leaders

Executive Representation and Thought Partnership

  • Attend select internal and external meetings on the CEO's behalf, representing her/his priorities and positions with authority and discretion
  • Capture decisions, commitments, and follow-ups from those meetings and brief the CEO on what matters, what needs her/his input, and what has been handled
  • Serve as a trusted sounding board for the CEO, offering candid, well-reasoned perspectives on operational, organizational, and business matters
  • Apply executive-level judgment to resolve issues independently when appropriate, and know when a decision must go back to the CEO

Team Cadence and Follow-Through

  • Run the operating rhythm of the leadership team, including agendas, pre-reads, structured notes, and action items with named owners and dates
  • Chase commitments to completion, including with people who do not report to you
  • Maintain project trackers, documentation, and status views for brand initiatives
  • Support OKR tracking and quarterly planning rhythms for Brello Health

Business Operations and Reporting

  • Support preparation of board materials, investor updates, and AHG corporate reporting on the CEO's behalf
  • Coordinate with AHG's finance, HR, legal, and People Ops functions on the CEO's behalf
  • Maintain a clean record of key decisions, approvals, and open items across the business
  • Assist with vendor research, tooling evaluations, and renewal calendars

Travel, Events, and Operations

  • Plan and book travel, including itineraries, accommodations, and expense reporting
  • Plan and coordinate company events, town halls, and all-hands meetings end to end, including logistics, agendas, speaker preparation, run-of-show, and post-event follow-up
  • Take on ad hoc special projects as assigned Qualifications
  • 10+ years supporting a C-level or senior executive, ideally in healthcare, consumer, or a high-growth startup, with a track record of operating independently rather than task by task (exceptional candidates with less experience will be considered)
  • Extensive exposure to executive-level decision-making, with the business acumen and confidence to offer the CEO an informed point of view across a range of subject matters
  • Credibility and presence to represent a CEO in meetings with senior leaders, partners, and vendors
  • Demonstrated comfort managing access to a senior leader, including declining and redirecting requests without escalation
  • Experience working autonomously in a fast-moving, brand-driven organization
  • Proven experience planning and coordinating events and town halls, from small leadership offsites to company-wide meetings
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Outstanding organizational discipline, attention to detail, and follow-through under shifting priorities
  • High emotional intelligence, sound judgment, and a proven record of handling highly confidential business, commercial, and personnel information with absolute discretion
  • Strong, advanced-level proficiency in Excel (e.g., pivot tables, lookups, formulas, and building trackers and reports), plus fluency with Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and modern project management tools
  • Demonstrated, hands-on use of AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini) in daily work to draft, summarize, research, and automate routine tasks

Your First 90 Days

Days 1 to 30: Full ownership of the calendar and inbox triage. You know the CEO's priorities and leadership team well enough to route most requests without asking.

Days 31 to 60: The leadership cadence runs on your structure. Action items are tracked and closed. You are anticipating conflicts before they land.

Days 61 to 90: You are surfacing problems the CEO has not seen yet, and you are trusted with the brand's most sensitive material. Growth

This role is designed to expand. As trust is established, the scope broadens into deeper involvement in planning, cross-functional programs, and independent ownership of workstreams on behalf of Brello Health. Location and Work Setup

This role is based in Houston, TX. It is fully remote, with occasional onsite visits to the Houston office for team and leadership events.

Given the sensitivity of the information involved, this role is subject to enhanced confidentiality obligations and background screening.

jobs.excerpt: Title:Business Development Manager(Utilities and Critical Infrastructure) Location:(Unites States) - Remote role Hanwha Vision America (HVA), formerly known as Hanwha Techwin America (HTA), is an affiliate of the Hanwha Group, a Fortune Global 500 company.
jobs.description:
Title:Business Development Manager(Utilities and Critical Infrastructure)

Location:(Unites States) - Remote role

Hanwha Vision America (HVA), formerly known as Hanwha Techwin America (HTA), is an affiliate of the Hanwha Group, a Fortune Global 500 company. HVA is an industry-leading provider of advanced network video surveillance products, including IP cameras, storage devices, and video management systems founded on world-class technologies. We offer end-to-end security solutions and have achieved global success across various industry verticals, including retail, transportation, education, banking, healthcare, hospitality, and airports.

We are seeking a Business Development Manager (BDM) for the Utilities & Critical Infrastructure Vertical that drives new-logo growth, brand preference and revenue for Hanwha Vision's intelligent video surveillance and edge-AI solutions across electric, water/wastewater and natural gas utilities.

Target environments include transmission and distribution substations, generation sites, utility control centers, water and wastewater treatment plants, pump stations, reservoirs and dams, and gas distribution facilities. Target customers include investor-owned utilities, public power and municipal utilities, and electric cooperatives.

As the vertical's subject matter expert, the BDM builds senior relationships with utility security directors, compliance (NERC CIP) managers, operations and engineering leaders, and the system integrators and engineering firms that serve them. The role positions Hanwha's thermal, AI analytics, PTZ and ruggedized camera portfolio against the sector's core problems: physical attacks on substations, copper theft and vandalism at unmanned sites, regulatory compliance, and lean operations staff.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • New-Logo Hunting & Vertical Strategy:Build and run a national plan to win net-new utility accounts. Prioritize target lists of investor-owned utilities, public power and municipal utilities, electric co-ops and large water/wastewater systems.
  • End-User Relationship Management:Build trust-based relationships with utility corporate security directors, NERC CIP compliance managers, substation and T&D engineering, water/wastewater operations leaders, and risk and emergency management teams.
  • Partner & Channel Alignment:Work with Hanwha regional sales, the A&E team, utility-focused system integrators, engineering firms (EPCs and consulting engineers that write substation and treatment-plant specs), and distribution partners to identify, register and win multi-site and system-wide rollouts.
  • Specification & Standards Influence:Get Hanwha written into utility security standards, substation design standards and engineer-of-record specifications, which govern purchasing.
  • Solution Selling & Technical Advocacy:Deliver presentations and demonstrations of Hanwha's value for utilities, such as:
    • Substation & Remote-Site Perimeter Protection:Radiometric thermal and AI-based perimeter intrusion detection, PTZ auto-tracking and long-range coverage for unmanned substations, pump stations and reservoirs. Covers ballistic-attack, intrusion, copper-theft and vandalism scenarios.
    • Compliance Support:Positioning video, analytics and audit trails to support customers' NERC CIP-014 security plans, CIP-006 physical access monitoring, and water-sector risk and resilience assessments.
    • Operational Thermal Monitoring:Temperature monitoring of transformers, breakers and other critical assets for early fault detection and preventive maintenance.
    • Supply-Chain Trust:Leading with Hanwha's trusted supply chain and cybersecurity posture with utility security, IT/OT and procurement teams.
    • Enterprise Integration:Interoperability with enterprise VMS, PSIM and utility SOC platforms over constrained substation and remote networks.
  • Funding & Procurement Navigation:Help customers and partners align projects with public bids, rate-case capital plans and grant programs, including the federal-funding rules attached to them.
  • Market Intelligence & Feedback:Communicate Voice of the Customer insights to Product Management to shape utility-specific products, such as substation-hardened and long-range thermal hardware.
  • Pipeline & Forecast Management:Keep an accurate CRM pipeline that reflects utility capital-planning and budget cycles, RFP timelines and multi-year rollouts.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Experience:5–7+ years of business development or enterprise sales in physical security, video surveillance, utility technology or industrial automation. Must have a track record of winning net-new accounts, not only growing existing ones.
  • Vertical Expertise:Deep, verifiable knowledge of the utility ecosystem. That includes public procurement and RFPs, rate-case and capital-budget timing, and the differences between investor-owned utilities, public power and co-ops.
  • Regulatory Fluency:Working knowledge of the regulations that drive utility security spending, especially NERC CIP-014 and CIP-006 for electric utilities and AWIA risk and resilience assessments for water.
  • Technical Proficiency:Strong understanding of IP video networks, OT and substation network topologies, bandwidth-constrained remote sites, enterprise VMS architectures, and thermal and AI analytics.
  • Relationship Network:An existing network among utility security and compliance leaders, utility-focused integrators, and engineering firms that design substations and treatment plants is a significant plus.
  • Communication Skills:Excellent presentation and writing skills. Must be able to translate technical and compliance concepts into clear risk-reduction and operating benefits for utilities.
  • Clearance to Access Sites:Able to pass a utility personnel risk assessment for unescorted access, which under NERC CIP-004 includes identity verification and a seven-year criminal history check.
  • Travel:Up to 50% regional and national travel for meetings, substation and plant site surveys, and utility trade events.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Frequent travel via commercial airlines and/or driving is required.
  • Must be able to enter energized substations, treatment plants and remote utility sites for site surveys. Must follow all utility safety rules and escort requirements and wear required PPE (hard hat, safety glasses, steel-toe boots, FR clothing where required).
  • Must be able to pass utility background screening for site access.
  • Standard office conditions when working from a home office.

jobs.description:
DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems. Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: BIM Intern

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

JOB SUMMARY

The BIM Intern will support the MEP Engineers, BIM Managers and BIM Technicians with responsibilities to

coordinate across various groups. This position will use Revit MEP, ACC / BIM 360 and Navisworks for production

of a variety of projects. The scope of work will involve both small and large-scale mechanical, electrical, plumbing

and fire protection projects.

The BIM Intern will rely on instructions and pre-established guidelines to perform the functions of the job. Works

under immediate supervision and learns to navigate the business environment. Expected to learn company policies

and procedures to resolve routine issues.

The BIM Technician will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as

departmental objectives.

This position is designed as a learning opportunity for students pursuing engineering, BIM, or related technical

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

  • Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote environment through effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
  • Ability to work with engineers, other designers and drafters as part of a design team
  • Ability to work with engineers to incorporate MEP design into Revit
  • Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, optimize operational processes, and contribute to company-wide innovation.
  • Interest in and willingness to learn to understand all parts of engineering contract documents
  • Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information)
  • Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines
  • Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of

this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential

functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Frequently moving through office, facility and other environments

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Engineering, Construction Management, BIM, Drafting, or a related technical discipline

OR

jobs.description:

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

We're seeking an experienced VIP Corporate Travel Consultant to join our Emergency Customer Care (ECC) team, delivering white-glove, personalized service to C-Suite executives and high-profile clients during after-hours, overnight, weekend, and holiday periods.   • Other duties and tasks as assigned

  • 4+ years of recent experience in corporate travel management, with a thorough understanding of the unique needs and challenges of business travelers, particularly in emergency and after-hours scenarios.

  • Comfortable and proficient using Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, Teams), travel booking tools (Concur, Deem), and various communication tools, with a strong technical aptitude and the ability to adapt to new technologies quickly.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a polished, professional, and empathetic demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • A natural inclination to respond promptly to emergency travel requests, with the ability to handle high-stress situations, make quick and effective decisions, and provide expert guidance while consistently upholding the VIP standard of service.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

jobs.description:
We're seeking a Business Systems Consultant to partner with business and technology teams to analyze processes, identify opportunities for improvement, investigate business and system issues, support testing and validation, and deliver solutions that support business objectives. In this role, you'll serve as a key liaison between stakeholders, helping drive initiatives from intake through implementation and ongoing operational support while ensuring systems, processes, and business needs remain aligned. This role specifically supports the DCHIPS Care team within the Senior Health ART. This position may be filled at the I or II level based on experience.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

  • Estimated Compensation (Levels have variable responsibilities and qualifications):
    • Business Systems Consultant I: $75,500-$97,000, plus annual bonus opportunity.
    • Business Systems Consultant II: $86,000-$114,000, plus annual bonus opportunity.
  • 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match.
  • Work-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays. See our benefits and perks page for details.
  • Applicants for this position must not now, nor at any point in the future, require sponsorship for employment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Partner with business and technical teams to gather, document, and refine requirements for process improvements, system enhancements, production support needs, data-related requests, testing efforts, and strategic initiatives. Translate business needs into effective and sustainable solutions.
  • Analyze business processes, workflows, data, and system capabilities to identify gaps, risks, and opportunities for increased efficiency, effectiveness, and customer experience.
  • Support the planning, testing, validation, and implementation of business and system changes. Ensure solutions are thoroughly documented and meet business objectives.
  • Research and troubleshoot business, data, and system issues; document findings, assess impacts, and recommend next steps.
  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration among stakeholders, helping drive decision-making, resolve issues, and ensure successful delivery of initiatives and projects.
  • Develop recommendations based on business analysis, current and future state assessments, and organizational priorities to support informed decision-making and operational improvement.
  • Serve as a trusted partner to business leaders, project teams, and vendors by providing consultation, communication, change management support, and ongoing process improvement expertise.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • Experience analyzing business processes, gathering requirements, and translating business needs into actionable solutions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate information, identify trends, and develop recommendations.
  • Experience working with business systems, technology teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to support business initiatives and operational goals.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, facilitate discussions, and build effective relationships across all levels of an organization.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Familiarity with project delivery methodologies, testing practices, process improvement techniques, or change management concepts.
  • You promote a culture of diversity and inclusion, value different ideas and opinions, and listen courageously, remaining curious in all that you do.
  • Able to work remotely with access to a high-speed internet connection and located in the United States.

PREFERRED:

  • Experience supporting business transformation, process improvement, system implementation, or operational excellence initiatives.
  • Exposure to data analysis, SQL, system integrations, APIs, JSON, or enterprise business systems.
  • Familiarity with business analysis methodologies, project management practices, Agile frameworks, or related disciplines.
  • Experience within insurance, financial services, or other highly regulated industries.

jobs.title: Fractional CFO
jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. Starting at approximately 4 to 5 hours per month, this remote fractional position provides expert financial oversight, model review, and strategic structuring advice for a growing SME.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Starting at approximately 4 to 5 hours per month, this remote fractional position provides expert financial oversight, model review, and strategic structuring advice for a growing SME. The primary focus is to review and stress-test financial models, diagnose current financial standing, and ensure full compliance across regulatory and tax obligations before key business decisions are executed.

Working on an ad-hoc, project-commissioned basis, this role serves as a trusted oversight partner to company directors and works directly with the internal finance contact. The position offers high-level strategic involvement in reviewing loan book performance, refining pricing strategies, and evaluating funding structures without handling day-to-day bookkeeping.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and stress-test new or updated financial models, budgets, forecasts, and business cases prior to submission to prospective partners or management.

  • Check and correct model logic, formulas, and underlying assumptions including growth rates, cost escalation, margins, and tax treatment.

  • Conduct scenario and sensitivity testing (best, base, and worst case) for material decisions such as contract terms, capital purchases, or pricing changes.

  • Provide clear written or verbal opinions detailing risk areas, recommended fixes, and elements to challenge before models are finalised.

  • Perform monthly diagnostics on balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow to monitor liquidity, solvency, working capital, and profitability trends.

  • Track key metrics and ratios—including current ratio, gross margin, debtor days, debt-to-equity, and interest cover—against prior periods to identify early red flags.

  • Identify cost lines to renegotiate or cut, evaluate pricing strategies to improve margins, and optimize working capital collection cycles.

  • Advise on capital allocation, debt-versus-equity funding, facility consolidation, and contract payment terms to optimise tax efficiency and lower interest costs.

  • Review, edit, and finalise bi-annual funder reports covering claims book performance, arrears, book quality, and required credit calculations (including NROC).

  • Reconcile reported metrics against internal tracking systems and flag potential covenant risks early.

  • Oversee compliance and identify gaps across CIPC requirements (Companies Act 71 of 2008), SARS corporate/provisional tax, VAT, PAYE/UIF/SDL, financial reporting frameworks (IFRS for SMEs/full IFRS), B-BBEE, POPIA, COIDA, and relevant statutory obligations.

  • Conduct an initial assessment of the business's regulatory footprint within the first weeks of engagement.


Requirements

Essential Requirements

  • A recognised professional accounting qualification (CA(SA) preferred, or ACCA / CIMA.

  • Prior experience as a CFO, Financial Manager, or Financial Consultant to SMEs, ideally working in a fractional, portfolio, or part-time capacity.

  • Proven experience in preparing or reviewing funder and covenant reporting for loan or debtor books, including arrears, book performance, charge-off, and recovery metrics.

  • Strong regulatory fluency in South African tax (SARS) and Companies Act/CIPC requirements.

  • Ability to work autonomously on an ad-hoc, project-based model.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical financial details into plain language and clearly articulate risks.

Desirable Requirements

  • Experience or familiarity with FSCA/FAIS, FICA, and the Debt Collectors Act.

Required Software Skills

  • Sage

  • Microsoft Excel

Part-time
Independent contractor

jobs.title: Microsoft Dynamics Business Central (BC) Solution Architect Finance
jobs.excerpt: The RoleThe BC Solutions Architect is responsible for designing, implementing and ensuring the integrity of financial solutions in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, with a focus on General Ledger, Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.
jobs.description:
The Role

The BC Solutions Architect is responsible for designing, implementing and ensuring the integrity of financial solutions in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, with a focus on General Ledger, Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable. This role leads and coordinates teams of functional consultants and serves as a trusted advisor to customers’ finance teams, helping them design processes from the chart of accounts and dimensions through payables, receivables and month-end close. The BC Solutions Architect also contributes to the development of Western Computer’s BC finance best practices and participates actively in presales activities.

What You'll Do

  • Design finance processes in BC, from chart of accounts and dimensions to posting groups and approvals.

  • Turn finance requirements into clear design documents and configuration specs.

  • Provide leadership and guidance to a team of functional consultants on the implementation of BC solutions, including configuration, customization, and integration with other enterprise systems.

  • Plan data migration so opening balances and open AP/AR reconcile at go-live.

  • Ensure smooth deployment of solutions by coordinating with project teams, managing timelines, and addressing technical challenges.

  • Oversee integrations of BC systems with other enterprise applications.

  • Ensure data integrity and consistency across integrated systems.

Selection process developed by matteria

Location and Work Mode

Remote (Preferably based in Latin America).

Who we are

We partner with mission-driven organizations and high-growth ventures to build leadership teams that move the world forward. Our approach blends rigorous executive search, data-informed market mapping, and a human, long-term relationship with both clients and candidates.

We’ve delivered 1,900+ placements across 15 countries (Latin America, North America, and Europe), worked with 600+ organizations across the private, public, and civil sectors, and host a talent platform with 90,000+ registered users. Our impact

  • 1,900+ executive and leadership placements completed.

  • Active across 15 countries in Latin America, North America, and Europe.

  • Trusted by 600+ organizations across the private, public, and social sectors.

  • Community of 90,000+ professionals within our talent platform.

Purpose of the Position

The Senior Talent Consultant at matteria leads executive searches end to end, partnering with leaders who are changing the world, wherever they happen to be building. This person brings both the technical execution of headhunting and a strategic, consultative lens, listening closely to translate a client's ambitions into winning candidate profiles, and becomes the client's senior point of contact, able to navigate complex conversations fluently in English.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Client Advisory

  • Lead executive discovery sessions to deeply understand organizational challenges and leadership needs.

Executive Search Leadership

  • Own the full executive search lifecycle, including intake meetings, role definition, compensation calibration, sourcing strategy, executive outreach, candidate assessment, client presentations, offer management, and successful placement.

  • Conduct sophisticated market mapping and direct headhunting of passive executive talent.

Leadership Assessment & Consulting

  • Conduct structured executive interviews and leadership assessments.

  • Evaluate candidates based on competencies, leadership capabilities, cultural alignment, and mission fit.

  • Advise clients on market dynamics, candidate trade-offs, and hiring decisions with sound judgment and objectivity.

Candidate Experience

  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience through transparent communication, timely feedback, and respectful engagement.

  • Lead executive negotiations and support successful onboarding and post-placement follow-up.

Market Intelligence & Operational Excellence

  • Produce executive search reports, market intelligence, compensation insights, and pipeline analytics.

  • Continuously leverage technology and AI tools to strengthen research, sourcing, documentation, and decision-making.

  • Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, methodology improvements, and mentoring of junior consultants when appropriate.

Requirements and competences to work with us

Education

  • We prioritize proven capability over credentials. No specific degree required.

  • What matters: a track record delivering end-to-end executive searches, sharp judgment, and consistent results.

  • Advanced studies or certifications (e.g., executive coaching, org psychology, OD, analytics) are welcome but optional if your experience speaks for itself.

Experience

  • 7–12+ years in executive search, senior recruiting, or leadership hiring—agency or in-house—delivering Director/C-Suite or hard-to-fill leadership roles.

  • Proven track record of direct headhunting and closing passive candidates across multiple markets/time zones.

  • Comfortable running multiple searches concurrently in a freelance/independent setup with clear SLAs and outcome accountability.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Professional, fluent, bilingual English, able to lead client calls, negotiations, and written deliverables independently, with no translation support required; additional languages such as Spanish or Portuguese are an asset.

  • Expertise in leadership assessment, behavioral interviewing, and talent mapping.

  • Outstanding project management and organizational abilities.

  • Fluency with technology and AI tools as a core part of how you work, not an afterthought, using them to accelerate research, sourcing, and decision-making.

  • Proficiency in digital recruitment platforms, applicant tracking systems (ATS), and professional networking tools.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

Competencies

  • Ownership & speed: bias to action, proactive risk mitigation, reliable on-time delivery.

  • Judgment: sharp evaluation of leadership competencies and cultural/mission fit.

  • Consultative seniority: the instinct to ask the right questions, truly listen, and translate loosely defined client needs into concrete, actionable deliverables.

  • Global mindset: comfort working across cultures, languages, and sectors; high adaptability.

  • Integrity & empathy: candidate-first approach with uncompromising ethics and confidentiality.

  • Learning agility: iterate on playbooks, test new channels, and share best practices.

Our team profile

At matteria, Executive Search is fundamentally a people business. We believe outstanding results come from combining technical excellence with empathy, curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement.

Our culture is built around ten guiding principles:

  • We Connect with People: curiosity, empathy, and meaningful opportunities.

  • We Solve for the Client: their impact is our impact; we exceed expectations.

  • We Are World-Class: rigorous preparation, professional presence, never late.

  • Responsible Autonomy: freedom with sound judgment; ownership and speed.

  • We Solve with Data: evidence over opinion; reduce bias, decide better.

  • We Take Care of EVERY Detail: impeccable deliverables; craft matters.

  • Immediate Feedback: candid, caring, and frequent—growth is a team sport.

  • Curiosity: learn daily, research proactively, elevate collective knowledge.

  • AI Collaborates with Us: tech amplifies our creativity and execution.

  • We Love to Laugh: humility and humor as resilience and connection.

Key interests for working with us

This role is designed for someone who wants to become a trusted advisor to organizations creating meaningful change around the world, not simply someone who fills executive positions.

Our team is inspired by organizations addressing challenges such as:

  • Climate action

  • Sustainable development

  • Education

  • Healthcare

  • Economic inclusion

  • Entrepreneurship

  • Social innovation

  • Technology for good

  • Institutional strengthening

  • Purpose-driven business

We believe leadership changes organizations, and organizations change the world.

Reasons to join our team

  • Partner directly with founders, CEOs, Boards, and leadership teams driving meaningful impact.

  • Lead sophisticated international executive searches with significant autonomy.

  • Build a long-term consulting career with one of Latin America's leading executive search firms focused on impact organizations.

  • Learn advanced executive search methodologies, leadership assessment frameworks, and AI-powered recruiting practices.

  • Join a collaborative culture that values excellence, ownership, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

  • Enjoy the flexibility of a fully remote work environment.

  • Benefit from a performance-based compensation model with strong earning potential.

Relevant details before applying for this vacancy

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Developer to support priority initiatives across our aviation, federal, transportation, aerospace, health & science, and corporate market sectors requiring secure, scalable, and client-focused application development.

This role serves as a technical subject matter expert responsible for designing, developing, and deploying full-stack applications within production environments. It balances front-end delivery with a deep focus on backend engineering to guarantee the long-term reliability, scalability, and extendibility of market-ready products.

You will work with teams across our market sectors to advance early-stage concepts into commercial products and services, carrying each solution through requirements definition, architecture, system and interface design, development, testing, evaluation, and launch into configurable, client-specific production environments. You will also provide full-stack development expertise to RS&H project teams and client contracts, delivering the applications, integrations, and automation that project work requires.

The role is also responsible for establishing the software development practices that both areas of work depend on, including development standards, version control, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, documentation, security protocols, and the selection of development tools and platforms. You will apply professional judgment to determine the appropriate approach for each solution, including when to deliver through low-code platforms such as Microsoft Power Platform, Power Automate and when to develop custom code in C, C#, .NET, Python, or TypeScript. The position has no direct reports and provides authoritative technical direction to project teams and junior staff.

Core Responsibilities

  • Own software development for Digital Solutions offerings across the life cycle, from fitting concepts into products through delivery and transition to a product support team.
  • Lead the scoping, level of effort, and technical approach for pursuits, projects, and internal initiatives. Own the transformation of manual workflows into automated and agentic processes.
  • Establish the standards, tooling, and release practices that guide software development, and apply expert judgment on when to deliver through low code, no code, and GenAI assisted builds and when to write custom code.

Technical Skills

  • Full stack development in C#, .NET, Python, and JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Front-end frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
  • Back-end and database design across SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and NoSQL platforms.
  • Cloud-native development and deployment in Azure, AWS or GCP, including containerization and serverless architectures.
  • Deployment of solutions into multiple client-hosted production environments, each with distinct constraints, security requirements, and release processes.
  • API design and systems integration across data sources including PDFs, spreadsheets, data lakes, streaming IoT sensor feeds, point-cloud surveys, and BIM models.
  • Secure development practices, including authentication and authorization, encryption at rest and in transit, vulnerability scanning, and dependency management.
  • Automated testing, CI/CD, and version control at a level sufficient to establish these practices and standards for others to follow.
  • Low-code platforms such as Microsoft Power Platform, and the integration of large language models and generative AI into custom software.

Leadership and Judgment

  • Translating problem statements from non-technical colleagues into technical requirements and system architecture.
  • Documenting design decisions and communicating technical trade-offs to business stakeholders.
  • Selecting development tools and platforms based on cost, support requirements, and long-term maintainability.
  • Establishing development standards, documentation, playbooks, and reusable components that accelerate future projects.
  • Providing technical direction and code review to project teams and junior staff.
  • Evaluating solution maturity to determine which concepts are ready to advance into production.

Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field with 10 years of experience, or a Master’s degree with 5 years of experience.
  • Full life cycle software development experience, from concept definition and requirements through architecture, development, testing, and production launch.
  • Typically requires at least 5 years in architecture and engineering, professional services consulting, or a comparable environment developing software for operational or client-facing use.
  • Experience establishing or maturing software development practices, including source control, build and deployment pipelines, automated testing, and release management.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States permanently. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship or visa transfer.**

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in a related technical field.

About Us

Psychiatry UK is the UK’s leading provider of digital psychiatry services, working both privately and with the NHS to support children, teenagers and adults with expert, patient-centred care.

Psychiatry UK engages independent contractors on a temporary basis to provide flexible additional capacity during periods of significant growth, increased patient demand. The requirement for contractor support is temporary and dependent on service demand and capacity. The scope and volume of services will be agreed for the relevant engagement.

This opportunity is for experienced independent clinicians able to provide specialist ADHD prescribing services on a contract-for-services basis. Contractors retain responsibility for their own professional practice and may provide services to other organisations.

Scope of Services

The ADHD Specialist Independent Prescriber will provide specialist ADHD prescribing and medication management services within their professional scope and the agreed services. This may include:

  • Provide safe, effective and evidence-based prescribing for adults with ADHD in line with NICE guidance and relevant professional standards.

  • Undertake medication initiation, titration, review and ongoing management.

  • Review treatment effectiveness, side effects, adherence and other relevant clinical information.

  • Respond to patient medication-related queries through agreed secure digital systems.

  • Complete End of Titration Reviews (EOTRs) and annual medication reviews where agreed.

  • Exercise independent or supplementary prescribing rights within scope of practice.

  • Liaise with Consultant Psychiatrists and other relevant clinical professionals where required to support safe patient care.

  • Undertake appropriate risk assessments and respond to safeguarding concerns.

  • Maintain accurate and confidential clinical records in accordance with professional and legal requirements.

  • Participate in agreed clinical governance, audit or quality improvement activity where required as part of the contracted services.

  • Maintain current knowledge of relevant legislation, prescribing guidance and professional standards.

The contractor will retain responsibility for their professional and clinical decision-making within their scope of practice.

Working Arrangements

The services will be provided remotely within the UK.

The scope, delivery of services will be agreed between Psychiatry UK and the contractor. Where specific sessions, meetings or other activities are required, these will be agreed as part of the contracted services.

There is no expectation that the contractor will work exclusively for Psychiatry UK, subject to professional, confidentiality and conflict-of-interest requirements.

To Provide These Services, You Will Have

Sound clinical experience in the initiation, titration and management of ADHD in adults. You will demonstrate a strong patient-centred approach, with empathy, professionalism and excellent communication skills.

You will be able to work autonomously, exercise sound clinical judgement and communicate effectively with patients and other healthcare professionals.

You will have experience of ADHD rating scales, validated monitoring tools and safeguarding procedures, particularly within remote or digital healthcare.

You will have a sound understanding of relevant legislation, professional standards and current developments in ADHD prescribing.

Essential Qualifications and Experience

Registered Nurses:

  • First-level registered Mental Health Nurse (RMN); or

  • First-level registered Adult, Children's or Learning Disabilities Nurse with one year’s post-qualification secondary mental health experience or a further relevant mental health qualification.

  • Independent and Supplementary Non-Medical Prescribing (V300) qualification.

  • Minimum of one year’s post-prescribing qualification experience.

  • Minimum of one year’s specialist ADHD prescribing experience, within private and/or NHS secondary mental health services or equivalent.

  • Experience of prescribing for people with ADHD, including medication initiation, titration, review and longer-term management.

  • Current professional registration and prescribing authority appropriate to the services provided.

  • Appropriate professional indemnity insurance.

Desirable Qualifications and Experience

  • Further relevant training or qualifications in mental health or neurodevelopmental conditions.

  • Previous experience within specialist ADHD services.

  • Experience of remote clinical service provision or digital healthcare.

Desirable Knowledge and Skills

  • Experience with titration and longer-term management of stimulant and non-stimulant ADHD medications.

  • Understanding of clinical governance, audit and quality improvement relevant to prescribing.

  • Knowledge of safeguarding and risk assessment in mental health and remote care.

  • Experience of working autonomously across different clinical settings or organisations.

Independent Contractor Status

This engagement is offered on a contract-for-services basis and is not an offer of employment with Psychiatry UK.

The engagement will be assessed under the applicable off-payroll working rules (IR35) based on the contractual terms and actual working arrangements.

  • Guide customers through their first 3 month-end closes.
  • Troubleshoot all transactions where the payment processor (Stripe/PayPal) and the cart (Shopify) don't align.
