jobs.description:
The Role & Team:

As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will build, operate and improve Infovista's hybrid platform, spanning on-premises data centers and public cloud, supporting the Network Lifecycle Automation, Network Intelligence and SaaS product portfolios. Your core mission is to make automation the default way of working: replacing manual, ticket-driven processes with self-service, code-driven infrastructure that makes delivery faster, more reliable and more cost-effective across the business.

Reporting to the Head of Infrastructure & Platforms, you will be part of a hands-on team of infrastructure, DevOps and site reliability engineers, working alongside internal network teams and the offshore third-party delivery partner. You will work closely with product engineering, security and IT operations to identify automation opportunities and help drive their adoption. Success will be measured by the proportion of infrastructure and deployments automated, reduction in manual effort and lead times, platform availability against SLAs, deployment frequency, and the adoption of self-service tooling by engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities:

Deliver assigned work against the hybrid platform roadmap, with guidance from senior engineers and the Head of Infrastructure & Platforms.

  • Help build and operate a consistent hybrid estate across on-premises virtualization (VMware vSphere, Nutanix, ProxMox) and public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), including networking, identity and connectivity between them
    • Support enterprise storage across the hybrid estate (iSCSI, Fibre Channel, NFS/SMB and object storage), with provisioning and configuration delivered through automation
    • Help manage domain services (Active Directory, DNS, DHCP) and their integration with cloud identity, automating routine administration and changes
    • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using terraform, ansible, cloud formation and similar automation stacks, so that environments are provisioned, configured and changed through version-controlled code
    • Contribute to control plane management and automation across virtualization, container and cloud platforms, keeping management layers consistent, version-controlled and recoverable
    • Automate systems lifecycle management, from build and patching through upgrades and decommissioning, so that systems remain current, supported and compliant
    • Design automation strategies that take account of existing infrastructure, integrating with and progressively modernizing legacy systems rather than relying on greenfield replacement
    • Support and operate container platforms across on-premises and cloud (Kubernetes, OpenShift, EKS/AKS) with standardized Helm charts and GitOps deployment through Argo CD or Flux
    • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or Jenkins) that give product teams fast, secure, repeatable releases
    • Identify automation opportunities across the business and help build a pipeline of use cases with clear ROI
    • Help integrate automation with IT service management (ServiceNow) to deliver self-service provisioning, automated change and event-driven remediation
    • Build self-service automation, workflows and catalogue items that let engineering teams request, change and retire infrastructure without manual intervention
    • Implement observability using Prometheus, Grafana, the ELK/OpenSearch stack and OpenTelemetry, and apply SRE practices including SLOs, incident response and blameless post-incident reviews
    • Go beyond alerting to automated remediation, developing support-focused runbooks and automations that enhance NOC and SRE operations and reduce time to resolution
    • Support systems health and capacity management, using monitoring data and trend analysis to forecast demand, plan capacity and address issues before they impact service
    • Explore and apply AI-driven improvements, such as AIOps, anomaly detection, intelligent reporting and AI-assisted automation, to improve platform reliability and operational insight
    • Help implement automated asset discovery and documentation (ITGlue), keeping inventory, configuration and dependency records accurate and up to date
    • Contribute to metadata and tagging standards across on-premises and cloud resources, so that assets are consistently described and ready for automation
    • Build security and compliance into the platform through policy as code, secrets management (HashiCorp Vault), image scanning and automated compliance checks
    • Follow and contribute to engineering standards and reusable automation modules, and support the review of offshore partner work
    • Support FinOps practices across cloud and on-premises, using automation to right-size, schedule and decommission resources
    • Share knowledge and document solutions, helping build automation skills across the wider infrastructure organization

Qualifications:

  • 5-7 years in infrastructure, platform or DevOps engineering
    • Hands-on experience building and operating hybrid environments that span on-premises data centers as well as various cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure, Hetzner, OVH, etc).
    • Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and configuration management
    • Experience with Kubernetes and container platforms, GitOps and CI/CD tooling
    • Solid understanding of enterprise networking (routing, load balancing, DNS, firewalls, VPN/Direct Connect/ExpressRoute) and Linux and Windows server environments
    • Working knowledge of enterprise storage (iSCSI, Fibre Channel, SAN/NAS) and domain services (Active Directory, DNS, DHCP)
    • Scripting and development skills in Python, Bash or PowerShell, with experience provisioning and delivering reliable and secure automation solutions.
    • Experience automating manual processes, supporting the development of runbooks or similar automation tools, and a keen interest in driving wider adoption of automation
    • Exposure to systems lifecycle, capacity and health management, including automated remediation and support-focused runbooks for NOC/SRE teams
    • Familiarity with automated asset discovery and documentation tools (e.g. ITGlue) and metadata or tagging standards that support automation
    • Interest in applying AI to infrastructure operations, such as AIOps, anomaly detection or AI-assisted reporting and automation
    • Experience introducing automation into existing environments, working alongside legacy infrastructure
    • Experience working with offshore or third-party engineering teams
    • Relevant certifications (e.g. AWS Solutions Architect – Associate, Azure Administrator, CKA, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, Red Hat Ansible) are desirable

jobs.excerpt: Field Dispatch Co-ordinatorJob Summary:The Dispatch team sits at the centre of Speedcast's Global Field Engineering operation, coordinating the deployment of Field Engineers and approved third-party engineers to customer sites worldwide, including offshore rigs, commercial and cruise vessels, and land-based locations.
jobs.description:
Field Dispatch Co-ordinator

Job Summary:

The Dispatch team sits at the centre of Speedcast's Global Field Engineering operation, coordinating the deployment of Field Engineers and approved third-party engineers to customer sites worldwide, including offshore rigs, commercial and cruise vessels, and land-based locations. The Field Dispatch Coordinator receives dispatch requests from the NOC and Project teams and manages every aspect of the dispatch lifecycle end-to-end — from resourcing and travel to HSE, security, spares logistics and post-dispatch documentation — ensuring engineers arrive at site safely, on time, and fully equipped to complete the work.

Key Area of Responsibility:

  • Receive and log dispatch requests from the NOC and Project teams, confirming scope, priority and site requirements.
  • Assign a suitably experienced Field Engineer — Speedcast or approved third-party — based in the correct location for the job.
  • Coordinate the dispatch directly with the customer site, agreeing access, timing and on-site point of contact.
  • Arrange and book all travel — flights, visas, ground transport, offshore transfers and accommodation — for the assigned engineer.
  • Review HSE requirements for each dispatch, ensuring the engineer holds the certifications and PPE required for the site.
  • Review travel security requirements, including destination risk assessments, and apply any necessary travel advisories or approvals.
  • Identify, arrange and ship suitable spares and equipment to site in line with the job scope and delivery timelines.
  • Work as part of a shift rota providing 24-hour / on-call dispatch support, including nights and weekends.
  • Create and issue all pre-dispatch work packs and field documentation to the assigned engineer.
  • Review and manage all post-dispatch documentation, ensuring completeness and accuracy before close-out.
  • Manage and update ServiceNow Work Orders throughout the dispatch lifecycle, keeping status current for all stakeholders.
  • Prepare and consolidate all dispatch-related documentation and pass to the billing team to support customer invoicing.
  • Carry out all activities in full compliance with Speedcast's QHSE policies, procedures and best practices.
  • Undertake any other ad-hoc duties as reasonably requested by the business.

Job Specification

Academic Qualifications

  • Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, Telecommunications, or a related discipline

Or

  • Equivalent professional experience in dispatch, logistics or field service coordination

Relevant Experience

  • 2+ years' experience in dispatch, scheduling, logistics coordination or field service operations
  • Experience in the satellite communications, telecommunications, maritime, energy or offshore industries is highly desirable
  • Experience coordinating international travel, freight or spares logistics

Technical Know-How

Essential:

  • PC literate in a Windows environment, with strong Microsoft Office skills (Outlook, Excel, Teams)
  • Understanding of HSE requirements and travel security considerations for offshore, maritime and remote sites
  • Ability to coordinate travel bookings (flights, visas, offshore transfers, accommodation) via corporate travel systems

Desirable:

  • Experience with spares/RMA logistics and international freight or customs processes
  • Familiarity with VSAT, maritime or offshore communications equipment and terminology
  • Experience with a work order / ticketing platform such as ServiceNow, or a similar ITSM tool

Skills / Competencies

  • Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent dispatches
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Able to communicate clearly and confidently with customers, engineers and internal teams across time zones
  • Strong attention to detail when preparing work packs, documentation and Work Order updates
  • Calm and decisive under pressure, particularly during urgent or out-of-hours dispatches
  • Capable of assessing HSE and travel security information and applying it correctly to a dispatch

Strength / Character

  • High level of flexibility and adaptability, able to reprioritise quickly as dispatch needs change
  • Willing and able to work a rotating shift pattern providing 24 x 7 on-call coverage, including nights, weekends and public holidays
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and take ownership of a dispatch end-to-end
  • Able to build effective working relationships with a globally distributed team of Field Engineers and third parties
  • Proactive in anticipating issues — such as travel disruption or missing spares — and resolving them before they impact the customer
  • Comfortable working to deadlines in a fast-paced, customer-facing operational environment

Working at Speedcast:

At Speedcast, we want people that like adventure. Who are motivated by work that takes uncommon ingenuity and thinking outside the box. Who relish the idea of working in an industry undergoing massive transformation. If you want to be part of a global team responsible for connecting the world, then you’re in the right place.

We're always pushing forward, never standing still. When people rely on you and your team to stay connected, it brings everyone closer together. Find great opportunities to make an impact. We have a "one team, one dream" mentality. We work together to make great things happen. Working at Speedcast isn't just a job, it's a career that you can take to new levels.

jobs.excerpt: Job Description Summary‎ The Director, Risk Adjustment Product & Technology will lead the product roadmap, and technology capabilities that enable Mosaic Health to identify, prioritize, orchestrate, and capture burden-of-illness opportunities across its patient populations.
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

‎

The Director, Risk Adjustment Product & Technology will lead the product roadmap, and technology capabilities that enable Mosaic Health to identify, prioritize, orchestrate, and capture burden-of-illness opportunities across its patient populations.

This role will own the evolution of Mosaic’s enterprise Burden of Illness (BOI) Hub—the centralized intelligence and orchestration layer that brings together clinical, claims, payer, attribution, and supplemental data to determine which patients and clinical opportunities should be acted upon, through which intervention, and at what point in the workflow.

The Director will move the organization from fragmented, vendor-specific, and manually driven prioritization toward an enterprise-owned approach to risk adjustment decisioning and orchestration. The role will oversee how opportunities are identified, deduplicated, economically prioritized, routed to the appropriate execution engine, and measured through completion.

Sitting within Clinical Technology, this leader will partner closely with Risk Adjustment, Clinical, Coding, Operations, Product, Engineering, Data & Analytics, Finance, and market leadership.

The Director will also serve as a senior product and technology partner to external vendors, ensuring that platforms such as Navina operate as execution engines within Mosaic’s broader enterprise strategy rather than independently defining prioritization and workflow

The successful candidate will combine expertise in risk adjustment, healthcare product management, clinical technology, data, workflow design, and value-based care economics.

‎

How will you make an impact & Requirements

‎

Strategic Leadership

  • Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and operating model for Mosaic’s enterprise risk adjustment technology capabilities.
  • Lead development and maturation of the Burden of Illness Hub as the central orchestration capability for risk adjustment and related clinical opportunities.
  • Translate Risk Adjustment, Clinical, Operations, market, payer, and financial requirements into scalable product and technology capabilities.
  • Establish a clear distinction between:
    • enterprise-owned decisioning and prioritization,
    • foundational data capabilities,
    • execution engines,
    • vendor functionality, and
    • provider, coder, and operational workflows.
  • Define the target-state architecture and multi-year roadmap for moving from fragmented tools and processes to a standardized enterprise platform.

Burden of Illness Hub

  • Build the Hub as the enterprise system for:

- patient eligibility and prioritization,

- attributed and high-probability unattributed population identification,

- suspect and opportunity aggregation,

- opportunity deduplication,

- clinical and economic prioritization,

- work queue generation,

- intervention routing,

- opportunity status and disposition,

- attribution and retention interventions, and

- enterprise performance analytics.


  • Establish common rules and governance for determining when an opportunity should be surfaced, suppressed, combined, escalated, or routed to an alternative intervention.
  • Ensure prioritization logic is transparent, measurable, and configurable by population, payer, market, and intervention type.
  • Create feedback loops in which outcomes from providers, coders, AI, and other interventions continuously improve future prioritization.

Strategic Leadership

  • Own product requirements and prioritization for risk adjustment technology capabilities across the enterprise.
  • Partner with Engineering, Data, Architecture, and Clinical Informatics to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Define product requirements, user stories, workflows, acceptance criteria, and outcome measures for major capabilities.
  • Maintain a prioritized product backlog and roadmap aligned to enterprise objectives.
  • Establish appropriate product governance, release planning, testing, adoption, and change-management processes.
  • Ensure risk adjustment technology integrates effectively with EHRs, clinical applications, analytics platforms, data infrastructure, and operational systems.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies—including AI, NLP, clinical inference, and automation—for their ability to improve identification, prioritization, and capture of clinically appropriate opportunities.

Change Management & Adoption

The Director will ensure that multiple execution channels operate against a common enterprise prioritization strategy, including:

  • Point-of-care clinical technology and provider workflows
  • Platforms such as Navina
  • Coding and chart review teams
  • Incremental AI and clinical rules
  • Prospective and retrospective interventions
  • Provider and coder workflows
  • Attribution and patient retention interventions
  • Operational outreach and work queues

The Director will define when and how opportunities move between these execution channels and establish clear ownership, handoffs, and disposition logic.

The goal is not simply to generate more suspecting opportunities, but to ensure that the highest-value, clinically appropriate opportunity reaches the most effective intervention at the right time.

Vendor Strategy and Management

  • Collaborate with clinical, operational, analytics, finance, compliance, and technology teams to align priorities and execution.
  • Lead and mentor multidisciplinary teams including workflow analysts, clinical informatics resources, optimization specialists, and program managers.
  • Manage vendor relationships and participate in technology selection and evaluation processes.
  • Support enterprise scaling efforts, acquisitions, integrations, and operational transformation initiatives.

Performance & Analytics

  • Define and monitor operational and clinical metrics tied to workflow optimization initiatives.
  • Use data and analytics to identify inefficiencies, quantify impact, and guide prioritization decisions.
  • Develop executive-level reporting demonstrating ROI, adoption, productivity, and quality outcomes.
  • Drive continuous improvement methodologies across workflow and technology initiatives.

Experience


  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, nursing, informatics, business, information systems, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare operations, clinical informatics, healthcare technology, or workflow optimization, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise clinical transformation or EHR optimization initiatives at scale.
  • Proven success driving cross-functional operational and technology initiatives in complex healthcare environments.
  • Strong understanding of ambulatory and/or population health clinical workflows.
  • Experience with change management, clinician stakeholder engagement, and adoption strategies.
  • Track record of translating technology capabilities into measurable clinical and operational outcomes.

Preferred Experience


  • Advanced degree (MHA, MBA, MS in Informatics, or equivalent).
  • Certification or demonstrated proficiency in EHR workflow optimization.
  • Experience implementing ambient AI documentation tools or AI-enabled clinical decision support.
  • Background in process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent).
  • Experience in a multi-entity or integrated healthcare delivery system spanning primary care, specialty, and value-based care models.

Technical Fluency


  • Working knowledge of EHR platforms and clinical workflow configuration, particularly Athena.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled clinical tools, telehealth platforms, and digital health technologies and their integration into clinical workflows.
  • Understanding of population health platforms and care management tools.
  • Ability to translate workflow and technology concepts clearly across clinical, operational, and technical audiences.

Skills & Competencies


  • Executive presence with the ability to communicate clinical technology strategy to senior clinical, operational, and business audiences.
  • Strong instincts for driving adoption and behavior change across large, distributed clinical populations.
  • Cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management — this leader earns credibility by delivering change that clinicians experience as meaningful improvement.
  • Commitment to measurable outcomes, continuous improvement, and evidence-based decision-making.
  • Ability to lead through managers and analysts, setting direction and holding teams accountable to a high standard.

‎

TTM stands for time-to-market, representing how TTM's time-critical, one-stop design, engineering and manufacturing services enable customers to reduce the time required to develop new products and bring them to market.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Talent Management Partner Lead is a senior practitioner and people leader within TTM Technologies' Global Talent Management COE, anchored within the third arm of the TM COE dedicated to succession readiness, critical talent pool health, and organizational effectiveness.

This role works in close, day-to-day partnership with HR Business Partners (HRBPs) supporting critical and key talent — moving beyond advisory to direct execution. The Talent Management Partner Lead drives talent review cycles, succession planning, specific development programs, and targeted readiness and retention strategies from design through delivery, ensuring interventions are implemented, tracked, and producing measurable outcomes. Working alongside HRBPs, this role owns the identification, assessment, and development of critical talent within assigned client groups — translating talent data into clear, actionable insights and ensuring those insights result in real movement: successors' readiness, stronger talent pipelines, and enhanced retention of critical talent.

As a people leader, the Talent Management Partner Lead will build, develop, and manage a growing team of Talent Management Partners — setting the standard for quality talent work, coaching team members to operate with both strategic depth and executional rigor, and scaling the team's impact across the organization.

This individual operates with a high degree of autonomy while contributing to the broader goals of the Global Talent Management COE and the HR function.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


A. Strategic Talent Management

· Drive succession readiness across assigned North America client groups by building and maintaining robust successor pipelines for critical roles, ensuring depth of talent bench strength.

· Lead the identification, assessment, and development of critical talent pools — including high-potential (HiPo) employees — through structured talent reviews and calibration sessions facilitated in close partnership with HRBPs.

· Consult and partner with HRBPs on talent strategy and critical role planning within their assigned business units and sectors, serving as the dedicated talent management resource alongside the HRBP team.

· Build, monitor, and evolve succession readiness plans that align with business priorities for assigned client groups

· Assess organizational effectiveness to surface structural and capability gaps and recommend evidence-based interventions to the supporting HRBPs.

· Execute retention strategies including stay interviews, flight-risk identification, and targeted interventions for critical talent segments in partnership with HRBPs.

· Connect critical and high-potential talent to stretch assignments, mobility opportunities, and cross-functional experiences that accelerate readiness and development.

· Design and support targeted development programs in collaboration with Learning & Development and HRBPs to close identified capability gaps.

· Produce and maintain bench strength, pipeline readiness, and talent health reports; translate data into actionable insights for HR leadership and HRBP partners.

· Partner with HRBPs to ensure talent review action plan follow-through and drive accountability for critical talent outcomes within their client groups.


B. People Leadership & Team Development (M4 Managerial Responsibilities)

· Lead, coach, and develop direct reports, setting clear performance expectations and fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.

· Translate the Talent strategy and vision into team priorities, operational plans, and measurable goals with clear ownership and accountability.

· Conduct regular one-on-ones, performance reviews, and development conversations to grow team members' functional expertise and career progression.

· Hire, onboard, and integrate new team members as the function scales; establish team norms, workflows, and an effective operating cadence.

· Model inclusive leadership behaviors and champion talent practices within the team.

· Identify and remove barriers to team effectiveness; escalate critical risks and resource needs as appropriate.

· Serve as a senior thought partner to the head of global talent management, contributing to the overall strategic direction of TM COE.


C. Strategic Partnership & COE Collaboration

· Build trusted, advisory relationships with HRBP partners to integrate talent strategy into their client group planning and people decisions.

· Communicate talent health, succession risk, and pipeline readiness to HRBP partners and senior HR stakeholders through structured reporting and clear, data-driven narratives.

· Collaborate with Learning & Development, Total Rewards, and other COE partners to source and connect high-impact interventions and development solutions that close succession gaps and enhance retention of critical talent.

· Champion consistent use of talent management tools, frameworks, and processes, aligning to Global TM COE standards.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

· Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or a related field.

· 8+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 5 years in talent management, organizational development, or a closely related specialty.

· Demonstrated experience designing and facilitating talent reviews, succession planning processes, and HiPo identification and development programs.

· Proven track record of consulting with and influencing senior HR partners (HRBPs) on talent strategy, critical role planning, and workforce capability.

· Experience managing or leading HR teams, including setting goals, developing talent, and driving accountability.

· Strong analytical skills with experience translating talent data and bench strength metrics into strategic recommendations.

· Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to present complex talent insights clearly to HR leadership and HRBP audiences.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

· Master’s Degree in Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, or MBA with an HR concentration.

· Professional certification such as SHRM-SCP, SPHR, or a recognized talent management or coaching credential (e.g., SHL, Korn Ferry, DDI).

· Experience operating in a global, matrixed organization — ideally in manufacturing, technology, or defense/aerospace industries.

· Familiarity with psychometric and assessment tools used in talent identification and succession calibration.

· Experience building or scaling a talent management function or team.

· Proficiency with HRIS and talent management platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors) and data visualization tools.


COMPETENCIES / SKILLS


Competency/Proficiency Level & Description

Talent Strategy & Succession Planning

jobs.excerpt: Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities.
jobs.description:
Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. With over four decades of experience and teams of highly experienced professionals across 50+ office locations, we deliver impactful strategic insight and business development guidance across all sectors through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms, performance coaching, and curated corporate event programmes. Based in 30+ countries, we create services that connect decision-makers, spark innovation, and drive real business growth.

ME Perform is the performance improvement consultancy of the Marcus Evans Group. We work differently from most of the training market: we diagnose what is actually holding an organisation's people back, design a programme specifically for them, deliver it over months rather than days, and measure whether behaviour genuinely changed, then hand the client written evidence of what improved. Because the design work is done in-house by our Programme Scientists, our trainers get something rare: a fully built, properly researched session, briefed to them in advance, delivered to a cohort who have already been diagnosed and who are expecting to work rather than watch.

Job Summary

You will deliver live sessions, typically 90 to 150 minutes, mostly online, working from a session design and a written brief prepared for you by the Programme Scientist.

This is a delivery role, and deliberately so. You are not asked to write content, find clients, or sell anything. You are asked to be outstanding in the room. Based on the seniority and ability of the applicant there will also be an opportunity extend this role to a follow-up coach with the same group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver live sessions to our designed structure, to a consistently high standard.

  • Prepare from the written brief you receive at least five working days before each session — preparation time is paid within the session fee.

  • Run structured practice: our sessions are built around participants doing the thing, not listening to it explained. Expect to spend much of each session facilitating small-group work, giving feedback, and coaching in the moment.

  • Manage the room — including the sceptical senior participant, the quiet group, and the one who wants to debate rather than practise.

  • Submit brief written session notes within 48 hours of every session, so the Programme Scientist can adjust what comes next.

  • Take part in accreditation before your first client session, and stay open to observation and feedback afterwards.

Qualifications

Essential

  • 5-10 years of substantial experience in facilitating live learning or development sessions for professional or managerial audiences in a corporate setting.

  • Genuinely strong online delivery — confident running breakout groups, keeping cameras on and energy up, and handling the mechanics without it disrupting the session.

  • Comfortable delivering material you did not write, to a structure you are asked to keep to. This is the single most important requirement of the role.

  • Skilled at running practice and giving direct, useful feedback to adults — rather than presenting.

  • Reliable on the administrative side: punctual, responsive, and consistent with session notes.

  • Fluent, credible professional English, and comfortable with senior audiences.

Desirable

  • Experience in one or more of: leadership and management development, communication and influence, collaboration, resilience and change, or working across cultures.

  • A coaching qualification, or experience delivering one-to-one as well as group work.

  • Additional languages, or experience delivering to international cohorts working in a second language.

  • Familiarity with evidence-based learning design — you do not need to be a researcher, but you should be interested in why a session is built the way it is.

How the engagement works

  • Paid accreditation first: a methodology induction, then you deliver a full session for our Programme Scientist to observe, paid at half the standard session fee. Accreditation is completed before any client-facing work.

  • You are then briefed and booked per session. Fees are paid per session with preparation included, invoiced on delivery, on 30-day terms.

  • Standard contract terms apply, including confidentiality, intellectual property assignment for anything created in connection with the work, and non-solicitation of our clients. These are shared in full before accreditation.

  • If a client cancels at short notice, you are protected: cancellations inside five working days are paid in full.

Marcus Evans is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

INDG creates digital twins and CGI content systems for global product brands. In our Automotive vertical, that means turning complex vehicle data into images and animations that can represent a car across configurators, launch campaigns, print, exhibitions, and promotional videos.

We are looking for a Senior 3D Artist who can turn complex automotive data into polished visual output. You will work from high-poly vehicle assets, build materials, render stills and animations, composite final images, and keep quality consistent across large content sets.

Your impact is visible. You will create content that represents premium automotive brands in configurators, campaigns, launch campaigns, retail tools, and large-format experiences. The work must look beautiful, but it also has to survive scale.

What You Will Do

  • Create automotive CGI that holds up at close range
    Build still images and animations from high-poly vehicle models. Texture, shade, light, render, and composite final content for automotive brands with strict visual standards. You will work on exteriors, interiors, detail crops, accessories, colorways, wheels, trims, and motion sequences.

  • Own the render, not just the task
    Evaluate image quality from a senior production perspective. You can see when a render issue comes from lighting, material response, geometry, camera setup, render settings, or compositing. You will refine clearcoat, metallic flakes, glass, rubber, leather, stitching, displays, brushed metal, chrome, and shadow behavior until the image feels physically and visually right.

  • Work inside scalable production pipelines
    Create scenes and outputs that can survive large content sets. You will follow naming, versioning, render-layer, compositing, and scene-organization standards. You will help keep assets clean, reusable, and ready for configurators, campaign derivatives, market adaptations, and automated content workflows.

  • Improve quality while delivering content
    Implement feedback from art directors, leads, clients, and production teams without losing control of the setup. You will spot recurring issues, improve material libraries, refine lighting templates, document useful fixes, and help reduce manual rework across automotive production.

Requirements

You Have

  • Strong experience in automotive CGI and high-end 3D production. You are comfortable working with complex high-poly models, physically based materials, lighting setups, render passes, compositing workflows, and final image polish.

  • You know 3ds Max, V-Ray, Photoshop, and Nuke or After Effects at a professional level. Your portfolio or showreel demonstrates seniority through visual judgment, technical control, and finished output, not just clean modeling or isolated shots.

  • You can communicate clearly in English with artists, leads, producers, and technical teams. You can explain what is wrong in an image, what needs to change, and what tradeoff is being made.

Why Join INDG

INDG has spent more than 20 years building visual production systems for global brands. We are not a traditional creative agency and not a pure software vendor. We build the systems that turn physical products into digital twins, production-grade CGI, and scalable content.

Grip extends that work into AI-assisted content orchestration. For a Senior 3D Artist, that means your craft does not disappear into automation. It defines the quality standard the system must reproduce.

deine aufgaben

Du kennst dich mit Cloud-Native-Technologien aus und rollst moderne Software mit GitOps-Prinzipien aus? Du siehst in CloudOps mehr als das Zusammenstecken einzelner Tools und Automatisierungsskripten?

Dann werde unser neuer Cloud Engineer (all genders)! Die Vollzeit-Anstellung ist ab sofort, remote aus ganz Deutschland verfügbar.

dein profil

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb moderner Cloud Infrastruktur
  • Du definierst Infrastruktur nachvollziehbar als Code und legst Wert auf Code Qualität

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Cluster und automatisierst repetitive Aufgaben.
  • Du kannst technische Probleme analysieren, eingrenzen und nachhaltig lösen.
  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für sinnvolle Standards, ohne Teams unnötig einzuschränken, und findest Kompromisse.
  • Du kannst technische Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar begründen, dokumentieren und kommunizieren.
  • Du bist offen dafür, dich in neue Technologien einzuarbeiten und bestehende Lösungen kritisch zu hinterfragen.
  • Du hast sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1) und optional erste Deutschkenntnisse.

Unser Tech-Stack
  • Wir nutzen hauptsächlich Terraform/OpenTofu.
  • Als Cloud-Provider werden aktuell Azure, GCP und Telekom Public Cloud genutzt.
  • Für die CI Pipelines nutzen wir unter anderem Gitlab CI, GitHub Actions und gelegentlich Azure DevOps Pipelines.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $155,000–$175,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an accomplished Senior DevOps Engineer to architect, build, automate, and maintain enterprise-grade cloud infrastructure, CI/CD platforms, and deployment pipelines that support mission-critical applications operating at significant scale across multiple business domains. In this role, you will be responsible for the complete infrastructure lifecycle, from translating business and application requirements into secure, scalable cloud architectures to implementing infrastructure as code, automating deployments, monitoring production environments, and ensuring operational excellence throughout the application lifecycle. The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in cloud platforms, DevOps practices, infrastructure automation, containerization, and monitoring technologies, combined with strong experience supporting highly available, secure, and resilient production systems. You will work closely with software developers, solution architects, security engineers, QA teams, and business stakeholders in an Agile environment to deliver reliable, scalable, and cost-effective infrastructure that enables continuous software delivery and supports strategic business objectives.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of professional experience implementing and supporting enterprise DevOps practices, cloud infrastructure, automation, and CI/CD solutions in production environments.
  • Strong, demonstrable understanding of cloud computing principles, infrastructure architecture, networking, operating systems, virtualization, automation, high availability, disaster recovery, and system security best practices.
  • Advanced working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including compute, networking, storage, identity management, monitoring, and security services used in enterprise cloud environments.
  • Hands-on production experience designing and managing CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or similar automation platforms supporting enterprise software delivery.
  • Proven experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Azure Resource Manager, or equivalent automation frameworks for infrastructure provisioning and lifecycle management.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux system administration, Docker, Kubernetes, container orchestration, networking concepts, scripting languages (Bash, Python, PowerShell), and configuration management tools such as Ansible, Chef, or Puppet.
  • Solid experience with Git-based version control, branching strategies, code review processes, release management, DevOps workflows, and Agile software development methodologies.
  • Hands-on experience implementing monitoring, logging, observability, security, backup, disaster recovery, and cloud governance solutions across enterprise production environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose complex infrastructure issues, automate repetitive processes, and support mission-critical systems under tight operational deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience designing and supporting event-driven architectures, serverless computing, Kubernetes operators, service mesh technologies, and cloud-native application platforms.
  • Familiarity with DevSecOps practices, security automation, vulnerability management, policy-as-code, container security, secrets management, and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, or HIPAA.
  • Exposure to distributed systems, site reliability engineering (SRE), chaos engineering, blue-green deployments, canary releases, infrastructure resilience, and performance engineering methodologies.
  • Experience implementing automated testing, release automation, cloud cost optimization, platform engineering, self-service infrastructure, and continuous improvement initiatives within enterprise Agile and DevOps environments.

We are looking for a Client Success Coordinator to join our global team and play a key role in delivering exceptional client experiences. This is an exciting opportunity for an early-career professional who is passionate about customer success, relationship building, and driving value for clients.

How you will make a difference:

As our Client Success Coordinator, you will support a portfolio of approximately 75-100 clients serving as their day-to-day operational contact. You will contribute to client satisfaction, product adoption, and retention while developing the skills and expertise needed to progress within the Client Success career path.

This role is ideal for recent graduates and early-career professionals who bring strong communication skills, a customer-first mindset, and a desire to grow into a successful Client Success career.

Key responsibilities would include:

  • Serve as the day-to-day operational point of contact for an assigned portfolio of clients, ensuring timely and accurate follow-up on requests and inquiries.
  • Develop a strong understanding of each client's business objectives, service utilization, and success measures.
  • Help drive customer satisfaction, product adoption, and retention across your portfolio.
  • Respond to client questions through appropriate communication channels, documenting all activities in customer service and CRM systems.
  • Maintain accurate client records and account information within Salesforce and other internal platforms.
  • Educate clients on Safeguard Global's services, capabilities, and best practices to help maximize value and adoption.
  • Identify potential growth and expansion opportunities and collaborate with your manager to pursue them.

  • Escalate risks and concerns with clear documentation and recommendations.

Job Description:

Database Analyst /Administrator

GDIT has an opportunity for a dynamic and talented candidate to join our team supporting the Administrative Office of the US Courts (AOUSC) Mission Support Systems Division (MSSD) in one of its mission-critical applications that is used by all federal courts’ community. MSSD has a mature agile practice using the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) and supports a broad range of complex business systems which are instrumental to the AOUSC mission.

The Database Analyst/ Administrator will execute the following responsibilities:

  • Works within an Agile solution development environment with daily scrums, biweekly sprint planning and quarterly Program Increment planning.
  • Develops operating standards and best practices, including performance, security, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Ensures the proper definition, control, and coordination of data elements and standards, and the facilitation of efficient data relationships, systems integration, and physical structure.
  • Participates in the development and implementation of database management policies and standards for efficient quality control and data administration.
  • Collaborates with Product Owners and users to gather business requirements and define and maps them to technical requirements. Meets with agency leaders and stakeholders, collaborating with other consultants and program/agency personnel regarding the development of innovative data analysis techniques.
  • Demonstrates ability to document complex workflow designs to present to project team and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrates ability to work on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of multiple factors and frequently contributes to the development of new business strategy, ideas, and methods adhering to best practices within the Agile framework.
  • Collects, analyzes, and interprets large amounts of data to help guide business decisions. Experience with using advanced statistical analysis, data mining, and predictive modeling techniques.
  • Synthesizes disparate information and recognizes patterns and relationships across data; synthesizes large sets of data from multiple sources, develops data visualizations for the purposes of tracking key performance indicators and other critical metrics tied to program outcomes.
  • Hosts and conducts peer reviews of the code of other developers on the team. Performs data validation and ensures data accuracy and integrity.
  • Develops stored procedures, jobs, views, tables, and other database objects in SQL Server Management Studio.
  • Designs and develops dimensional data models including start and snowflake schemas, fact and dimension tables, and enterprise data marts to support analytics, reporting and business intelligence solutions.
  • Develops and deploys ETL packages using CI/CD pipeline. Exposure to core configuration management systems for version control.
  • Works with Atlassian Suite of software development management tools.
  • Indexes system and application logs in to the Splunk system monitoring application, then creates dashboards, alerts, and reports from those logs.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least seven (7+) years of Server database maintenance and database analysis or similar role.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Programming, Computer Engineering or relevant computer-based major. Experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
  • Database or cloud certification preferred such as Microsoft Certified Azure Database Administrator Associate, Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert or equivalent industry recognized database certification.
  • Proficient experience with Databases like Microsoft SQL Server, Informix, Oracle.
  • Experience with Snowflake and exposure to cloud platforms, Azure cloud platform.
  • Experienced with completing database environment installation, configuration, on-going administration support.
  • Demonstrated understanding of standard Data warehouse concepts.
  • Adept with data modeling, data mapping, data flow diagrams and data marts.
  • Previous experience architecting and implementing cloud-based database solutions on various platforms.
  • Experience with Data migration from legacy on-premises database to multi-cloud/hybrid cloud platforms.
  • Proven ability to spearhead and work independently, prioritize, and get things done.
  • Strong analytical, technical, problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent organization and time management skills and ability to identify priorities to accomplish a variety of tasks on schedule.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills and ability to work with people at every level. Comfortable writing down ideas, implementation plans and status reports.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience creating and managing database reports, visualizations, and dashboards.
  • Knowledge of court operations and law enforcement business data.

Transform technology into opportunity as a Senior Business Analyst at GDIT. Shape what’s next for mission-critical government projects while shaping what’s next for your engineering career.


The Naval Enterprise Service Desk (NESD) program is deploying a cognitive Artificial Intelligence (AI) platform integrated with a COTS IT Service Management (ITSM) solution to consolidate Tier 1 IT service desks and automate incident resolution. As the Navy’s solution partner, GDIT is implementing leading-edge technology to support the Navy’s evolving business model.


In this role, you will work collaboratively with an agile team of product owners, system users, and developers to capture, document, and refine requirements that populate the Agile sprint backlog. The ideal candidate brings leadership, data analysis, and requirements analysis skills to ensure designed solutions align with business and mission objectives. Experience with service desks, ITSM, and AI is preferred; however, if you have strong business/technical analysis experience and a genuine interest in learning about new technologies, we’d like to speak with you. Because this is a client-facing role, strong interpersonal and communication skills are essential.


MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT
As a Senior Business Analyst the work you’ll lead the translation of Government stakeholders’ business needs into technical requirements that drive NESD Service Desk capabilities across the Cognitive AI platform, Contact Center, and ITSM suite.

  • Lead the elicitation, analysis, and documentation of business processes and functional requirements for NESD solutions.
  • Perform system function analysis to ensure capabilities align with stakeholder needs and Navy ITSM objectives.
  • Facilitate and collaborate with Government and Program stakeholders, system users, and development teams on design recommendations and documentation.

  • Review solution designs to verify alignment with requirements, stakeholder expectations, and program constraints.
  • Engage directly with Customer and Program stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage expectations, and validate proposed solutions.
  • Support testing activities (e.g., requirements validation, UAT support), ensuring defects are traced back to requirements and that acceptance criteria are met.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED

Bring your initiative and drive for innovation to GDIT. Our Senior Business Analyst must have:

  • Security Clearance: Active Secret clearance.
  • Experience: 3+ years of experience translating business requirements into technical requirements for software engineering or similar technical teams, including work on complex or multi-system initiatives.
  • Domain Knowledge: Practical familiarity with AI/cognitive or machine learning concepts, or a strong interest and demonstrated ability to learn these quickly.

  • Work Location: Remote.
  • Citizenship: US Citizenship required.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience working on IT service desk or ITSM implementations (e.g., ServiceNow, BMC Remedy/Helix, or similar platforms).
  • Experience with cognitive AI, virtual agents, or chatbots integrated into contact center or ITSM solutions.
  • Background supporting DoW or Federal programs, particularly the U.S. Navy or other service branches.
  • Hands-on experience working within Scrum or other Agile frameworks, including writing user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Familiarity with data analytics, reporting, or metrics related to service desk performance and customer experience (e.g., FCR, AHT, CSAT).
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., ITIL Foundation, Certified Scrum Master (CSM), or similar).

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE
At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Als Operations Manager bei EVOLVE Digital verantwortest du die operative Steuerung in der Organisation. Du sorgst dafür, dass die strategische Ausrichtung des Unternehmens im operativen Tagesgeschäft wirksam wird. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung triffst du operative Grundsatzentscheidungen, setzt Prioritäten und schaffst die Voraussetzungen dafür, dass das EVOLVE planbar, effizient und zukunftsfähig wachsen kann.

Über EVOLVE Digital

EVOLVE Digital ist eine spezialisierte E-Commerce- und Performance-Marketing-Agentur mit einem klaren Fokus auf skalierbare Wachstumssysteme, strukturierte Prozesse und messbare Ergebnisse.

Es ist ein Umfeld für Führungspersönlichkeiten, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Komplexität beherrschen und Organisationen nachhaltig auf Skalierung ausrichten wollen.

Deine Aufgaben im Überblick

Du baust nicht nur die Prozesse im Hintergrund. Du sorgst im Alltag dafür, dass unser Unternehmen und das gesamte Team reibungsloser funktionieren: Deadlines werden eingehalten, Aufgaben abgeschlossen, Projekte kommen voran.

  • Du führst neue Automationen und Prozesse über Claude, Make und n8n ein. Für die Umsetzung stellen wir dir ein Team zur Verfügung.

  • Hohe Affinität für AI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude und Co. Du nutzt sie, um Systeme zu bauen und Probleme zu lösen, nicht nur ,um Texte zu erstellen.

Was wir dir bieten

jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY: The Payroll Analyst I supports enterprise payroll operations by processing, auditing, and analyzing payroll for a large, complex, and highly unionized workforce of 40,000+ employees across 150+ collective bargaining agreements (CBAs). The incumbent is responsible for ensuring payroll accuracy, compliance, and timeliness through detailed data validation, reconciliation, and application of union contracts, as well as federal, state, and local payroll regulations. The Payroll Analyst I serves as a subject matter expert in payroll processing and analysis, partnering cross-functionally with HR Management, Total Rewards, HRIS, and field operations to support labor agreements, resolve payroll issues, and improve payroll processes. The incumbent also contributes to payroll system enhancements through testing and implementation activities while managing high-volume transactions and employee inquiries in a fast-paced environment.


PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Performs detailed payroll processing, auditing, and analysis for a large, complex environment encompassing 150+ union agreements and 40,000+ employees.
  • Conducts large scale payroll data validation and reconciliation, auditing payroll during each cycle to confirm accuracy of complex deductions and earnings, including LOA, one-time payments, union dues, commissions, PTO, and time reporting.
  • Reviews and evaluates CBA ratifications, applying changes to payroll processes to support accurate employee compensation. Analyzes high volume payroll data to ensure compliance with union contracts, internal policies, and regulatory requirements, including support of new or revised labor agreements.
  • Works cross functionally with HR Management, Total Rewards, HRIS, Field Management, and other cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on payroll processes and requirements.
  • Utilizes advanced Excel skills—including PivotTables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and data queries—to review, reconcile, and validate payroll data. Responds to employee payroll inquiries through ServiceNow.
  • Resolves payroll tickets related to time and absence corrections, additional earnings, rate overrides, and other pay adjustments for both on cycle and off cycle payrolls.
  • Assists with payroll system enhancements by participating in testing, upgrades, and implementation efforts.
  • Responsible for knowledge transfer to other team members and supporting the team.
  • Other non-essential duties as assigned or may be necessary

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 1-2 years payroll experience, preferable in a large, complex organization.
  • Knowledge of FLSA, Regular Rate of Pay calculations, and collective bargaining agreements.
  • Understanding of federal, state, and local payroll laws and regulations.
  • Experience with Workday Payroll.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with the ability to manage high-volume transactions with accuracy.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office products, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and OneNote.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • 0 - 2 years of payroll experience including processing payroll in large and complex organizations, leveraging payroll systems (e.g., Workday, ADP, etc.) and utilizing excel for data analysis and reconciliation.

The Payroll Analyst I must be able to work normal business hours during MST.


Pay range $56,400.00 - $77,550/Annually

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

GDIT has an opportunity for a dynamic and talented candidate to join our team supporting the Administrative Office of the US Courts (AOUSC) Case Management Systems Office (CMSO) in its modernization effort for one of its mission-critical applications that is used by all U.S. district and appellate courts’ staff members and external stakeholders. The Business Analyst will execute the following responsibilities:

  • Elicit and capture business requirements in an Agile software development environment (including but not limited to consulting with product owners, customers, key stakeholders, or end users).
  • Document and manage acceptance criteria, business rules, requirement documents, risks, issues, and dependencies.
  • Work closely with Product Owners to prioritize user stories, perform user research, user centered design and usability testing throughout the software development lifecycle.

  • Decompose Epics into detailed functional and nonfunctional requirements.

  • Document standard operating procedures (SOP) and maintaining the release information radiator for the team.
  • Develop process flow, wireframes, high and low fidelity mockups, and dependency diagrams to show dependencies between user stories, visualize the flow of work, and identify bottlenecks and critical paths.
  • Support the testing team to ensure the system is aligned with the vision of the business teams.
  • Review and maintain documentation for distribution, including project and process documentation, instructional materials, user guides, training manuals, and online content in content authoring tools (i.e., RoboHelp).
  • Support and conduct user interviews, group workshops, and surveys as required to develop detailed functional and technical requirements.
  • Conduct business process analysis, workflow analysis, and business process re-engineering.
  • Provide technical assistance and guidance through performing gap analyses, workflow analysis, Analysis of Alternative (AoA) studies, business process modeling, wireframes, and storyboards.
  • Deliver technical briefings and hosting meetings to diverse audiences.

  • Bachelor’s Degree plus 5+ years of experience (or master’s degree plus 4+ years) in supporting the product owner and agile team, eliciting business needs, maintaining user stories in the backlog, writing, and maintaining technical documentation, modeling business processes and system requirements, architecture, and data.
  • Experience with at least one enterprise software development project within the past three years.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments, processes, and practices.
  • Experience assisting with testing, by writing acceptance criteria and confirming test cases result.
  • Experience with producing relevant and current requirements, sizing user stories correctly, and removing roadblocks prior to sprints starts.
  • Ability to handle a fast-paced Agile software development environment.
  • Experience using Agile tools such as JIRA, Confluence, etc.
  • Ability to develop & decompose Epics, Features, and User Stories.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and be effective at communicating with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong problem-solving capacity in a highly visible and mission critical environment.
  • Strong articulation, listening, and communication skills required for interaction with diverse audiences and self-forming teams.
  • Adaptable ability to perform independently and within a team.
  • Energetic, goal oriented, detailed oriented, proactive, innovative, hardworking, and patient.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Understanding of database design, SQL Techniques, and perform database queries.
  • Experience in Adobe XD, Visio, Figma and usability testing tools.
  • Knowledge of user experience (UX) and Human centered design (HCD) processes and methodology.
  • Experience with Interaction Design, interaction modeling, and mental modeling.
  • Creating user scenarios, user flow, low fidelity, and high-fidelity wireframes.
  • Skills in wireframing and/or prototyping tools and methodologies.
  • Experience on UX strategy, user researcher, user interviews, surveys, and usability study. Builds personas, user journey map, empathy maps.
  • Experience on UX analysis to conduct competitive analysis, market assessments and heuristic evaluations.

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Payments Risk Operations team protects Airbnb's guests, hosts, and the platform from fraud, financial loss, and abuse. Our investigators and agents review high-risk activity every day, and the quality of their tools directly shapes the speed, accuracy, and consistency of every decision they make. You will join a team of operators, analysts, and program leaders who partner closely with Platform, Engineering, Data Science, Design, and Legal to keep our community safe.

The Difference You Will Make

As the Senior Risk Tools & Automation Lead, you will own the end-to-end agent experience for risk and fraud operations. You will define what our investigators need, design and conceptualize the next generation of the risk workbench, and drive automation through process efficiencies and AI. You will be the voice of the agent in tooling decisions and the bridge between operational reality and technical execution. Your work will reduce manual effort, shorten handle times, improve decision quality, and free our experts to focus on the most complex cases.

A Typical Day

Agent experience

  • Own the end-to-end agent experience across risk and fraud investigation workflows, from case intake through decision, documentation, and quality review.
  • Spend time with agents to observe workflows, map pain points, and quantify friction in handle time, clicks, context switching, and error rates.
  • Establish feedback loops (surveys, office hours, champion networks, ticket intake) so agent needs are captured, prioritized, and closed out transparently.
  • Partner with Training, Quality, and Workforce Management to ensure tooling changes land with clear enablement, documentation, and adoption tracking.

Tooling requirements and improvements

  • Translate operational needs into clear, prioritized business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that Platform and Engineering can build against.
  • Own and manage the operational risk tooling roadmap and backlog, balancing quick wins, foundational investments, and policy or regulatory needs.
  • Lead intake, triage, and prioritization of tooling requests using impact sizing (time saved, loss prevented, accuracy gained, risk reduced).
  • Drive user acceptance testing (UAT), launch readiness, and post-launch measurement for every tooling release.

Workbench design and conceptualization

  • Define the long-term vision for a unified risk workbench that brings signals, account history, payment data, linked entities, and decisioning into a single, intuitive workspace.
  • Partner with Platform, Design, and UX Research to run discovery, build journey maps, create wireframes and prototypes, and conduct usability testing with agents.
  • Champion design principles of simplicity, consistency, and accessibility so agents can make accurate decisions quickly and confidently.

Automation through efficiencies and AI

  • Identify, size, and prioritize automation opportunities across manual and repetitive work, including case routing, data gathering, enrichment, summarization, and low-risk decisioning.
  • Partner with Platform, Engineering, and Data Science to design and deploy AI-assisted capabilities such as case summaries, recommended actions, agent copilots, and automated documentation.
  • Define human-in-the-loop guardrails, quality controls, and monitoring so automation improves efficiency without compromising accuracy, fairness, or compliance.
  • Build business cases that tie automation to measurable outcomes and report progress to senior leadership.

Cross-functional leadership

  • Serve as the primary operations policy partner to Platform, Engineering, Data Science, Design, Policy, Legal, Compliance, and Finance on all risk tooling initiatives.
  • Influence without authority, align technical and non-technical stakeholders on priorities, tradeoffs, and timelines.
  • Communicate roadmaps, launches, and impact clearly to audiences ranging from frontline agents to executive leadership.

Your Expertise

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in operations, program management, or product management.
  • 5+ years of experience in fraud, payment risk, trust and safety, or a related investigations industry.
  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred.
  • Proven track record of writing successful business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that led to shipped tools with measurable impact.
  • Familiarity with user experience testing and design, including discovery interviews, journey mapping, usability testing, and working from wireframes or prototypes.
  • Demonstrated success in cross-functional collaboration with both technical partners (Engineering, Data Science, Platform) and non-technical partners (Operations, Legal, Compliance, Finance).
  • Experience identifying and delivering automation or process efficiency improvements at scale, with results tied to metrics such as handle time, throughput, accuracy, or loss.
  • Strong analytical skills, with comfort using data to size opportunities, build business cases, and measure outcomes (SQL or similar skills a plus).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical and operational concepts for executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience designing or launching agent workbenches, case management systems, or investigation consoles.
  • Experience applying generative AI or large language models in operational settings, such as agent copilots, case summarization, or automated decision support.
  • Working knowledge of fraud and risk domains such as payment fraud, chargebacks, account takeover, identity verification, or AML.
  • Familiarity with workflow and automation platforms (for example, rules engines, RPA, or low-code tools) and with agile delivery practices.
  • Experience leading change management and driving adoption across large, globally distributed operations teams.
  • Experience working at an e-commerce, travel, fintech, or payments company.

How We'll Take Care of You:

jobs.description:
Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease. Its Clinical Intelligence takes on the routine, high-volume work of chronic care – monitoring patients, surfacing risks, and coordinating action – so clinicians can focus on the decisions that require them. Grounded in partnerships with more than 20 leading health systems, deep EMR integrations, dedicated medical group, and experience serving a population of more than 100,000 patients, the system learns from real-world care delivery, improving as it scales. Cadence has been recognized by TIME as one of the Top 100 HealthTech Companies and by LinkedIn as a Top Startup (#4, 2025).

The Role

We’re hiring a Clinical Navigator (Licensed Practical Nurse) to deliver virtual chronic care support for Medicare patients enrolled in Cadence care programs.

Clinical Navigators deliver proactive, patient-centered outreach and follow-through. Depending on program needs, this role includes structured patient check-ins, coaching and goal-setting, care coordination to close gaps in care, and addressing barriers such as access to resources, transportation, or medication refills. Clinical Navigators document patient interactions in the Cadence platform and collaborate closely with the clinical team to escalate concerns and coordinate next steps, ensuring patients feel supported, informed, and engaged throughout their care journey.

Schedule

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States. Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, from 8am to 5pm or 9am to 6pm Eastern Time.

What You’ll Do

  • Conduct outbound telephonic patient outreach and provide one-on-one coaching and support to patients managing chronic conditions, including but not limited to type 2 diabetes, hypertension, and cardiovascular disease.
  • Help patients execute personalized care plans and achieve their goals by providing education and coaching focused on behavior modification, nutrition, physical activity, and self-management strategies using evidence-based techniques such as motivational interviewing and SMART goals.
  • Conduct comprehensive assessments of patients' health status, lifestyle behaviors, nutritional habits, and readiness to change.
  • Educate patients on disease management, medication adherence, symptom recognition, and prevention strategies, and execute care delivery tasks in accordance with Cadence clinical policies and established protocols, under appropriate clinical supervision.
  • Monitor patients' progress, adherence to treatment plans, and health outcomes through regular check-ins and remote monitoring tools.
  • Document patient interactions, outcomes, and follow-up plans in the Cadence platform; identify barriers to care (including social needs) and connect patients with resources or internal support pathways.
  • Collaborate in real time with clinicians and patient support teams using tools such as our Cadence Platform, Google Workspace, and Slack, and contribute feedback to improve workflows in a fast-moving, change-oriented environment.

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

Who You Are

  • A clinician who thrives at the intersection of rigorous care standards and a care delivery model that is still being built.
  • Skilled in patient education, coaching, and care coordination - you meet patients where they are in life, considering their age, lifestyle, and diet.
  • Disciplined in documentation and follow-through, with the attention to detail required for accurate clinical records in a remote environment.
  • Reliable and consistent in schedule adherence, with the interpersonal communication skills to build trust with patients over the phone.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-paced environment with evolving workflows, and tech-savvy enough to navigate and troubleshoot multiple systems simultaneously while keeping patients engaged.
  • Comfortable using AI-assisted clinical tools (such as Gemini or Open Evidence) to support patient interactions and surface relevant clinical context, while maintaining clinical judgment as the primary guide for every patient decision.
  • Biased toward action - you bring clinical authority to every interaction, make the call when it counts, and take ownership of outcomes.

What You Need
