  • Remote work readiness (including stable high-speed WiFi) is required.
  • Fluency in Spanish is strongly preferred.
  • Experience providing patient education and support to individuals managing chronic conditions is preferred.
  • Fluency with AI-assisted clinical tools (such as Gemini, Open Evidence, or comparable platforms) and the ability to speak credibly with providers and patients about where AI supports care delivery and where human judgment remains non-negotiable.

We’re always meeting therapists who would be a great fit for our team. This is an open posting, so we’ll be collecting applications and reaching out as needed based on our current client needs. This is an independent contractor role.

What This Role Actually Looks Like

We invest heavily in growing your caseload through marketing, client matching, and a strong referral engine. What we need from you is a partner in that effort: someone who shows up consistently, runs excellent Meet & Greet sessions, builds strong therapeutic relationships, and keeps clients engaged in thoughtful treatment planning.

We do the heavy lifting on visibility and operations. You focus on delivering excellent clinical care and building a caseload that lasts.

Hours

  • Typically 8 to 10 hours a week to start
  • Evening and weekend availability is a strong asset
  • Potential for schedule growth, based on your availability and our demand.

What We Handle, So You Don't Have To

Billing, scheduling, client intake admin, and back-office support are all covered. Our secure telehealth platform gives you one place to manage sessions and notes. Your time goes to clinical work and client relationships, not chasing paperwork.

Compensation

Our compensation model reflects clinical experience, tenure, client demand, market rates, and the full support that comes with practicing at Shift Collab. Your rate is part of a broader model that includes client referrals and matching, marketing, billing, scheduling, intake administration, technology, and ongoing practice support.

Why Therapists Stay

  • Remote work. We're remote-first, so there's no commute.
  • Real professional growth. Regular workshops, webinars, and clinical training, plus access to supervision and peer groups.
  • Admin and marketing support. We take care of the infrastructure behind your practice and invest in bringing new clients to Shift.
  • A real community. Being 100% virtual doesn't mean practicing alone. Peer supervision, team meetings, and knowledge-sharing keep you connected.
  • Your own professional presence. We help build your bio and visibility, with opportunities for some therapists to write, speak, or contribute their expertise publicly.
  • Support for you, too. Wellness resources, peer support, regular touchpoints, and social events help you stay connected to the community.

Who Thrives Here

Therapists who:

  • Approach the therapeutic relationship with engagement over acronyms
  • Deliver high-quality, accessible virtual care and understand virtual-first practice
  • Excel at Meet & Greet sessions and know how to turn a first conversation into a strong therapeutic match
  • Take retention and treatment planning seriously so clients feel cared for and know where their therapy is going
  • See caseload growth as a shared effort and are ready to actively partner on it
  • Can offer some evening availability, where client demand is highest
  • Want a long-term engagement, not a short-term gig

What You Bring

  • Master's in Social Work or Counselling Psychology, registered as an MSW RSW or RP
  • A minimum of 2 years of post-licensure experience
  • Professional liability insurance
  • Reliable internet and a secure, private workspace
  • Strong virtual therapy skills and comfort with telehealth platforms
  • Experience or training in any of the following is a strong asset: personality disorders, workplace injuries, narcissistic abuse recovery, complex PTSD (C-PTSD), somatic or body focused therapies, anxiety, and couples therapy
  • Some evening availability, ideally between 6 and 9 PM, as our clients are asking for more evening appointments. You don’t need to work only evenings to be considered
  • Fluency in additional languages beyond English is a strong asset
  • A genuine commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion and to working with a diverse client base
  • Professional references and a Vulnerable Sector Check, required for all successful candidates

Ready to Apply?

This posting is open on an ongoing basis. If this sounds like your kind of fit, we’d love to hear from you. We’ll review applications as they come in and reach out as needed.

Our Hiring Philosophy

Our organization is deeply committed to employment equity and diversity in the workplace. We wholeheartedly welcome applications from women, members of racialized groups, visible minorities, Aboriginal persons, persons with disabilities, persons of any sexual orientation, and persons of any gender identity or gender expression.

We are committed to ensuring that each individual has genuine, open, and unhindered access to employment opportunities within our company. Accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment process. If you require accommodations for interviews or other meetings, please let us know.

Disclaimer

In accordance with Ontario's Employment Standards Act, we want to be transparent about our use of artificial intelligence in this hiring process. Shift Collab uses applicant tracking software (Workable) that may include AI-assisted features to help organize, parse, and rank applications. All hiring decisions, including screening, interviewing, and final selection, are made by members of our People Operations and Clinical teams. AI is used to support our process, not to make decisions on our behalf.

If you would like to learn more, please visit our website at

We are alight with passion over building this remarkable business from the ground up. Everything we do matters. As an individual contributor but with an eye towards sales leadership, you will own your sales pipeline, manage the full sales cycle, and be accountable for achieving your revenue targets. You'll thrive in an environment where not everything is already defined, where initiative and autonomy are essential, and where you have the opportunity to influence how we grow.

This role is ideal for someone energized by ownership, doing hard things, motivated by measurable results, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and excited by the opportunity to help build something from the ground up. jobs.description:
About the role

Wealthfront is looking for a Senior Staff Product Designer to help drive design for our Investing products, reporting to the Design Director for Self-Directed Investing. Building great financial products requires digging diligently into the details to address complex problems with elegant solutions. We’re seeking a designer who cares deeply about all aspects of a great product experience, from strategy to pattern to pixel.

Wealthfront pioneered automated investing by offering broad access to sophisticated investing strategies at a fraction of the cost of traditional financial advisers. Our mission is to build a financial system that favors people over institutions. On this team, you would be a key part of expanding the ways we help our clients build long-term wealth through saving and investing.

Success in this role requires strong collaboration skills, the ability to think in scalable systems/platforms, and a high bar for craft & execution. A passion for investing or experience building consumer financial technology products is highly desirable.

Growing and managing your wealth is fundamental to being able to build the life you want with the people who matter most. This is a unique opportunity to be at the center of charting the next generation of technology innovation in investing products. If this gets you excited, we want to hear from you!

Design at Wealthfront

Designers at Wealthfront transform complex financial technology into simple and delightful experiences. Our commitment to our clients and high bar for craft set us apart from traditional financial institutions, fostering trust with our clients and empowering them to build lasting wealth on their own terms.

We pride ourselves on our meticulous attention to detail, consistently striving for excellence in all areas of our craft. We place just as much emphasis on the words we use to communicate with our clients as we do the interactive elements of our experiences. This shows up in our team structure–we have nearly a 1:1 ratio of content designers to product designers. We understand how design plays an important role in the success of our business and we are active participants in various leadership forums.

Collaboration is at the core of our approach. We work closely with our counterparts in engineering, product management, research, data science, legal, and compliance to define opportunities and explore solutions. We are equal partners in making strategic decisions and defining impactful roadmaps. We embrace a culture of continuous learning, prioritizing the magnitude of our successes over the percentage of times we are successful.

Most importantly, we love what we do! We are passionate about our mission, the financial technology space, and our clients. We take pride in our culture with a high bar, and a low ego.

Learn more about our design team at

We’re a remote friendly team and open to candidates in the US.

Key responsibilities

  • Create structure and drive outcomes for high-ambiguity, high-complexity work, including organizing and driving design sprints, upleveling strategy and craft, designing and delivering world-class designs

  • Become the go-to designer for investing initiatives, with an in-depth understanding of current and future endeavors

  • Use design to accelerate strategic decision-making by harnessing skills such as rapid prototyping and broad design exploration

  • Help innovate and scale as a company by partnering with leaders across Wealthfront. Identify and pursue impactful ideas on everything from what we build to how we work, such that we are able to learn as quickly and efficiently as possible

  • Uphold culture and team health by leading design-team wide initiatives, bolstering an inclusive environment, defining new patterns and processes to mature the design team

  • Ensure positive and productive collaboration by partnering with pm, eng, research, data science, legal, compliance, and other designers to identify, prioritize, and ship high-impact opportunities across Investing products and Wealthfront

About You

  • 8+ years of product design experience in a consumer software company

  • Experience working in consumer tech companies shipping exceptional quality products in a fast paced environment

  • Ability to communicate abstract design concepts visually and verbally in a clear and engaging manner to senior leaders and executives.

  • A self-starter with the ability to manage multiple projects across teams and navigate ambiguity

  • Ability to think strategically and shape the user experience overall, beyond just design. You’re an exceptional product thinker who takes a deep interest in understanding the business

  • You have a proven track record setting a vision for great customer experiences, inspiring others to get behind a vision, translating a vision into roadmap, and ensuring your team ships high quality experiences to bring the team’s vision to customers

  • You effectively use tools such as user experience methods, innovation, ideation, storytelling, prototyping, design frameworks, concept visualization, problem-framing skills and design principles.

  • Models a respectful, inclusive culture where debate is welcomed

  • Bonus: experience building modern fintech products

Mindset that excels at Wealthfront

  • Someone who embraces complexity, loves engaging in intellectually rigorous discussions, and critically evaluates trade-offs from a customer and business perspective

  • Someone who transforms ambiguity into clarity and navigates the organization to drive alignment

  • Someone who consistently thinks about the company and team first and has the resilience to work through tough situations, steps up and leads the team

  • Someone who goes above and beyond to make others around them successful

  • Someone who is enterprising and demonstrates high agency. You don’t wait for change—you come to the table with proposals on how to improve

  • Someone who deeply cares about learning and growing with the company

Estimated annual salary: ~$240,000 plus generous equity and a discretionary bonus.

Benefits include medical, vision, dental, 401K matching, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, generous time off, parental leave, wellness reimbursements, professional development, employee investing discount, and more!

About Wealthfront

Here at Wealthfront, our mission is to create a financial system that favors people, not institutions. We do this by leveraging technology to build powerful, low-cost, and easy-to-use financial products that help modern investors grow and manage their money.

We started with the ambition to transform the investment advisory industry when we pioneered automated investing in 2011. By automating strategies typically reserved for the wealthy, we unlocked access to high quality investment advice for a digitally-native generation that was underserved by traditional institutions. Since then, we've expanded to a full suite of products designed to help our clients save, spend, invest, and borrow for all of their goals, including:

•A Cash Account that, through our program banks, offers one of the highest annual percentage yields on uninvested cash in the industry, while providing instant and secure access to your money with no account fees and a full suite of checking features.

• Multiple automated investing portfolios managed for you and tailored for long-term wealth building across various financial needs, including general investing, retirement, family wealth management, and more. Our taxable investing accounts are designed to unlock tax savings through sophisticated strategies like fixed income, tax-loss harvesting, and direct indexing—which we offer at industry-leading low costs and accessible minimums.

• A zero-commission Brokerage Account with 8000+ stocks and ETFs that’s designed to give DIY investors an incredibly easy way to get started investing. Plus, with our Cash Account, they can earn a high yield (from program banks) until the minute they’re ready to invest.

• A digital-first mortgage experience designed to reduce costs, remove unnecessary friction, and aim to offer rates consistently below the national average.

Our award-winning products have attracted over 1.5 million funded clients who trust us with more than $100 billion of their hard earned savings on our platform—and we're far from done. If you’re inspired to help us reshape the financial industry as we create our next chapter, let’s talk!

jobs.description:
To protect candidates from recruitment scams, MarCom Group will only communicate with applicants through domains such as @marcomgroup.com or . MarCom Group will never contact an applicant from another domain or ask to provide payment as part of the recruiting process.

MarCom Group is a top-ranked creative agency that provides strategic advertising, branding, marketing, design, digital, and events solutions. We are a woman-owned small business founded in 1996 in the Washington, DC area.

The Audience Insights Analyst is a member of MarCom Group’s Brand Strategy department, specializing in audience research, workforce intelligence, and candidate persona development to support awareness and recruitment marketing initiatives. This role is responsible for collecting, analyzing, and interpreting labor market data, demographic and psychographic research, workforce trends, and candidate behaviors to develop comprehensive, data-driven audience personas that inform recruitment marketing strategies. Working collaboratively with Creative, Media, and Account Services teams, the Audience InsightsAnalyst transforms complex research and workforce data into actionable insights that help clients better understand, attract, and engage priority talent audiences. The position plays a key role in identifying high-value talent segments, understanding candidate motivations and barriers, mapping candidate journeys, and translating audience intelligence into strategic recommendations for messaging, creative development, media targeting, and campaign optimization. The Audience InsightsAnalyst ensures marketing strategies are grounded in meaningful audience understanding, supported by reliable research methodologies, and aligned with hiring objectives and applicable compliance requirements.

MarCom Group Core Values 
 
At MarCom Group, our “Core Four” values guide every interaction — with each other and with our clients: 

 

  • Foster Collaboration: We value every voice. We win as one. We proactively seek opportunities to collaborate, reaching across teams and with clients to create solutions together.  
  • Inspire Possibilities: We imagine more, create boldly, and turn ideas into reality. We stay open-minded, flexible, and creative, always seeking innovative approaches.  
  • Champion People: We invest in people, and they invest in themselves, so we grow together. We celebrate our team, share wins, and have immense compassion for each other, our clients, and the audiences we serve.  
  • Lead with Why: We seek to understand, are always curious, and act with intention. We ask “why” to get to the root of challenges and deliver solutions that truly matter

Supervisory Responsibilities

The Audience InsightsAnalyst position does not formally supervise other employees but may facilitate research workstreams, guide deliverable development, and provide direction to internal team members supporting research development tasks.   

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to identify, understand, and prioritize talent audiences relevant to recruitment initiatives.
  • Lead the development, refinement, and maintenance of research-based audience personas for marketing campaigns, integrating demographic, psychographic, behavioral, geographic, occupational, and motivational data to identify distinct candidate segments.
  • Translate audience research into persona frameworks that inform campaign messaging, creative direction, channel selection, and audience engagement strategies.
  • Develop detailed audience profiles that capture candidate characteristics, career motivations, values, communication preferences, employment barriers, and recruitment decision drivers.
  • Create scalable persona templates, segmentation frameworks, and audience intelligence resources that can be applied across multiple client accounts.
  • Establish processes for validating and updating personas using campaign performance data, candidate feedback, and emerging research.
  • Monitor changes in workforce trends, candidate sentiment, and employment preferences that may influence recruitment marketing effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with Brand Strategy, Creative, Media, and Account Services teams to incorporate audience intelligence into integrated recruitment marketing strategies.
  • Participate in campaign planning sessions, creative brief development, client workshops, and strategic presentations to ensure audience insights are incorporated into execution.
  • Analyze marketing performance data to assess audience engagement, candidate response, and progression through awareness and recruitment funnels.
  • Develop clear, compelling audience intelligence reports, persona profiles, candidate journey maps, and research presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Skills & Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Market Research, Psychology, Sociology, Data Analytics, Business, Communications, Human Resources, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in market research, audience insights, workforce analytics, talent intelligence, recruitment marketing, or a related field.
  • Experience developing audience segments, candidate personas, or research-based audience profiles.
  • Experience conducting qualitative and quantitative research – including demographic, behavioral, psychographic, geographic, and occupational data - and translating into actionable recommendations.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint for analysis, visualization, and presentations.
  • Strong analytical, communication, organizational, and project management skills.
  • Ability to collaborate across teams and explain insights to technical and nontechnical audiences.

Preferred

  • Experience in recruitment marketing, employer branding, talent acquisition, workforce development, or public-sector marketing.
  • Familiarity with federal hiring, workforce priorities, or specialized talent populations.
  • Experience with labor market, survey, social listening, digital analytics, CRM, or recruitment funnel tools (i.e. Sprout, Salesforce/Yello, BLS, SEMRush, Qualtrics/Survey Monkey, Lightcast, etc.)
  • Experience with data visualization or business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Knowledge of statistical analysis, audience segmentation, research validation, candidate journey mapping, or competitive talent analysis.
  • Understanding of equal employment opportunity principles, privacy, and responsible use of audience data.

About Baker Tilly Digital

Baker Tilly has an exciting opportunity for an experienced insurance transformation leader to join our growing Digital Consulting practice. We combine deep industry, functional and technology capabilities to help insurers navigate complex business and digital transformations, modernize core operations and deliver measurable business outcomes. This Senior Manager will lead client engagements and multidisciplinary teams while helping expand our insurance industry capabilities.


You Will Enjoy This Role If...

  • You are energized by solving complex business and technology challenges for insurance organizations.
  • You enjoy leading diverse teams and translating strategy into practical, measurable change.
  • You thrive in an entrepreneurial, collaborative consulting environment and want to help grow an insurance-focused offering.
  • You value building trusted relationships with clients, coaching colleagues and continually developing your expertise.

What You Will Do

  • Lead insurance client engagements from discovery and business case development through roadmap, design, implementation, testing, deployment and adoption.
  • Advise property and casualty, life and annuity, health insurance, broker, MGA and insurance services clients as relevant to your expertise; understand their operating models, distribution channels and regulatory considerations.
  • Manage transformation programs across insurance functions such as underwriting, policy administration, claims, billing, customer and agent experience, finance and distribution.
  • Translate business priorities into transformation roadmaps, requirements, delivery plans, milestones, budgets, governance structures and measurable performance indicators.
  • Guide core system modernization, platform integration, process redesign, cloud and digital enablement, data and analytics, intelligent automation and responsible AI use cases.
  • Facilitate workshops with insurance business leaders, CIO/technology teams, operations leaders and third-party solution providers to define requirements, prioritize initiatives and resolve tradeoffs.
  • Direct cross-functional Baker Tilly, client and vendor teams; manage workstreams, staffing, dependencies, risks, issues, quality and executive reporting.
  • Build compelling business cases and track outcomes such as expense reduction, cycle-time improvement, improved claims or underwriting performance, customer experience and operational resilience.
  • Develop trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders; communicate clear recommendations and proactively identify follow-on opportunities.
  • Contribute to proposals, scoping, thought leadership, go-to-market efforts, delivery methods and reusable insurance transformation assets.
  • Coach and develop consultants and managers, foster an inclusive team culture and uphold high standards of client service and delivery.

Successful Candidates Will Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, finance, insurance or a related field.
  • At least 8 years of relevant experience in management consulting, insurance industry transformation, enterprise program delivery or related roles; substantial experience serving or working within insurance organizations strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of insurance business processes and technology ecosystems, with depth in one or more of underwriting, policy administration, claims, billing, distribution or customer experience.
  • Proven success leading complex, cross-functional business and technology transformation engagements, including managing multiple workstreams, budgets, vendors and senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to connect insurance business strategy to technology decisions, operating model changes, process improvements and quantifiable outcomes.
  • Experience eliciting requirements, developing business cases and roadmaps, leading workshops, and overseeing implementation and change management.
  • Strong executive communication, facilitation, analytical, relationship management, team leadership and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with full lifecycle technology implementations, integrations and testing; familiarity with Agile delivery practices and tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Ability to travel as needed and work outside standard business hours when client engagements require it.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with insurance platforms or ecosystems such as Guidewire, Duck Creek, Majesco or comparable solutions.
  • Experience applying advanced analytics, AI or automation to insurance operations, with appropriate governance and risk considerations.
  • PMP, PgMP, Agile or comparable project/program management certification.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, CPQ
jobs.excerpt: PandaDoc is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager, CPQ to own the go-to-market strategy for a critical product line in our document workflow and revenue operations suite.
jobs.description:
PandaDoc is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager, CPQ to own the go-to-market strategy for a critical product line in our document workflow and revenue operations suite. CPQ (Configure-Price-Quote) is how we help sales teams close deals faster and expand ACV. It is a strategic revenue engine, and we need a PMM who understands how to market a product that moves the needle on sales velocity and deal size.

You'll work directly with our CPQ product team and Sales leadership to define positioning, messaging, and campaigns that resonate with Sales leaders and RevOps professionals who are evaluating whether to build vs. buy. Our buyers need to see clear ROI, implementation speed, and competitive differentiation before they commit. You'll run a dual-track GTM motion that speaks to both the business buyer who owns the budget and the technical operator who will configure and manage the system.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own the CPQ GTM strategy. From influencing the roadmap to post-launch adoption and expansion, you're the connective tissue between Product and the market. You define who we're building for, why it matters, and how we win against entrenched competitors.
  • Lead AI positioning for CPQ. AI is changing how sales teams configure, price, and approve quotes. You will translate what our AI features do into outcomes a RevOps leader can defend to a CFO. You will set the standard for accuracy and trust in every claim we make about them.
  • Partner deeply with Product. You'll be in the room early, bringing customer data, competitive intelligence, and market feedback to roadmap conversations. You will advocate for capabilities that unlock commercial opportunity and help co-author product strategy.
  • Own our narrative. Our buyers are Sales leaders and RevOps at SMB companies who evaluate CPQ based on ROI, implementation timeline, and competitive positioning. You will build positioning that converts budget holders and technical operators who influence the decision.
  • Partner with demand gen to develop and execute campaigns. You will help define the campaign vision: audience segmentation, demand hypothesis, and content topics, and working with our demand gen team help deliver sales pipeline.
  • Enable Sales to sell and expand. You build the tools that help revenue teams have confident conversations and partner with Sales on win/loss analysis to continuously sharpen positioning and identify gaps.
  • Drive post-launch adoption and expansion. CPQ is only valuable if it's adopted and used. You will work with Customer Success and Sales to identify expansion use cases, build case studies, and drive adoption campaigns that help customers realize ROI.

You'll Have

  • 5+ years in marketing, with at least 3 in B2B SaaS product marketing with demonstrated experience marketing to business buyers (Sales Ops, RevOps, Finance, IT) and technical operators.
  • Hands-on fluency with AI tools. You use AI daily to draft, analyze, and test ideas, and you know where it fails. You can explain to a skeptical buyer where AI speeds up a quote process and where a person still needs to check the output.
  • Content strategy and direction chops. You've identified what assets need to exist, written the brief, set the quality bar, and coordinated subject matter experts to produce output that's both credible and compelling. You write clearly, you know what lands with business and technical audiences, and you can show the work.
  • Campaign planning and demand gen collaboration experience. You've developed campaign strategy with a clear demand hypothesis, defined the content topics and offer, and partnered with demand gen to translate strategy into the right channel mix and execution plan. You know the difference between leading a campaign and micromanaging channels.
  • Progress before the plan is finished. CPQ does not have a playbook yet. You will write the first version of the brief, make positioning calls with incomplete data, and correct course in market. You have shipped work without a process to lean on, and you can name the first three things you did when no one was there to ask.
  • Evidence of taking a half-built program to launch. Examples where you inherited unclear scope, defined the work yourself, and delivered results others could measure.
  • Experience marketing to or working alongside sales and operations professionals is a strong plus. Experience in sales tech, revenue operations, or quote-to-cash workflows is valuable.

The annual range is $140k-$160k.

PandaDoc provides an all-in-one document workflow automation platform that helps fast scaling teams accelerate the ability to create, manage, and sign digital documents including proposals, quotes, contracts, and more. Pandas work best when they're happy. We retain our talent by upholding our values of integrity & transparency, and selling a product that changes the lives of our customers.

As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for people living paycheck to paycheck. EarnIn is becoming an AI-native company, embedding AI agents into how we build, analyze, and operate across every function. Teams use AI Agents to move from ideas to execution faster. By letting agents handle repetitive tasks, our people can focus on judgment, creativity, and hard problems. We pair this experimentation with the strict review and security guardrails our regulated financial environment requires, always keeping a focus on privacy and the people who rely on our products.

As a company, we are becoming AI-native, and we encourage you to use AI tools throughout much of your interview process. If you use AI during the live interview, just say so; a quick, natural mention of how it helped and why you are using it is all we need. What we're evaluating is your judgment, reasoning, and ability to own and defend your work, not whether AI was involved. Some rounds, particularly those focused on your career history and past experiences, will not allow the use of AI, and we'll let you know of those in advance. This role designs, configures, and optimizes scalable people systems that enable business growth and operational efficiency. You will act as a strategic partner to People, Finance, and IT teams—translating business needs into system solutions while ensuring data integrity, security, and streamlined processes across the employee lifecycle. We are in the midst of an exciting Intelligent Work Systems transformation, evolving from manual operations to designing AI-enabled, cross-system workflows that scale across the enterprise. We’re looking for someone with a strong Workday foundation and an inventor mindset to help build what’s next.

The San Diego base salary range for this full-time position is $153,130-$187,158, plus equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. If based in or near Mountain View, CA, the role requires in-office work 2 days a week, though we are open to remote candidates in PT or CT time zones.

POSITION SUMMARY

We are seeking a Senior HRIS Analyst to own and evolve our Workday platform. This role primarily focuses on payroll administration, and payroll administration experience is required. You'll also bring strong Core HCM expertise and support other Workday functional areas, including Time and Absence and Advanced Compensation. This role is responsible for designing, configuring, and optimizing scalable payroll and people systems that enable business growth and operational efficiency. You will act as a strategic partner to People, Finance, Total Rewards, and Payroll teams—translating business needs into system solutions while ensuring payroll accuracy, data integrity, and streamlined processes across the employee lifecycle.

We are in the midst of an exciting Intelligent Work Systems transformation, evolving from manual operations to designing AI-enabled, cross-system workflows that scale across the enterprise. We’re looking for someone with a strong Workday payroll foundation and an inventor mindset to help build what’s next.

The Mountain View base salary range for this full-time position is $184,000-$226,000, plus equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. If based in or near Mountain View, CA, the role requires in-office work 2 days a week, though we are open to remote candidates in PT or CT time zones.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Payroll & Workday Configuration Ownership

  • Administer Workday Payroll configuration end-to-end, including pay groups, earnings, deductions, and payroll-impacting business processes
  • Serve as the primary systems point of contact for Payroll Operations, ensuring accurate, on-time pay processing
  • Own configuration and ongoing optimization of Workday Payroll and also other areas in Core HCM, including security frameworks as assigned
  • Support configuration and troubleshooting across other Workday functional areas, including Time and Absence
  • Design and maintain business processes, workflows, and system controls across the employee lifecycle
  • Lead system enhancements, releases, and feature adoption in areas assigned

System Strategy & Optimization

  • Ensure Workday is not operated in isolation but as part of a broader enterprise ecosystem; design solutions that support end-to-end business processes across systems, including access governance, compliance, and cross-functional workflow orchestration
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate People processes through Workday and integrated systems
  • Drive scalable solutions that reduce manual effort and improve data accuracy
  • Contribute to the Workday roadmap by defining and prioritizing enhancements based on business impact, scalability, and system health
  • Establish and maintain system governance and best practices
  • Partner with People Operations and external Workday support to manage escalations, prioritize issues, and drive systemic resolution of recurring problems
  • Ensure data consistency and integrity across Workday and downstream financial systems, including reconciliation of headcount, compensation, and organizational structures used in financial reporting and planning.
  • Develop and maintain system documentation (business processes, decision logic, architecture diagrams); leverage AI tools to accelerate documentation, identify logic gaps, and propose enhancements
  • Troubleshoot system issues, root-cause errors, and implement scalable fixes

  • Map mission use cases: Position AI and decision intelligence across readiness, maintenance, logistics, supply chain, workforce, financial and program management, acquisition, data modernization, and threat analysis.

  • Lead the internal team: Orchestrate solutions engineering, customer success, marketing, product, contracts, capture, partners, and executive advisors around the highest-value opportunities.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of success in a quota-carrying federal enterprise-software or mission-technology sales role.
  • Demonstrated relationships and revenue experience across OSW, Defense Agencies, Department of War Field Activities, or comparable enterprise-level defense organizations.
  • Experience selling enterprise software, AI/ML, data analytics, decision intelligence, or other complex mission and business technology solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with MEDDPICC, Challenger, or another disciplined enterprise-sales methodology.
  • Active security clearance and bachelor's degree, or equivalent relevant experience.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: Establish territory credibility, validate the relationship map, prioritize the initial account portfolio, and create a focused pipeline tied to funded or fundable mission priorities.
  • First year: Convert new relationships into qualified opportunities and net-new awards, build a repeatable expansion path, maintain disciplined pipeline coverage, and meet or exceed annual quota.

This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance (interim and/or final). Continued employment is contingent upon successful adjudication; failure to obtain or maintain the required level of access may result in rescission of the job offer or termination of employment.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary based on experience and a lucrative 50/50 commission plan.
  • 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision premiums; unlimited paid time off; paid national holidays; stock options; 401(k); company equipment; and remote work.

You’ll have meaningful ownership from day one, with the ability to accelerate your career alongside a company scaling rapidly in national security and critical infrastructure.

We offer highly competitive compensation, meaningful equity participation, and fully paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents. Our benefits also include unlimited PTO and flexible work arrangements, with remote flexibility and hybrid options for team members based in the Los Angeles or Washington, DC areas.

Onsite Dermatology makes it easy for seniors to see a dermatologist right where they live. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Who We AreAt Murmuration, we believe that America’s promise is shaped and reshaped by the best ideas and ideals of its communities, and the dreams of the people who believe in a better life for themselves, their families, and each other.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Murmuration, we believe that America’s promise is shaped and reshaped by the best ideas and ideals of its communities, and the dreams of the people who believe in a better life for themselves, their families, and each other.

We help organizations build power in their communities in four key ways: we organize a network of values-aligned partners; we provide deep, data-driven insights into people, places, and perspectives; we develop tools that make organizing and engagement easy and more effective; and we offer services that strengthen our partners’ capacity to lead change in their communities.

We envision an America where every community has what it needs to help people lead healthy, free, and dignified lives. We work to redesign the systems and structures we all depend on — how we learn, live, govern, and solve problems — so that they are just, equitable, resilient, and rooted in shared responsibility. By strengthening the ties that hold communities together, we aim for civic life defined by collective action and care, with effective leadership that truly represents everyone.

We are a collaborative, curious, and creative team of organizers, scientists, teachers, technologists, campaign veterans, and more who share the unwavering belief that we can use our gifts in service of transforming America — together. We’ve built our team guided by the belief that the whole is greater than the sum of its parts. And so we support each other relentlessly — rallying together to face challenges the same way we celebrate each other’s wins.

About the Position

Do you thrive in inclusive, thoughtful environments where engineers hold themselves to high standards of technical excellence, ownership, and impact at scale?

As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and evolving the systems and services that power the Organizer platform. You’ll tackle complex technical challenges, help shape architectural decisions, and play an important role in keeping our backend systems reliable, scalable, maintainable, and secure as we grow.

Your impact will go beyond the code you write. You’ll own problems from discovery through production, partnering closely with Product, Design, Engineering, and other stakeholders to turn ideas and requirements into thoughtful, effective solutions. You’ll also have opportunities to share your expertise and help raise the technical effectiveness of the engineers around you.

Job Level P4

What You’ll Do

  • Own outcomes, not just implementation: Understand the problem being solved and remain engaged through deployment and production;
  • Exercise technical judgment: Evaluate alternatives, identify tradeoffs, and recommend solutions appropriate to the problem rather than automatically choosing the most sophisticated approach;
  • Handle ambiguity: Identify missing information, ask the right questions, and move work forward when a solution has not already been defined;
  • Think beyond your immediate changes: Consider how decisions affect system reliability, maintainability, other services, and future engineering work;
  • Raise the effectiveness of the team: Share context, provide useful feedback, mentor others, and improve engineering practices;
  • Communicate early: Surface risks, uncertainty, dependencies, and changing assumptions before they become delivery problems; and
  • Leave systems better than you found them: Look for opportunities to improve reliability, documentation, testing, observability, and developer experience while delivering product work.

Requirements

  • Proven experience designing, developing, and maintaining backend software in production environments;
  • Strong understanding of software design principles and the ability to evaluate architectural tradeoffs;
  • Proven experience designing and maintaining APIs (e.g., GraphQL), distributed services, and data-intensive applications;
  • Proven experience debugging complex problems across services, infrastructure, and data;
  • Strong understanding of relational and/or NoSQL databases (MongoDB), including data modeling and query performance;
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills;
  • Proven experience collaborating effectively across Engineering, Product, and other disciplines;
  • Familiarity with incident management and logging, monitoring, and observability in production environments;
  • Familiarity with CI/CD practices and modern deployment environments;
  • Demonstrated mentorship and technical leadership in team settings;
  • Experience building modern JavaScript/TypeScript solutions; and
  • Experience working with event-driven or distributed architectures (e.g., AWS).

Nice to Haves

  • Formal degree optional; we welcome candidates from nontraditional or retraining paths;
  • Full-stack or open-source contributions;
  • Security and privacy-conscious system design;
  • Experience planning and executing database migrations and large-scale data operations;
  • Experience using AI tools/workflows; and/or
  • Experience in civic-tech, nonprofit, or data-driven social-impact products.

Talented Senior Software Engineers come from all walks of life and career. If you are passionate about civic engagement and technology, please apply, even if you do not check every box!

Benefits

Location and Compensation

The Senior Software Engineer is a full-time, salaried position with a comprehensive benefits package (detail below), open to candidates anywhere in the United States.

The starting salary for this position is $190,576. We set compensation using market data and apply it consistently across the organization to ensure fairness and transparency for everyone in similar roles.

Our Culture of Care

We work hard to create a culture of care to ensure that our staff are best equipped to lead happy, healthy, and balanced lives. To that end, we offer a comprehensive benefits package which includes:

  • Health, vision, and dental insurance with 100% of premiums covered for you and qualifying family members;
  • Retirement benefits with a 5% employer match;
  • A flexible unlimited PTO plan;
  • Generous paid parental leave;
  • Pre-tax commuter benefits;
  • A company laptop;
  • A flexible remote work environment;
  • A home office setup stipend for all new employees;
  • Monthly reimbursement for remote work expenses;
  • A yearly professional development fund;
  • Mental health and wellness benefits through Calm and Better Help;
  • Yearly in-person staff retreats; and
  • A welcoming culture that celebrates diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging.

At Murmuration, we believe a vibrant, representative democracy depends on the inclusion of diverse voices, lived experiences, and perspectives. The best ideas don’t come from a single person or ideology — they emerge at the intersection of different backgrounds, identities, and viewpoints. We are proud of our commitment to building an organization and culture shaped by respect, empathy, and collaboration, where our team’s diversity fuels innovation, civic engagement, and meaningful change. We welcome new colleagues who will help us nurture this collective effort. Join us.

An Equal-Opportunity Employer with a Commitment to Diversity

Murmuration is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and as an organization committed to diversity and the perspective of all voices, we consider applicants equally of race, gender, color, sexual orientation, religion, marital status, disability, political affiliation and national origin. We reasonably accommodate staff members and/or applicants with disabilities, provided they are otherwise able to perform the essential functions of the job.

Note: Murmuration is two organizations working together to pursue our mission of amplifying the power of civic engagement: Murmuration Research Institute, a 501(c)(3) that conducts research to identify, design, and create the data, tools, and insights that build healthier and more equitable communities; and Murmuration, Inc., a 501(c)(4) that supports organizations working across the country on the nation’s most challenging issues with access to data, tools, and research that build healthier and more equitable communities.

About the Opportunity

We’re looking for a proactive, organised and people-focused Recruitment Pipeline Coordinator to support a growing recruitment team.

This role is ideal for someone with experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, candidate sourcing, recruitment coordination or high-volume candidate management who enjoys keeping processes moving, maintaining accurate records and ensuring candidates receive timely follow-ups.

You’ll play an important role in managing candidates throughout the recruitment pipeline, maintaining accurate candidate information in Salesforce, coordinating with facilities, completing reference checks and helping the wider recruitment team meet its sourcing, activity and interview targets.

The successful candidate will be energetic, reliable, responsive and comfortable working in a structured, fast-paced, target-driven environment where communication, accountability and consistent follow-through are essential.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

1. Candidate Pipeline Management

  • Manage and monitor candidates throughout the recruitment pipeline, ensuring each candidate progresses through the appropriate stages.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date candidate profiles, contact details, notes and status updates in Salesforce.
  • Monitor candidate progress and identify outstanding actions, delays or bottlenecks.
  • Follow up with candidates and relevant stakeholders to keep recruitment processes moving.
  • Ensure candidate records and pipeline information are organised, complete and reliable.

2. Recruitment Coordination and Follow-Up

  • Coordinate candidate communication, follow-ups and next steps throughout the recruitment process.
  • Liaise with facilities and other relevant stakeholders to obtain updates, confirm information and resolve outstanding items.
  • Ensure candidates and stakeholders receive timely, professional communication.
  • Track outstanding actions and follow through until tasks are completed.
  • Support interview coordination and help ensure candidates are ready for the next stage.

3. Reference Checks and Candidate Verification

  • Conduct and coordinate candidate reference checks in line with the recruitment process.
  • Follow up with referees and relevant contacts to obtain outstanding feedback.
  • Record reference outcomes and supporting information accurately in the appropriate systems.
  • Escalate missing information, inconsistencies or concerns to the relevant team member.

4. Recruitment Systems and Administration

  • Use Salesforce and other recruitment systems to manage candidate information, track progress and maintain accurate records.
  • Ensure recruitment data is consistently updated and reflects the current status of each candidate.
  • Support the team with recruitment administration, reporting and pipeline maintenance.
  • Learn new systems, processes and workflows quickly as the business grows.

5. Targets, Performance and Team Collaboration

  • Work towards agreed recruitment activity, sourcing, follow-up and interview targets.
  • Monitor individual progress and outstanding tasks to ensure deadlines and expectations are met.
  • Participate in regular team meetings, check-ins and performance discussions.
  • Communicate progress, challenges and potential bottlenecks proactively.
  • Collaborate with recruiters and other team members to achieve shared recruitment goals.
  • Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and remain accountable for completing work to a high standard.

Minimum Requirements

  • Previous experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, recruitment coordination, candidate sourcing or candidate pipeline management.
  • Experience managing a high-volume candidate pipeline or coordinating multiple candidates and vacancies simultaneously.
  • Familiarity with ATS, CRM, recruitment or candidate database systems.
  • Experience using Salesforce is advantageous; the ability to learn and adapt to new systems quickly is essential.
  • Strong computer literacy and confidence working across multiple digital platforms.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Enterprise Information Display System (E-IDS) is a new system under development that will provide a modern auxiliary information display to Air Traffic Controllers in the National Airspace System (NAS). E-IDS will consolidate several legacy IDS systems into a common platform to provide controllers with current and consistent information needed to perform air traffic operations from both local and enterprise sources.   • ATC Display Development: Build and configure customized displays for Air Traffic Control users, including selecting, assigning, and arranging widgets based on operational needs.

The Team

Upstart’s Compliance team helps ensure the company operates in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements and maintains effective risk management practices. As part of the second line of defense, the team partners with business and operations stakeholders to oversee compliance issues, strengthen remediation practices, and support regulatory readiness.

As the Senior Compliance Associate, Issues Management at Upstart, you will support the end-to-end compliance issue management lifecycle, from identification and tracking through remediation validation and closure. You will help strengthen program effectiveness by identifying emerging risks, improving issue reporting, and ensuring remediation efforts are timely, well-documented, and sustainable.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Execute second-line compliance issue management activities, including issue intake, documentation, tracking, remediation monitoring, validation, and closure.
  • Review and challenge remediation plans, milestones, and supporting evidence to ensure corrective actions address identified issues and meet established requirements.
  • Maintain accurate issue inventories, monitor remediation progress and aging, and proactively identify delays or high-risk issues requiring escalation.
  • Support independent validation and closure activities by evaluating remediation evidence, documenting findings, and confirming closure requirements have been met.
  • Analyze issue trends, recurring themes, and root causes to deliver reporting and insights that inform compliance oversight and risk-based prioritization.
  • Partner with Engineering, Operations, Legal, and Compliance stakeholders to improve remediation quality, strengthen issue management procedures, and support regulatory readiness.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in compliance, issue management, audit, or risk management within banking or financial services.

  • Experience reviewing remediation plans, corrective action milestones, supporting documentation, or closure evidence.
  • Experience maintaining issue records or inventories within a regulated risk or compliance environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of second-line compliance oversight, issue management frameworks, and remediation validation practices within financial services.
  • Experience using governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platforms or issue management systems.
  • Ability to analyze issue aging, remediation progress, and recurring root causes to identify emerging risks and inform reporting.

jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer in Test to raise the quality bar across our mobile app and backend domain - not by owning a test suite, but by changing how the whole domain designs, ships, and trusts its software.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer in Test to raise the quality bar across our mobile app and backend domain - not by owning a test suite, but by changing how the whole domain designs, ships, and trusts its software.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll shape architecture for testability and reliability, own the quality gates that let teams release with confidence, and build a culture where engineers own quality rather than hand it off. You'll operate as a true Staff Engineer: setting technical direction across several teams, going deep in the codebase when it matters, and framing quality as an engineering and business outcome - not a QA phase at the end.

If you've done this in a product with real mobile scale, even better.

Your scope of work will cover 3 areas.

I. Quality architecture & engineering

  • Set and own the quality and reliability strategy across the domain - from the API/contract layer through to native iOS (Swift/SwiftUI) and Android (Kotlin) clients.
  • Design for testability and release confidence: quality gates inside release and store-deployment pipelines, device and OS-version fragmentation coverage, and flakiness control at scale (BrowserStack + GitLab CI).
  • Keep the backend/API/contract layer strong and connect it cleanly to the mobile client layer.
  • Drive resolution of quality and reliability issues that cross team boundaries within the domain.
  • Get hands-on in the codebase where your depth moves the needle - prototypes, tooling, reference implementations, thorny incidents.

II. Technical leadership, coaching & culture

  • Shift quality ownership left into the engineering workflow - be the person teams pull in before implementation starts, not after.
  • Mentor senior engineers across the domain and accelerate real, visible growth.
  • Run knowledge-sharing across the org: tech talks, workshops, reusable documentation, pair sessions; co-lead the OneTech community.
  • Co-shape the domain's technical direction with the SEM, with full autonomy within the domain, and analyse quality trends from metrics to identify where to improve.
  • Define quality and reliability metrics and gates, and use them to frame risk in business terms for EMs, SEMs, and PMs.

III. AI governance in engineering

  • Define how AI is adopted for quality and engineering productivity in the domain — which tools, which workflows.
  • Design AI-assisted workflows and set governance and data-security standards across teams.
  • Assess and manage the risk of AI usage (including production-facing work), not just the productivity upside.
  • Mentor engineers on responsible, effective AI use and report on its ROI.

Must-have

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record operating at Staff / Principal / Tech Lead / Architect level - proven impact beyond a single team (standards set for multiple teams, or a cross-team initiative led).
  • Proven experience in testing in at least one mobile platform (iOS or Android) using market standard approaches as well as commercial, working-level experience with testing native mobile apps.
  • Deep ownership of quality and reliability as an engineering discipline - you've set standards and designed testing/quality strategy (not just executed someone else's plan) and changed outcomes measurably.
  • Proven shift-left experience - entering the process before code is written and measurably moving the result.
  • A strong hands-on engineering foundation - you can read, review, and write production-quality code, and teams respect your technical depth.
  • Experience leading technical and process change directly with development teams.
  • A hands-on, critical relationship with AI - using it and assessing its risks, not just its benefits.
  • Fluent English.

Strong plus - this is where you'll stand out

  • Experience with BrowserStack and CI/CD (GitLab).
  • Snapshot testing experience (e.g. swift-snapshot-testing, Paparazzi) and introducing mock-based testing standards.
  • Experience in the logistics or e-commerce industry.
  • Fluency in Polish.

Nice-to-have

  • Familiarity with Appium (useful for understanding what we're migrating away from).
  • Experience applying AI in engineering / testing workflows.
  • ISTQB Advanced Level – Test Automation Engineer certification.

Why InPost?

  • An international, cross‑functional environment with experienced engineering leaders.
  • The opportunity to work on products used by millions of users across Europe.
  • Real ownership and influence over teams, technical direction, and long‑term solutions.
  • Flexible working model with remote options in Poland.
  • A strong engineering culture focused on quality, collaboration, and impact.
  • We offer a B2B contract.

InPost has revolutionised e-commerce parcel delivery in Poland and is now one of Europe’s leading out-of-home (OOH) e-commerce enablement platforms. Founded in 1999 by Rafał Brzoska.

InPost provides delivery services through a network of over 64,000 Automated Parcel Machines (APMs) and more than 30,000 pick-up and drop-off (PUDO) points across nine European countries: Poland, the United Kingdom, France, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg, alongside to-door courier and fulfilment services for ecommerce merchants.

InPost’s extensive OOH network supports rapidly growing parcel volumes across its markets, with 1.4 billion parcels delivered in 2025. Its locker solutions offer consumers a delivery option that is cheaper, more flexible and convenient, environmentally friendly and contactless. As a leading OOH logistics provider, InPost is recognised for transforming parcel delivery economics in Europe, appealing to both consumers and merchants through its flexible, technology-driven solutions.

The mission of the Project Manager is to be a communication and relationship liaison between Med Planet, our clients, and other teams involved in the project’s completion. The Project Manager is responsible for managing all aspects of the project, ensuring excellent client service and delivering projects on time and within budget.

This is the ideal role for someone who has experience in international market research, with focus on healthcare, fieldwork, and collaboration with all teams involved in the project.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Including, but not limited to the following:

  • Manage international market research projects through entire project lifecycle, ensuring client satisfaction and project financial goals are at core of decision making, keeping ownership of all aspects of the project, including:
    • Project specifications review, project set up, resource planning, fieldwork and timelines planning
    • Coordination of project kick-off meetings to ensure all involved parties understand project specifications, client needs, timelines, and responsibilities
    • Programming, translations, overlays and testing, ensuring quality standards and timelines are met
    • Project launch execution and analysis, with detailed feedback to clients with a solution approach
    • Fieldwork management, delivering timely and high quality client updates, proactively managing and monitoring project recruitment to ensure smooth and timely delivery via maximisation of internal sample, custom recruitment and partner onboarding, controlling project budget and achieving project financial goals
    • Ensure market research participants have a positive project experience by following sampling practices, and ensuring incentive approvals and project queries are handled in timely manner
    • Provide to client the agreed deliverables within expected timelines and quality
    • Meet billing deadlines and goals, ensuring high adherence to internal processes
  • Comply with M3MR groups operating procedures, and ensure all practices and systems follow the ISO Accreditation and M3MR group policies
  • Manage and leverage relationships with vendors to facilitate accurate and timely deliverables, communications, and issue resolution..
  • Support the execution client service improvement plans on allocated accounts, ensuring collaboration with sales and other members of the team, and providing a consistent and solution-oriented approach across each touch point of the client journey

Minimum Experience:

Must have 2 years’ experience in market research project management, preferably in healthcare

Education and Training Required:

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience

Knowledge, Skill, Ability:

  • Be a self-motivated individual with exceptional time management, organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Able to work well meet deadlines and under pressure.
  • Have exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Have strong Microsoft Office skills including Excel, Outlook, and Word.
  • have well-developed analytical and problem-solving skills.

jobs.title: Manager, Strategic Finance
jobs.excerpt: At The Battery Network, we are leading the charge to turn yesterday’s batteries into tomorrow’s power.
jobs.description:
At The Battery Network, we are leading the charge to turn yesterday’s batteries into tomorrow’s power.

As the nation’s premier battery collection and recycling nonprofit, we’ve spent over three decades leading the charge toward a cleaner planet and a circular economy.

We connect consumers, businesses, manufacturers, and municipalities through one trusted network. We provide education, collection, logistics, and compliance expertise, helping our partners stay ahead of regulation while capturing the critical materials that power the future. We keep valuable materials in circulation and out of landfills—reducing reliance on foreign supply chains, strengthening America’s energy independence, and protecting people, property, and the planet.

We’re looking for passionate changemakers to help us scale our impact and shape the future of sustainability. If you're ready to turn purpose into action, you’ll thrive in our mission-driven, collaborative environment.Learn more at and follow us on Facebook, Instagram, or LinkedIn.

POSITION SUMMARY

    The Manager, Strategic Finance expands the Finance team’s capacity to deliver timely, reliable monthly reporting and decision support as The Battery Network grows. Reporting to the Senior Director, Strategic Finance, this hands-on role will own key elements of the monthly reporting cycle, strengthen forecasting and business analysis, and build new processes that improve accuracy, consistency, and efficiency. The Manager will partner with cross-functional business leaders to improve financial data, automate reporting, and translate financial results into clear insights for leadership and the Board of Directors. The role will also lead and develop one direct report while supporting strategic initiatives, including profitability analysis, pricing, planning, and multi-entity reporting.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

    Duties and responsibilities of this role include but are not limited to the following:
  • Lead the monthly reporting cycle, including budget-to-actual and prior-period variance analysis, business-line results, and management commentary, so leaders receive timely and decision-ready information
  • Partner with Operations and other business leaders to understand performance drivers, challenge assumptions, and translate financial results into actions
  • Build and maintain business unit profitability analyses, KPI dashboards, forecasts, scenario models, and business cases that inform decisions about pricing, investments, partnerships, services, and new markets
  • Design, document, and continuously improve reporting and planning processes, identifying gaps and building scalable solutions that keep pace with the organization’s growth
  • Support annual budgeting, long-range planning, and in-year reforecasting by maintaining models, coordinating inputs from budget owners, and reconciling plans to actual performance
  • Collaborate with IT and Finance partners to strengthen data structures, accounting mapping, and automated data flows, including reporting through Power BI
  • Support multi-entity reporting and analysis, including intercompany considerations and consolidated views for leadership
  • Prepare clear financial analysis and presentation materials for the Senior Leadership Team, Board, Finance Committee, and other stakeholders in partnership with Finance leadership
  • Manage, coach, and develop a growing team of analysts by setting priorities, reviewing work, strengthening capabilities, and maintaining high standards for accuracy, insight, and follow-through

CORE QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Accounting or a related field; an MBA or other advanced degree is a plus
  • 5-8 years of experience in strategic finance, FP&A, investment banking, corporate development, equity research, or another setting requiring rigorous financial analysis and decision support, including at least 2 years leading or mentoring analysts
  • Ability to build and improve financial models, forecasts, reporting packages, and business cases using complex or imperfect data
  • Demonstrated ability to own monthly financial reporting, analyze budget-to-actual performance, identify variance drivers, and communicate the business implications of financial results
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Accounting, IT, Operations, and business leaders to improve processes and translate financial information into actionable insight
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the ability to create concise, audience-appropriate presentations in PowerPoint
  • Experience using AI tools to accelerate analysis, forecasting, and management reporting, with a disciplined approach to validating figures and assumptions before distribution
  • Must be authorized to work lawfully in the United States for The Battery Network, with or without sponsorship
  • Knowledge of GAAP, financial statements, multi-entity reporting, or organizational restructuring involving multiple legal entities

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience leading, coaching, or mentoring analysts, or demonstrated readiness to manage and develop a direct report
  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or a comparable ERP, particularly in a financial reporting environment
  • Experience developing and validating dashboards or automating reporting with Power BI or similar business intelligence tools
  • Experience in a growing, evolving, mission-driven, nonprofit, or similarly fast-moving organization where processes and systems are still being built

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE, & EXPERIENCE

  • Builder mindset demonstrated by creating structure, improving workflows, and resolving manual or error-prone processes without waiting for a fully defined playbook
  • Strong analytical judgment and problem-solving skills, including the ability to determine what changed, why it changed, and what action the business should consider
  • Clear written, verbal, and presentation communication that turns detailed financial information into concise insights for Finance and non-Finance audiences
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented approach to managing recurring deadlines, ad hoc requests, and multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy
  • Collaborative relationship-building with teammates and stakeholders, especially when gathering inputs, challenging assumptions, and solving cross-functional problems
  • Curiosity and adaptability when learning unfamiliar systems, navigating incomplete data, and working through changing business needs
  • Demonstrates a genuine commitment to thriving in a mission-based organization where culture and values are paramount, and where diversity, equity, inclusion, collaboration, and innovation are embedded in the way work gets done

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • This position is remote based within the United States. Candidates must be able to work from a U.S.-based location and be eligible to work lawfully in the United States for The Battery Network
  • Limited travel (estimated 3-4 times per year) as needed. Travel could include, but not be limited to, attending conferences, customer meetings, or team/organization-wide meetings
  • Standard full-time work hours are Monday–Friday, 8 hours per day. Some roles may require additional hours during peak periods. We prioritize the quality and timeliness of work over rigid schedules and recognize the importance of connection, collaboration, and work-life balance. To support this, we offer flexible scheduling where roles allow, and in alignment with current policy, while ensuring operational needs and team collaboration are met.

ABOUT THE BATTERY NETWORK

    At The Battery Network, we enjoy a culture of teamwork, innovation, and fun.Our team is the primary reason for our unique culture. We hire energetic and dedicated people who are committed to helping us achieve our goals. Each one of our employees is a valued contributor, not just a number. We work in teams to benefit from our collective talents to make a real impact on the environment.
    The way we operate contributes to the success of our employees and our organization. We embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion as core values, and believe everyone’s unique perspectiveis critical to our success. Diversity and intercultural collaboration are fundamental to what we do. Our team members bring different backgrounds, languages, and personal pursuits to work, and all share a commitment to environmental sustainability and to doing their part to improve our planet.
    We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, marital status, ancestry, national origin, citizenship status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
    We value our employees. In keeping with our values, we strive to support our team members in and out of work. As part of this, we offer a strong, well-rounded benefits package. Our benefits support our employees’ health and wellness, time off, and productivity. Learn more at The Battery Network - Careers.

TO APPLY

We are committed to providing a supportive and inclusive work environment. We encourage applications from individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences and believe that a diverse team brings a variety of perspectives and ideas that are critical to our success.

Interested applicants must submit botha cover letter and resume through the application link.

All candidates must be available for phone and video interviews. Interviews will be scheduled on a rolling basis once application review occurs. If you need an accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, contact . We'll work with you!

Newsweek is the global media organization that has earned audience time and trust for more than 90 years. Newsweek reaches 100 million people each month with thought-provoking news, opinion, images, graphics, and video delivered across a dozen print and digital platforms. Headquartered in New York City, Newsweek also publishes international editions in EMEA and Asia.

Senior Product Manager, Ad Tech

Location: Argentina
Reports to: Chief Technology & Product Officer

About Adprime

Adprime Media is a vertically integrated advertising technology company headquartered in New York. Our platform spans a demand-side platform, a programmatic ad exchange, audience, data, and ad products, and campaign intelligence. We work with agencies, brands, and publishers across performance and healthcare verticals, and we are building an AI-first engineering and operations culture.

The Role

Adprime is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own product execution across our ad tech suite. The CTPO owns product strategy; The Senior Product Manager, Ad Tech will own turning that strategy into well-defined, well-researched, shippable products. The ideal candidate should be able to hold their own in strategy discussions and make educated contributions, but the center of this role is execution: research, definition, requirements, and internal enablement.

This role suits a self-reliant PM who knows the programmatic industry well enough to evaluate what competitors offer, decide what belongs in our products, and explain both to a sales team in plain language.

What The Senior Product Manager Will Do:

  • Own product definition across the DSP, exchange, audience and data products, and CTV offerings
  • Research the ad tech landscape: competitive products, industry standards, and market direction, and turn that research into concrete recommendations on what we build and why
  • Write clear product requirements and specs that engineering can execute against, and work with the Director of Technology to scope and sequence delivery
  • Partner with sales and marketing in both directions: educate them on product functionality and positioning, and gather client-driven requirements for new products and features
  • Contribute to product strategy discussions with the CTPO with well-reasoned, evidence-backed input
  • Collaborate with our product manager focused on internal AI tooling to keep internal and client-facing product work coordinated
  • Define how each product creates value for Adprime: revenue contribution, differentiation, or operational advantage, and measure whether shipped products deliver it

Requirements:

  • 5+ years in product management, including meaningful time in programmatic advertising or ad tech
  • Real domain knowledge: you understand how DSPs, exchanges, and data products work, and concepts like RTB, identity resolution, audience segmentation, and supply quality are familiar ground
  • Enough technical fluency to work directly with engineers on data-heavy products without a translator
  • Strong research and writing skills: your PRDs are specific, your competitive analyses are useful, and your recommendations come with reasoning
  • Comfort presenting to and training commercial teams
  • Self-reliance: you take direction at the strategic level and come back with finished work, not open questions

What Success Looks Like

  • Within six months, every active product has a clear definition, a rationale for why it exists, and requirements engineering trusts. Sales and marketing understand what our products do and are feeding you a steady stream of client-driven requirements.
