PSI is seeking a Medical Monitor (Oncology) to join our international Medical Monitoring team.

In this role, you will provide medical oversight and expertise across global clinical trials, working closely with study sponsors, investigators, sites, project teams, and other clinical research professionals. Your contribution will help protect participant safety, maintain scientific and medical quality, and support the successful delivery of oncology studies.

This is an opportunity to apply your clinical oncology experience to international research and contribute directly to the development of new treatments for patients who need them.

Full-time employment

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as primary medical point of contact for clinical trial sponsors, internal project teams, investigators and trial sites for medical matters related to the conduct of clinical trials per protocol and per GCP guidelines
  • Provide medical oversight throughout the conduct of clinical trials, in accordance with the protocol, applicable regulations, and ICH-GCP requirements
  • Respond to medical questions from investigators, sites, sponsors, project teams, and third-party vendors
  • Provide medical input into eligibility assessments, protocol deviations, participant safety issues, and other trial-specific medical matters
  • Contribute medical expertise to clinical development plans, protocols, investigator brochures, informed consent documents, annual reports, clinical study reports, patient narratives, and scientific presentations
  • Review and assess clinical and safety data to support participant safety and identify medically relevant trends, risks, or quality concerns
  • Prepares and delivers medical training and/therapeutic area training to investigators and study teams
  • Support medical data review activities and contribute to the assessment of aggregated clinical trial data
  • Participate in bid defense meetings and proposal activities
  • Provide support with Pharmacovigilance activities
  • Identify medical trial risks, and collaborate with relevant functions to define appropriate mitigation and escalation measures
  • Support or participate in advisory boards, safety monitoring boards, and other medical or scientific committees, as applicable.
  • Help ensure that trial conduct and medical oversight activities comply with the approved protocol, applicable regulatory requirements, and quality standards

You will be a strong fit for this role if you have

  • Medical Doctor degree
  • Board certification in Oncology
  • Previous experience as a practicing Oncologist
  • Previous experience in clinical research or the pharmaceutical or CRO industry is a plus
  • Full professional proficiency in written and spoken English
  • Strong medical judgement, analytical thinking, and attention to detail
  • Clear communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex medical information to different stakeholders
  • A collaborative and solution-oriented approach to working within international, cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and confidence working with clinical trial systems and digital collaboration tools.

As part of PSI's Medical Monitoring team, you will become part of an international team of medical professionals working at the frontline of clinical research. You will have the opportunity to apply your oncology expertise across global studies, collaborate with experienced colleagues, and contribute to bringing new treatment options to patients.

PSI is a leading Contract Research Organization (CRO) with 30 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry. Originated in Switzerland, PSI is a privately owned, full-service CRO with a global reach, supporting clinical trials across multiple countries and continents. Our reputation for being highly selective about the projects we undertake highlights our commitment to delivering high-quality, timely services across a broad spectrum of therapeutic indications.

At PSI, we foster an environment where a diverse range of colleagues feel welcomed and valued. Our inclusive culture is a cornerstone of our success, enabling us to attract and retain top talent globally.

We are not just about conducting clinical trials; we are about building a community where every team member has the opportunity to thrive and contribute to groundbreaking advancements in the pharmaceutical industry.

jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. We are seeking a Database Developer with approximately four years of professional experience to support database development, modernization, cloud-hosted PostgreSQL environments, and migration initiatives.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

We are seeking a Database Developer with approximately four years of professional experience to support database development, modernization, cloud-hosted PostgreSQL environments, and migration initiatives.

The ideal candidate has strong SQL and database development skills and hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and Oracle, familiarity with the AWS Database Migration, and practical experience using Liquibase to manage database changes through DevSecOps pipelines. The candidate should be comfortable developing automation scripts and collaborating with microservice teams to ensure database structures remain aligned with application object models.

What you will do
  • Database Development and Schema Management
    • Maintain and optimize a PostgreSQL database hosted in AWS.
    • Develop, maintain, and version-control data definition (DDL) scripts for schema creation, modification, and migration.
    • Work with senior developers to execute the migration of existing data and schema from an Oracle database to PostgreSQL, ensuring data integrity and performance.
    • Maintain technical documentation for database design, configuration, schema changes, and operational procedures.
    • Monitor and tune database performance for reliability, scalability, and efficiency.
    • Design and implement back-up and disaster recovery processes to ensure high availability and business continuity.
    • Manage database backups, restores, and updates in alignment with best practices.
    • Perform database object synchronization by identifying and resolving discrepancies involving tables, indexes, packages, views, constraints, LOBs, grants, and invalid objects.
    • Manage database security and access controls by validating user permissions, schema grants, role assignments, and object-level privileges.
    • Perform index reconciliation and optimization by comparing source and target database structures and generating missing index deployment scripts.
    • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to ensure database security, scalability, and compliance.
  • Oracle-to-PosgreSQL Migration and AWS DMS Support
    • Manage schema conversion, object validation, and post-migration reconciliation across multiple Oracle database schemas.
    • Support AWS DMS configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting, including task validation, CDC synchronization, LOB handling, endpoint verification, and migration performance tuning.
    • Conduct migration validation activities including row count comparisons, object count verification, CDC testing, referential integrity checks, and application smoke testing.
    • Develop and execute SQL and shell automation scripts for schema exports, row count validation, object comparison, and migration verification using SQL*Plus, Bash, PostgreSQL utilities, Oracle metadata utilities, and related tools.
    • Create automated workflows for identifying missing database objects and generating DDL scripts to remediate inconsistencies between source and target environments.
    • Coordinate migration cutover activities and work cross-functionally with cloud engineers, developers, database administrators, and program stakeholders to ensure successful deployment and operational continuity.
    • Author migration procedures, validation checklists, turnover materials, and operational documentation to support sustainment and knowledge transfer.
  • Database Management for Microservices using Liquibase
    • Support automated generation or validation of database table definitions based on Java object models and microservice data contracts.
    • Review OpenAPI specifications to understand microservice interfaces, request and response models, and data structures that affect database design.
    • Work with Java microservice teams to ensure database tables and schema changes are consistent with Java domain objects, persistence models, DTOs, and service-layer requirements.
    • Help define repeatable workflows for translating OpenAPI-defined service models and Java application objects into consistent PostgreSQL schema updates.
    • Integrate Liquibase database changes into CI/CD pipelines to support controlled, repeatable, and auditable schema deployments.
    • Validate Liquibase changes across environments and troubleshoot schema deployment failures, rollback issues, checksum conflicts, and environment drift.
    • Collaborate with backend developers to ensure database changes support microservice functionality, API contracts, data integrity, and performance requirements.

You should be familiar with
  • SQL, relational database design, schema development, and database object management.
  • Developing DDL scripts, migration scripts, validation scripts, and database automation scripts.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, preferably hosted in AWS RDS.
  • Familiarity with Oracle
  • Familiarity with AWS Database Migration Service
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, Bash, and other DevSecOps tools
  • Agile software development methodology and team practices
  • Experience using Liquibase or a similar database change management tool
  • Proficiency with Git-based version control and collaborative development workflows.
  • Familiarity with AWS infrastructure, cloud-hosted database environments, security groups, networking, and application connectivity.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to analyze schema, data, migration, and deployment issues across environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical procedures and collaborate with developers, cloud engineers, and stakeholders.

What we like to see
  • Passionate about database development and coding
  • Flexible and adaptable when requirement change or priorities change
  • Enthusiastic about adopting DevSecOps practices
  • Thrives when collaborating within a small, cross-functional team
  • Proactive communicator who knows when to ask for help when blocked

Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional experience in software engineering, DevOps, or database administration.
  • Security+ certification (or willingness to obtain one)
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
The position requires a government security clearance. Candidates must be U.S. citizens and eligible for work without a visa sponsorship.

Benefits

  • Paid Time Off
  • Medical benefits: Health Care, Vision, Dental, Long- and Short-Term Disability, and Life Insurance
  • Dependent Care and Healthcare Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Annual Health Reimbursement Arrangement
  • Education Assistance Program

Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



About the Role:

The Falcon Complete Detection Engineering (FCDE) team builds and maintains the NG-SIEM detection ruleset that powers CrowdStrike's managed detection and response capability. The team develops high-fidelity detections driven by threat intelligence and real-world observations, including rapid response to zero-days and emerging threats, filling detection gaps across a broad range of third-party data sources where adversaries increasingly operate. FCDE also builds and refines AI-powered tooling to maximize the speed and fidelity of detection development at scale. Engineers collaborate across the full pipeline, from ingestion and parsing to response and automation, to improve triage efficiency and accelerate threat disruption.


What You’ll Do:


  • Perform threat research and threat hunting to identify emerging tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) to build detections using an intelligence driven approach
  • Develop, test, and deploy actionable high fidelity CrowdStrike Next-Gen SIEM detection rules to enable a world class Managed Detection and Response team
  • Conduct code reviews and testing to ensure rules meet our quality and performance expectations prior to deployment at scale
  • Leverage CI/CD best practices and principles to deploy detections as code
  • Contribute to and leverage an AI-powered detection engineering ecosystem, including LLM-assisted tooling and coding agents, to accelerate threat research, rule development, and detection workflow automation
  • Collaborate with SIEM architects to develop and define best practices for parsing data and normalizing data to a common event schema
  • Build and maintain utilities and tools to enable the managed services team to operate efficiently and at a large scale
  • Develop and maintain processes and documentation
  • Participate in a Detection Engineer handler on-call rotation

What You’ll Need:

Successful candidates will have experience in many of the following areas:

  • 3+ years of experience as a detection engineer, security engineer, security analyst, threat intelligence analyst, or related field
  • Knowledge of current cyber threats and how to detect them using SIEM and relevant technologies
  • Relevant industry certifications (i.e. GCFA, GCDA, GCIH, etc.)
  • Experience with analyzing large datasets across a variety of vendors and technologies
  • Experience working with SIEM solutions (LogScale, Splunk, SumoLogic, Sentinel, QRadar, LogRhythm, etc)
  • Familiarity with large language models (LLMs) and AI coding agents, with hands-on experience integrating or building LLM-assisted workflows a plus
  • Python or other scripting experience strongly preferred
  • A curious, self-motivated mindset with a high standard for your own work
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.


Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards
  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge
  • Paid parental and adoption leaves
  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role
  • Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections
  • Vibrant office culture with world class amenities
  • Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where everyone is valued for who they are and empowered to succeed. We support veterans and individuals with disabilities through our affirmative action program.

jobs.excerpt: About CoLabAt CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.
jobs.description:
About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.
CoLab is the AI platform for driving stronger product development decisions. Every design review in CoLab builds a knowledge repository of design feedback, decisions, and lessons learned - with AI agents flagging design issues before they compound. Companies like Ford, Komatsu, and Johnson Controls use CoLab to catch issues earlier, eliminate rework cycles, and bring products to market faster.
Founded in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab has grown quickly from our first customer in 2019 to a rapidly scaling company. We’ve recently been recognized on Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, and named a Canadian company to watch by The Globe and Mail and Financial Post.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Mechanical Engineer to help shape the future of engineering collaboration.

This is not a traditional mechanical engineering role focused on designing physical products. Instead, you’ll work at the intersection of engineering, software, and customer problem-solving — helping ensure CoLab deeply understands how modern engineering teams actually work.

You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Sales, and Customer teams to bring real engineering context into everything we build. You will help inform product decision making through the lens of an expert Mechanical Engineer. This helps bridge the gap between complex engineering workflows and intuitive software experiences.

One day you might be helping a product team understand why a design review process breaks down between manufacturing and suppliers. Another day you could be reviewing CAD workflows with a customer, testing new product capabilities, or helping translate technical engineering challenges into product insights.

This role is ideal for someone who loves engineering problems, but also enjoys navigating complex data systems and processes while working cross-disciplinary.,

You probably won’t enjoy this role if you want highly repetitive work, narrowly scoped ownership, or an environment where engineering knowledge stays siloed. This role requires curiosity, initiative, and comfort operating in ambiguity.

The average person might think this role sounds unusual for a mechanical engineer. They’d be right. That’s part of what makes it interesting.

Our Ideal Candidate

You’re an expert on how products get designed, reviewed, and manufactured in the real world.

You understand intrinsically the realities of engineering work — competing priorities, messy workflows, supplier coordination, revision cycles, and risk management. But you also enjoy stepping back and thinking about how systems, tools, and processes could work better.

You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences. You ask good questions. You’re comfortable challenging assumptions respectfully, and you care more about solving the right problem than protecting your ego.

You’ll thrive here if you enjoy:

  • Working across engineering, product, and customer-facing teams
  • Learning quickly in ambiguous environments
  • Thinking beyond individual parts or assemblies toward larger workflows and systems
  • Helping shape the future of engineering tools and collaboration

Job Responsibilities

  • Bring real-world engineering expertise into CoLab’s product development process
  • Work closely with Product and Design teams to scope and test new product capabilities Partner with customers to understand design review challenges, collaboration bottlenecks, and process gaps
  • Review and validate product concepts through an engineering lens
  • Help translate complex technical workflows into clear product requirements and user insights
  • Support customer conversations, product demos, and feedback sessions when deep engineering context is needed
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to improve how engineering knowledge is captured and operationalized within CoLab
  • Stay close to emerging trends in mechanical engineering workflows, CAD collaboration, and AI-assisted engineering tools

Qualifications

  • Degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics, Manufacturing Engineering or a related discipline
  • 5+ years of experience working in product development, manufacturing, industrial equipment, automotive, aerospace, or related industries
  • Familiarity with multiple CAD systems and engineering review workflows
  • Brought complex mechanical products from concept to production, at scale
  • Worked iteratively on designs through validation and verification
  • In-depth experience with design reviews, change management, or supplier collaboration processes
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work cross-functionally and communicate with both technical and non-technical teams
  • Curiosity, adaptability, and a strong learning mindset

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with PLM, ERP, CAD collaboration, or engineering workflow or simulation software
  • Exposure to ECAD software and experience with integrated electromechanical products
  • Experience working with enterprise engineering teams
  • Interest in software development, AI and the future of engineering tools

Extra Details

  • This is a full-time, permanent position with a competitive compensation package that includes stock options.
  • This role offers an extended health and benefits package that includes unlimited paid vacation and RRSP/401K matching
  • This role has the flexibility to work remotely from anywhere in North America.

Equity Note

Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic and apply even if you don’t meet every single qualification—your potential is what matters most to us.

About TKO

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Overview

The Specialist, Employee Experience will support how employees experience TKO across key moments in the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, performance management, talent and leadership development, recognition, transitions, and employee communications.

This role will help coordinate and continuously improve employee-facing People + Culture programs and experiences. The Specialist will work closely with People + Culture, People Insights, Internal Communications, IT, business units, and manager communities to organize programs, develop clear and engaging content, support employee listening activities, and turn feedback into practical improvements.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, creative, detail-oriented, collaborative, and employee-centered, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver polished work in a fast-paced environment.


Responsibilities

Employee Experience Support

  • Support the planning, coordination, delivery, and continuous improvement of the employee experiences across key moments in the employee lifecycle including onboarding, performance management, talent and leadership development, recognition, transitions, and employee communications.
  • Use employee feedback, data, research, and business context to identify opportunities to improve clarity, consistency, connection, and ease of use.
  • Help track activities, deliverables, and measures related to employee experience initiatives.

Onboarding Experience

  • Support the onboarding experience across preboarding, the first day, the first week, and beyond.
  • Help maintain onboarding communications, resources, manager expectations, and materials that help new hires feel prepared and connected.
  • Gather onboarding feedback and help identify and prioritize improvements.

People + Culture Communications and Engagement

  • Support the People + Culture communications calendar and editorial rhythm in partnership with Corporate Communications.
  • Develop and maintain clear, relevant, and engaging content, templates, visual assets, and communication campaigns across key life-cycle events like recruiting, onboarding, employee and leadership development, performance management, change management and transitions.
  • Support the implementation of communication tools, templates and measurement practices to measure the success of regular communications and updates, and help understand its impact and effectiveness.

Employee Listening and Surveys

  • Support engagement, onboarding, lifecycle, pulse, and targeted surveys in partnership with People Insights.
  • Coordinate survey logistics, communications, follow-up activities, and documentation.
  • Review employee feedback and data to identify themes and summarize insights.
  • Help communicate what was heard, what is being prioritized, and what will happen next.

Project and Stakeholder Coordination

  • Coordinate external partners, facilitators, vendors, and internal stakeholders supporting leadership development experiences and business simulations.
  • Coordinate cross-functional work across People + Culture, People Insights, Internal Communications, IT, business units, and manager communities.
  • Manage timelines, action items, content reviews, and deliverables across multiple projects.
  • Maintain a high standard of quality, consistency, detail, and follow-through.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of progressively responsible experience in employee experience, people programs, talent management, internal communications, organizational development, employee listening, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting or improving an onboarding program or other employee-facing People + Culture or HR program.
  • Experience coordinating leadership development, cohort-based learning, executive programs, employee experiences, or complex events from planning through delivery.
  • Experience supporting employee surveys, listening activities, feedback efforts, or related data collection.
  • Experience managing workplans, risk/issues logs, project status updates, and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex topics clear, relevant, and engaging.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Comfort working with employee feedback and data to identify themes and support recommendations, including intermediate Excel skills such as sorting, filtering, pivot tables, lookups, and basic analysis.
  • Sound judgment when working with confidential employee information and sensitive organizational topics.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a high bar for quality, consistency, and follow-through.
  • A practical, employee-centered mindset, a bias toward continuous improvement, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, changing environment.

Details

jobs.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

How will you make an impact?


We are seeking a highly skilled, hands-on, and customer-focused Fiber Optics Integration Engineer within the Intelligent Infrastructure Segment to lead fiber optic architecture, integration, troubleshooting, qualification, and deployment activities for next-generation AI, HPC, cloud, and networking rack solutions.

This role is critical in ensuring successful end-to-end optical connectivity across integrated rack platforms through development of fiber cabling standards, installation procedures, routing strategies, optical validation plans, and root cause analysis methodologies. The engineer will serve as a key technical resource supporting customers, manufacturing sites, compliance teams, and engineering organizations throughout the product lifecycle.

The successful candidate will bridge optical networking technologies with rack-level integration and deployment requirements, enabling reliable, scalable, and serviceable solutions for hyperscale data center customers worldwide.

What will you do?

  • Own optical connectivity integration across rack-level solutions, including transceivers, DACs, AOCs, fiber trunks, breakout assemblies, patch panels, and switch-to-server interconnects.
  • Develop and maintain fiber routing, bundling, strain relief, labeling, installation, and serviceability standards for air-cooled and liquid-cooled rack solutions.
  • Lead root cause investigations for optical communication failures observed during prototype validation, factory test, shipment, deployment, and customer operation.
  • Support customer escalations involving optical performance, network bring-up issues, transceiver compatibility, link instability, signal degradation, or deployment-related failures.
  • Establish troubleshooting methodologies and failure-analysis procedures utilizing optical power meters, OTDRs, BER testing, insertion-loss measurements, switch diagnostics, and transceiver telemetry.
  • Create rack-level fiber optic installation guides, work instructions, service manuals, qualification plans, and best practices documentation.
  • Collaborate with networking, electrical, mechanical, and manufacturing engineering teams to optimize fiber routing paths and ensure manufacturability and field serviceability.
  • Support qualification and validation testing of integrated rack solutions, including transportation, shock, vibration, and environmental testing where optical performance must be maintained.
  • Partner with compliance and certification teams to support UL, CE, NFPA, and other regulatory requirements impacting fiber optic and networking infrastructure within rack systems.
  • Participate in customer meetings, technical reviews, onsite deployments, and data center visits to support solution implementation and issue resolution.
  • Work directly with transceiver suppliers, switch vendors, cable manufacturers, and networking technology partners to resolve product and interoperability issues.
  • Support factory test development and manufacturing procedures to ensure consistent optical installation quality and repeatable system performance.
  • Train manufacturing personnel, field service teams, and customers on approved fiber handling and installation practices.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on optical network reliability, deployment efficiency, and reduction of field failures.
  • May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

How will you get here?


Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Optical Engineering, Networking Technology, or related technical field required.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience supporting optical networking technologies, fiber optic systems, transceivers, or data center infrastructure.
  • Experience performing root cause analysis and field troubleshooting of fiber optic communications systems.
  • Hands-on experience with optical transceivers including SFP, QSFP, OSFP, and emerging high-speed optical interfaces.
  • Experience supporting customers in field deployments, issue escalation management, and technical problem resolution.
  • Experience developing installation procedures, troubleshooting guides, or technical documentation.
  • Working knowledge of hyperscale data center architecture, server racks, networking switches, and structured cabling systems preferred.
  • Experience supporting product compliance, inspections, audits, certifications, or regulatory evaluations is highly desirable.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills are a must.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

  • Strong understanding of fiber optic communication systems and optical networking fundamentals.
  • Knowledge of multimode and single-mode fiber systems, MPO/MTP architectures, structured cabling standards, and data center interconnect technologies.
  • Experience utilizing optical diagnostic equipment including OTDRs, light sources, optical power meters, BER testers, and network analysis tools.
  • Ability to analyze complex system failures and develop effective corrective actions.
  • Skilled in developing standardized engineering procedures and work instructions.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Comfortable working directly with customers during design reviews, lab evaluations, and on-site troubleshooting activities.
  • Self-motivated, accountable, and capable of working independently within a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to influence design decisions through technical expertise and data-driven recommendations.
  • Strong presentation and technical reporting capabilities.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 25%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with hyperscale data center deployments.
  • Familiarity with NVIDIA, Arista, Cisco, Juniper, Broadcom, or similar networking ecosystems.
  • Experience with AI/HPC rack infrastructure or integrated rack solutions.
  • Knowledge of UL, CE, IEC, GR-63, GR-1089, ISTA, ASTM, and related qualification standards.
  • Certified Fiber Optic Technician (CFOT), FOA certification, or equivalent industry certification.
  • Hands-on experience with prototype fabrication and testing; experience working with global suppliers and contract manufacturers (CM) a plus.

About Jabil’s Intelligent Infrastructure Group:

  • Headquartered in Austin, TX, with a flagship facility located near The Domain and the Austin FC stadium
  • Growing rapidly, with a team of more than 100 employees and significant expansion planned through 2026
  • Generated over $12 billion in FY25 revenue, driven largely by partnerships with major hyperscale customers
  • Delivers cutting‑edge engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions that power the world's AI infrastructure and global data center ecosystems

jobs.description:
The Client Engagement Manager is the gatekeeper of Product and Services resources for strategic ERP opportunities, partnering with Account Executives from early-stage discovery through Statement of Work execution and hand-off to Delivery. This role owns solution scoping, deal economics, and commercial structuring for QAD Adaptive ERP and Champion AI engagements, ensuring every proposal is grounded in disciplined discovery, priced to protect margin, and staffed for predictable delivery. Acting as the primary Professional Services counterpart to Sales, the Client Engagement Manager balances competitiveness with commercial rigor and ensures a clean transition from sales engagement to project execution.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Pre-Sales Discovery & Solution Scoping

  • Partner with Account Executives from early-stage opportunities to shape services positioning and deal strategy.
  • Lead structured discovery covering services scope: pain points, workflows, success criteria, delivery considerations, and training requirements.
  • Support the AE in architecting the solution and defining services components (deliverables, timeline, effort), incorporating Solutions Engineering input on technical feasibility and dependencies.
  • Enforce engagement request prioritization, directing Tier 2 and smaller opportunities to self-service playbooks so direct support is reserved for the highest-value deals.

SOW Development & Commercial Structuring

  • Draft and validate Statements of Work in partnership with the AE, defining scope boundaries, assumptions, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
  • Validate pricing, discounting, and total cost of ownership to protect deal economics, including in multi-year contract structures.
  • Review commercial arrangements — services pricing, risk-sharing, and contract terms — for consistency with company policy.
  • Recommend resource allocation for delivery based on scope, timeline, and required skill sets.

Deal Governance & Sales Partnership

  • Serve as the primary Professional Services liaison to the Account Executive throughout the sales cycle, including participation in deal reviews.
  • Ensure alignment with Services Delivery on the proposed solution before a deal is closed.
  • Track win/loss drivers and request patterns to inform playbook and resource-allocation improvements.
  • Maintain current knowledge of service offerings and industry-specific playbooks to support consistent, competitive proposals.

Delivery Hand-Off & Continuity

  • Co-lead the hand-off from Sales to Services Delivery, ensuring the delivery team receives a complete, validated SOW and supporting discovery artifacts.
  • Act as an escalation point for pre-sales misalignment or scope disputes prior to project kick-off.
  • Partner with Delivery leadership to feed field learnings back into scoping standards and estimation models.

Experience

  • 5+ years in Professional Services, Solutions Consulting, or Pre-Sales within ERP or enterprise SaaS environments.
  • Demonstrated experience writing and negotiating Statements of Work, estimating project scope and effort, and structuring services pricing.
  • Working knowledge of ERP implementation methodologies (manufacturing, supply chain, or related domains) strongly preferred.
  • Experience partnering directly with Account Executives in a matrixed Sales / Delivery organization.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong commercial acumen: pricing strategy, margin protection, forecasting, and contract structuring.
  • Ability to translate discovery findings into an executable, well-bounded scope of work.
  • Comfortable applying pricing and scoping discipline under sales-cycle time pressure.
  • Proficiency with CRM/CPQ tooling (e.g., Salesforce) and services estimation tools.
  • Executive-level written and verbal communication skills.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced degree a plus.

Additional Expectations

  • Willingness to travel as required to support key client engagements and on-site discovery workshops.

  • Ability to operate across time zones in support of global account teams.

  • High level of rigor in scope definition, risk identification, and governance under sales-cycle time pressure.

  • Compensation:
  • Plus a strong benefits package inclusive of PTO, 401K matching, and Healthcare/Medical Insurance plans.
  • Virtual-First Culture: work remotely, with the flexibility to lead in-person customer workshops in your market.
  • Atmosphere of Growth: join a team where idea-sharing is prioritized over hierarchy, at the leading edge of agentic AI for manufacturing.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: health, dental, vision, PTO, 401K matching, and a collaborative culture of smart, hard-working people.

jobs.title: Senior GTM Recruiter - Long Term Contract
jobs.excerpt: About MariaDBMariaDB is making a big impact on the world.
jobs.description:
About MariaDB

MariaDB is making a big impact on the world. Whether you’re checking your bank account, buying a coffee, shopping online, making a phone call, listening to music, taking out a loan or ordering takeout – MariaDB is the backbone of applications used every day. Companies small and large, including 75% of the Fortune 500, run MariaDB, touching the lives of billions of people. With massive reach through Linux distributions, enterprise deployments and public clouds, MariaDB is uniquely positioned as the leading database for modern application development. MariaDB now includes GridGain, a leader in in-memory computing, extending MariaDB to handle the extreme-velocity data requirements of autonomous AI agents.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a ContractSenior Technical GTM Recruiter to drive full-cycle recruiting across our global organization. Our company builds and delivers database technology used by customers around the world, and our talent needs are equally global — spanning APAC, EMEA, and the Americas. This role will own hiring for technical sales roles as well as cross-functional roles across Finance Product, and G&A (Finance, Legal, People, IT, etc.).

The ideal candidate is a versatile, consultative recruiter who can flex between deep technical sourcing and evaluation for engineering roles and broader generalist recruiting for go-to-market and corporate functions — all while navigating the nuances of hiring across multiple regions, time zones, and labor markets.

Key Responsibilities

Full-Cycle Recruiting

  • Manage full-cycle recruiting for technical engineering sales roles across Sales and Marketing to support the GTM team. Some possible recruitment for Product, and SG&A as well.
  • Partner directly with hiring managers and executive stakeholders to define role requirements, calibrate candidate profiles, and build effective hiring strategies for each function.
  • Source active and passive candidates using a mix of channels: LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, technical communities, Boolean/X-ray search, referrals, and niche database/infrastructure networks.
  • Conduct technical and behavioral phone screens, assess candidates for role fit, technical depth, and cultural alignment, and manage candidates through onsite/virtual interview loops.
  • Own offer strategy, including compensation benchmarking, negotiation, and closing candidates in competitive, multi-offer situations.

Global & Regional Recruiting

  • Recruit across APAC and EMEA regions, and minimal possible roles in the Americas, adapting sourcing strategy, candidate messaging, and interview processes to regional market conditions, compensation norms, and labor regulations.
  • Partner with regional People/HR partners and legal teams to ensure compliant, locally-appropriate hiring practices (contracts, notice periods, work authorization, data privacy).
  • Manage time-zone-sensitive scheduling and communication to deliver a consistent, high-quality candidate experience across all regions.
  • Build and maintain regional talent pipelines and market maps for hard-to-fill technical roles (e.g., distributed systems engineers in EMEA, database specialists in APAC).

Sales and Marketing GTM Recruiting

  • Develop fluency in the company's core technology (databases, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure) sufficient to credibly engage senior technical sales candidates and hiring managers.
  • Partner with technical sales leaders to build leveled, structured interview processes and technical assessment criteria.
  • Track and continuously improve technical sales hiring funnel metrics (sourcing-to-hire conversion, time-to-fill, offer-accept rate).
  • Recruit for Go-to-Market roles (EAEs, EPA's SDRs, Sales Engineers, Marketing, Customer Success, and Sales Operations) and corporate functions. Some roles in Finance, Legal, People, IT and Product Management/Design may be included depending on bandwidth.
  • Tailor sourcing and assessment approaches to each function's unique competencies (e.g., quota attainment history for Sales, portfolio review for Product/Design).
  • Act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers outside of engineering, educating them on market conditions and best-practice hiring processes.

Process, Data & Employer Brand

  • Maintain accurate, real-time data in the ATS (e.g., Greenhouse) for pipeline reporting and forecasting.
  • Provide regular hiring updates and funnel metrics to leadership; flag risks to hiring plans proactively.
  • Champion a best-in-class, consistent candidate experience globally, including timely communication and structured feedback loops.
  • Contribute to employer branding initiatives (careers page content, technical blog contributions, conference/community presence) to strengthen the company's reputation among engineering and business talent.
  • Continuously improve recruiting processes, tools, and playbooks; mentor junior recruiters or coordinators as the team scales.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with meaningful experience recruiting technical sales roles at a software or infrastructure company.
  • Demonstrated experience recruiting across multiple global regions (APAC, EMEA, and the Americas), including familiarity with regional hiring practices and market dynamics.
  • Experience recruiting for non-technical sales functions (Finance, Product, G&A) in addition to engineering.
  • Strong sourcing skills across LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, and other technical talent channels.
  • Proven ability to manage a high-volume, cross-functional requisition load in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience partnering with senior/executive hiring managers.
  • Proficiency with an ATS (Greenhouse) and recruiting/sourcing tools.
  • Experience utilizing AI to enhance and improve the recruiting experience.

Preferred:

  • Prior recruiting experience at a database, infrastructure, or developer-tools company.
  • Experience hiring for highly specialized technical talent (e.g., distributed systems, storage engines, AI, query optimization).
  • Familiarity with global employment considerations (contractor vs. employee models, visa/work authorization, EOR partners).
  • Experience scaling recruiting processes at a high-growth startup or scale-up.

What Success Looks Like

  • Delivers a candidate experience that earns positive feedback across all regions and functions.
  • Consistently meets time-to-fill and quality-of-hire targets across both technical and non-technical requisitions.
  • Builds durable, diverse pipelines for hard-to-fill technical and regional roles.
  • Is viewed by hiring managers — from Sales to G&A — as a strategic partner, not just an order-taker.
  • Stays informed of trends and innovative recruiting techniques in order to be competitive in state-of-the-art recruiting practices.

Location

Remote - Sofia, Bulgaria, Romania or Poland

What’s in It for You?

Impact the world of technology by pushing the boundaries of technology and business models, working at MariaDB plc. Be part of a game-changing organization that encourages outside-the-box thinking, values empowerment, and is truly shaping the future of the software industry.

You’ll be collaborating with high-caliber colleagues around the world, offering unparalleled learning and growth opportunities. We provide a very competitive compensation package, 25 days paid annual leave (plus holidays) and a massive degree of flexibility and freedom, and more.

jobs.title: Director, Regulatory Affairs
jobs.excerpt: State regulators and departments of insurance, industry advocacy groups and more are actively deciding how aerial imagery and AI can be used in underwriting and rating.
jobs.description:
State regulators and departments of insurance, industry advocacy groups and more are actively deciding how aerial imagery and AI can be used in underwriting and rating. More than a dozen departments of insurance have issued bulletins on the subject, with imagery recency limits running from 180 days to two years, constraints on what evidence supports an adverse action, and new disclosure and appeal requirements for consumers. Legislation is moving in several more states, and a national model act is in draft. These rules determine how much of Nearmap's value a carrier can realize, and in the most restrictive states they shape whether particular use cases are viable at all.

This role owns Nearmap's answer. You will build and lead our insurance regulatory affairs function, setting our regulatory strategy, engaging with regulators and legislators to help inform and understand the latest changes, and advising insurance customers on best practices for using Nearmap AI products in admitted markets. You will track every bulletin and bill that touches imagery and AI, and you will publish the positions our customers and our field can rely on.

The framework for imagery and AI for the insurance industry is still being written, and you will put Nearmap in the room, arguing standards that reflect what current imagery and AI can support.

You will be starting from a solid foundation. Nearmap data is approved in more than fifty rate filings, and we maintain a working database of state bulletins and legislation. What we do not have is a single owner. This is a builder role with immediate impact: you will step into active filing engagements from week one, and you will build the function behind them, which includes the state playbooks and the positions Nearmap stands behind.

You will report into Insurance Product, which puts you close to where new attributes and scores are designed, and you will work daily with data science, actuarial, Legal, and our customer-facing teams.

You'll be the regulatory face of Nearmap:

  • Act as the named Nearmap contact across the filing lifecycle, from pre-filing consultation through objection response and post-approval maintenance.
  • Own Nearmap regulatory strategy, which includes where we will register, where and what we will file, and how. You’ll partner with insurance carriers to jointly design regulatory approaches that suit their needs.
  • Lead objection response strategy, drawing analytical inputs from our actuarial and data science teams.
  • Own our advisory organization relationship and the subscriber mechanics that sit between us and our carrier customers, and establish where those requirements are regulatory and where they are commercial.
  • Develop a recommendation on advisory organization registration beyond our existing Arizona registration and own this strategy on an ongoing basis as the regulatory landscape continues to evolve.
  • Partner with Legal on the privilege, contractual, and compliance questions that arise from filings and regulator engagement.

You'll own the filing program:

  • Own Nearmap rate filing approach end-to-end to support carrier filing programs: scoping, materials, submission coordination, tracking, objection response, and close.
  • Coordinate on and collaborate with cross functional teams to support a rate filing materials library, including model memos, validation summaries, and methodology documentation, for every Nearmap attribute and score used in rating.
  • Maintain state-by-state command of filing requirements, permissible confidentiality treatment, and filer eligibility.
  • Manage version control and re-filing triggered by model updates, new attributes, validation findings, or regulator feedback.
  • Monitor regulatory filings across all states and maintain up-to-date database of rating plans that use aerially derived data.

You'll help shape the rules, not just follow them:

  • Track NAIC, NAMIC, and NCOIL activity on insurance AI and imagery, including the NAIC AI Systems Evaluation Tool, and represent Nearmap's perspective in those venues.
  • Advise product and data science on filing implications before new attributes and scores ship, so regulatory risk is designed out and new products are released in a “filing-ready” state.

You'll make the field credible:

  • Equip Sales, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success with accurate positioning on what our filing history does and does not transfer to a given state.
  • Build the filing schedules, metrics, and playbooks the whole insurance vertical works from.

Experience

  • 8 to 12 years in property and casualty rate filings, regulatory affairs, or state product management. Personal lines property especially.
  • Hands-on experience managing complete filing lifecycles and interacting directly with state insurance regulators. California experience is a significant advantage.
  • Experience preparing regulator-ready materials: filing narratives, methodology summaries, actuarial exhibits, statistical plans, forms, and rate pages.
  • Bachelor's degree in insurance, actuarial science, public policy, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Skills

  • You know SERFF and multi-state prior-approval processes cold, and you know which states behave differently and why.
  • You can translate model documentation and validation output into language a regulator will accept the first time.
  • You work towards many parallel deadlines you do not control, and you do not drop them.
  • You hold your own in a room with carrier actuarial and regulatory teams.
  • You write clearly, and you can explain a technical method to a reviewer without losing the substance.

What makes you stand out

  • Actuarial credentials such as ASA or ACAS, or relevant regulatory training or certification.
  • Prior regulator-side experience inside a department of insurance.
  • Experience with AI, predictive model, or catastrophe model filings, and familiarity with model governance frameworks.
  • Experience standing up or maintaining advisory or rating organization status.

You’ll be successful if you are:

  • Comfortable being the first person in a function and writing the playbook while the work is live.
  • Calm under deadlines set by other people, which is most of them.
  • Commercially aware. You understand that filing approval is a revenue event, and a delay is not just an inconvenience.
  • A strong communicator in writing, in conversation, and on a call with a regulator.

Why you'll love working at Nearmap:

We move fast and work smart; often wearing multiple hats. We adapted to remote working with ease and are continually looking at ways to improve. We’re proud of our inclusive, supportive culture, and maintain a safe environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging and can be themselves.

In addition to your annual leave, Nearmap offers:

  • 4 extra "YOU" days off each year—take a break, no questions asked!
  • Company-sponsored volunteering days to give back.
  • Generous parental leave policies for growing families.
  • Work from Overseas Policy - explore the world in the approved list of cities while you work!
  • Discounted Private Health Insurance plans.
  • A Nearmap subscription (naturally!).

Learn More About The Work We Do:

YouTube Page

LinkedIn Page

Thanks, but we got this! Nearmap does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies and search firms. Please do not email or send unsolicited resumes to any Nearmap employee, location or address. Nearmap is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Property intelligence is reshaping how the world understands the built environment, and Nearmap is driving that. We put powerful aerial imagery, AI-driven analytics, and geospatial tools into the hands of the people who plan, build, insure, and govern the places we all live and work. Our technology turns property uncertainty into decisive action, and our culture brings out the best in the people who build it.

Leverage your expertise to lead and forge partnerships that advance the biotechnology and biopharmaceutical science that can turn the tide of serious, life-interrupting illnesses. Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. The Global Marketing Senior Manager will be a strategic leader on the Global Oncology Marketing team, playing a vital role in shaping the next phase of IMDELLTRA’s growth. Reporting to the Global Marketing Director, this role will synthesize market, clinical, competitive, access, and business inputs into clear recommendations; coordinate matrix partners; make workstream and initiative tradeoffs; and drive consistent, effective execution across global, regional, and affiliate teams.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

Adprime is hiring a Director of Technology to lead engineering execution across our platform. The Director of Technology will work directly with the CTPO to shape technical strategy, then own turning that strategy into delivered software through our distributed engineering team.

  • Excellent written and spoken English

What Success Looks Like

  • Within six months, the CTPO is out of the day-to-day engineering loop. Architecture decisions are made quickly and well, sprints ship what they commit to, and delivery timelines are trusted by the rest of the company.

Company Introduction:

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.

Airspace has been rated one of America’s best Startup Employers and listed as one of CNBC’s Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics.

Be the Team's Deepest Problem-Solver

Every ops floor needs a small number of people who can be handed the hardest problem in the queue and trusted to get it right — balancing cost, speed, and customer impact without defaulting to escalation. As an Operations Specialist III, you're that person for your team.

You resolve what OS I and OS II can't, you help the team solve it themselves next time, and you understand the business well enough to make the close calls — which carrier, which cost, which tradeoff — that protect both service quality and margin. For the rare issue that needs to be fielded by someone supporting Ops leadership and account managers directly, you know when to bring in an Ops Expert.

What You'll Do

Must be able to perform all responsibilities included in the Operations Specialist II job description, in addition to the following:

Resolve the Hardest Escalations

  • Independently resolve all escalated issues using available resources with minimal to no assistance
  • Assist in resolving team member escalations and questions
  • Anticipate problems before they surface and act early

Make the Margin and Cost Tradeoffs

  • Understand margin versus total cost for an order and apply that knowledge to additional charge approvals
  • Balance speed, cost, and customer impact when making big-picture decisions, without defaulting to escalation (e.g., choosing a carrier based on service reliability and error-rate history rather than the fastest or cheapest option alone)
  • Maintain deep, practiced knowledge of the trade, regulatory, and compliance requirements relevant to your assigned sector

Set the Standard for the Team

  • Serve as the go-to resource on sector-specific process nuance and edge cases within the team
  • Flag SOP gaps and suggest improvements to your supervisor based on frontline experience
  • Uphold team expectations by leading through example
  • Maintain any certifications required for your assigned sector and stay current on related compliance requirements; assist teammates with related questions

Maintain a Balanced Level of Performance

As an OS III, you'll be expected to maintain minimal to no errors or service failures, make sound decisions under pressure, and meet the customer service standards appropriate for this level. Specific metrics vary by sector and will be communicated by your direct reporting supervisor.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated success as an Operations Specialist II, or equivalent experience independently resolving complex, time-critical logistics escalations
  • Working knowledge of margin and cost tradeoffs, and comfort applying that knowledge to real-time approval decisions
  • Deep, near-expert familiarity with the trade, regulatory, and compliance requirements relevant to your sector
  • Track record of coaching or supporting less-tenured teammates through difficult issues
  • Sound judgment under pressure, with a track record of getting ahead of problems rather than reacting to them
  • Willingness to obtain additional certifications, where applicable within your sector
  • Available for 2 weeks of training in person on-site in our Carlsbad, CA headquarters

Advancement to Ops Expert

Ops Expert is a step up in scope, not just tenure: it moves from executing within your sector to being the escalation point leadership and account managers turn to directly, with elevated coaching and live-operations responsibility. To advance, you'll need to demonstrate all of the following:

  • Minimum of 9-12 months in the OS III role
  • Consistently meeting or exceeding OS III performance standards, tracked through ongoing 1:1 check-ins and confirmed across two consecutive Semi-Annual Reviews (SARs)
  • Demonstrated ability to guide teammates in real time — catching and correcting issues as they happen, not just after the fact
  • Working familiarity with monitoring and resourcing tools (e.g., Zendesk, Twilio, live dashboards) beyond your own queue
  • Willingness to obtain additional certifications required for the Expert tier, where applicable, in addition to your existing sector certifications
  • Manager recommendation, confirming readiness to operate as the sector's top escalation resource and take on informal team-leadership responsibility

Compensation

  • Hourly pay range: $26-30/hr
  • High-quality health, vision, and dental care plan options
  • 401K company contribution program
  • Professional learning and training reimbursements

Core Values:

  • We are One Team. We believe we all accomplish more when we are working together.
  • We make an Impact. We are determined to have a positive influence on our environment, our customers, our industry, and our world.
  • We are Passionate. We care deeply about our mission and are not afraid to raise the bar.
  • We are Transparent. We pride ourselves on having open, honest, and sincere communication with our team and customers.
  • We are Innovative. We never settle and are always striving to improve our product, service, and ourselves.

At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere, can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. Position Summary

We are seeking a Director, Consumer Marketing & Strategy to define and advance iRhythm’s direct-to-consumer (DTC) marketing strategy and help shape our longer-term approach to consumer growth and engagement. Reporting into the VP, Global Marketing and Commercial Strategy, this highly visible, senior individual contributor will connect consumer insights, market opportunities and commercial priorities to strategies that increase awareness, improve patient education and engagement, and support sustainable business growth.

This leader will own the consumer marketing strategy and roadmap across priority business initiatives, establish scalable omnichannel capabilities, and translate market and patient insights into strategic choices, investment recommendations and measurable outcomes. Working through influence rather than direct people management, the Director will convene cross-functional teams and agency partners to bring high-impact programs to market in a compliant and patient-centered manner.


As the organization’s consumer capabilities mature, this role is expected to play an increasingly significant role in defining an enterprise consumer strategy, including where and how iRhythm engages consumers throughout their health journey. The ideal candidate combines strategy development and hands-on operating judgment, executive-level communication, analytical rigor, and the ability to build in an evolving environment.

Key Responsibilities


Consumer Marketing Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own and evolve the DTC marketing strategy and multiyear roadmap across prioritized disease states, audiences and business initiatives, aligned to enterprise and commercial objectives.
  • Define consumer segmentation, journeys, value propositions, messaging and channel roles; prioritize initiatives based on consumer needs, business value, feasibility and compliance considerations.
  • Lead annual and ongoing planning for consumer marketing, including strategic tradeoffs, agency direction, resource needs and investment recommendations.

Consumer & Commercial Growth Strategy

  • Partner with Commercial Strategy, Product Marketing, Market Access, Sales and other leaders to identify and assess consumer-driven market opportunities, unmet needs and potential growth pathways for the organization’s full portfolio of products.
  • Develop strategic hypotheses, opportunity assessments and business cases that integrate market dynamics, patient behavior, care pathways, competitive trends and commercial economics.
  • Bring the consumer perspective into commercial planning, portfolio and go-to-market discussions; recommend where iRhythm should focus, invest, test, scale or change course.
  • Help shape a longer-term enterprise consumer strategy and the organizational capabilities required to deliver it, with ownership expanding as priorities and governance evolve.

Omnichannel Marketing & Consumer Engagement

  • Provide strategic leadership for compliant omnichannel campaigns that build awareness, educate consumers and support appropriate provider-led conversations and care-seeking behaviors.
  • Direct integrated plans across paid, owned and earned channels in partnership with Digital Marketing, Communications, Product Marketing and external agencies; guide creative, content, testing and optimization.
  • Ensure development of high-quality consumer and patient education experiences and assets across web, social, video, email, in-office and other relevant touchpoints.
  • Partner with commercial teams on field readiness and appropriate customer-facing integration of consumer initiatives.

Consumer, Market & Competitive Insights

  • Establish a consumer learning agenda using primary research, voice-of-customer work, behavioral data, market intelligence and program analytics.
  • Synthesize insights about awareness, health decision-making, patient journeys, care settings, insurance considerations, access barriers and competitive activity into implications for strategy.
  • Communicate insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders, influencing strategic priorities and go-to-market decisions.

Patient Advocacy & Ecosystem Partnerships

  • Define the strategic role of patient advocacy, community education and relevant consumer ecosystem partnerships in advancing awareness, understanding, self-advocacy and appropriate access to care.
  • Evaluate partnership opportunities and guide coordinated, compliant initiatives with Patient Advocacy, Market Access, Government Affairs, Communications and Medical Affairs partners.

Performance, Investment & Operating Discipline

  • Establish a measurement framework spanning awareness, engagement, qualified actions, learning milestones and contribution to business goals; distinguish leading indicators from outcomes that are difficult to attribute directly.
  • Evaluate channel and campaign performance, recommend resource reallocation and translate results into executive-ready strategic decisions and business reviews.
  • Guide cross-functional workstreams and external agency performance through clear objectives, governance, milestones and accountability, without formal direct reports.

Compliance & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Ensure consumer programs operate within applicable Medical, Legal and Regulatory requirements and established review processes; anticipate claims, privacy and reputational considerations with expert partners.
  • Act as a senior strategic connector across Marketing, Commercial Strategy, Digital, Sales, Market Access, Medical, Regulatory, Legal, Communications and external collaborators.
  • Influence senior leadership through clear points of view, evidence-based recommendations, crisp executive storytelling and effective management of competing priorities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in marketing, business, strategy, communications, public health or a related field preferred.
  • 12+ years of progressive experience in consumer marketing, commercial strategy, growth strategy or related areas, including substantial healthcare experience in medical devices, diagnostics, digital health, pharmaceuticals or disease awareness.
  • Demonstrated ownership of enterprise-relevant consumer marketing strategies, integrated programs and measurable business outcomes; experience creating new capabilities or entering new markets strongly preferred.
  • Ability to develop market opportunity assessments, synthesize consumer and competitive insights, make investment tradeoffs and translate ambiguity into actionable strategic roadmaps.
  • Deep expertise in omnichannel marketing, segmentation, customer journeys, consumer research, digital measurement and agency leadership.
  • Experience with patient advocacy and cross-functional healthcare stakeholder engagement, including working within Medical, Legal and Regulatory review environments.
  • Executive presence, exceptional written and verbal communication, and a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and leading complex initiatives without formal authority.
  • Comfort balancing strategic development with practical execution in a fast-moving, evolving business environment.

Travel

jobs.excerpt: Job DescriptionNetImpact Strategies has an opportunity for a SharePoint / Web Administrator to manage training-site content and support accessible, reliable digital learning resources for a federal healthcare technology program.
jobs.description:
Job Description

NetImpact Strategies has an opportunity for a SharePoint / Web Administrator to manage training-site content and support accessible, reliable digital learning resources for a federal healthcare technology program. This role maintains SharePoint training sites and related web content, organizes approved materials, manages publication workflows, and helps instructors and learners find current guidance. Working with training coordinators, content developers, subject matter experts, and Government site owners, the administrator keeps training repositories accurate, searchable, and aligned with approved curricula and system releases; this position is remote.

Responsibilities

  • Administer assigned SharePoint training sites, pages, document libraries, lists, navigation, and related web content within authorized permissions.
  • Publish approved curricula, instructor and student guides, quick-reference materials, training schedules, announcements, and learning-system links.
  • Organize content using consistent metadata, naming conventions, categories, and audience labels to improve searchability and usability.
  • Maintain version control, approval status, publication dates, and review schedules so users can identify and access current training materials.
  • Coordinate content updates with training and change-management personnel, instructional designers, subject matter experts, and Government reviewers.
  • Maintain publishing and approval workflows; track pending submissions and resolve administrative issues affecting timely publication.
  • Review sites for broken links, outdated documents, duplicate materials, navigation problems, and accessibility issues; coordinate corrections and approved archival actions.
  • Configure site and library permissions within delegated authority, conduct access reviews, and escalate access requirements to Government site owners.
  • Maintain training calendars, resource pages, and approved announcements that support scheduled instruction and release readiness.
  • Test page layouts, links, embedded content, forms, and downloads before publication and following approved changes.
  • Analyze available site usage, search behavior, and user feedback to recommend improvements to content organization and the training-site experience.
  • Troubleshoot site-content and user-access issues; coordinate platform-level problems with enterprise SharePoint or infrastructure administrators.
  • Maintain site inventories, content-management procedures, publishing records, and administrative documentation.
  • Follow applicable Section 508 accessibility, privacy, security, branding, and records-management requirements.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, web administration, communications, information management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • At least three years of experience administering SharePoint sites, managing web content, or supporting enterprise content-management platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with SharePoint pages, document libraries, lists, metadata, navigation, permissions, versioning, and approval workflows.
  • Experience managing content reviews, publication schedules, and controlled document repositories.
  • Ability to organize complex information into clear, usable site structures for different audiences.
  • Working knowledge of Section 508 accessibility requirements and accessible web and document-publishing practices.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including SharePoint, Teams, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong troubleshooting, attention to detail, written communication, and stakeholder-coordination skills.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain required Government system access and satisfy applicable Tier 3 background investigation requirements.
  • Ability to complete required privacy, security, and information-handling training. No specific professional certification is required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience maintaining federal healthcare, training, knowledge-management, or employee-enablement portals.
  • Familiarity with both modern and classic SharePoint sites.
  • Experience using Power Automate or comparable approved tools for content-review and publication workflows.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and web-content troubleshooting.
  • Experience using site analytics, search reports, or user feedback to improve navigation and content discovery.
  • Familiarity with links and interfaces between SharePoint training repositories and learning management systems.
  • Relevant Microsoft, SharePoint, accessibility, or web-administration certification.

Location Requirement

Remote. Coordinate with geographically dispersed content owners and training teams and support scheduled publication, release, and site-maintenance activities across applicable time zones. Routine travel is not anticipated.

About Us

At NetImpact Strategies, we post salary ranges in compliance with the specific labor laws and regulations of each county and state, ensuring transparency and fairness in our hiring practices. This approach reflects our commitment to adhering to legal requirements and promoting equitable pay standards across all regions where we operate. The posted salary range for this role is $102,000-111,000. The posted salary range is not an exact indication of the actual compensation offered and is instead a range of what NetImpact, in good faith, could compensate at the lowest and most high end of the salary market. In general, NetImpact may not pay the top of the salary range. Compensations are determined by several mitigating factors including skillset, experience, trainings, location, and other factors including benefits packages.Perks of working at NetImpact Strategies

  • Your health comes first – we offer comprehensive medical, dental, & vision insurance that starts the first of the month after you join the team
  • Invest in your future – 401(k) Plan – Immediately vested employer contributions; no matching required
  • Work hard, play hard – we offer a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) policy, one (1) additional day of paid wellness leave per calendar year, and observe ten (10) federal holidays
  • Pawsitively pawesome – Pet Insurance (because our little critters are part of our families, too!)
  • Invest in your education – Tuition reimbursement, internal training programs, & company-sponsored industry certifications!
  • Be part of a dynamic and collaborative work environment recently ranked by The Washington Post as a Top Work Place in 2019, 2021,2022, 2023, & 2024!
  • Have fun and celebrate and give back – Team building activities, community volunteering, quarterly HQ days, wellness events, happy hours, family fun events, and more!

ABOUT US

NetImpact Strategies Inc. (NetImpact) has been a Trusted Advisor driving impact through digital transformation for the Federal Government for over a decade. We solve complex problems with innovation and agility to create meaningful, transformative, and enduring change. As Trusted Advisors, NetImpact professionals partner with customer agencies to deliver solutions that empower them to not only meet their missions but also realize their strategic vision through agile, outcome-focused solutions addressing both strategic and tactical requirements. We design and implement comprehensive, tailored solutions that are both mindful of the client's culture and organizational dynamics. NetImpact’s core values and commitment to a customer and results-oriented delivery approach has propelled our growth and enabled us to deliver impactful value across Strategic Consulting, Process Automation, Cloud, DevSecOps, Data and Analytics, and Cyber Security for the Federal Government.
