The company focuses on short-haul, B2B logistics for Fortune 500 retailers and in 2021 launched the world’s first fully driverless commercial transportation service with Walmart. Gatik's Class 3-7 autonomous trucks are commercially deployed across major markets, including Texas, Arkansas, and Ontario, Canada, driving innovation in freight transportation.

The company's proprietary Level 4 autonomous technology, Gatik Carrier™, is custom-built to transport freight safely and efficiently between pick-up and drop-off locations on the middle mile. With robust capabilities in both highway and urban environments, Gatik Carrier™ serves as an all-encompassing solution that integrates advanced software and hardware powering the fleet, facilitating effortless integration into customers' logistics operations.

About the Role

Gatik is looking for a detail-oriented, improvement-minded Program Manager, Operations Process to own and improve the workflows that power our autonomous trucking operations. In this role, you will lead process creation, process review, and workflow design, and maintain the templates, standards, and gates that keep quality consistent across every operational workstream. Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Operational Excellence, you will partner closely with subject matter experts across Operations, Fleet Maintenance, Safety, Training, and Engineering to turn operational knowledge into clear, standardized, scalable processes. You will be instrumental in maintaining quality and consistency while driving lean practices and continuous improvement.

This role is remote in the USA, with travel to sites.

What You'll Do

  • Own processes end to end. Act as the accountable owner for assigned operational processes across workstreams, keeping them current, consistent, and aligned from start to finish.
  • Design and maintain workflows. Build, document, and maintain operational workflows, including process maps, SOPs, RACI charts, and handoffs between teams.
  • Set templates and standards. Create and maintain standard templates for processes, SOPs, work instructions, and change requests so documentation looks and works the same everywhere.
  • Run process gating. Run quality gates and approvals for new and changed processes so they meet quality, safety, and readiness standards before rollout.
  • Lead process creation. Partner with stakeholders to scope, design, and launch new processes as operations and markets grow.
  • Run process reviews. Hold regular reviews to audit existing processes, find gaps or drift, and drive updates.
  • Partner with subject matter experts. Work closely with SMEs to capture expertise, validate process design, and secure adoption by the teams doing the work.
  • Drive lean practices. Apply lean tools (value stream mapping, waste elimination, standard work, root cause analysis) to simplify workflows and improve quality and efficiency.
  • Manage process change. Own version control and change management for process updates, working with Training to make sure changes are communicated and trained before rollout.
  • Improve continuously. Gather feedback from the field and turn it into targeted process improvements.

What We're Looking For

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in process engineering, operational excellence, quality, program management, or business process management.
  • Experience owning and maintaining processes across several teams or workstreams.
  • Experience designing workflows, writing SOPs, and building documentation templates.
  • Experience running process review or approval mechanisms.
  • Working knowledge of lean principles and tools.
  • Strong ability to work with subject matter experts and turn complex operational knowledge into clear, usable processes.
  • Proficiency with process mapping and documentation tools such as Lucidchart, Visio, Miro, or Confluence.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in autonomous vehicles, trucking, logistics, fleet maintenance, or other safety-critical operations.
  • Lean Six Sigma Yellow or Green Belt, or equivalent lean training.
  • Experience with quality management systems or frameworks such as ISO 9001.
  • Experience in a startup or high-growth environment where processes were still being defined.
  • Familiarity with change management methodologies such as Prosci or ADKAR.
  • Experience with workflow tools such as Jira, ServiceNow, or Smartsheet.

More about Gatik

Founded in 2017 by experts in autonomous vehicle technology, Gatik has rapidly expanded its presence to Mountain View, Dallas-Fort Worth, Arkansas, and Toronto. As the first and only company to achieve fully driverless middle-mile commercial deliveries, Gatik holds a unique and defensible position in the AV industry, with a clear trajectory toward sustainable growth and profitability.

We have delivered complete, proprietary AV technology - an integration of software and hardware - to enable earlier successes for our clients in constrained Level 4 autonomy. By choosing the middle mile – with defined point-to-point delivery, we have simplified some of the more complex AV challenges, enabling us to achieve full autonomy ahead of competitors. Given extensive knowledge of Gatik’s well-defined, fixed route ODDs and hybrid architecture, we are able to hyper-optimize our models with exponentially less data, establish gate-keeping mechanisms to maintain explainability, and ensure continued safety of the system for unmanned operations.

Visit us at Gatik for more company information and Careers at Gatik for more open roles.

Notable News

  • Forbes: Forget robotaxis. Upstart Gatik sees middle-mile deliveries as the path to profitable AVs
  • Tech Brew:Gatik AI exec unpacks the regulations that could shape the AV industry
  • Business Wire: Gatik Paves the Way for Safe Driverless Operations (‘Freight-Only’) at Scale with Industry-First Third-Party Safety Assessment Framework
  • Auto Futures: Autonomous Trucking Group Gatik Secures Investment From NIPPON EXPRESS HOLDINGS
  • Automotive News: Gatik foresees hundreds of self-driving trucks on road soon, and that's just the beginning
  • Forbes: Isuzu And Gatik Go All In To Scale Up Driverless Freight Services
  • Bloomberg: Autonomous Vehicle Startup Takes Off by Picking Off Easier Routes
  • Reuters: Driverless vehicles on limited routes bump along despite US robotaxi scrutiny

Taking Care of Our Team

At Gatik, we connect people of extraordinary talent and experience to an opportunity to create a more resilient supply chain and contribute to our environment’s sustainability. We are diverse in our backgrounds and perspectives yet united by a bold vision and shared commitment to our values. Our culture emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect and agility.

We at Gatik strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that together we can do great things. We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.

Amazon Operations Specialist

Join the Zulay Kitchen Team!
Zulay Kitchen is a fast-growing consumer products brand creating innovative, practical, and affordable kitchen products that make everyday life easier.
We're looking for a detail-oriented, proactive, and results-driven Amazon Operations Specialist who enjoys solving problems, staying organized, and making things happen!

The Amazon Operations Specialist will help manage the day-to-day operations of Zulay Kitchen's Amazon business, including inventory, product listings, account health, and issue resolution.
We're looking for someone with hands-on experience working in the backend of Amazon Seller Central who understands the platform and is comfortable navigating its tools and processes.
You don't need to know everything, but you should have a solid foundation in Amazon operations, be a quick learner, and enjoy figuring things out!

Inventory Management & Shipments
  • Monitor inventory levels, forecast replenishment needs, and coordinate product reorders.

Amazon Product Listings

  • Follow up consistently until issues are resolved.

  • Work with Amazon Support to resolve inventory discrepancies and recover inventory when possible.

Qualifications

  • Experience navigating Seller Central, troubleshooting issues, and communicating with Amazon Support.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Comfortable using Excel, Google Sheets, and other business tools.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
Bonus Points For:
  • Experience working for an Amazon-based e-commerce brand.

The Ideal Candidate
You're organized, resourceful, and enjoy solving problems. You're comfortable managing multiple priorities, taking ownership of your work, and finding solutions when challenges arise.
Most importantly, you bring a positive attitude, take initiative, and want to grow with a successful e-commerce company.
Why Join Zulay Kitchen?
At Zulay Kitchen, we're not just building great kitchen products. We're building a company where people take ownership, support one another, and work together to create something meaningful.
Our mission is to deliver innovative, high-quality culinary products and services that foster family values, enhance people's lives, and create joyful moments worldwide.

jobs.description:
Coding Manager, Professional Fee Medical Coding

The Coding Manager oversees the provider-based medical coding team ensuring all professional services are coded with the highest level of accuracy, compliance and efficiency while supporting HURC clients.

This role serves as a subject matter expert and client-facing leader responsible for evaluating professional fee medical coding and related revenue cycle operations, identifying performance opportunities, developing recommendations, and leading implementation initiatives that improve coding accuracy, billing performance, reimbursement, compliance, quality, and financial outcomes.

This position requires a strong understanding of provider-based coding methodologies, revenue cycle operations, payer requirements, reimbursement, analytics, and operational performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervises day-to-day coding operations for professional fee claims across multiple clinical specialties.

  • Monitor workflow and ensure compliance with standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Steps in for hands-on support on complex coding reviews and escalated coding issues from the customer and coders.
  • Monitor program performance and develop corrective action and improvement plans.
  • Identify opportunities to improve coding accuracy, reimbursement, productivity, quality, and financial performance.
  • Provide subject matter expertise in professional fee coding and billing.
  • Evaluate coding and billing workflows and identify operational gaps.
  • Review coding accuracy, productivity, quality, reimbursement, and compliance trends.
  • Evaluate the relationship between documentation, coding, billing, reimbursement, and denials.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce coding-related denials and prevent revenue leakage.
  • Evaluate charge capture, claim submission, edits, billing workflows, and payer requirements.
  • Partner with CDI, coding, utilization review, denials, and revenue cycle teams to improve overall financial performance.
  • Maintain knowledge of ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT, HCPCS, modifiers, edits, medical necessity, and applicable payer requirements.

Client Leadership

  • Serves as a client-facing leader for professional fee coding operations.
  • Lead coder and client meetings.
  • Develop recommendations based on client data, workflows, financial performance, and operational findings.
  • Establish strong relationships with coding leaders, providers and other stakeholders.
  • Manage client escalations and ensure timely resolution.
  • Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships through additional solutions.
  • Evaluate the impact of coding, CDI, billing, denials, utilization, and payer behavior on reimbursement.
  • Identify revenue leakage and opportunities for improved reimbursement.
  • Support initiatives designed to improve clean claim rates, reduce denials, accelerate reimbursement, and improve net revenue.
  • Partner with clients to establish appropriate benchmarks and improvement targets.

Analytics & Reporting

  • Develop and interpret dashboards and performance reports.
  • Establish program baselines and measurable improvement targets.
  • Analyze productivity, quality, denial, reimbursement, and financial metrics.
  • Partner with HURC analytics resources to develop meaningful client reporting.
  • Participate in implementation of new coding, billing, and revenue cycle programs.

Quality, Compliance & Audit

  • Ensure coding and billing programs comply with applicable federal and state regulations, payer requirements, and client policies.
  • Monitor coding quality and compliance.
  • Support internal and external audits.
  • Identify compliance risks and recommend corrective action.
  • Ensure appropriate documentation and audit trails are maintained.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and accountability.

  • Promote a culture of quality, accountability, continuous improvement, and client service.

Qualifications Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in health information management, Healthcare Administration, Business, Finance, or related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in professional fee coding, billing, HIM, revenue cycle, or healthcare financial operations. Must be credentialed coder with a minimum of one of these certifications: RHIA, RHIT, CPC, CCS, or CCS-P.
  • 2+ years of leadership or supervisory experience.
  • Strong understanding of professional fee billing and revenue cycle operations.
  • Experience working with healthcare clients, hospitals, health systems, or physician organizations.
  • Strong understanding of payer requirements and reimbursement methodologies.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and communication skills.
  • Experience with Epic or other major EHR platforms.
  • Experience with encoder, CAC, CDI, billing, or revenue cycle technology.
  • Experience with hospital denials and appeals.
  • Experience with revenue integrity.
  • Experience working with outsourced coding or revenue cycle organizations.
  • Experience managing multi-client or national healthcare programs.
  • Travel as needed.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This role leads our Inside Sales team of 7-9 Mid Market Account Executives selling into the Mexico market, to expand our business and grow our customer base.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customer's value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Mentor, coach and develop existing Senior Account Executives in everything from outbound cold calling to conversion to deal close and quota over-attainment
  • Assist live with deal progression and negotiation across the team
  • Coordinate extensively with Marketing/Growth and Account Development Leadership to ensure quality lead volume for Mexico market / Inside Sales team
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales Engineering, Finance and Order Operations to ensure smooth deal flow
  • Identify opportunities and lead initiatives to benefit the entire market and grow our business in Mexico
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Obsess Over the Customer, Build for the Long Term, Growth Mindset, Inclusivity, Winning as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop, and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • 6+ years sales experience
  • 2+ years experience managing a team preferred
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce.com (SFDC) and MEDDIC/MEDDPICC
  • Strategic problem solving, project management, interpersonal and team management skills
  • Strong track record of overachievement with experience in coaching a team on outbounding
  • Experience with a Proof of Concept or Trial sales motion
  • Ability to provide upward feedback

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.description:
Who is Credible?

Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level. On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance — all without impacting their credit score. On the enterprise side, we power financial product comparison and distribution through deep integrations and partnerships with lenders, insurance carriers, and financial institutions, as well as providing marketplace technology and capabilities to third-party partners and distribution channels.

About the Role:

Credible is seeking an analytical, product-minded leader to own how consumers discover Credible online. The way people find financial products is evolving at a rapid pace. Search is turning into AI answers, and the decision to compare a loan or an insurance policy is moving beyond Google to AI platforms, Reddit, YouTube, or TikTok. We are uniquely positioned to be the trusted answer wherever that search begins.

In this role, you will own and scale organic discovery across Credible.com and our tier-1 publishing partners. SEO is the foundation but; the role spans everything SEO is becoming: traditional search, AI answer engines, and social and community platforms. You will also own the performance of the pages that organic traffic lands on, turning visits into completed applications through rigorous conversion rate optimization.

This is a highly visible role, both inside Credible and across our publisher partner network. You’ll work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Editorial, Partnerships, and Paid Marketing, while leading a team of SEO and content specialists. The ideal candidate is deeply analytical, thinks like a product manager, and is grounded in revenue-based decisions. They can explain in dollars what happened, why it happened, and what we’re doing about it. You will thrive in a fast-moving environment and are passionate about helping consumers make great financial decisions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own and lead Credible’s organic discovery strategy across Credible.com and our tier-1 publishing partners, spanning SEO, AI platforms (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews), and social and community platforms (Reddit, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Win visibility in AI-generated answers by understanding how large language models retrieve, summarize, and cite content, making our pages and product data easy to use and cite, and building presence in the off-site sources those models draw on, including forums, publishers, and earned media.
  • Lead technical SEO at scale, including crawlability, indexation, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, structured data, and schema, partnering closely with our Content Platform engineering team.
  • Own conversion rate optimization for organic entry pages: set page and template requirements, build and run a disciplined A/B testing program, and partner with Product to improve the journey from first visit to completed application.
  • Act as a product owner for organic experiences, writing clear requirements, prioritizing a roadmap with Product and Engineering, and shipping improvements that move both traffic and conversion.
  • Bring analytical rigor to every decision: separate competitive non-brand traffic from brand and direct demand, tie organic performance to revenue, and diagnose changes in performance down to the query, page, and funnel stage.
  • Establish clear measurement frameworks that track leading indicators and long-term outcomes, including rankings, AI citations and share of voice, conversion rate, and revenue per visit.
  • Reporting to leadership and stakeholders, with clear communication on KPIs, initiatives, and overall portfolio performance.
  • Build authority through digital PR, expert contributors, and partner content that strengthens trust and E-E-A-T in a regulated, high-trust category.
  • Conduct opportunity sizing and ROI modeling to prioritize verticals, queries, and platforms, balancing near-term revenue impact with durable brand authority.
  • Build and lead a high-performing team of SEO and content specialists, setting a high bar for craft, testing discipline, and clear communication.
  • Foster a culture of experimentation, using data, insights, and testing to continuously refine how consumers find and choose Credible.
  • Stay at the forefront of search, AI discovery, analytics, and conversion best practices to keep Credible ahead of the curve.

Education & Experience

We know the “perfect” candidate doesn’t exist, so if you meet most of the criteria below and are excited about the opportunity, we’d love to hear from you:

  • 8+ years of experience in SEO and organic growth, with senior leadership of an organic or growth function, ideally at a marketplace, publisher, or consumer fintech.
  • Proven track record of growing non-brand organic demand and tying it to revenue, not just traffic.
  • Hands-on, current experience improving brand visibility in AI answer engines, with a point of view on how to measure it.
  • Demonstrated success in conversion rate optimization, including designing and running A/B tests on high-traffic pages.
  • Strong product sense, with a history of writing requirements and shipping with Product and Engineering teams.
  • Advanced analytical skills, with fluency in Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, and SQL or Looker.
  • Experience with YMYL content and compliance review; financial services experience a plus.
  • Experience working with publishers or media partners a plus.
  • 4+ years of people management, with a passion for coaching and scaling teams.

Why work at Credible?

We combine the intelligence, expertise, and confidence of a financial advisor with the approachability and honesty of a friend. In other words, we’re the friend you always wish you had in finance.

We are optimistic, challengers, trustworthy, clever, and smart. We are open and transparent. We strive to act as advisors by being friendly, objective, and open in our communication. We use language that is intelligent yet approachable. When appropriate, we’ll drop in a bit of wit to position ourselves as a fresh, reliable voice in the financial world.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

AFFILIATE PARTNERSHIPS MANAGER

We Realize Potential in Your Story

We are a multi-platform production company, social media agency, and digital media network who are currently on a quest to find a Affiliate Partnerships Manager to join our Network team - Is this your next opportunity?

We're looking for an individual to help power one of the largest deal-focused channels on YouTube (3M subscribers). The Affiliate Partnerships Manager will own, scale, and optimize the affiliate commerce revenue engine for one of our lead Creator channels. In this role, you will lead publisher-side affiliate strategy and day-to-day commercial relationship management, partnering directly with top-tier US retail merchants and affiliate networks. Working closely with the Content and Channel Management teams, you will be tasked with maximizing earnings via affiliate links/shopping features. You will be responsible for proactively negotiating bespoke commission increases, securing exclusive promotional codes and advance deal sheets for marquee shopping events (such as Prime Day and Black Friday/Cyber Monday), and aligning high-converting retail deals with our content calendar. You will collaborate closely with the Channel Manager and the content production team to integrate affiliate links seamlessly into video descriptions, community posts, and newsletters while maintaining audience trust and strict compliance.

HOW YOU WILL SPEND YOUR TIME

Retailer partnership management and business development

  • Manage and scale direct relationships with major US retail partners, (eg. Amazon and Walmart) alongside major affiliate networks (eg. Impact, CJ Affiliate, MagicLinks).

  • Pitch and negotiate with retailers and networks to secure beneficial commission rates, hybrid campaign fees, performance bonuses, exclusive merchant coupon codes, and curated landing pages to drive maximum revenue yield.

  • Serve as the primary commercial point of contact for brand affiliate managers, affiliate PR reps, and network account teams.

Affiliate strategy and operations

  • Own and execute the commercial affiliate playbook for the Creator channel, including around major retail tentpole events such as Amazon Prime Day, Fall Prime Day, Black Friday, Cyber Monday, and Q4 holiday shopping.

  • Regularly liaise with merchant partner contacts (including well in advance of tentpole dates) to secure embargoed deal sheets, early bird promotions, high-tier commission incentives, and guaranteed exclusive promotional codes.

  • Coordinate with content and channel production leads to plan timely content releases that capitalize on real-time flash sales and lightning deals.

Product curation and link operations

  • Curate commercially compelling, high-converting product selections tailored to the audience's interests, seasonal trends, and upcoming video releases.

  • Coordinate with the Channel Management team to supply optimized affiliate tracking links, promotional copy, and call-to-action (CTA) text for video descriptions, pinned comments, newsletters, and social channels.

  • Manage smart-link routing and redirection platforms (e.g., Geniuslink) to ensure multi-retailer fallback logic, global geo-targeting, and rapid resolution of out-of-stock items or broken URLs.

Performance analytics and compliance

  • Maintain tracking structures to attribute revenue, clicks, and conversion by video, placement type, product category, and distribution channel.

  • Monitor and report on core performance indicators and run regular A/B testing on channel output to improve performance

  • Ensure that 100% of affiliate placements and promotional messaging strictly adhere to FTC disclosure regulations, merchant operating terms, and host platform community policies.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Skills matter, experience is useful, attitude is everything.

  • Proficiency across major affiliate networks including Amazon Associates, Impact, CJ Affiliate, Rakuten, ShareASale, PartnerStack, Commission Juncture and MagicLinks

  • Direct US retailer relationships, particularly with Amazon and Walmart.

  • Expertise in smart-link and redirection tools (e.g., Geniuslink, Pretty Links) for link localization, dynamic routing, and out-of-stock monitoring.

  • Strong communication and deal-making skills to pitch brands for direct affiliate partnerships and higher commission splits.

  • Ability to analyze user behavior and craft effective call-to-action (CTA) copy that drives click-throughs without compromising audience trust.

  • Understanding of how affiliate strategies differ across long-form YouTube videos, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels to optimize click-through rates per platform format.

  • Proficiency in Google Sheets/Excel to track and monitor affiliate link performance.

  • Attention to detail and ability to work with our legal and compliance team to ensure FTC and regulatory compliance at all times.

  • Core skills: Communication, Collaboration, Organisation, Delivering Results, Solutions Focused, Adaptability

  • Experience of managing publisher-side affiliate partnerships and operations at a deal site or media company

  • Demonstrable experience managing high-volume link publishing with high accuracy and zero tolerance for broken or incorrect URLs

  • Experience building and maintaining affiliate tracking structures that attribute revenue by content, video and placement using Sub IDs/tracking parameters, including identifying tracking discrepancies, reversals and underperforming programs

  • Proven track record of successfully pitching and negotiating direct affiliate split increases or custom rates with brands

  • Hands-on experience leveraging native video shopping tools (YouTube Shopping or TikTok Shop) (bonus)

  • Experience working directly with content or production teams in a fast-paced YouTube or creator-led publishing environment (bonus)

Candidates must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States.

USE OF AI IN APPLICATIONS

Please keep it human; we want to get to knowyou -your thinking, and your originality. Whilst generative AI tools can be helpful for text refinement, we require your application to jobs at Little Dot Studios to be in your own voice and words. AI cannot be used to generate your responses and any applications appearing to be entirely AI-generated will not be progressed.

LITTLE DOT, BIG IMPACT

We’re probably the biggest studio you didn’t know was fueling your favorite content. We’ve been one of the top dogs in the digital content space since 2013 (some would say, before its potential was even fully realized). We're proud to work with some of the hottest TV and movie studios, distributors, rights holders, sports federations and brands in the business.

Our people-first culture is grounded in collaboration, integrity, continuous learning, and operational excellence. Team members gain meaningful exposure to international clients while building long-term careers in a supportive, performance-focused environment.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The ideal candidate combines advanced Python back-end engineering with hands-on experience developing agentic workflows, reusable Model Context Protocol integrations, secure APIs, and production-quality distributed services. You should be comfortable independently executing complex assignments, reviewing designs and code, mentoring less-experienced engineers, diagnosing problems across application components and environments, and preparing complete, well-tested capabilities for review and promotion. You will succeed in this role if you balance technical innovation with security, reliability, auditability, and disciplined software-engineering practice.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Back-End and Agent Development: Design, develop, test, integrate, and maintain Python services, FastAPI applications, asynchronous components, and LangGraph workflows, including state management, conditional routing, checkpointing, recovery, parallel operations, and multiple tool calls.

  • MCP and Enterprise Integration: Author reusable Model Context Protocol servers, tools, schemas, and integration patterns that securely connect agentic applications with approved enterprise services. Develop and validate integrations using simulators, emulators, mock services, and representative test environments rather than live customer systems.

  • Azure OpenAI and Approval Workflows: Implement Azure OpenAI tool-calling, model abstraction, prompt and context handling, grounding, structured outputs, error handling, configurable approval gates, and human-in-the-loop controls.

  • Data, State, and Auditability: Design and implement PostgreSQL data models, persistence services, LangGraph checkpointing, run-state management, audit logging, traceability, authorization checks, and related data-access patterns.

  • Testing and Engineering Quality: Develop comprehensive pytest suites covering asynchronous, unit, integration, behavior-driven, and end-to-end testing. Maintain appropriate fixtures, mocks, simulators, test data, regression coverage, observability, and secure-development practices.

  • Troubleshooting and Root-Cause Analysis: Diagnose complex issues across APIs, agent graphs, tools, models, databases, containers, and development or test environments. Document root causes, implement corrective actions, and add regression protection.

  • Code Review, Mentoring, and Innovation: Participate in design and merge-request reviews, developer pairing, and demonstrations. Mentor less-experienced engineers, evaluate emerging technologies, develop assigned prototypes, and present recommendations that may improve performance, security, reliability, maintainability, or mission value.

  • Governance and Delivery Readiness: Follow established technical, security, review, and promotion controls. Promptly elevate unclear requirements, unresolved decisions, security concerns, access limitations, and proposed deviations from approved direction. Ensure assigned work is complete, tested, documented, and prepared for ASCENT review and promotion.

Collaborate regularly with GCC and U.S.-based ASCENT team members and perform all work within approved systems, repositories, datasets, and development environments.

Infopro Digital, the B2B group specialising in information and technology, is currently looking for a Consultancy Sales Executive on a permanent contract to drive commercial success within the consultancy team at its Barbour ABI business.

Alongside our market-leading construction project leads service, we provide bespoke consultancy, market research, market sizing, strategic insight and analytics to organisations operating across the built environment.

As Consultancy Sales Executive, you will play a central role in the growth of Barbour ABI's consultancy division. This is a true 360 sales role, responsible for identifying opportunities, generating demand, managing prospects through the sales cycle and winning new projects.

Working closely with the Head of Consultancy, you will develop and manage your own pipeline, engage senior decision-makers, understand client challenges and position bespoke consulting solutions that deliver measurable value.

The consultancy team works remotely, meeting monthly at our Cheshire Oaks office (near Chester), with access to our London office near Liverpool Street.

This is an opportunity to join a fast-growing team with significant scope for progression and direct exposure to high-value strategic projects across the built environment and related sectors.

Business Development & Pipeline Generation

  • Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline of consultancy opportunities.
  • Research prospects, create and execute targeted outreach campaigns to generate meetings with senior decision-makers.
  • Consistently achieve prospecting, meeting and pipeline creation targets.

Consultative Sales

Opportunity Management & Sales Closure

Market Awareness

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.excerpt: At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies.
jobs.description:
At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.

We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our $22m Series B round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

About the Role

As a Senior DevOps Engineer at Ledgy, you'll build the infrastructure and tooling that help our engineers ship quickly and reliably. You'll join our Platform team, collaborating with engineers and InfoSec to improve CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure for a product that helps companies manage equity.

Our challenge is to make delivery faster, production easier to operate, and AI-assisted development safer - while keeping complexity and costs in check.

Location: We hire remotely across Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania.

The team you'll join: Platform - Builds the infrastructure and tooling that help our engineers ship quickly and reliably, working with InfoSec to improve CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure.

What You'll Work On

  • Cloud infrastructure. Evolve our GCP and Kubernetes cloud architecture and setup with Terraform, improving reliability, simplicity, and cost visibility and enabling scaling to multiple availability regions.
  • CI/CD and developer experience. Speed up feedback loops, reduce flaky builds, and turn recurring support requests into self-service tooling.
  • Observability. Reduce alert noise, define meaningful SLOs, and make production issues easier to diagnose.
  • Security and automation. Partner with InfoSec on secure delivery, access controls, and guardrails for AI-assisted workflows.

You'll also join our incident-response on-call rotation during working hours and help prevent recurring issues. As we expand our servicing of public companies and jurisdictions, this on-call might evolve to compensated 24h/7 hour rotation.

You'll Thrive in This Role If You

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. These are the things that would make you an especially good fit.

  • Have strong DevOps / SRE background designing and operating cloud infrastructure and production systems
  • Have worked with Kubernetes and infrastructure as code, ideally GCP and Terraform
  • Enjoy building fast, reliable CI/CD pipelines and improving developer experience
  • Can diagnose issues across networking, infrastructure, and application code
  • Write maintainable code and bring a practical approach to observability and security
  • Value collaboration, mentorship, and thoughtful trade-offs between reliability, complexity, and cost
  • Are curious about supporting AI-assisted development safely - no AI specialism required

Experience with Node.js, MongoDB or Temporal is a plus.

Our Tech Stack

We work in TypeScript: React, Tailwind CSS, and tRPC on the front end, and tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, and Temporal on the back end. Infrastructure runs on GCP, Terraform Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, and GitHub Actions. For observability and incident response we use Grafana, Sentry, and PagerDuty.

You don't need to know all of it. We don't expect proficiency in every part of this stack. Strong infrastructure fundamentals and the ability to learn matter more than knowing every tool already.

What Your Journey Could Look Like

First 30 days:

  • Get to know Ledgy, the Platform team, and our internal users with an onboarding buddy
  • Explore our infrastructure and delivery workflows, and ship your first improvement
  • Analyze current state of our cloud infrastructure and propose meaningful enhancements

First 3 months:

  • Independently deliver improvements to CI/CD, observability, or infrastructure design
  • Share operational ownership and help reduce recurring friction for engineers
  • Contribute to architecture discussions and document what others need to operate our systems

First 6-12 months:

  • Own DevOps and SRE function and DevOps initiatives from problem definition through rollout and adoption
  • Deliver measurable improvements to developer experience, reliability, or cost
  • Help shape our platform's direction and mentor other engineers

The interview process

  • Getting to know you (45 min): Meet with someone from our people team to talk about your experience and to ask questions about the role
  • Live Coding (60 min): An equity domain problem to solve collaboratively using your preferred language and IDE. We want to see how you think, so this step does not allow AI. But you can freely look up syntax questions if you need to.
  • System Design (60 min): A system design session where you will design an architecture for a problem from the Ledgy domain using a visual tool of your choice
  • DDSA (45 min): A Deep Dive into real System Architecture that you have built, owned and monitored.
  • Culture Interview: A chance to meet one of our founders and your hiring manager for a 30-minute chat about Ledgy's mission and values
  • Offer 🎉

Being part of Ledgy means

  • Recharge and re-energize with flexible working hours, 25 days of vacation, and up to 40 days of remote work from outside your home country.
  • We make space for your own professional development, with a generous yearly learning & development budget.
  • This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. All salaries are aligned with competitively benchmarked ranges based on work location and levelling.

jobs.excerpt: About RXRoute At RXRoute, your work directly contributes to a better experience for patients, clients, and pharmacy partners.
jobs.description:
About RXRoute

At RXRoute, your work directly contributes to a better experience for patients, clients, and pharmacy partners. As a Support Agent, you’ll play an important role in keeping communication clear, resolving issues efficiently, and helping ensure patients receive the products and support they need.

This is an opportunity to join a team where attention to detail, accountability, communication, and exceptional service matter.

RXRoute Support Agent- Remote

Compensation & Schedule

  • Hourly Base Pay Range: $20- $25 per hour
  • Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Mountain Time
  • Training: Two-week training program
  • Training hours may vary and may occasionally take place outside of the regular 9:00 AM–5:00 PM MT schedule.

Note: The hourly base pay range listed above represents a good-faith estimate of the minimum and maximum target for this position. Actual compensation offered may vary depending on the candidate's geographic location, job-related skills, experience, and education.

Join Our Team

RXRoute is looking for a reliable, detail-oriented, and customer-focused Support Agent to join our team. In this role, you’ll be a key point of contact for patients, clients, and pharmacy partners, helping ensure questions are answered, issues are resolved, and orders move forward smoothly.

If you enjoy helping people, staying organized, solving problems, and working in a fast-paced environment, we’d love to hear from you.

About the Role

The RXRoute Support Agent is a frontline support position responsible for providing responsive, accurate, and professional assistance to patients, clients, and pharmacies.

You’ll manage incoming requests, follow up on outstanding issues, create replacement orders, and proactively communicate with patients when there are delays or product availability issues.

The ideal candidate is someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, pays close attention to detail, and approaches every interaction with a customer-first mindset.

What You’ll Do

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Return patient and client voicemails promptly and professionally.
  • Respond to incoming emails and support requests.
  • Create replacement orders when needed.
  • Monitor and respond to client and pharmacy tickets through the RXRoute portal.
  • Proactively contact patients when products are delayed or out of stock.
  • Track follow-ups and ensure outstanding issues are addressed in a timely manner.
  • Maintain accurate and thorough documentation of support interactions.
  • Identify and escalate issues when additional assistance is needed.
  • Follow RXRoute processes and procedures to ensure consistent and accurate support.
  • Provide a positive and professional experience to every patient, client, and pharmacy partner.

What We’re Looking For

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple tickets, priorities, and follow-ups simultaneously.
  • Comfort working with online portals, ticketing systems, and other technology.
  • The ability and willingness to quickly learn RXRoute systems and processes.
  • A customer-first attitude and a genuine desire to help others.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach to problem-solving.
  • The ability to work independently, stay organized, and take ownership of assigned tasks.
  • Reliability, professionalism, and strong follow-through.
  • Previous experience in customer support, healthcare, pharmacy, or a similar service-focused environment.

Candidates must also have the following available prior to their start date:

  • Reliable personal laptop or desktop computer (Chromebooks not accepted)
  • Quality headset suitable for high-volume calls
  • High-speed, reliable internet connection
  • Quiet, professional workspace suitable for customer conversations

Compensation & Schedule

  • Hourly Base Pay Range: $20- $25 per hour
  • Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Mountain Time
  • Training: Two-week training program
  • Training hours may vary and may occasionally take place outside of the regular 9:00 AM–5:00 PM MT schedule.

Benefits:

  • Health, Dental, and Vision benefits
  • Paid time off
  • Company holidays
  • Fully remote work
  • Career advancement opportunities within a rapidly scaling company
  • Mission-driven culture focused on impact, integrity, and teamwork

Why Join RXRoute?

At RXRoute, your work directly contributes to a better experience for patients, clients, and pharmacy partners. As a Support Agent, you’ll play an important role in keeping communication clear, resolving issues efficiently, and helping ensure patients receive the products and support they need.

This is an opportunity to join a team where attention to detail, accountability, communication, and exceptional service matter.

The Ideal Candidate

You’re someone who:

  • Takes ownership rather than waiting to be asked.
  • Communicates clearly and professionally.
  • Notices the small details that others may miss.
  • Can stay calm and organized when managing multiple requests.
  • Follows through on commitments.
  • Enjoys solving problems and finding solutions.
  • Understands that great customer service means being both responsive and proactive.

How to Apply

If you’re interested in joining RXRoute as a Support Agent, we’d love to hear from you.

Please submit your resume and a brief introduction highlighting your customer service experience and why you’re interested in the role.

jobs.title: Estágio Contábil-Financeiro [Operações]
jobs.excerpt: Sobre a Conheça nossa visão nas palavras doRonaldo, fundador e líder da empresa: [Clique para acessar o vídeo] AGIRO.
jobs.description:
Sobre a

Conheça nossa visão nas palavras doRonaldo, fundador e líder da empresa:

[Clique para acessar o vídeo]

AGIRO.TECHé uma fintech que atua como uma plataforma de originação e distribuição de crédito para correspondentes bancários, combinando tecnologia de ponta e inteligência de mercado. Somos resolvedores de problemas complexos e o nosso combustível são os desafios trazidos por nossos parceiros. Com nossa expertise de negócios, simplificamos a jornada de crédito e habilitamos novas receitas financeiras para que empresas e varejistas ofereçam crédito de forma eficiente.

Aqui todos precisam ter o conhecimento dos instrumentos que viabilizam essa engrenagem. Portanto, prepare-se para aprender a fundo como funcionam FIDCs, Securitizadoras e soluções tecnológicas para a originação e distribuição de crédito.

Nossas soluções são integradas e invisíveis: por meio de APIs robustas, nossos parceiros acoplam nossa tecnologia de intermediação diretamente nos serviços que já prestam. É aí que reside um dos nossos maiores desafios: cada parceiro possui um ambiente de sistemas diferente, com cenários técnicos particulares. Cada desafio é único, e temos enorme satisfação em arquitetar e desenvolver a solução de integração ideal.

Como pensamos (Nosso DNA)

Valorizamos quem temBRIO!

Somos uma empresa formada por NERDS apaixonados por resolver problemas complexos do mercado financeiro. Atuamos com umamentalidade de jogo infinito: não focamos em ganhar uma partida isolada, mas em permanecer no jogo, buscando desafios cada vez maiores e manter um aprendizado contínuo para ser cada dia melhor.

Na GIRO.TECH temos um ambiente realmente meritocrático, quem entrega e colabora mais, será sempre recompensado. Nosso time sênior e lideranças é majoritariamente formado por pessoas que entraram na empresa em cargos Júnior e até mesmo como estagiários. Aqui, novas vagas importantes são prioritariamente preenchidas com pessoas da casa.

Nossos processos seletivos são uma busca de futuros sócios da empresa. Para ir rápido, melhor ir sozinho. Se queremos construir algo grande, precisamos nos juntar a mais gente boa que pense como a gente. Dedicamos muito tempo nos processos seletivos para achar essas pessoas e entregamos desafios constantes para promover crescimento. Temos hoje comosócios da empresa, muitas pessoas que começaram em posições de base e mostraram que têm vontade de ser mais.

Fundadores - nossa base

Uma empresa é a extensão dos valores e sonhos de seus sócios fundadores. A GIRO.TECH foi fundada por quatro sócios, que têm como primeira formação a tecnologia, e são apaixonados por servir os outros usando seu conhecimento e por resolver problemas complexos.


Isso é GIRO.TECH

  • Liderança e Mentoria:aqui não temos "chefes", mas líderes que caminham lado a lado, incentivam e ensinam.
  • Voz Ativa:a melhor ideia prevalece, não o maior cargo. Oferecemos espaço para testar, errar e aprender.
  • Liberdade e Responsabilidade:valorizamos o trabalho remoto e a autonomia. Você tem liberdade para trabalhar de onde preferir e vestir o que for mais confortável; em troca, esperamos responsabilidade total com as entregas.
  • Crescimento Interno:priorizamos nosso time para ocupar novas vagas e posições mais desafiadoras. Temos muitas pessoas que iniciaram como estagiários e hoje evoluíram para o nível sênior, alguns, inclusive, passaram a ser sócios da empresa.
  • Excelência Técnica:nossa principal estratégia comercial é possuir a melhor tecnologia e um produto de alta performance. O resultado é a satisfação dos nossos clientes, que nos avaliam constantemente com notas acima de 9.

Isso NÃO é GIRO.TECH

  • Não somos uma instituição financeira tradicional de "terno e colete puffer".
  • Não valorizamos hierarquias rígidas ou burocracias excessivas para tomada de decisão.
  • Não somos os donos da verdade; somosinquietos, curiosos e abertos a mudanças.

Perfil que buscamos

Buscamos pessoas capazes de se adaptar a cenários dinâmicos e com sede de conhecimento. Valorizamos ainquietude: a busca constante por evoluir processos e construir resultados melhores a cada dia.

Se você é apaixonado por solucionar problemas com excelência, busca desafios que te tirem da zona de conforto e nunca está satisfeito com o mediano, seu lugar é aqui.

Vem construir o futuro da tecnologia de crédito com a gente!



Sobre a vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a)estagiário(a) contábil-financeiro. NaGIRO.TECH, a contabilidade não é apenas burocracia; é a base de dados que sustenta nossas operações complexas de crédito.

﻿Se você é um "nerd dos números", apaixonado por entender como demonstrações contábeis refletem a saúde de uma operação financeira e possui umamentalidade de jogo infinito, queremos você no nosso time para nos ajudar a manter a fluidez e a precisão da nossa infraestrutura.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesta cadeira, você será responsável por garantir que a engrenagem financeira gire sem atritos. Suas principais missões serão:

  • Oferecer um excelente atendimento aos nossos clientes;
  • Oferecer um atendimento consultivo e resolutivo aos nossos clientes, sanando dúvidas e mediando conflitos com parceiros e fornecedores.
  • Realizar a importação de operações de crédito no sistema e gerir a venda desses ativos para os fundos vinculados;
  • Apoiar na gestão das rotinas do setor (securitização e financiamentos), garantindo que os números reflitam a realidade estratégica do negócio.
  • Executar rotinas de contas a pagar/receber, conciliação financeira e funções administrativas com precisão e atenção.
  • Elaborar relatórios mensais e pontuais com base nos dados da área e dados dos clientes.
  • Como estamos em constante mudança e crescimento, esperamos que você se adapte rapidamente a novos cenários e ajude a evoluir nossos processos internos, propondo melhorias para ganhar eficiência.

O que buscamos (requisitos):


  • Formação:cursando Ciências Contábeis ou Administração.
  • Residência:vaga preferencial para candidatos de Curitiba e região.
  • Experiência:vivência anterior em rotinas contábeis/financeiras.
  • Ferramentas:conhecimento de Excel/Google Planilhas (essencial), Google Drive e ferramentas de colaboração como Notion.
  • Organização e Adaptabilidade:A essência da nossa operação é o processo. Procuramos um perfil que valorize a rotina e a estabilidade das tarefas diárias, executando-as com excelência. É fundamental ter sede de conhecimento para entender o "porquê" de cada etapa e poder identificar oportunidades de melhoria, mantendo a flexibilidade para se adaptar a mudanças de cenário quando necessário.

Informações adicionais

Remuneração e benefícios (nosso ecossistema):

  • Remuneração: R$ 1.300,00
  • Caju (Cartão Flexível): R$ 879,00
  • Saúde Integral (Keiken): R$ 100,00 exclusivos para saúde física (academia) e mental (psicologia).
  • Saúde física e mental: acesso à plataforma Wellhub.
  • Crescimento:Auxílio financeiro para cursos de especialização em bancarização e assuntos relacionados.

Cultura e Liberdade:

  • Remote First:trabalhe de onde quiser.
  • Sem Dress Code:vista-se como for mais confortável.
  • Day Off:um dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário para celebrar.
  • Horário Semi-flexível

Multi-Property | Remote – United States

About the Role: We are looking for an experienced, highly organized and commercially minded Revenue Manager to oversee revenue-management execution across a multi-property hotel portfolio.
This is a hands-on, execution-focused role for someone who understands that great Revenue Management is about more than reporting numbers. It’s about making the right pricing and inventory decisions every day and ensuring those decisions are executed. The Revenue Manager will work closely with General Managers, Assistant General Managers and Sales teams to maximize hotel performance through strategic pricing, yielding, inventory management, forecasting and accountability. The ideal candidate can look at the numbers, understand the story, make the recommendations and confidently lead the team through the action plan.

What You’ll Own

Daily Revenue Management

  • Monitor daily occupancy, pickup, ADR, RevPAR, pace and demand.
  • Make daily pricing and yielding decisions.
  • Manage inventory, availability, restrictions and selling strategies.
  • Monitor OOO rooms and their impact on sellable inventory.
  • Monitor third-party channels and distressed inventory opportunities.
  • Monitor competitive pricing and market conditions.
  • Identify need periods and high-demand dates.
  • Proactively adjust strategy based on booking pace and market demand.
  • Ensure pricing and inventory strategies are accurately executed across systems.

Revenue Strategy Calls

  • Lead recurring revenue strategy calls with GMs, AGMs and Sales leaders.
  • Prepare and distribute meeting agendas and supporting information.
  • Review current-week and forward-looking performance.
  • Evaluate pickup, pace, pricing, inventory and demand.
  • Review upcoming high-demand dates and need periods.
  • Review group blocks and future inventory.
  • Establish clear action items and ownership.
  • Send concise post-call recaps.
  • Follow up to ensure strategies are executed.

Forecasting & Analysis

  • Maintain accurate short- and long-term forecasts.
  • Analyze historical performance, booking pace, pickup and market demand.
  • Review actual performance against budget, forecast and prior year.
  • Analyze ADR, occupancy, RevPAR and market-share performance.
  • Utilize STR and competitive-set information.
  • Identify performance opportunities and risks.
  • Communicate the “why” behind performance — not simply the numbers.
  • Make clear recommendations to improve hotel results.

Group & Sales Strategy

  • Partner closely with Sales on group opportunities.
  • Evaluate group rates and inventory requirements.
  • Analyze displacement and opportunity cost.
  • Review group pickup, wash and cut-off dates.
  • Review 30/60/90-day group holdings.
  • Identify potential inventory risks and opportunities.
  • Help Sales teams make commercially sound pricing decisions.
  • Balance group demand with transient demand.

Systems & Execution

  • Manage rate loading, restrictions, inventory controls and other revenue-related system functions.
  • Ensure accurate implementation of revenue strategies.
  • Maintain rate integrity and parity.
  • Monitor distribution channels.
  • Troubleshoot revenue-system issues.
  • Work with brand and technology partners as needed.
  • Ensure property teams understand and execute revenue decisions.

What We’re Looking For

Required:

  • Previous hotel/hospitality Revenue Management experience.
  • Hands-on experience with hotel pricing, yielding and inventory management.
  • Experience making daily pricing decisions.
  • Strong forecasting and analytical skills.
  • Experience leading or participating in revenue strategy meetings.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple properties/priorities.
  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Must be located in the United States.

Strongly Preferred:

  • Hilton, Marriott and/or IHG experience.
  • Multi-property or cluster Revenue Management experience.
  • STR experience.
  • Experience with hotel revenue-management systems.
  • Experience working directly with hotel GMs and Sales teams.
  • Experience with both transient and group revenue strategy.

The Right Person for This Role

You are someone who:

  • Executes:You don’t just recommend a strategy, you make sure it gets done.
  • Thinks commercially:You understand the balance between occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, group business, transient demand and long-term opportunity.
  • Makes decisions:You are comfortable making pricing recommendations based on the available information and adjusting as conditions change.
  • Communicates clearly:You can explain a revenue decision to a GM or Sales leader without burying them in revenue-management jargon.
  • Holds people accountable:You send the recap, track action items and follow up.
  • Knows hotels:You understand how Sales, Operations, Groups, Front Desk, Reservations and Revenue Management all connect.

Success in this role means our hotels:

  • Are priced appropriately every day.
  • Are actively yielding rather than reacting.
  • Have the right inventory available at the right time.
  • Have clear strategies for the current week and future periods.
  • Are effectively managing group blocks and future inventory.

jobs.title: Partner Marketing Data and Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: Parallels has an immediate vacancy for this role.
jobs.description:
Parallels has an immediate vacancy for this role.

This role sits in our Partner Marketing team and owns the operational side of the partner programme from start to finish: Salesforce reporting, campaign data, MDF, the partner portal, and the training and enablement content our partners rely on. You’ll be the person who keeps all of it running, knows where every number comes from, and turns partner data into insight the team can actually act on. It’s a hands-on role with real ownership, so you’ll need to be highly organised and comfortable running several projects at once.

The top creative and technical minds could work anywhere.So why are so many of them choosing Parallels? Here are three reasons:

  1. This is the moment.It’s an exciting time at Parallels, with strong leadership, a refreshed brand, and a whole new approach to changing the way the world works. We’re at the forefront of a movement, and we want you to ride this wave with us.
  2. We want you to be you.Too often, companies tell you about their culture and then expect you to fit it. Our culture is built from the people who work here. We want you to feel safe to be who you are, take risks, and show us what you’ve got.
  3. It’s your world.We know you have a life. We want to be part of it, but not all of it. At Parallels, we’re serious about empowering people to work when, how, and where they want. Couch? Sweatpants? Cool with us. We believe that happy employees mean happy customers. That’s why we hire amazing people and get out of their way.

As a Marketing Data and Ops Manager you will:

  • Salesforce Reporting & Analytics
    • Own Salesforce reporting for Partner Marketing, designing, building and maintaining the dashboards and reports the team runs on
    • Pull, analyse and interpret partner data from Salesforce and the partner portal, and turn it into clear, actionable insight
    • Track and report on partner engagement, campaign performance and pipeline contribution, including regular MDF performance reporting by region
  • Campaign Data & Operations
    • Own campaign setup and data in Salesforce, making sure it’s accurate, complete and lined up with the Partner Marketing plan
    • Keep spreadsheets, Salesforce fields and trackers up to date
    • Work alongside Partner Marketing Managers to plan, run and measure campaigns
  • MDF Programme Management
    • Own the MDF budget programme end to end, from claim submission through to financial reconciliation
    • Manage MDF-related leads and make sure proof of performance is collected and reviewed on time
    • Be the go-to person for MDF queries, keeping everything accurate and compliant
  • Partner Portal Management
    • Own the day-to-day running of the partner portal, keeping content, data and partner records accurate and current
    • Own the setup of deals, MDF and training within the portal, and work with DevOps on CRM sync and integration
    • Be the first point of contact for portal queries, troubleshooting issues and working with internal teams to get them fixed
    • Manage partner access and profiles across all partner tiers
  • Training & Enablement Content
    • Load, organise and maintain partner training and enablement material in the portal, including courses, learning paths and certifications.
    • Work with Partner Marketing, Product Marketing and Sales Enablement to get new and updated content live on time
  • Data Platform Sync & Integration
    • Manage back-end data syncing between Salesforce, the partner portal and our other marketing and BI tools
    • Spot and resolve data discrepancies between systems so partner and campaign data stays consistent and reliable
    • Work with Sales Operations and IT to maintain and improve data integration workflows
    • Document data processes and sync logic so the team always knows how things work

What YOUBring to the Team:

  • 3+ years in marketing operations, channel or partner marketing operations, or marketing analytics, ideally in B2B software
  • Strong hands-on Salesforce experience, including building reports and dashboards from scratch
  • Experience managing a partner portal or PRM platform (Impartner or similar), including loading training and enablement content
  • Hands-on experience managing budgets and MD, including claims and reconciliation
  • Exceptional project management and organisational skills. You can run several things at once, hit your deadlines and still keep on top of the detail
  • Very confident in Excel and comfortable working with data across different systems
  • A problem solver who notices when the numbers don’t add up and gets to the bottom of it
  • A clear communicator who’s happy working with Sales, Marketing, Finance, IT and our partners
  • Someone who takes ownership and doesn’t wait to be told what to do next

US:

  • We have millions of users and decades of innovation under our belts.
  • We offer a fully remote workspace. There is no pressure to work in an office whatsoever.
  • Hours are flexible, too! You’ve worked hard to build your life, and we don’t want you to give it up for work.
  • Our team is growing fast, and there’s a tonof energy and a lot of really smart, motivated, fun people ready to welcome you in.

What are you waiting for? Apply now! We can’t wait to meet you.

(FYI, we’re lucky to have a lot of interest and we soappreciate your application, though please note that we’ll only contact you if you’ve been selected for an interview.)

About Parallels

Parallels is a top VDI/EUC product helping businesses since 1999. Whether it’s desktop or cloud, on-prem or hybrid, Parallels has a solution to help your company optimize the speed and security of your work environment at an affordable price.

Sr. Corporate Counsel, Product and Compliance

Parallels has an immediate vacancy for this role.

Push the boundaries of tech. In your sweatpants.

Parallels is seeking an experienced Product and Compliance Counsel to serve as a trusted legal partner to our Product and Engineering teams for a portfolio of Parallels software products. This role will provide practical, risk-calibrated guidance across product development, AI governance, privacy, security, intellectual property, and regulatory compliance, helping the business innovate responsibly while supporting its product and commercial objectives.

The top creative and technical minds could work anywhere.So why are so many of them choosing Parallels? Here are three reasons:

  1. This is the moment.It’s an exciting time at Parallels, with strong leadership, a refreshed brand, and a whole new approach to changing the way the world works. We’re at the forefront of a movement, and we want you to ride this wave with us.
  2. We want you to be you.Too often, companies tell you about their culture and then expect you to fit it. Our culture is built from the people who work here. We want you to feel safe to be who you are, take risks, and show us what you’ve got.
  3. It’s your world.We know you have a life. We want to be part of it, but not all of it. At Parallels, we’re serious about empowering people to work when, how, and where they want. Couch? Sweatpants? Cool with us. We believe that happy employees mean happy customers. That’s why we hire amazing people and get out of their way.

Sound good so far? Awesome. Let’s talk more about the Sr. Corporate Counsel role and see if we’re destined to be together.

As a Senior Corporate Counsel, you will:

  • Serve as embedded compliance and product counsel partnering with Product and Engineering teams early in development —during roadmap, design, and testing—to identify legal, regulatory, privacy, IP, and customer trust considerations before they become launch blockers. In addition, you will provide practical, risk-calibrated recommendations that give Product and Engineering clear paths forward.
  • Create and operate legal and compliance review processes for software products and AI features, ensuring that privacy, security, regulatory, intellectual property, and customer trust considerations are addressed throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Translate evolving AI, privacy, consumer protection, IP, and regulatory requirements into product criteria, required third-party certifications, and monitoring obligations.
  • Advise Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders on global trade and export control compliance requirements, including sanctions and export classification, translating legal requirements into practical product and operational guidance
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and leadership teams to identify, evaluate, and protect innovations through patents and other intellectual property rights, serving as a liaison to outside counsel and helping shape and scale the company's patent and invention disclosure program.
  • Act as a senior legal advisor on privacy-sensitive product design, data use, retention and deletion, cross-border data flows, data protection agreements, security commitments, and privacy documentation.
  • Advise cross-functional stakeholders during security incidents, audits, customer escalations and compliance reviews, helping the business assess legal and operational risks and align product behavior with contractual and regulatory commitments.
  • Advise Product and Engineering on copyright, trademark, patent, open-source, licensing, data rights, and other IP issues arising from software development and AI systems.
  • Support customer-facing and commercial matters when product, AI, regulatory, privacy, data, IP, or security questions affect a deal, renewal, expansion, or strategic partnership.
  • Participate in selected customer and prospect conversations as a subject matter expert.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate customer, partner and vendor agreements, particularly where product, AI, privacy, security, intellectual property, or compliance issues are involved.
  • Collaborate closely with a small, agile global legal team to provide practical, coordinated support across the business.

What YOU bring to the team:

  • JD from an accredited law school and active bar membership, with substantial legal experience spanning a leading law firm and high-growth technology company. 8+ years of legal experience preferred with at least 5 of those in-house.
  • Deep experience in at least one of the following: software licensing, security, or privacy/data protection.
  • Familiarity with export control, sanctions, and trade compliance considerations relevant to global software products, cloud services, and international product distribution.
  • Experience advising on intellectual property strategy, including patents, invention disclosure programs, open-source software, licensing, trademarks, copyrights, and technology commercialization.
  • Demonstrated ability to advise on complex, ambiguous matters involving product design, data, emerging AI legislation, intellectual property, security, open source software, and practical commercial risk.
  • Experience building or improving scalable legal programs, including governance frameworks, review processes, playbooks, templates, decision tools, training, or knowledge systems.
  • Ability to translate technical, legal, and regulatory complexity into clear practical guidance.
  • Consistently strong judgment with the ability to balance legal risk, customer trust, product usability, delivery timelines, and company goals; identify difficult decisions; and escalate appropriately.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex issues clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Solid technical understanding of software licensing, open source software, AI, a challenger approach to the future of legal work, paired with critical thinking, consideration of business context, and ability to find practical solutions.

US:

  • Parallels features award-winning solutions that have helped millions of users for 40 years (can you believe it?!).
  • We have millions of users and decades of innovation under our belts.
  • We offer a fully remote workspace. There is no pressure to work in an office whatsoever.
  • Hours are flexible, too! You’ve worked hard to build your life, and we don’t want you to give it up for work.
  • Our team is growing fast, and there’s a tonof energy and a lot of really smart, motivated, fun people ready to welcome you in.

What are you waiting for? Apply now! We can’t wait to meet you.

(FYI, we’re lucky to have a lot of interest and we soappreciate your application, though please note that we’ll only contact you if you’ve been selected for an interview.)

Our products enable millions of connected knowledge workers around the world to do great work faster. Our success is driven by an unwavering commitment to deliver a broad portfolio of innovative applications – including Parallels RAS, Parallels Desktop Enterprise, and Parallels DaaS, among others.
