Be Part of Something Eternal

Nearly 2 billion Muslims have never heard the saving message of Jesus Christ. At Frontiers, we believe God is calling His Church to change that. We partner with local churches to send workers to the Muslim world—workers who make disciples and plant churches where the Gospel has never been heard.

If you’re passionate about mobilizing the Church for global mission and equipping leaders to fulfill the Great Commission, this role is for you.

Coaching. Support. Shepherd.

As a Pastoral Coach, you’ll come alongside field workers serving around the world, providing spiritual encouragement, prayer, coaching, and relational support so they can thrive in their walk with Jesus and remain effective in their ministry. If you have a heart for missions, a passion for caring for others, and a desire to invest in the wellbeing of cross-cultural workers, this is an opportunity to make a lasting Kingdom impact.

At Frontiers, we believe God is calling His Church to bring the Gospel to the least-reached Muslim peoples. Our field workers serve in some of the most challenging and spiritually significant places on earth. Through intentional relationships, pastoral care, and Christ-centered coaching, the Barnabas Team helps sustain and strengthen those on the front lines of ministry. As a Pastoral Coach, you will play a vital role in encouraging, equipping, and caring for workers as they faithfully pursue God's calling among the nations.

About the Role

As a Pastoral Coach, you will:

  • Seek to develop and maintain active relationships with field workers and their teams.
  • Read newsletters and email updates from selected Frontiers field workers to keep track of their status and general wellbeing.
  • Seek to debrief field workers upon their home assignment and follow up as necessary.
  • When workers return from the field in transition or in another type of extended field leave, provide pastoral leadership and accountability as needed.
  • Establish a rhythm of prayer and spiritual support encouraging field workers to thrive in their relationship with Jesus.
  • Initiate relationships with workers at every opportunity. Seek to be available for encouragement, coaching, counseling and prayer.
  • Raise 100% of your financial support (salary, benefits, ministry expenses)

What We’re Looking For

  • A personal relationship with Jesus Christ and a heart for missions
  • Previous missions experience either 2-3 years living overseas or extensive interaction with field workers.
  • Heart for missions, cross cultural workers, Muslims and pastoring others.
  • Ability to travel 2-3 times per year and willing to raise funds as needed for coaching trips and IC.
  • Pastoral or Life Coaching experience preferred.
  • A track record of being sought by people for pastoring, especially by field workers.
  • Ability to travel occasionally and raise personal support
  • Spiritual gifts in leadership, encouragement, and teaching
  • Ability to raise and maintain personal support

Why Join Frontiers?

When you join Frontiers, you become part of a grace-filled, mission-driven community that:

  • Prioritizes the least-reached– We focus on Muslim peoples with no sustainable Gospel witness.
  • Catalyzes movements– Everything we do contributes to planting healthy, reproducing churches.
  • Empowers teams– Our teams serve with a common vision and freedom to pursue locally appropriate strategies.
  • Values lifelong learning– We are dedicated to coaching, mentoring, and continuous growth.
  • Operates with integrity– Decisions are made by those closest to the action, ensuring effectiveness and accountability.
  • Work-Life culture– We encourage healthy rhythms, flexibility, and margin so team members can sustainably pursue their calling, invest deeply in relationships, and serve with excellence—both in the work and in the mission beyond it.

Zenrows is the web data infrastructure for AI. Founded in 2021, we give developers, AI agents and businesses one reliable way to access, extract and structure data from any website, at any scale, however hard the site tries to block them.

Whether it’s an agent that needs fresh web context mid-task, an LLM application grounded in live data, or an enterprise pipeline pulling millions of pages a day, Zenrows handles the rendering, the anti-bot defences and the parsing behind a single API, 10B+ requests a month. Teams at more than 10,000 companies, including Microsoft, Amazon, Dell, IBM, Slack, eBay, EY, Nokia and Clay, rely on Zenrows to turn the web into a reliable source of data for their products, workflows and AI-driven applications, across e-commerce, finance, real estate and AI.

As we continue our expansion, we are now looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join us on a permanent basis and make an instant impact, working directly with the CEO and CTO.

The Role

AI runs on web data, and more and more of the work that needs it is done by AI agents. Zenrows is how they get it. Fetch gets any page past the toughest anti-bot systems. Extract turns it into clean, structured data. Batch and Crawl do it across whole websites.

We’re also changing how software gets built. Our engineers already write 100% of their code with agents. We are moving more and more operational workflows from manual, to automated, to autonomous, trusting agents with real work in production. Very few teams are doing this for real. We are, and we want you to help lead it.



What You’ll Do

  • You’ll own a customer-facing product end to end: what it does, how it runs, and the business number it moves. There are no product managers here. You talk to customers, decide what to build, build it with your agents, ship it, and own it.
  • The problems are real. Our systems run on thousands of CPU cores, handle millions of requests a day, and stay ahead of anti-bot systems built by companies many times our size. You’ll design systems that hold up under that load. You’ll also build the tests, evals and guardrails that tell us when an agent’s work can be trusted.
  • As a Staff Engineer, you’ll shape how the whole company works with agents. When one team finds a better way of working, you’ll help turn it into the standard for everyone.
  • Your days aren’t prescribed. You’ll look across the company, find where you can add the most value and go after it.

What We're Looking For

  • You’ve built high-load, complex production systems and you’ve set the technical direction that other engineers followed.
  • You put product first. You talk about customers and business impact before code, and you can say clearly what your work changed for the business.
  • You’re all in on AI-native engineering. You build with agents every day, and you know how to verify, test and take ownership of what they produce. Bonus points if you’ve built and shipped products that use LLMs or agents in production.
  • You write clearly. We’re remote and our agents work from written context, so a good spec or decision record is worth as much as good code.
  • You’re comfortable working with non-technical people. You can sit down with sales, GTM or operations colleagues, understand their problems and turn them into something that ships, no translator needed.
  • You take ownership without being asked. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, happy to experiment, fail and argue for ideas, and you think like a co-founder.
  • You pick the tool that serves the customer. Today that’s mostly Go, AWS, and Terraform, and you are open to learn new languages and tools quickly.
  • A love of hands-on work. You’ll still champion collaboration via knowledge-sharing sessions, kickoffs, and cross-team reviews, but this is an IC role at its heart, focused on building and influence.
  • Availability to work EMEA hours, as our team collaborates across European time zones.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Our people crave ownership and opportunity over everything else. We offer responsibility and scope to do things in your role that you can only dream of in similar roles in larger companies.
  • We have a CEO who values world class talent over everything else. Trust and respect is earned and with it comes reward and recognition like nowhere else.
  • In a world where it feels like everyone is being called back being in an office, we operate a truly 100% remote approach that allows you to work from anywhere you choose.
  • Forget Agile, Scrum, Lean... or whatever development methodology is trendy this week. We give you a horizontal view that enables you to identify where you think you can contribute the most.
  • We have fun! The above may sound like we are all about work but we put a lot of focus on ensuring our culture is one that our people enjoy, lets you build lasting friendships and grow both personally and professionally.

Why You Might Not Fit

  • We are a small yet efficient team of 20, and our competitors are 10x our size. We manage to outperform them because everyone takes ownership of their work, holds themselves accountable and focuses on delivering meaningful outcomes. If you’re just looking for a job rather than a mission then you probably shouldn’t apply.
  • We are an agentic company, and agents are an essential part of how every team works. If you aren’t excited to build, delegate to and take ownership of AI agents in your day to day, then you probably shouldn’t apply.
  • We work 100% remotely and give our people the freedom to work wherever they choose. To offset this there is naturally more need to document and update workflows than in other companies. If you hate documenting then you probably shouldn’t apply.
  • Feedback is how we better ourselves every day and we foster a culture that encourages everyone to have a voice. If you don’t like being surrounded by world class talent that will always express strong opinions then you probably shouldn’t apply
  • We are a start-up and know the growth journey holds plenty of lessons to learn. If you are looking for the perfect organization, flawless processes and predictability in your day to day then you probably shouldn’t apply.

Our Rewards And Benefits

  • 100% remote work: We are a company that offers true freedom. Work wherever life takes you.
  • The salary you are worth: We never ask people what they are earning but instead what you are looking for. If your ability and experience justifies it and we think you are going to help us succeed then we will match your expectations.
  • The equipment you want: We believe in giving our people the tools they need to succeed and don’t have a default machine to give you.
  • Generous Learning & Development budget: We believe in always adding value to our top performers and helping them grow their skills in a direction that is beneficial both to them and the business
  • All Star Awards: We recognize achievements in many ways within the business but the bi-annual All star rewards allows the CEO to tailor reward packages to the person. Whether this is a holiday destination of choice, a learning course that adds value or something else.. We believe in getting to know every employee personally.
  • Charity Initiatives: We are a business that believes in giving back to the community and every year allows our employees the opportunity to give back.
  • Annual Kick-Off: We want our employees to see where Zenrows was born and enjoy all the Pinxos they can handle.
  • Share in Our Success: We want our top performers to be part of the company's success and offer opportunities for stock option allocation when people show their value.
  • Deel Benefits: As a fully remote organization we employ our people via Deel. This not only brings freedom of location but also a host of other benefits including discounts on VPNs, memberships and services.

Values

We are proud of our uniquely agile, fast paced, and autonomous environment. Our core values of Ownership, Dedication, Impact, Transparency and Agility run through everyone who works for us, and everything we do.

We are a sociable company and don’t let a fully remote model stop us from feeling connected to the place we work and the people that we work with. The atmosphere across the business is friendly and supportive, with a constant desire to improve in everything we do!

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Here at Zenrows we are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion but recognise that we can always do more. Every job description is subject to scrutiny through a gender bias decoder ensuring our roles are as inclusive and attractive as possible. Our culture is one that aims to nurture a welcoming and safe working environment for everyone with initiatives that embrace our globally diverse family. We are committed to protecting the mental health of our employees and aim to create a great place to work, whoever you are and wherever in the world you work from.

Privacy and Your Data

At Zenrows, we prioritize the privacy and security of data entrusted to us. We are committed to complying with all applicable data protection regulations and industry best practices. As part of our team, you will contribute to creating and maintaining systems that uphold the highest standards of data integrity, confidentiality, and transparency. Your role will help ensure that we continue to protect sensitive information, foster trust with our customers, and support a privacy-first culture across our organization.

Any job offer that we may make to you will be subject to you successfully passing background checks.

jobs.description:
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Managing Director, Forward Deployed Engineering - REMOTE to join our team in Plano, Texas (US-TX), United States (US).

Position Summary

NTT DATA is building a new Forward Deployed Engineering capability to accelerate AI Service-as-Software, one of the company's key strategic growth bets. We are seeking an Executive, Head of Forward Deployed Engineering to build and lead this function globally.

This leader will create the field execution engine that brings AI products into strategic client environments. The role will deploy high-caliber technical teams to shape, prototype, validate, and scale AI solutions, while converting client learning into reusable product and platform patterns.

This is not a traditional delivery, solution architecture, or technical pre-sales role. It is an executive technical leadership role focused on connecting client demand, AI product strategy, and product engineering to help NTT DATA move from bespoke AI services toward repeatable, platform-led AI Native growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and lead a high-impact Forward Deployed Engineering team of up to 20 engineers, combining AI engineering, solution architecture, industry/domain expertise, and client-facing technical credibility.
  • Define the Forward Deployed Engineering operating model, including engagement rules, delivery standards, escalation paths, handoff models, and interfaces with product, engineering, sales, industry, and delivery teams.
  • Deploy FDE teams into priority client and industry opportunities to shape AI solution hypotheses, prototypes, MVPs, pilots, and production deployments.
  • Partner closely with the Executive, AI Solutions Product Leader to translate field learning into product roadmap recommendations, reusable platform capabilities, and productization opportunities.
  • Work with Product Engineering to move validated field solutions into scalable, secure, enterprise-ready product capabilities.
  • Support strategic pursuits and executive client conversations by providing technical credibility, solution clarity, demos, prototypes, and deployment plans.
  • Establish reusable deployment patterns, reference architectures, templates, integration assets, and solution playbooks to reduce bespoke delivery and improve speed to value.
  • Promote a 70% standardized / 30% configurable model for AI Service-as-Software offerings to improve repeatability, scalability, and margin potential.
  • Recommend FDE deployment priorities based on client demand, strategic value, product learning potential, technical feasibility, and commercial relevance.
  • Track field impact through metrics such as deployment quality, time to prototype, time to client value, reusable patterns created, productization candidates identified, client feedback, deployment repeatability, and team health.

Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in engineering, field engineering, solution architecture, enterprise platforms, AI/data products, product engineering, or technical delivery leadership.
  • Experience leading technical teams at scale, ideally 15-30 engineers or equivalent.
  • Strong technical fluency across AI, GenAI, agentic workflows, data platforms, cloud architecture, APIs, integrations, enterprise applications, and software delivery.
  • Proven ability to work directly with senior client, business, and technology stakeholders in complex enterprise environments.
  • Experience translating ambiguous business problems into practical, deployable technical solutions.
  • Strong understanding of how field-built solutions can become scalable product capabilities.
  • Experience working across product, engineering, sales, delivery, architecture, security, and client teams.
  • Ability to build new operating models, delivery standards, team structures, and execution rhythms in a scaling environment.
  • Executive presence and ability to influence across a global, matrixed organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Forward Deployed Engineering, field engineering, solutions engineering, platform engineering, technical product leadership, or enterprise AI delivery.
  • Experience in a global systems integration, consulting, enterprise software, SaaS, cloud, or AI platform environment.
  • Experience with Service-as-Software, productized services, or platform-led delivery models.
  • Experience building repeatable deployment patterns from client-specific implementations.
  • Experience partnering with product and engineering leaders to convert field learning into roadmap priorities and scalable product capabilities.

Success Measures

  • Establishment of a high-performing Forward Deployed Engineering function.
  • Quality and speed of AI deployments in strategic client environments.
  • Strength of the feedback loop from field deployments into product and platform roadmaps.
  • Number and quality of reusable patterns, accelerators, and productization candidates generated.
  • Improved deployment repeatability and reduced bespoke implementation effort.
  • Effectiveness of partnership with AI Solutions Product, Product Engineering, AI Vista, AI Market Makers, industry, sales, and delivery teams.
  • Contribution to strategic pursuits, client confidence, and commercialization readiness.
  • Technical quality, reliability, and enterprise readiness of field-deployed solutions.
  • Health, retention, and development of the FDE team.

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to build a new executive-level technical field capability at the center of NTT DATA's AI strategy.

You will lead the team that makes AI Service-as-Software real in client environments, proves value quickly, and turns field learning into scalable product advantage. You will work alongside product and engineering executives to help the company move from bespoke AI delivery toward repeatable, platform-led AI Native growth.

You will not simply lead implementation. You will build the field engineering system that connects client demand, AI product strategy, and scalable product engineering.

About NTT DATA

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. Acronis is a global leader in cyber protection, delivering AI-powered protection for productive MSPs in a single, natively integrated platform that unifies operations management, cybersecurity, and data protection. Driven by our mission to protect, manage and automate every workload, we’ve built the industry’s only all-in-one solution.

In this role, you will be responsible for building and nurturing strategic relationships with OEMs, integrators, and end customers to expand our market presence. As a senior individual contributor, you will focus on identifying opportunities, enabling partners, and driving sales of our innovative cybersecurity solutions tailored for industrial environments. Every member of our “A-Team” has an instrumental role and impact on the success of Acronis’ business, so we are looking for a highly-motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced and high-volume, work environment.

The ideal candidate for this position will not only possess the skills and experience required but will also possess a positive attitude and ability to solve complex problems and work in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment. And just like every position at Acronis, the ideal candidate will embody all of our company values: responsive, alert, detail-oriented, makes decisions, and never gives up

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Revenue Generation: Drive sales growth by actively engaging with partners and end customers in complex industrial environments, ensuring sales targets are consistently met or exceeded.
  • Channel Development: Establish and manage relationships with key channel partners, with heavy focus on the industrial automation channel including ICS manufacturers and their control system integrator channel.
  • Sales Enablement: Provide partners with the training, tools, and resources they need to effectively position and sell our industrial cybersecurity solutions.
  • Strategic Planning: Collaborate with partners to develop joint business plans, set revenue targets, and identify new market opportunities.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams, including product management, marketing, and engineering, to align solutions with customer and partner needs.
  • Metrics and Reporting: Monitor and report on key performance indicators, such as partner sales pipeline, revenue contributions, and program effectiveness.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Experience: 5+ years in channel sales, business development, or a related role, preferably in the industrial cybersecurity or technology sector.
  • Proven experience in a cyber security company demonstrating a strong understanding of industry practices and protocols is required.
  • Industry Knowledge: Deep understanding of industrial cybersecurity, including key technologies, market challenges, and regulatory requirements (e.g., NIST, IEC 62443).
  • Sales Skills: Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets through channel strategies.
  • Relationship Management: Strong ability to develop and maintain long-term professional relationships with partners and customers.
  • Technical Acumen: Familiarity with cybersecurity solutions, OT/IT convergence, and industrial control systems (ICS).
  • Communication: Excellent presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or equivalent preferred

WHO WE ARE

Acronis is revolutionizing cyber protection by unifying backup, disaster recovery, storage, next-generation anti-malware, and protection management into one solution. This all-in-one integration removes the complexity and risks associated with non-integrated solutions and offers easy, complete and reliable data protection for all workloads, applications, and systems across any environment—all at a low and predictable cost.

Its solutions are trusted by more than 5.5 million home users and 500,000 companies, and top-tier professional sports teams. Acronis products are available through over 50,000 partners and service providers in over 150 countries and 26 languages.

Our corporate culture is focused on making a positive impact on the lives of each employee and the communities in which we live. Mutual trust, respect, personal achievement, individual leadership, and a belief that we can contribute to the world everyday are the cornerstones of the Acronis Team.

Acronis is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, medical condition, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process.

Use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during live interviews may be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process and a full criminal, education and identification background check is required for all new hires.

jobs.excerpt: Simulmedia is looking for an experienced and dynamic Data Engineer with a curious and creative mindset to join our Data Services team.
jobs.description:
Simulmedia is looking for an experienced and dynamic Data Engineer with a curious and creative mindset to join our Data Services team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Python, SQL and large-scale data pipelines. This is an opportunity to join a team of amazing engineers, data scientists, product managers and designers who are obsessed with building the most advanced TV and streaming advertising platform in the market. As a Data Engineer you will design, build and operate the data platform that powers the company: pipelines that ingest and transform very large datasets from external data partners, data models that the whole company queries, and services that make that data available to internal products. You will work on a team that empowers the other teams to use our huge amount of data efficiently. Using a large variety of technologies and tools, you will solve complicated technical problems and build solutions to make our pipelines robust and fault tolerant and our data easily accessible throughout the company.

Location: Ukraine is mandatory. Our offices are located in Kyiv and Lviv. Teams are located in Kyiv and Lviv and primarily work remotely with occasional offline meetings.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and build batch data pipelines that ingest, validate and transform multi-billion-row datasets from external data providers and internal systems
  • Model complex real-world data: dimensional models, reference data, and temporal data whose attributes change over time (e.g. slowly changing dimensions), and evolve those models safely as upstream sources change their schemas and semantics
  • Develop and operate workloads on our lakehouse platform (Databricks / Spark / Delta) and our data warehouse (Redshift), including migrating existing pipelines from the warehouse to the lakehouse
  • Orchestrate pipelines with Airflow: scheduling, dependencies, retries, backfills and alerting
  • Prove correctness, not just completion: design parity checks and reconciliation queries when replacing an existing pipeline, run large historical backfills, and investigate data discrepancies down to the row level
  • Build and maintain Python services and REST APIs that serve data to internal products
  • Optimize for performance and cost: query tuning, table design, workload management and right-sizing compute
  • Own what you ship: monitor production pipelines, participate in incident triage and root-cause analysis, and harden systems so the same failure does not happen twice
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, data scientists and stakeholders across the company to deliver on product roadmap
  • Work within an Agile team that releases cutting-edge new features regularly
  • Take a high degree of ownership and freedom to experiment with new technologies to improve our software

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 7+ years of work experience as a data engineer
  • Proficiency in Python and using it as the primary development language in recent years
  • Expert-level SQL: comfortable writing, reading and tuning complex analytical queries against very large tables, and debugging why two result sets disagree
  • Hands-on experience with a distributed data processing platform (Spark/Databricks strongly preferred; EMR, Snowflake or BigQuery also relevant) and with a columnar data warehouse (Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse, etc)
  • Ability to design complex data models: normalized, dimensional and temporal (slowly changing dimensions, effective-dated records, point-in-time correctness)
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Airflow or similar): building DAGs, managing dependencies and running backfills
  • Experience integrating third-party data feeds: handling schema drift, late or missing deliveries, vendor data-quality defects and versioned reference data
  • Experience building REST services in Python (FastAPI, Flask, etc)
  • Experience developing, maintaining, and debugging problems in large server-side code bases
  • Working knowledge of AWS (S3, IAM, ECS or similar compute) and Docker
  • Good knowledge of engineering best practices and testing (unit test, integration test, code review, CI/CD)
  • The desire to take a high level of ownership of the things you work on
  • Ability to learn new things quickly, maintain a high bar for quality, and be pragmatic
  • Must be able to communicate with U.S based teams
  • Experience with Delta Lake / medallion lakehouse architectures is a plus
  • Experience migrating legacy pipelines between platforms with strict parity requirements is a plus
  • Experience with advertising, media or measurement industry data is a plus
  • Ability to communicate effectively with the U.S.-based teams and work 11:00 AM — 8:00 PM EEST (11:00 - 20:00).

Our Tech Stack:

  • Almost everything we run is on AWS (S3, ECS, EMR, RDS and more)
  • Python is our primary language; SQL is everywhere
  • Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake) is our lakehouse platform; Redshift and Postgres are our warehouses and operational databases
  • Airflow orchestrates our pipelines
  • Docker for packaging; GitHub Actions and Jenkins for CI/CD
  • Grafana, Sentry and OpenSearch for observability
  • Datasets measured in billions of rows

Interview Process:

  1. Pre-screening (30 mins)
  2. Technical Interview (1h)
  3. System Design (1.5h)
  4. Product Interview (30 mins)
  5. Offer

jobs.description:
About Pair Team

Pair Team is a public benefit company reimagining care for the safety net. As an AI-enabled medical group for Medicaid and Medicare, we deliver medical, behavioral, and social care by integrating shelters, pantries and other community-based organizations into our whole-person model. As California’s largest complex care provider, we’ve proven our impact to reduce avoidable emergency care, including a 52% and 26% reduction in ER visits and hospitalizations respectively. Once scaled nationally, our approach would save tax payers $150B per year.

With our years of experience and vast data collected, we are now building an AI platform that embeds social work agents across the safety net to truly unify our fragmented healthcare and welfare system. By scaling our country’s frontline medical and social services workforce, we aim to bring high-touch care to everyone.

At Pair Team, we’re not just delivering care—we’re transforming it. We’re building a future where high-touch, community-driven care is accessible to everyone, especially the most underserved.

  • Forbes: For Pair Team, Accessibility Is About Delivering Healthcare To Those Who Need It The Most
  • TechCrunch: Building for Medicaid’s regulatory moment with Neil Batlivala from Pair Team
  • Journal of General Internal Medicine: A Novel Intervention for Medicaid Beneficiaries with Complex Needs

About the Opportunity

Pair Team is hiring its second lawyer. As Associate General Counsel, you’ll work directly with our Head of Legal to build the legal function at a healthcare company that serves some of the most complex, highest-need patients, and you’ll shape how we scale.

Growing in this space means working through telehealth regulation, Medicaid and Medicare program requirements, privacy and data use, payer and provider contracting, and state-by-state licensure and operating rules. The questions are new, the rules are shifting, and the answers don’t sit in a playbook.

At a company our size, you won’t be a specialist in a silo or a reviewer at the end of the line – you’ll be a trusted partner to Product, Operations, Clinical, and the Executive team, helping them move quickly and with confidence. You’ll take on a wide range of matters, from regulatory strategy to complex payer agreements. You’ll also have real ownership. The templates, processes, and policies you build will become the foundation the legal team runs on as we grow, and you’ll have a real voice in how the department is built.

This role reports directly to the Head of Legal.

What You’ll Do

Legal & Regulatory Guidance

  • Lead advisor on corporate, healthcare regulatory, litigation, commercial, product, employment, and privacy matters.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and translate their impact into clear, actionable guidance for product, clinical, and operations teams.
  • Collaborate with operational, clinical and marketing leaders to ensure adherence to applicable laws and regulations (e.g. HIPAA, Anti-Kickback, Corporate Practice of Medicine).
  • Understand and provide business friendly guidance on use and impact of artificial intelligence and other technologies in healthcare programs.

Commercial Strategy & Contracting

  • Work on contract development and negotiation—drafting, redlining, and advising on deal terms for health plans, vendors, and partners.
  • Draft templates and playbooks for contracting with partners, including service agreements, BAAs, NDAs, and other agreements..
  • Provide legal and regulatory guidance related to Medicaid, Medicare, value-based care, and product development to support commercial strategy.

Risk Identification & Building Out Legal Function

  • Act as a trusted advisor to business, product, and clinical teams — flagging legal risks early and helping design compliant solutions rather than blocking progress.
  • Help develop legal processes and policies that support risk mitigation, compliance, and business enablement.
  • Effectively manage outside counsel work and spend.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with clinical operations on care delivery compliance, including documentation standards, authorization requirements, and billing compliance.
  • Collaborate with the People team on compliance training, onboarding, and workforce policy development.
  • Support company litigation needs.
  • Represent Pair Team professionally and compliantly in partner, health plan, and regulatory conversations.
  • Other duties as needed.

What You’ll Need

  • 5+ years of healthcare legal experience and regulatory frameworks (e.g., CMS, OIG, HIPAA, FWA).
  • 3+ years legal experience at a digital health company, health plan, provider, payor or managed care organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment — startup or high-growth company experience strongly preferred.
  • Deep working knowledge of the healthcare regulatory environment and practical application to technology products and digital health services.
  • Strong communication skills — able to explain complex regulatory requirements in plain language and make crisp risk/benefit recommendations to business leaders.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage projects and tasks.
  • Experience supporting building processes, procedures, and workflows that enable sustainable business scaling.
  • Strong collaboration skills with thought partners from clinical, operations, finance, and leadership
  • Proven ability to prioritize competing demands and make risk-proportionate decisions.
  • Mission-driven and passionate about improving outcomes for underserved communities

Bonus Points for any of the following:

  • Familiarity with value-based care contracts, capitation arrangements, or risk-bearing entities and their compliance implications.
  • Direct experience in pre-litigation and litigation matters and managing outside counsel.
  • Healthcare, privacy, or other relevant certification is a plus.

Our Values

  • Lead with integrity: We keep our commitments and take responsibility for our actions. We are dependable and choose authenticity over perfection.
  • Embrace challenges: We leave our egos at the door and step forward into discomfort instead of back into safety. We help each other to learn and provide feedback using candor and kindness.
  • Break through walls: We go the extra mile for our patients, partners and one another, and we run toward hard things. We are resilient in our push for consistent improvement and challenge the status quo.
  • Act beyond yourself: We build each other up and respect boundaries. We seek first to understand and assume positive intent.
  • Care comes first: We hold ourselves to the highest standards for our patients. We are relentless in the pursuit of our mission, and ensure that we are taking care of ourselves in order to care for others.

Because We Value You

  • Remote-first with equipment and $100/mo home office stipend

Job Description

Department: Technical Operations

Reports To (LMA): Sr. Manager of Technical Operations

Hourly Rate: $13-$17/hr

Location: Remote; Worldwide

—

Role Summary

RSI Security is seeking a skilled, independent IT Systems Consultant to provide intermediate remote support, administer Addigy (macOS, iPadOS, iOS) and Datto RMM (Windows) Remote Management and Monitoring platforms, complete data governance checks (ensure we are running backups and that they are completing successfully. Any failures should be escalated to the System Administrator accountable for administering and maintaining backups and data integrity), and execute standard client infrastructure projects. The Consultant will operate independently to resolve Tier 2 escalations, maintain secure endpoint configurations, and deliver exhaustive technical documentation. The Consultant retains full control over the methods, means, and schedule by which they accomplish these deliverables, provided all Service Level Agreements (SLAs) are met.

Core Responsibilities

  • Intermediate Incident Escalation Services: Serve as an independent Tier 2 escalation point, triaging, troubleshooting, and resolving intermediate technical and security issues within defined SLAs.
  • Systems & Tool Administration: Operate and configure Addigy (macOS, iPadOS, iOS) and Datto RMM (Windows) Remote Management and Monitoring, and integrated security platforms. Execute and deliver weekly data governance checks (ensure we are running backups and that they are completing successfully) to validate data integrity and basic tool health. Any backup failures should be escalated to the System Administrator accountable for administering and maintaining backups and data integrity.
  • Standard Project Execution: Manage and execute specific technical projects as outlined in individual Statements of Work (SOWs), including endpoint imaging, user provisioning/deprovisioning (O365/Active Directory), routine network troubleshooting, and standard vulnerability remediation.
  • Documentation & Knowledge Transfer: Maintain rigorous, real-time documentation within the client's IT Glue environment and author technical FAQs to support the broader operational team.
  • Process Improvement: Assist in deploying automation scripts to streamline redundant processes and provide recommendations for basic infrastructure enhancements to RSI Security leadership.

Service Level Agreement (SLAs) and Acceptance Criteria

  • The Consultant’s services will be evaluated against the following deliverable standards:
  • SLA Compliance: Maintain consistent adherence to all agreed-upon response and resolution SLAs for accepted Tier 2 escalations.
  • Governance Execution: Governance Execution: Deliver 100% of required weekly backup and Addigy (macOS, iPadOS, iOS) and Datto RMM (Windows) Remote Management and Monitoring governance checks by the designated weekly deadline.
  • Documentation Completeness: Ensure 100% of client engagements, troubleshooting steps, and system configurations are accurately documented and delivered in IT Glue upon project or ticket completion.

Measurables

These are tracked weekly or monthly via the Scorecard.

Notes / Special Considerations

  • Professional Experience: Minimum of 3 years of demonstrable experience providing systems analysis and Tier 2 IT support in an MSP or MSSP environment as an independent consultant or agency.
  • Technical Proficiencies: Strong proficiency in Windows/Mac OS, Active Directory/Entra ID, Microsoft 365 administration, and basic scripting languages (e.g., PowerShell). Working knowledge of PSA, Addigy (macOS, iPadOS, iOS), and Datto RMM (Windows) Remote Management and Monitoring platforms (Autotask, HubSpot), as well as completing data governance checks for enterprise backup solutions.
  • Required Certifications: The Consultant is expected to hold relevant foundational IT or security certifications (e.g., CompTIA Network+/Security+, Microsoft 365 Certified) prior to the start of the engagement.
  • Background Verification: Due to the highly sensitive nature of the data accessed, the Consultant (and any personnel deployed by the Consultant) must successfully pass a comprehensive multi-jurisdictional background check prior to being granted access to RSI Security or client infrastructure.
  • Security-First Operations: Demonstrate integrity, accountability, and a strict adherence to RSI Security’s data privacy and security protocols in all operations.
  • Proactive Problem Solving: Approach intermediate technical issues with an analytical mindset, effectively escalating highly complex infrastructure risks (Tier 3+) to the Primary Liaison in a timely manner.
  • Data Security & Privacy: Maintain rigorous operational security over all client data, utilizing encrypted channels and immediately relinquishing access and data upon project or contract completion.

Important Notice to Job Applicants and Recruitment Agencies

Work Authorization & Visa Sponsorship RSI Security is currently unable to provide sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B, TN, O-1, STEM OPT extensions, or Permanent Residency/Green Card sponsorship) for any position (except for our offshore contractor positions). All applicants must be currently authorized to work for any employer in the United States on a full-time, ongoing basis without the need for current or future employer immigration sponsorship

Unsolicited Agency & Staffing Submissions Policy RSI Security does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate submissions, or profiles from recruiters, placement services, or staffing agencies.

XTB is a global company from the financial industry, focusing on online trading of financial instruments. We are the largest FinTech in Poland and a leader in Central and Eastern Europe, and the range of our operations covers several countries, including Asia and South America. At XTB, we focus on the development of our employees, giving them opportunities to gain knowledge and skills in various fields, as well as offering a number of training and development programs. If you are looking for challenges and want to gain valuable experience in an international business environment, XTB is the right place for you.

We are a certified Great Place to Work company.

Responsibilities

  • Designing, maintaining, and developing LAN/WAN/WLAN networks across offices and data centers.
  • Managing traditional data center networks and VXLAN/EVPN-based IP fabrics.
  • Configuring and optimizing BGP and OSPF routing, inter-site connectivity, and connections to service providers.
  • Administering firewalls, security policies, and IPsec VPN tunnels.
  • Administering F5 BIG-IP LTM and F5 BIG-IP DNS/GSLB, including load balancing and traffic distribution across data centers.
  • Maintaining and tuning DDoS protection solutions and participating in incident response.
  • Monitoring infrastructure, troubleshooting issues, and optimizing network performance and availability.
  • Planning and implementing changes, upgrading infrastructure, and testing redundancy and failover mechanisms as part of BCP/DR initiatives.
  • Automating infrastructure management and operational workflows using Terraform, Ansible, and GitLab CI/CD.
  • Creating and maintaining technical documentation, configuration standards, and operational procedures.
  • Performing root cause analysis and implementing preventive measures in collaboration with infrastructure, security, and application teams.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in maintaining and developing enterprise and data center networks.
  • Strong practical knowledge of Cisco Nexus and Catalyst platforms, including NX-OS and IOS-XE, as well as Cisco Firepower Threat Defense (FTD), Firepower Management Center (FMC), and Cisco ASA firewalls.
  • Practical knowledge of switching technologies and high-availability mechanisms, including VLAN, STP, LACP, vPC, and HSRP/VRRP.
  • Experience in configuring and troubleshooting BGP and OSPF routing.
  • Practical knowledge of VXLAN/EVPN IP fabric architecture, including underlay and overlay networks.
  • Experience in managing WLAN networks, controllers, and access points, along with knowledge of 802.1X, RADIUS, and TACACS+.
  • Practical knowledge of firewalls, security policies, ACLs, NAT, and IPsec VPNs.
  • Experience in administering F5 BIG-IP LTM and F5 BIG-IP DNS/GSLB, including load balancing, health monitors, and global server load balancing.
  • Knowledge of DDoS protection mechanisms and the ability to analyze network traffic during incidents.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills using monitoring systems, logs, NetFlow/sFlow data, and tools such as Wireshark and tcpdump.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform, Ansible, and GitLab CI/CD for network infrastructure automation.
  • Ability to independently manage changes and resolve issues, take ownership of infrastructure, and proactively improve the environment.
  • Polish proficiency sufficient for fluent communication.
  • Good technical English, spoken and written, at a minimum B2 level, enabling communication with vendors and work with technical documentation.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Azure/AWS networking services and their integration with on-premises infrastructure.
  • Knowledge of IP multicast, including IGMP and PIM.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes networking, including CNI, routing, NetworkPolicy, and load balancing.
  • Experience in high-availability, low-latency environments, such as fintech, trading, or telecommunications.

  • Work in an experienced team that is happy to share its knowledge.

jobs.excerpt: About Hugel Aesthetics Hugel Aesthetics is a fast-growing leader in the medical aesthetics industry, bringing innovative injectable and skin-care solutions to the Aesthetics market across the United States.
jobs.description:
About Hugel Aesthetics

Hugel Aesthetics is a fast-growing leader in the medical aesthetics industry, bringing innovative injectable and skin-care solutions to the Aesthetics market across the United States. We are building our U.S. organization from the ground up, creating a culture that is intentionally different from traditional, highly layered organizations.

Founded in 2001, Hugel is a South Korea–based global leader in medical aesthetics, specializing in the development and commercialization of botulinum toxin, hyaluronic acid fillers, skin boosters, threads, and biocosmetics. Over the past two decades, Hugel has built a strong global footprint, with commercial presence in approximately 70 countries and operations across nine international subsidiaries.

Leveraging strong global momentum, Hugel Aesthetics was formed as the Company’s dedicated North American business unit, established to lead commercialization in the United States, Canada and Australia. Backed by Hugel’s global scale and expertise, Hugel Aesthetics is a well-resourced, growth-oriented organization focused on expanding access to Letybo and establishing a strong, long-term presence in medical aesthetics.

Our culture is rooted in high ownership, collaboration, and the belief that every voice matters. We value people who bring ideas, take initiative, and want a true seat at the table. In this environment, individuals are empowered to make an impact, move with agility, and help build what comes next.

This is a rare opportunity to join at an early stage and help shape not only the business, but the way we work, lead, and grow together. As we scale our commercial footprint, we're building a sales organization defined by hunger, excellence, and relentless customer focus.

The Opportunity

The Senior Manager, US Professional Education will lead the strategy, development, and execution of HCP peer-to-peer (P2P) educational initiatives designed to build clinical confidence, strengthen product knowledge, and drive adoption across the Hugel Aesthetics portfolio. Reporting to the Senior Director, Strategic Communications and Professional Relations, this individual will have primary responsibility for the development and operational management of the Speaker Bureau, including speaker identification, onboarding, training, and ongoing faculty engagement, as well as the planning and execution of live educational programs, webinars, speaker training meetings, and advisory boards.

Working cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Sales, and Compliance, the Senior Manager will ensure the delivery of high-quality, compliant, and impactful educational experiences that support commercial objectives. The role will also help cultivate and engage a diverse network of national, regional, and emerging healthcare professional thought leaders, translating clinical expertise and real-world experience into meaningful peer-to-peer education that supports product trial, adoption, and long-term utilization.

What You’ll Do

Peer-to-Peer Educational Strategy & Execution

  • Lead strategic planning, development, execution, and optimization of national, regional, and local P2P educational programs.
  • Own end-to-end program delivery, including program planning, speaker coordination, field collaboration, logistics, vendor oversight, budget management, and post-program evaluation.
  • Develop and manage an integrated calendar of live and virtual programs, including speaker-led dinners, webinars, and other HCP educational initiatives.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to align educational programming with regional priorities and opportunities to build clinical confidence and support appropriate product trial and adoption.

Speaker Bureau Management & Faculty Development

  • Own the Speaker Bureau, including faculty identification, selection, contracting, onboarding, utilization planning, documentation, and compliant engagement.
  • Develop and maintain a tiered faculty roster of national, regional, local, and emerging HCP speakers, with defined development and engagement plans.
  • Coordinate faculty assignments and evaluate speaker performance, educational effectiveness, and utilization in partnership with internal stakeholders.
  • Partner with the Senior Director on strategic KOL alignment while independently managing Speaker Bureau operations and faculty activation.

Speaker Training & Educational Content

  • Lead speaker training programs, including initial onboarding, certification, annual refreshers, new-data updates, and training meetings.
  • Partner with Medical Affairs and Compliance to ensure educational content is clinically accurate, current, and consistent with applicable promotional requirements.
  • Collaborate with Marketing and external partners to develop and update speaker resources, webinar content, training materials, and program tools.
  • Drive awareness, enrollment, engagement, and utilization of HCP educational offerings and, where applicable, the digital education platform.

Program Performance, Budget & Operations

  • Own professional education program budgets, forecasts, vendor and agency relationships, contracting workflows, and execution timelines.
  • Define and track key performance indicators, including program completion, attendance, engagement, speaker training and certification, faculty utilization, participant feedback, and budget performance.
  • Evaluate educational effectiveness and, where reliable data are available, program-level trends in product trial and adoption; recommend improvements to program design and investment allocation.
  • Equip and communicate with field teams on available programs, speaker nomination processes, scheduling, and program follow-up.

Advisory Board, Congress & Partnership Support

  • Partner with the Senior Director to support HCP advisory boards, including advisor coordination, meeting planning, content preparation, logistics, and synthesis of actionable insights.
  • Support educational initiatives at national and regional congresses, including speaker programs, educational sessions, and faculty coordination.
  • Collaborate with the Senior Director on medical society and industry association partnerships, supporting execution of relevant educational initiatives.

What We Are Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field is required; MBA or advanced degree is preferred.
  • 7-10+ years relevant experience in pharmaceutical, medical device, or medical aesthetics marketing, professional education, or related commercial functions; including focus on HCP education.
  • Experience in medical aesthetics and demonstrated ability to independently lead complex professional education programs.
  • Proven experience managing speakers, educational events, vendors, agencies, budgets, and cross-functional workstreams.
  • Working knowledge of pharmaceutical promotional compliance, HCP engagement, contracting, and applicable medical and regulatory review processes.
  • Excellent project management, communication, organizational, and stakeholder-management skills; ability to execute multiple programs concurrently.
  • Excellent presentation skills, with confidence and business acumen in front of senior customer stakeholders
  • Ability to travel up to 40% of the time.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in injectable aesthetics and product launch or growth-stage commercial environments.
  • Experience launching or scaling digital HCP education programs and measuring engagement.
  • Experience supporting advisory boards, congress education, and national or regional speaker training.
  • Experience leading teams or mentoring colleagues.

Compensation

The most likely base pay range for this position is $150,000 - $170,000 per year. Several factors, such as experience, tenure, skills, and particular business needs, will determine an individual’s exact level of compensation. Base salary is only one element of employee compensation at Hugel Aesthetics. The total compensation could include base salary and bonus.

Benefits

At Hugel Aesthetics, we invest in our colleagues by offering a comprehensive benefits package built to support your health, financial future, and peace of mind.

Employees enjoy robust medical, dental, and vision coverage, alongside a 401(k) program with a company match to help build long-term financial security. Our trackless PTO program and competitive corporate holiday schedule give you the flexibility to rest and recharge while out of the office.

We also offer optional benefits like wellness programs, legal services, and identity monitoring, so you can choose the coverage that fits your life.

Salary: $150,000 - $170,000

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Vault PromoMats is the industry-leading platform that life sciences companies rely on to manage the full lifecycle of promotional content, and digital asset management (DAM) is how customers store, find, reuse, and distribute the approved assets behind every campaign. We are looking for an experienced product manager to own and grow Veeva's DAM capabilities, making our customers' brand, marketing operations, commercial, and medical affairs teams more efficient and productive.
In this role, you will own the product strategy and roadmap for DAM capabilities, such as asset ingestion and metadata, search and discovery, rights and usage management, content reuse, and multichannel distribution. You will work closely with Engineering, UX, and customers to identify high-impact problems, define requirements, and ship solutions that balance ease of use with the rigor demanded by a highly regulated industry.

What You'll Do

  • Product Strategy & AI: Own the vision, strategy, and multi-release roadmap for DAM, including where AI capabilities such as auto-tagging, semantic search, and generative variations fit, balancing customer demand, market trends, and the realities of design and engineering
  • Customer Discovery: Engage directly with brand, marketing operations, creative and agency, medical, and regulatory teams at life sciences companies to understand how they create, organize, find, reuse, and distribute assets, and translate those insights into prioritized product requirements
  • Measurement & Impact: Define and track the metrics that prove customer value, such as asset reuse rates, time to find and publish an approved asset, metadata completeness, and feature adoption, and use them to guide the next set of investments
  • Feature Definition & Delivery: Write clear specifications and partner with Engineering, UX, and QA through design, build, and release to ship capabilities that meet the scalability and quality standards of the Veeva Vault platform
  • Governance & Automation: Deliver capabilities that reduce manual effort across the asset lifecycle, such as automated metadata extraction, rendition and format management, rights and expiration tracking, and approved-asset distribution to downstream channels, while preserving the auditability regulated customers require
  • Cross-Product & Go-to-Market Alignment: Partner with product teams across Vault, including PromoMats MLR review and claims, to deliver connected experiences, and enable Sales, Services, and Support with the positioning, demos, and documentation needed to bring releases to market

Requirements

  • 5+ years of enterprise software product management, engineering, or consulting experience
  • 2+ years of hands-on focus on digital asset management (DAM), content management, or creative production platforms
  • Technical Proficiency: Working knowledge of how DAM systems are built, including metadata models and taxonomies, rendition and transcoding, APIs and integrations, and the application of AI/ML, such as auto-tagging, semantic search, and Generative AI, to asset workflows
  • Architectural Knowledge: Understanding of content and asset architecture, including storage and delivery, versioning, permissions and rights management, and integration with content management, work management, and distribution channels
  • Communication: Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value for non-technical stakeholders in Marketing, Creative, Legal, Medical, and Regulatory departments
  • Collaboration: Proven track record of working with UX and Engineering to build intuitive tools for complex workflows
  • Marketing Acumen: Experience in Marketing or Marketing Operations, or building products for marketing teams, with a working understanding of how brand strategy, campaign planning, and content production come together
  • Marketing Process Fluency: Familiarity with the methodologies brand teams run on, creative and campaign briefs, agency and studio workflows, brand guidelines and governance, modular content and content supply chain models, omnichannel distribution, and launch readiness

Nice to Have

  • Rich Media & Creative Workflows: Experience with image, video, and other creative file formats, proofing and review tools, and agency or studio handoffs
  • Brand & Launch Experience: Hands-on involvement in brand strategy, brand or product launch planning, or global campaign rollout, including the content, claims, and approval cycles that support a launch
  • Marketing Technology: Working knowledge of the martech stack brand teams use alongside DAM, including content and experience platforms (e.g., Adobe Experience Manager, Aprimo, Sitecore), marketing work management (e.g., Adobe Workfront, Asana, Monday), marketing automation and CRM (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo, Veeva CRM, Vault CRM), and campaign analytics tools

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.

We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Head of Design

Remote - UnitedStates

About the Role

As Head of Design, you will lead Blackboard’s global User Experience and Design (UXD) organization and own the vision and strategy for how people experience our products, from Blackboard LMS and Blackboard Illuminate to Ally and our institutional effectiveness solutions. Your multidisciplinary team spans design, research, documentation, and accessibility, and works across web and mobile platforms in multiple countries and time zones.

You will refine and evolve Blackboard’s design strategy, so it anticipates how teaching and learning are changing and drives measurable outcomes for our customers and our business. As a peer to leaders in Product Management and Product Development, you will make sure design shapes decisions from early discovery through delivery, and you will champion the value of design with executives, customers, and the wider design community.

You will also lead how design works in an AI-first era. We build the industry’s mostAI-advancedLMS, and we expect our Head of Design to work hands-on with generative AI every day. That means using tools such as Figma Make, Claude Design, and other large language model (LLM)-based technologies to explore ideas, prototype, and test faster, and guiding the team to adopt them thoughtfully and responsibly.

You will lead it with flexibility and inclusion, buildingconnectionacross locations and adjusting your own working hours when the business or the team needs you, so every colleague, in every time zone, has the access and support they need.

What does success look like? Products that solve complex problems with simplicity and elegance,a designculture of rapid iteration and continuous learning, and a team that is proud of both the work and the way it gets done.

What You Will Do

  • Refine and evolve the design vision and strategy for Blackboard’s products, aligned with company strategy, product roadmaps, and business outcomes
  • Lead, grow, and inspire a high-performing, diverse UXD organization across multiple countries and time zones, developing strong leaders at every level
  • Partner with Product Management and Product Development leadership so design is integral to product planning, prioritization, and execution

  • Build an agile culture that iterates quickly and refines solutions based on data, user insight, and cross-functional collaboration

  • Flex your working hours as needed to support business priorities and a team distributed across time zones
  • Travel up to 20% to support teams, customers, and company events

Required Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
  • At least 10 years of experience in user experience, product design, or a related field, including significant experience leading design leaders as well as individual contributors
  • Proven experience building and scaling design organizations of 10+ professionals across disciplines such as Product Design, research, documentation, and accessibility
  • Proven experience leading diverse, geographically distributed teams across multiple countries, regions, and time zones
  • A track record of defining and refining design strategy at an executive level and connecting design to measurable user and business outcomes
  • Hands-on, everyday fluency with generative AI design technologies such as Figma Make, Claude Design, Claude Code and other LLM-based tools, with a clear point of view on how AI is reshaping design practice
  • Deep expertise in modern design tools, including Figma, prototyping, and design systems, plus working knowledge of web standards (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, usability, and accessibility)
  • Strong expertise in engaging customers and users through design research, testing, and iterative feedback loops
  • A record of delivering simple, elegant solutions to complex problems in highly agile environments
  • Strong leadership skills and the ability to create a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing team culture
  • Flexibility to work outside standard hours when needed to collaborate with colleagues, partners, and customers in other time zones
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex design concepts clear to any audience
  • Experience with accessibility standards such as the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG)
  • Fluency in written and spoken English

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience in education technology or enterprise software as a service (SaaS)

About Blackboard

Blackboard is a leading EdTech company and SaaS provider that delivers the digital environment for transformational teaching and learning. We serve thousands of institutions with the industry's most AI-advanced LMS, Blackboard Ally for accessibility, and institutional effectiveness solutions that put educators and learners at the center. We're an education company that builds technology. Learn more at blackboard.com.

We are looking for a confident and customer-focused Customer Service Representative / Booking Coordinator to manage incoming customer inquiries and turn qualified leads into booked service appointments.

Customer Communication & Appointment Booking

Lead Follow-Up

  • Respond promptly to missed calls, voicemails, text messages, and online inquiries.
  • Follow up consistently with qualified leads that have not yet booked.
  • Track and document the outcome of every follow-up to ensure no opportunity is missed.

Scheduling & Documentation

  • Enter accurate customer details, job descriptions, lead sources, and dispatch notes into ServiceTitan.
  • Coordinate scheduling with the dispatch team without promising availability that has not been confirmed.
  • Maintain clear and accurate records of all customer interactions.

Reporting & Performance

  • Provide daily updates on bookings, pending follow-ups, and reasons qualified leads did not book.
  • Take ownership of key performance metrics, including booking rate, response time, follow-up completion, documentation accuracy, and customer experience.

Required Experience & Skills

  • At least 2 years of experience supporting U.S.-based home service customers, preferably in plumbing, HVAC, electrical, or a similar industry.
  • Proven experience with appointment booking, lead follow-up, and objection handling.
  • Clear spoken and written English with strong listening and communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to work independently and follow through on tasks.
  • Experience using ServiceTitan is strongly preferred.
  • A quiet and professional workspace, reliable high-speed internet, and a quality headset.
  • Reliable backup arrangements for internet connectivity and power.
  • Ability to remain fully focused on the role during scheduled working hours.
  • Spanish proficiency is a plus.

Perfect Fit / Culture

  • You take ownership of every customer inquiry and follow it through to a clear outcome.
  • You are confident asking for the appointment without being overly pushy.
  • You follow up consistently and do not let qualified leads fall through the cracks.
  • You communicate professionally, stay organized, and take responsibility for your results.
  • You can work independently while knowing when to coordinate with the wider team.

Typical Day

Your day starts by reviewing new inquiries, missed calls, and pending follow-ups. You spend much of your time answering inbound calls, understanding customer needs, and working to convert qualified inquiries into booked appointments. Throughout the day, you follow up with unbooked leads, respond to messages, and keep customer information and scheduling notes accurate in ServiceTitan.

You will coordinate closely with the dispatch team when scheduling appointments and provide a daily summary of bookings, outstanding follow-ups, and any reasons qualified customers did not move forward.

jobs.description:
Zwei Marken. Ein Team. ROVA Health entsteht, wenn zwei etablierte Namen im Bereich Gesundheit und Wohlbefinden aufhören, nebeneinander herzulaufen, und stattdessen gemeinsam vorangehen. Aufbauend auf über einem Jahrhundert Westfield Health Group-Erbe und getragen von der Überzeugung, dass sich die Art, wie Menschen leben, arbeiten und sich erholen, grundlegend verändert hat, wollen wir etwas bewirken. Dies ist eine Plattform mit Zweck, aufgebaut von Menschen, denen es wichtig ist, es richtig zu machen. Wenn Sie zu uns kommen, beginnen Sie nicht nur einen neuen Job. Sie helfen dabei, das zu gestalten, was als Nächstes kommt.

STRATEGIC ACCOUNT MANAGER

Meistern Sie das Unbekannte als ROVA Experience Specialist.

Der deutsche Markt für Gesundheit und Wohlbefinden verändert sich rasant – Sie sind der strategische Partner, der unsere größten Kunden durch diesen Wandel führt.

ROVA Health arbeitet mit vielen namhaften Unternehmen zusammen, um Tausenden von Mitarbeitenden in ganz Deutschland Bewegungsräume und Unterstützung für ihr Wohlbefinden zu bieten. Die Position des Strategic Account Managers ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit für eine Fitness-Fachkraft mit ausgeprägten Fähigkeiten im Stakeholder-Management und in der Neukundengewinnung, unser Team zu verstärken. Als Hauptansprechpartner für unsere Neukunden stellen Sie sicher, dass unsere Dienstleistungen einen Mehrwert bieten und den Anforderungen entsprechen.

Darüber hinaus nutzen Sie Ihre Erfahrung im Vertrieb und im Projektmanagement, um unser Geschäft in Deutschland weiter auszubauen, und unterstützen den Regional Client Director bei zentralen Projekten. Sobald neue Kunden erfolgreich eingebunden sind, übernehmen Sie die strategische Verantwortung für die Beziehung und sorgen so für langfristigen geschäftlichen Erfolg, operative Exzellenz und kontinuierliches Wachstum.

Sie verwalten die Beziehung nicht nur – Sie definieren, wie langfristige Partnerschaft aussieht.

DIE ROLLE

Standort:Remote, Deutschland

Sprachanforderungen:Fließend Deutsch & Englisch

Gehalt:50.000 – 70.000 € pro Jahr, abhängig von der Erfahrung

Leistungen:Spend it Card, 8 % Urlaubsgeld, Team-Events, Jahresurlaub (bis zu 29 Tage), kostenlose Nutzung des Fitnessstudios, gezielte Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, jährliche Gehaltsüberprüfung.

Vertragsart:12 Monate, befristet

WAS SIE MITBRINGEN

→ Erfahrung in der Verantwortung und Leitung strategischer Kundenbeziehungen in Umgebungen mit mehreren Standorten.

→ Nachweisbare Erfahrung in den Bereichen Fitness, Wellness oder Dienstleistungen, idealerweise einschließlich unternehmens- oder kundenorientierter Modelle.

→ Eine starke Erfolgsbilanz im Vertrieb, in der Neukundengewinnung und in der Geschäftsentwicklung.

→ Erfahrung in der Führung und Entwicklung leistungsstarker Teams.

→ Ausgeprägtes kaufmännisches Verständnis sowie Erfahrung im Management von Budgets und Leistungsergebnissen.

→ Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf der Ebene hochrangiger Entscheidungsträger aufzubauen.

→ Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

→ Bereitschaft zu Dienstreisen innerhalb Deutschlands.

AUFGABEN UND VERANTWORTLICHKEITEN

01 Strategische Kundenbetreuung

→ Fungieren Sie als leitender strategischer Ansprechpartner für den zugewiesenen Kunden.

→ Entwickeln und implementieren Sie eine Kundenstrategie, die auf die Ziele des Geschäftsbereichs und des Kunden abgestimmt ist.

→ Bauen Sie vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu hochrangigen Stakeholdern auf und übernehmen Sie die Rolle der primären Anlaufstelle für Kundenangelegenheiten.

→ Leiten Sie Leistungsbeurteilungen und strukturierte Governance-Foren mit internen und kundenseitigen Stakeholdern.

02 Operative Führung & Qualität

→ Übernehmen Sie die strategische Überwachung der operativen Umsetzung an allen Kundenstandorten.

→ Leiten und entwickeln Sie das Führungsteam und das operative Team vor Ort und stellen Sie sicher, dass effektive Leistungsmanagementstrukturen vorhanden sind.

→ Sorgen Sie für die konsequente Umsetzung operativer Standards, Governance-Rahmenwerke sowie regulatorischer und vertraglicher Verpflichtungen.

→ Fördern Sie „brilliant basics“, um Qualität, Sicherheit, Leistung und Kundenerlebnis voranzutreiben.

03 Geschäftswachstum & Kundenentwicklung

→ Übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die finanzielle Leistung und die vereinbarten geschäftlichen Ergebnisse für den Kunden.

→ Bauen Sie das Neugeschäft in Deutschland auf und aus, einschließlich Vertragsverlängerung und der Planung langfristiger Partnerschaften.

→ Identifizieren Sie Chancen für organisches Wachstum, Dienstleistungsentwicklung und Innovation.

→ Nutzen Sie Leistungsdaten und Erkenntnisse, um faktenbasierte Verbesserungen voranzutreiben.

04 Führung & Teamentwicklung

→ Leiten und entwickeln Sie das Führungsteam vor Ort nach erfolgreichem Onboarding.

→ Unterstützen Sie die Personalplanung, Nachfolgeplanung und Kompetenzentwicklung.

→ Fördern Sie eine Hochleistungskultur im Einklang mit den Unternehmenswerten.

→ Vermitteln Sie dem Team eine klare Führungsausrichtung.

05 Zusammenarbeit mit Stakeholdern

→ Arbeiten Sie eng mit Shared-Services-Teams zusammen, darunter Personalwesen, Finanzen, IT, Marketing und Angebotsentwicklung.

→ Arbeiten Sie mit regionalen Kundenbetreuern und Führungskräften zusammen, um die Abstimmung im gesamten EMEA-Raum sicherzustellen.

→ Bauen Sie effektive Beziehungen zu externen Partnern und Lieferanten auf.

WIE ES WEITERGEHT

→ Die Personalverantwortlichen prüfen Ihre Bewerbung.

→ Sie durchlaufen ein formales zweistufiges Interviewverfahren.

→ Angebot wird unterbreitet.

→ Ausweis- und Personalprüfungen.

  • Understand what makes people stop scrolling, stay engaged, and take action.
