jobs.excerpt: An exciting opportunity to join Veramed's Data Management Business Unit!
jobs.description:
An exciting opportunity to join Veramed's Data Management Business Unit! Are you passionate about clinical data, data integration, and building reliable pipelines that drive better decisions in drug development? We're looking for a Clinical Data Ingestion Manager to play a key role in ensuring high-quality clinical data flows seamlessly from multiple sources into cutting-edge review platforms.

In this role, you'll be at the heart of clinical data operations, managing the ingestion, quality control, monitoring, and delivery of data from EDCs, CTMS platforms, and external vendors into systems such as Veeva CDB, Elluminate, and JReview. Your work will ensure study teams have timely, accurate, and review-ready data to support critical development milestones.

Purpose:
The Clinical Data Ingestion Manager is responsible to support reliable, timely, and traceable ingestion of clinical data from EDC/CTMS and vendors into clinical data review platforms (e.g., Veeva CDB, Elluminate, JReview) by executing defined ingestion processes, performing QC/reconciliation and transfer monitoring, maintaining reusable templates/runbooks, and producing accurate documentation to enable review-ready datasets and downstream exports in a controlled (GxP) environment.

Accountabilities:
• Support ingestion of clinical data from EDC/CTMS and vendors (e.g., labs, eCOA, imaging, safety) into Veeva CDB/Elluminate/JReview by executing loads per approved specifications and refresh cadence.
• Execute and support file/API-based loads (mapping, transformations, referential integrity) and perform controlled reprocessing under established procedures.
• Perform and document ingestion quality checks (standardization, automated QC/validation outputs, reconciliation results, and basic lineage/provenance) to help ensure review-ready datasets.
• Contribute to reusable ingestion frameworks and standards by maintaining templates/mappings, QC rules, and runbooks; propose improvements to reduce manual effort.
• Support transfer monitoring and ingestion operations: expected vs received, timeliness/completeness checks, alert triage/escalation, scheduling/re-runs, defect logging, and operational metric reporting.
• Assist with downstream exports/feeds to internal consumers (CDM, analytics, programming) by preparing and validating outputs against defined data contracts and refresh expectations.
• Partner with vendors and internal stakeholders to clarify transfer specs and acceptance criteria; support troubleshooting and ensure fixes are documented for repeatable operations.
• Follow controlled documentation and change practices for regulated clinical processes, maintaining required validation/traceability evidence and audit-ready records as assigned.

Education & Competencies:
• Education/Experience: BS/BA (or equivalent) plus 5+ years in data ingestion/integration,
ETL/ELT operations, or clinical data pipeline support, ideally supporting clinical data review and

recurring study/vendor transfers.

  • Platform exposure (preferred): Exposure in clinical data review systems such as Veeva CDB,
    Elluminate, and/or JReview (or comparable platforms).
    • Clinical data ingestion fundamentals: Understanding of ingestion basics such as transfer
    specs/data contracts, refresh cadence, incremental vs. full loads, controlled reprocessing,
    reconciliation, and basic lineage.
    • Data quality & Review readiness: Ability to execute defined QC/validation
    checks (completeness/timeliness, reconciliation) and document results to support review-ready
    datasets.
    • Data formats & Interfaces: Hands-on with CSV, JSON, XML and file/API-based integrations;
    familiarity with secure transfers (e.g., SFTP/MFT concepts) is a plus.
    • Querying & Scripting: Working knowledge of SQL and Python (preferred) or similar scripting to
    support ingestion automation, parsing, and operational tasks.
    • Frameworks & Reusability: Ability to maintain and extend existing reusable ingestion
    components (templates, mappings, QC rules, runbooks) under guidance.
    • Monitoring & Operations: Experience using monitoring/operational processes (e.g., expected vs
    received, alerts, reruns, incident triage) and reporting basic operational metrics.
    • Source system familiarity: Familiarity with common clinical sources such as EDC, CTMS, and
    vendor feeds (labs, eCOA/ePRO, imaging, safety) and how data arrives/changes over time.
    • Controlled environment readiness: Strong documentation habits (specs, mappings, runbooks,
    issue logs) and ability to follow defined procedures in controlled/regulated settings.
    • Clear communicator and collaborative team member; comfortable working with vendors and
    cross-functional partners with guidance.
    • Detail-oriented and organized; able to manage recurring operational tasks, escalate risks early,

and drive issues to closure with support

jobs.description:
The Quality Manager position is key in fostering a culture of quality within the Company organization and acts as an ambassador for the QA department. The Quality Manager, Quality Assurance has an active role in the preparation, maintenance, and execution of the internal and vendor Strategic and Annual Audit Program as well as leading all aspects of the design, implementation and management of internal and vendor audits and corresonding quality risk management activities. Core responsibilities of the Quality Manager are

  • Audit Universe
    • Develops and maintains the internal Quality Risk Assessment methodology.
    • Develops and maintains a comprehensive Audit Universe.
    • Leads Quality Assurance activities in relation to procurement and vendor oversight.
    • Develops, maintains, and manages mechanisms that assure ongoing monitoring and compliance with all applicable laws and regulations including but not limited to EU GVP, USFDA CFRs, JMPA and ICH-E6.
    • Partners closely with Vendor Management and operations teams, driving risk-based and compliant audit strategy.
  • Auditing and Audit management
    • Coordinates and contributes to internal system and/or vendor audits initiated by the Company, according to the Company Audit Plan, including effective management of pre-audit and post-audit activities.
    • As required, and within their area of GxP expertise, conducts audits or coordinates audit documentation peer review and quality control activities.
  • Other
    • For Client contracted services within Quality Assurance area, undertakes activities in relation to the Quality as a Service, such as planning, coordinating or conducting audits, and providing GxP QA consultantcy in line with their expertise and experience.
    • Monitors compliance within the organization to ensure early identification and review its impact on audit strategy, audit plans and its execution.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in biomedical sciences, natural sciences, health sciences, or another relevant scientific discipline, or an equivalent combination of advanced education and relevant industry experience
  • Experience:
    • Experience with both GVP and GCP regulatory requirements, or a willingness to broaden your expertise
    • At least 3 years of direct auditing experience in GCP (e.g. investigational sites, TMFs, Vendors) and / or GVP area (e.g. safety case processing and reporting)
    • At least 2 years of experience in audit program management including the development and maintenance of risk-based audit plans
  • Skills: Organization skills, attention to details, excellent communication and facilitation skills within a global organization, proactive, fluent in English

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Ergomed is a specialist clinical research organization focused on rare disease and select oncology indications. We focus on the most complex trials, the studies where experience, judgement, and rigorous operational accountability make the biggest difference. We partner with small to midsize biotech companies to move promising therapies through early phase development, so they reach the patients sooner.

We choose complex work on purpose. Rare disease and oncology trials carry real operational risk, and our people are experts at reducing it, protecting timelines, data quality and the experience of sites and patients at the same time. It is demanding, meaningful work, and no one here forgets that patients cannot wait.

That is why culture matters to us as much as capability. We have built a collaborative, international team where people share ideas, grow their careers and are trusted to take ownership early. With colleagues across North America, South America, Europe, Asia and Australia, we value teamwork, flexibility and a real commitment to work-life balance, because good science comes from people who feel supported.

If you want work with purpose, the agility to make an impact and a team that cares about the people behind the work as much as the work itself, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
About Parloa

Parloa’s mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

As Business Continuity & DR Manager, you will build, implement and maintain Parloa’s Business Continuity Management System (BCMS), including business continuity, disaster recovery and crisis management plans for our digital systems, operations and infrastructure. You will be part of IS&T Governance and play a key role in strengthening Parloa’s resilience and overall security posture.

This is your opportunity to build a BCMS at a fast-growing, global AI company and lead it to ISO 22301 certification, keeping essential services running for enterprise customers who trust Parloa with their most important customer moments.

Areas of ownership:

  • BCMS Design and ISO 22301 Certification: Run gap analyses, define the framework and maintain the policies, procedures and guidelines behind it. Lead the certification process end to end, including preparing for external audits.
  • Risk Assessment and Business Impact Analysis: Identify and prioritise critical business processes by building risk models and mapping dependencies and vulnerabilities. Turn business impact analyses into a tailored continuity strategy for each critical process.
  • Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plans: Create and maintain plans for all critical processes, with clear recovery objectives, resources and recovery teams. Review them regularly so they stay current as Parloa grows.
  • Testing and Exercises: Plan and run tabletop exercises, drills and simulations across critical functions on a recurring schedule. Evaluate results, close gaps and refine plans based on what you learn.
  • Stakeholder Alignment and Resilience Culture: Build strong relationships with department heads and report progress, risks and milestones to senior management. Define KPIs for the BCMS and deliver training and awareness programmes that make resilience part of how Parloa works.

Who you are:

  • Proven experience developing and testing business continuity and disaster recovery plans, including risk assessments and business impact analyses.
  • Solid knowledge of how to implement a BCMS according to ISO 22301.
  • Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, risk management and crisis response.
  • A structured, execution-focused way of working: you build and follow a clear project roadmap, make decisions and see them through.
  • Confident communicator who engages stakeholders at all levels and presents to groups with clarity.

Our recruiting process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We’re at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn’t just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We’re building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren’t just support tickets; they’re defining experiences. We’re here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn’t a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that’s evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We’ve grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we’ve kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we’re scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.

Overview

Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at .


Our Laboratory Reinvention practice is where scientific and laboratory innovation meets leading-edge technology. We help our clients envision and achieve Digital and AI Laboratory Transformation through co-creation and application of digital technologies, revolutionizing scientific and laboratory processes. Our people have a combination of scientific and laboratory informatics expertise, tied with strategic and business consulting experience, and industry platforms knowledge. We provide an innovative approach and global scale s across a variety of industries.


We leverage digital technologies such as GenAI and Agentic SI solutions, automation, Internet of Things, analytics, and cloud, in combination with a fundamental redesign of the scientific user experience to help our clients better capture, manage, integrate, and analyze complex scientific data. We help improve the research, development, and manufacturing of new products, improve quality, ensure compliance, reduce time to market and improve operational efficiency. 


As a member of our team, you will be exposed to the cutting-edge technologies and processes that many leading companies and government agencies utilize.


What would you do?

Deliver exceptional, differentiated strategies, roadmaps, value cases, and highly valued projects for our clients that advance their ambitions for digital laboratory operations and scientific intelligence. As a Consultant you can expect to:

  • Apply management consulting and design-thinking techniques as you work on the fundamental redesign of the scientific user experience
  • Help shape client’s transformation vision, focus areas, and journey from the current state to a “to-be” enterprise environment
  • Reimagine, plan and execute on how AI reshapes the laboratory landscape
  • Redesign processes and operating models to enable new ways of working with data-driven business cases

  • Advise on data and system architectures as they relate to industry solutions for the laboratory
  • Create digital laboratory thought leadership for clients across Life Sciences.
  • Collaborate with client leaders to gain alignment on recommended solutions.

Preferred Qualifications:

jobs.description:
Actionstep is a pioneer in the development and sale of software-as-a-service (SaaS) products, specializing in the delivery of Legal Practice Management software. We are a fast growing, dynamic business with a global customer base of more than 50,000 and a team of over 300 in the USA, Australia, UK, Canada and New Zealand.

THE PURPOSE OF YOUR ROLE

As a Product Manager, you will maintain assigned products, manage ongoing product planning, requirements, development of new features, functionality and integrations. The role is ultimately tasked with the delivery of unique value-based products based on customer insights. You will also take responsibility for the creation of a product vision and strategy, product governance and senior stakeholder communication.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

In this role, you will be accountable for…

- Build and launch successful products in a SaaS B2B software company, working directly with and influencing/inspiring enterprise customers, and serving multiple user and business personas.

- Build and bring to market AI-powered features and products, applying hands-on experience taking AI/ML-driven capabilities from concept through go-to-market.

- Own the delivery of the strategic product direction based on clear commercial rationale and robust insights.

- Coordinate feature launches, including orchestrating testing, documentation, training rollout sequencing, customer communication, and adoption measurement.

- Generate, gather, and organize ideas for features and improvements for the product, prioritize feature requests, and maintain part of the roadmap.

- Design product enhancements and communicate designs orally, through diagrams, and through appropriate product artifacts.

- Demonstrate success producing product management artifacts such as opportunity briefs, prioritized roadmaps, product specs, user stories, wireframes, and customer-facing docs.

-Achieve stretch goals in innovative and fast-paced cross functional teams.

- Understand technical elements and communicate them to those who don’t.

- Lead, motivate and develop engineering & design team members.

- Demonstrate strong leadership and proven ability to operate successfully in a collaborative, matrixed global organizational structure.

- Follow industry trends through exploring complementary products, meeting with partners, and investigating innovative technologies.

- Contribute to company-level product planning by developing concepts into specs, evaluating them, and participating as we expand on our strategic product roadmap.

- Work with product research to conduct data gathering, competitive reviews, customer analysis, market-sizing as required.

- Perform any other duties within the scope of the key responsibilities as directed.

Relationship Management:

- Build and maintain strong working relationships with all internal and external parties ensuring transparent, proactive and effective communication always.

- Attending and proactively contributing to customer, partner and internal meetings with the view to add value in a constructive manner.

- Lead and actively participate in customer discovery sessions, beta programs, and user research with legal professionals to deeply understand their workflows and pain points.

- Represent Actionstep at customer-facing events such as webinars and industry conferences, building relationships with legal professionals and translating their feedback into product improvements.

Professional Development:

Actively looking to build own career through delivery of self and assisted professional development initiatives.

Being a thought leader both within Actionstep but also in the wider industry.

Staying abreast of industry best practice patterns, products and technologies and assisting in process improvement activities as required.

Continuous Improvement:

Proactive in identifying and participating in the continuous improvement of processes and procedures within the Relevant Team department.

Actively contribute to the development and maintenance of a strong department culture ensuring knowledge and experience is shared.

Health & Safety:

- Assume responsibility for your own and others safety and wellbeing, following all safety and wellbeing procedures and instructions, including reporting hazards, incidents and accidents and participating in safety and wellbeing initiatives and programmes as required.

Other Responsibilities:

- Undertaking any other reasonable duties as required

Requirements

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

Essential:

- 5+ years of SaaS product management experience building enterprise products.

- Proven track record of successfully bringing products to market & delivering product features that are aligned with company goals and strategy.

- Proven ability to bring AI-powered products to market that go beyond generic AI features, with a real understanding of what makes an AI capability defensible and hard to copy.

- Expertise in driving product development processes using agile methodologies.

- Experience in product management tools such as Azure DevOps, Notion, Pendo, Miro.

- Strong understanding of user-centered design principles, experience working closely with design and UX teams, and proven ability to create exceptional user experiences.

- Strong track record of driving successful product launches within strict timelines.

- Ability to dig into business or technical problems and find pragmatic solutions.

- Strong project management skills; able to identify needs, break down objectives into key results & initiatives, deliver value continuously with short and long-term initiatives, and move multiple related & unrelated workstreams forward in parallel.

- A profound understanding of product lifecycle management, user experience design, and market analysis.

- Hands-on experience with product roadmap creation, stakeholder collaboration, leading cross-functional teams, and data-driven decision-making processes.

- Working experience in creating, prioritizing and recommending epics and features.

- Ability to work in a remote environment – travel will be part of the role to successfully engage with the team and participate in cross functional meetings/working sessions.

- Working knowledge of application performance and analytics.

- Experience researching, defining and documenting market, product and platform requirements.

- Strong understanding of customer needs, pain points, and experience with similar technologies.

- Track project progress and initiatives in alignment with the roadmap.

Desirable:

- Exposure to the legal industry (working with lawyers and law firms) is an added bonus.

Personal Skills, Attributes & Behavioural Competencies:

- Ability to work in both team and individual capacities.

-Ability to manage multiple streams of work effectively.

- Ability to manage your daily workload through best practice time management techniques.

- Great communication and interpersonalskills.

- Passionate about teamwork and collaboration.

Other:

HOW YOU WORK WITH OTHERS

-Strong collaboration skills, able to build trust and negotiate with senior teams across functions (including product, design, technology, marketing, compliance, business development and sales), and geographies to build products that delight our global customers.

-Ability to influence multiple stakeholders without direct authority.

-Demonstrated relationship development with the ability to work effectively both independently and within a cross-functional teams.

-Excellent written and verbal interpersonal and communication skills with internal and external audiences at various levels and functions.

-Positive energy and optimism about the future with the determination to get there.

-“Can do” attitude of empowerment to take 100% responsibility for achieving our mission.

-Appreciative of direct communication as both an active communicator and eager listener.

jobs.title: Senior DBA / Database Architect (North America)
jobs.excerpt: About the CompanyLateral stands for technology excellence.
jobs.description:
About the Company

Lateral stands for technology excellence.

We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality.

Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.

We do things differently at Lateral

Our mission is simple: design and build great products.
What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’s the way we work:

We Have A Bias For Action & Results.

We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results - not the effort - speak for themselves.

We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality

Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to.

We Care Deeply.

We care about our work and about each other. Care Is A Competitive Advantage.

Every detail matters. Every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default.

We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do

Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way.

We Keep Improving

The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning.

We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection.

We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto

We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around.

We Take Ownership
Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior DBA & Database Architect at Lateral, you will:

  • Design and optimize real-time databases and data systemsto meet evolving client, product, and business needs - with a focus on performance, quality, and scalability.

  • Tune, productionize, and optimize data systems and machine learning models to enhance their effectiveness and efficiency.

  • Take ownership of features end-to-end, from initial concept through deployment. You’ll often drive substantial product features as the key developer alongside an architect, backend developer or analyst.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers, leading by example in design reviews and pair programming. You will offer constructive feedback that helps others grow, fostering a thoughtful, kind, and continuously learning team culture.

  • Provide technical leadership in architecture and design discussions, advocating for simple, elegant solutions. You’ll challenge unnecessary complexity and focus on pragmatic results.

  • Continuously refine systems balancing new development with technical debt management to keep solutions stable and adaptable.

  • Champion best practices in quality, security, and operations, including CI/CD, monitoring, and privacy compliance

Example Projects You May Join:

  • Build an AI-powered healthcare platform to help detect diseases earlier.

  • Launch a new fintech product from the ground up.

  • Scale a global SaaS commerce system with millions of products

Whatever the challenge, you’ll be building software that changes lives and moves industries forward.

How We Measure Success In This Role

In the first two weeks

  • You make your first meaningful contribution to the project

  • You communicate well async as well as in meetings

In the first 3 months:

  • You understand the system architecture well and can work independently or in teams on medium-sized features.

  • You design before you code (and produce design artifacts)

  • You have shipped code in Production, clean, tested

  • You communicate clearly, raising issues early and contributing to reviews.

  • You deliver what you commit to.

After 3 months:

  • You take ownership of larger features and improvements from start to finish.

  • You help others by sharing knowledge, spotting problems early, and improving processes or tooling.

  • You make decisions with both the data/codebase and business goals in mind.

We measure success through:

  • Evaluating results (what you’ve shipped)

  • Quality and reliability of your designs.

  • Consistency in delivery.

  • Feedback from peers and leads.

  • Your ability to work independently and unblock others.

What We’re Looking For

We are seeking for team members who are both highly technical and deeply care about their craft and how the work gets done. You must bring:

  • 7+ years experience in database engineering or administration

  • Deep expertise in SQL, relational databases, data modeling, and transactional design

  • Hands-on experience with ETL pipelines and data warehouses, optimizing data flows across systems

  • Proven ability to design efficient schemas and tune queries for high-scale, high-volume environments

  • A quality mindset: unit tests, integration tests, automation, defensive programming

  • Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills with a hands-on, proactive attitude

  • Ability to Design before you code—express decisions through clear diagrams, validate assumptions early, and think through edge cases and trade-offs.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • A commitment to making a difference, continuous learning, and collaboration

Bonus points for:

  • Proven leadership in data architecture across multiple projects or business domains

  • Deep understanding of database internals and how data systems work under the hood

  • Experience with large-scale systems or high-volume datasets, with a focus on performance and scalability

  • Clear, structured communication and excellence in design documentation

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.

  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.

    We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours.

  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work.

  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace

  • A Culture of Excellence: We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.

  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.

  • Distributed work isn’t your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.

  • Feedback doesn't excite you. We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.

  • Change makes you uncomfortable. We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process

Our hiring process is structured as a sequence of steps. Moving forward is based on how well the previous step goes. This helps us stay focused, fair, and respectful of everyone’s time.

We will always:

  • Let you know clearly what the next step is

  • Share updates and feedback wherever possible

  • Invite questions if anything feels unclear

Not everyone progresses through every stage. That doesn’t mean you’re not great at what you do. Sometimes it’s about timing, team fit, or simply what we’re looking for at the moment.

Step 1: Express Your Interest

If this sounds like your kind of team and you’re ready to bring your craft to Lateral, we want to hear from you.

Please send us:

  • Your resume

  • A short note about what excites you about this role

  • Links to your work: GitHub/ Code snippets, portfolio, architecture /design docs, blog posts, or anything that shows us how you think and build

    Please don’t include anything sensitive or proprietary.
    If you’re sharing team projects, let us know what your specific contributions were.

We review every application with care. If there’s a fit, we’ll reach out to schedule next steps.

Step 2: Talent Partner Conversation

Purpose: A structured discussion with our People Experience team to delve into your career trajectory, motivations, and alignment with Lateral's values.

What to Expect:

  • In-depth questions about your past experiences and decision-making processes.

  • Exploration of your career goals and how they align with the role.

  • Discussion about our company culture, availability, compensation and other logistics

  • Motivators and demotivators.

  • Your life outside coding.

Preparation Tips:

  • Reflect on your career journey and pivotal moments.

  • Be ready to discuss challenges you've overcome and lessons learned.

  • Familiarize yourself with the Job Description, Lateral's mission and values.

Step 3: Technical interview

Purpose: Assess your technical proficiency and problem-solving abilities.
Format: A collaborative session with our engineering team, focusing on real-world scenarios relevant to the role.

What to Expect:

  • Problem-solving exercises/questions that mirror tasks you'd encounter in the position.

  • Discussions around your approach, reasoning, and solutions.

Preparation Tips:

  • Practice articulating your thought process clearly and concisely.

  • Be prepared to discuss in depth past projects and the technologies used.

Step 4: Take Home Assignment

Purpose: Provide a practical demonstration of your skills through a task resembling real work at Lateral.

Format: A take-home assignment or a live session, depending on the role.

What to Expect:

  • Tasks designed to reflect actual challenges faced in the position.

  • An opportunity to showcase your problem-solving and technical skills.

Preparation Tips:

  • Set aside uninterrupted time to focus.

  • Explain your decisions and assumptions.

Step 5: Operational interview

Purpose: Understand your approach to prioritizing, collaborating, shipping, and iterating.

What to expect:

  • How you prioritize and break down work.

  • How you collaborate across disciplines.

  • How you handle blockers, feedback, and iteration.

Preparation Tips:

  • Pick 1-2 meaningful projects you led or heavily contributed to.

  • Walk through your process: what worked, what didn’t, what you’d do differently.

  • Think about how you manage time, scope, and changing requirements.

Step 6: Reference Checks

Purpose:We believe references are about understanding, not just validation. We do not look for perfection, but to understand patterns, strengths, and context. We use them to learn how to support you best.

What to Expect:we’ll ask you for 2–3 people who’ve worked closely with you. These are often: former managers, senior peers or collaborators, mentors or people you've mentored.

What we ask: We focus on how you’ve grown, where you shine, how you like to be led, and what support sets you up for success. We want practical advice for making this a great fit for you.

Yes, we do backchannels too:We do this when we feel we need more context. We will check with you if there are folks we should avoid reaching out due to confidentiality or other reasons. And here’s our commitment: if anything surprising or unclear comes up in a backchannel, we’ll bring it directly to you. We believe in “no stories without you in the room.” You’ll always get the chance to share your side, context, or clarification.

Step 7: Offer

What Happens: If selected, you'll receive a comprehensive offer detailing compensation, and other pertinent information.

Our hiring process is designed to be thorough yet respectful, ensuring a mutual fit. We encourage candidates to engage actively, ask questions, and view this as a two-way exploration.

About the Role:
Are you an SDET who wants to define how AI agents are tested, evaluated and trusted in production?

The CrowdStrike Detonations and Threat Analysis Platform Engineering team is hiring a hands-on Software Development Engineer in Test. You'll build and maintain the functional, integration and performance automation that keeps our large-scale, cloud-based cybersecurity platform reliable. You'll also help shape how we test AI. Our core testing frameworks include agentic test generation and analysis, and we use eval-driven development (EDD) to validate the AI agents we build.

What You’ll Do:

  • Maintain and extend the agentic test generation and analysis tooling built into our major testing frameworks
  • Build AI-powered workflows and agent skill files that automate manual test toil, such as test data setup, failure triage and release validation
  • Maintain eval suites, golden datasets and scoring pipelines for our AI agents, scoring correctness, tool use, trajectory, faithfulness, safety, latency and cost
  • Enforce CI eval gates so that every change to prompts, models, tools or orchestration is measured before release, and feed production failures back into the eval sets
  • Detect and mitigate unreliable AI output, including hallucinated assertions, flaky or redundant tests, incorrect failure triage and judge bias
  • Design, run and analyze performance, load and stress tests to find bottlenecks and validate scalability across distributed services
  • Validate the integration of platform systems, services, data and applications, as well as customer-facing features end-to-end
  • Review product, system and agent designs for testability, evaluability, flaws and improvements
  • Share knowledge and contribute to the team's quality and evaluation standards

What You’ll Use:

  • Data & Messaging: MongoDB, MinIO, RabbitMQ, Kafka
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (EC2, S3, DynamoDB), Docker, Nomad, Terraform, Unix/Linux
  • CI/CD & Tooling: Git, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Jira, Bitbucket
  • Performance Testing: Locust, k6
  • AI/Agentic & Evals: LLM APIs, agent frameworks and LLM eval tooling

What You’ll Need:

  • 5+ years in software quality, including 3+ years of hands-on SDET or test automation development
  • Strong programming skills in at least one of Java, Node.js or Python, with Python preferred for eval and agent work
  • Proven experience designing, building and maintaining test frameworks integrated with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD)
  • Experience testing web services and APIs (REST, gRPC, JSON)
  • Hands-on experience with performance and load testing using tools such as Locust or k6, including designing realistic workloads and interpreting results (latency percentiles, throughput, error rates)
  • A skeptical, verification-first mindset toward AI output, with a clear sense of when to use deterministic assertions and when to use probabilistic evaluation
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points:

  • Prompt engineering and context or tool design for agents
  • Integrating performance tests into CI/CD and using observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch)

We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

As of mid 2025, our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 2 million businesses we serve each month. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark - and we get to help make that happen.

About the Role

We are seeking a Staff Product Designer who can lead high-impact product design work across multiple teams, connect adjacent product experiences and turn complex problem spaces into coherent shipped outcomes. You have spent 8+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy, AI-enabled or similarly sophisticated product experiences.

As a staff individual contributor, you will operate across product areas where the right solution depends on more than one roadmap, team or feature brief. You will partner deeply with Product, Engineering, Data, Research, Design leadership and customer-facing teams to frame the right problems, define product experience direction and help teams move from ambiguity to high-quality execution.

This role requires exceptional craft, strong product judgment and the ability to balance strategic influence with hands-on design work. You should be comfortable defining experience direction, mapping complex workflows, prototyping new interaction models, strengthening shared patterns and helping teams preserve quality through implementation.

Design systems are an important part of this role, but not the whole role. You will use systems, patterns, accessibility standards and reusable components to connect product experiences while still leading original, customer-centered design work for high-impact product areas.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You'll Do

  • Lead design strategy and execution for complex initiatives that span multiple teams, product surfaces or customer workflows

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, technical constraints, data signals and product strategy into clear experience direction

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to clarify problem spaces, sequence design work and align teams around high-quality outcomes

  • Create prototypes, workflows, interaction models and high-fidelity designs that make complex product ideas tangible and testable

  • Identify product experience gaps, design debt and cross-team inconsistencies, then turn them into practical improvements

  • Shape AI-enabled workflows, intelligent interfaces and automation-heavy experiences that give customers clarity, control and confidence

  • Strengthen shared patterns, design-system adoption, accessibility standards and implementation guidance across adjacent product areas

  • Mentor senior and lead designers through critique, coaching, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale

  • Collaborate effectively across US and India time zones in a 100% remote environment

What We Are Looking For

  • 8+ years of relevant product design experience, leading complex, ambiguous and high-impact initiatives across multiple teams or product areas

  • An exceptional portfolio that demonstrates staff-level craft, product judgment, customer empathy, systems thinking, measurable impact and shipped product quality

  • Experience shaping product direction beyond a single feature or team, with the ability to connect adjacent workflows into coherent customer experiences

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility, content quality and implementation detail

  • Proven experience across the design lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing

  • Strong prototyping fluency, including the ability to use Figma, Framer, AI coding tools or lightweight front-end code to make complex ideas tangible

  • Experience designing AI-powered, automation-heavy or intelligent product experiences where customers need transparency, control, trust and useful guidance

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to align teams through customer insight, business rationale, data, prototypes and craft

  • A collaborative, low-ego leadership style with a track record of mentoring designers, improving critique and raising standards

How You Work

  • You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking, prototyping and hands-on design execution

  • You lead through influence, clarity and credibility across teams that may not report into the same roadmap or operating rhythm

  • You are a maker as well as a strategist, using prototypes, AI-assisted tools and practical technical fluency to make ideas concrete quickly

  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people

  • You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates

  • You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design

Equal Opportunity

Leap Event Technology is a remote-friendly company. This position is open to any candidate in North America.

WHO WE ARE:

Leap is revolutionizing the event technology industry by empowering organizers to create experiences that are more engaging, more thrilling, and more impactful than ever before. Our all-in-one suite of ticketing, mobile apps, experiential marketing, and patron management tools, combined with our expert marketing services, allows organizers to drive nonstop engagement and capture all customer data across the entire guest journey.

In Attractions, that means powering timed-entry ticketing, capacity management, pricing analytics, and guest data for immersive experiences, touring exhibitions, seasonal attractions, and location-based entertainment. Iconic brands like Burning Man, D23, The Friends Experience, New York Comic Con, Brooklyn Botanic Garden, Fanatics Fest, and the NFL choose us to power their events.

Sounds interesting? Let’s talk.

THE ROLE

We’re seeking an energetic, highly organized Business Development Specialist to join our Attractions team and help grow one of Leap’s fastest-moving verticals. You’ll power the attractions pipeline and keep its deals moving, from mapping the market and booking discovery meetings to qualifying inbound interest, preparing proposals, and making sure every follow-up lands.

You’ll work hand in hand with our Head of Attractions and the wider commercial team, including Sales, Accounts Management, Client Partnerships, Sales Engineering and Enablement, and you’ll get a front-row seat to how deals in immersive and location-based entertainment come together. Expect your time to split roughly 60% building pipeline and 40% supporting active deals.

If you’ve ever walked out of an immersive exhibit or seasonal attraction wondering how it all runs behind the scenes, we’d love to hear from you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Build the Attractions pipeline

  • Own the Attractions market map. Build and maintain a target list of attractions operators including immersive experiences, touring exhibitions, museums, seasonal and holiday attractions, family entertainment centers, and themed LBE venues. Map the decision makers at each.
  • Run targeted outreach. Plan and execute personalized, multi-channel campaigns (email, phone, and LinkedIn) to book net-new discovery meetings for the Attractions team.
  • Qualify inbound interest. Be the first point of contact for attractions inquiries, qualify fit and timing quickly, and route strong leads to the right Account team member.
  • Revive stalled opportunities. Partner with appropriate Account team members to re-engage prospects that have gone quiet, especially ahead of seasonal launches and new openings.
  • Make the most of industry events. Lead pre-show and post-show outreach for attractions conferences such as IAAPA Expo: research attendees, book on-site meetings, and follow up promptly afterward.

Support active deals

  • Prepare for meetings. Pull together account research, attendee bios, and talking points before discovery calls and demos.
  • Keep follow-through tight. Capture meeting notes, discovery insights, and action items, then coordinate next steps across Sales, Account Management, Sales Engineering, and Onboarding and Implementation.
  • Build proposals and RFP responses. Work with Sales Enablement to assemble customized proposals, pricing quotes, presentations, and RFP responses for attractions clients.
  • Keep Salesforce accurate. Log activity, update account and opportunity records, and maintain clean pipeline data so the team can forecast with confidence.
  • Share what you're seeing. Track openings, expansions, and trends across the attractions industry, and bring insights back to Sales, Marketing, and Product.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Bachelor’s degree or at least 3 years of relevant work experience (attractions, live entertainment, hospitality, ticketing, or sales all count)
  • 1 to 3 years of experience in sales coordination, sales development (SDR/BDR), business development, or a client-facing role, ideally in SaaS, ticketing, or live entertainment
  • Clear, warm, and confident communication by email, phone, and video, with the ability to speak credibly with Attraction operators, producers, and venue teams
  • Strong organization skills and a habit of following through without being asked, and a knack for building processes that keep the team running smoothly
  • Experience with Salesforce or another CRM
  • Comfort working remotely and managing your own priorities as a self-starter
  • A curious, proactive mindset: you anticipate what the team and prospects need next and are eager to learn the business

YOU’LL THRIVE HERE IF…

  • You can’t visit an attraction without noticing the entry line, ticket flow, and what’s driving the gift shop
  • You follow what’s opening, touring, and expanding in immersive and location-based entertainment
  • You like being the person who keeps a deal moving and makes everyone around you more effective

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience working at or with an attraction, museum, immersive experience, theme park, or touring exhibition (operations, guest services, ticketing, or marketing all count)
  • Familiarity with ticketing or guest experience technology
  • Familiarity with the attractions industry, its associations and events (IAAPA, TEA)
  • Experience helping with RFPs, pricing quotes, or sales proposals

BENEFITS:

We offer

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Voluntary benefits
  • Generous PTO
  • Paid parental leave (following 12 months of continuous employment)
  • 401K Match
  • $200 event reimbursement
  • Access to learning & development opportunities through our LMS platform and peer-to-peer LeapU program

OFFICE INFORMATION:

Leap Event Technology is a remote-friendly company. However, we do offer the option of working in the office for employees located in Montréal (CAN), Pittsburgh (U.S.), Dallas (U.S.), Sydney (AUS). All of our offices are stocked with snacks and drinks and we provide a free lunch every week. We offer a monthly travel stipend, and even host the occasional themed party and happy hour!

If you don’t live near an office but happen to be visiting nearby, you can work from the office for as long as you need.

LEARN MORE:

The Cigna Group is seeking an attorney to join its Privacy & Innovation Governance team within Legal & Corporate Affairs. This attorney will provide legal counsel and support related to artificial intelligence (AI) and other emerging technologies, with a focus on monitoring and interpreting evolving AI laws and regulations and conducting legal reviews of AI use cases, with additional responsibilities supporting review and negotiation of AI-related contractual terms, as well as assisting intellectual property counsel with IP-related matters and enterprise initiatives.


The successful candidate will work closely with attorneys and professionals across Privacy & Innovation Governance, Enterprise Model Governance, Compliance, Information Security, Technology, Procurement, and the business to help enable responsible innovation while identifying and managing legal and regulatory risk.


Responsibilities


  • Monitor and analyze emerging federal, state, and international laws, regulations, regulatory guidance, and enforcement developments relating to artificial intelligence, machine learning, automated decision-making, and other emerging technologies.
  • Assess new and proposed AI legal requirements and support the development of practical guidance regarding their impact on The Cigna Group’s businesses, operations, and AI governance framework.
  • Maintain regulatory inventories, legal summaries, guidance, and other resources to support implementation of evolving AI requirements.
  • Conduct legal reviews of proposed AI and machine-learning use cases, identify applicable legal and regulatory requirements, and advise on risks associated with the development, acquisition, deployment, and use of AI systems.
  • Participate in enterprise AI governance processes and collaborate with Enterprise Model Governance and other stakeholders to provide legal guidance throughout the AI lifecycle.
  • Review, draft, and negotiate AI and intellectual property related provisions in technology, vendor, data, licensing, and other commercial agreements, including provisions addressing data use, model training, intellectual property, confidentiality, regulatory compliance, transparency, audit rights, liability, and generative AI.
  • Support the development and maintenance of standard AI and IP contractual provisions, negotiation guidance, playbooks, and other resources to promote consistent treatment of AI and IP-related legal risks.
  • Advise on the intersection of AI requirements with privacy and data protection laws and collaborate with other legal subject-matter experts on intellectual property, healthcare regulation, employment, consumer protection, and other applicable areas of law.
  • Support intellectual property counsel in reviewing and advising on employee intellectual property obligations, outside activity requests, and matters involving ownership, licensing, protection, and commercialization of intellectual property assets.
  • Assist intellectual property counsel with enterprise IP initiatives, including identifying and addressing IP risks associated with AI and emerging technologies and developing practical guidance and resources to protect proprietary assets.
  • Help develop, implement, and improve practical processes and workflows for AI use-case review and related IP legal support, including intake, triage, documentation, escalation, and tracking, to promote consistency and efficiency.
  • Partner with colleagues across Privacy & Innovation Governance and other enterprise functions to translate evolving legal requirements into practical policies, standards, controls, and business guidance.
  • Support the development and enhancement of enterprise policies, standards, training, and governance frameworks related to responsible AI and emerging technologies.
  • Provide practical, business-oriented legal advice that supports responsible innovation while appropriately managing legal and regulatory risk.

Qualifications


Required Qualifications


  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school.
  • Active license and good standing to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.
  • 3+ years of relevant legal experience in a law firm, corporate legal department, government agency, or combination thereof.
  • Experience with technology, privacy, data, commercial contracting, artificial intelligence, or related legal matters.
  • Strong legal research and analytical skills, including the ability to monitor, interpret, and communicate the implications of new and evolving laws and regulations.
  • Experience reviewing and negotiating technology, software, data, cloud, or vendor agreements.
  • Ability to translate legal requirements into practical processes and workflows, with a continuous-improvement mindset and attention to consistent execution.
  • Sound legal judgment, including the ability to identify material risks, recommend practical mitigations, and recognize when to seek guidance or escalate issues.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex legal requirements into clear and practical guidance.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with attorneys, compliance professionals, governance teams, technical teams, and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a rapidly evolving area of law.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience or demonstrated interest in artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, automated decision-making, or emerging technology law.
  • Familiarity with evolving U.S. and international legal and regulatory frameworks governing AI.
  • Experience conducting legal or regulatory reviews of technology or AI use cases.
  • Experience reviewing or negotiating contractual provisions addressing AI, data use, model training, intellectual property, or generative AI.
  • Experience with intellectual property matters, such as ownership, licensing, confidentiality, protection of proprietary assets, or employee IP obligations.
  • Experience developing or improving legal review processes, intake workflows, playbooks, templates, or other tools that improve consistency and efficiency.
  • Experience with privacy and data protection laws and their application to AI and emerging technologies.
  • Experience in healthcare, health insurance, pharmacy benefit management, financial services, or another highly regulated industry.
  • Experience working with multidisciplinary legal, compliance, governance, risk, or technology teams.

jobs.excerpt: EGNYTE YOUR CAREER.  SPARK YOUR PASSION. Egnyte is a place where we spark opportunities for amazing people.
jobs.description:
EGNYTE YOUR CAREER. SPARK YOUR PASSION.

Egnyte is a place where we spark opportunities for amazing people. We believe that every role has meaning, and every Egnyter should be respected. With23,000 customers worldwide and growing, you can make an impact by protecting their valuable data. When joining Egnyte, you’re not just landing a new career, you become part of a team of Egnyterswhodoers, thinkers, and collaborators are who embrace and live by our values:

Invested Relationships

Fiscal Prudence

Candid Conversations

ABOUT EGNYTE

Egnyte is the secure multi-cloud platform for content security and governance that enables organizations to better protect and collaborate on their most valuable content. Established in 2008, Egnyte has democratized cloud content security for more than 23,000 organizations, helping customers improve data security, maintain compliance, prevent and detect ransomware threats, and boost employee productivity on any app, any cloud, anywhere. For more information, visit.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Salesforce Administration team enables Egnyte by automating business processes, integrating sales and marketing tools, and maintaining Salesforce data integrity. We partner with Sales Operations to equip sales teamsforeffective prospecting and quoting, and with Finance to ensure accurate billing for customers and partners.

This role sits at the Finance end of that partnership. We run a ~900-user Salesforce org with Salesforce CPQ and Salesforce Billing at the center of quote-to-cash, integrated with NetSuite and a broader GTM stack. We are hiring someone who owns the Billing side of that stack end to end.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Own Salesforce Billing (primary focus, ~60% of the role)

  • Serve as the subject matter expert for Salesforce Billing (blng) — invoice generation and scheduling, invoice runs, credit and debit notes, payments and payment allocation, refunds, and revenue schedules.
  • Configure and maintain billing rules, tax rules, revenue recognition rules, finance books, finance periods, and legal entities; diagnose why an invoice line posted the way it did and correct it at the source.
  • Run and troubleshoot scheduled billing and payment jobs; investigate failed or stuck invoice runs, unbilled order products, and proration or co-term discrepancies.
  • Own billing reconciliation between Salesforce and NetSuite — investigate sync failures, mismatched amounts, and duplicate or orphaned records, and drive them to resolution with Finance.
  • Support month-end and quarter-end close: period locks, cutoff issues, aging and deferred revenue reporting, and the ad hoc "why doesn't this tie out" questions that arrive at 6pm on the last day of the quarter.
  • Partner with Finance and Revenue Accounting on audit requests, controls, and evidence for SOX-style reviews.

Support CPQ and the upstream quote lifecycle (~25%)

  • Administer Salesforce CPQ (SBQQ): product and price book setup, price rules, product rules, discount schedules, quote templates, and Advanced Approvals (SBAA).
  • Support amendments, renewals, upgrades, downgrades, and cancellations — and understand how each one lands downstream in orders, contracts, subscriptions, and invoices.
  • Trace defects across the full quote→order→contract→subscription→invoice→paymentchain, andidentify where inthat chain the problemactually originatedrather than where it surfaced.

Generalsenior administration(~15%)

  • Handle core admin work across Sales Cloud, Revenue Cloud, and managed packages: user and license management, profiles and permission sets, validation rules, Flows, reports and dashboards.
  • Complete regular internal system audits and prepare the org for Salesforce seasonal releases and managed package upgrades; maintain SME-level knowledge of what each release changes for CPQ and Billing.
  • Coordinate the evaluation, scoping, and delivery of new development requests, including effort estimates and impact analysis.
  • Perform thorough system testing in sandboxes before promotion, following the team's change management and deployment process.
  • Work with the rest of the admin team to strengthen the processes that govern administrative, development, and change management activity.

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Minimum 4 years as a Salesforce administrator, including at least 2 years of hands-on Salesforce Billing configuration and support — not just exposure through a CPQ role.
  • Demonstrated ownership of end-to-end quote-to-cash: order management, invoicing, amendments, renewals, credits, payments, and billing reconciliation.
  • Working knowledge of the Billing and CPQ data model (blngand SBQQ objects) and how records relate across the lifecycle.
  • Familiarity with an integrated ERP, ideally NetSuite, and with the failure modes of ERP–Salesforce integrations.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex CPQ and Billing issues while protecting data integrity, and to work effectively with Finance, Sales Operations, and other cross-functional partners.
  • Proven ability to meet deadlines, prioritize competing requests, and manage laterally and upward.
  • Ability to communicate clearly at all levels of the organization, to reconcile conflicting information from multiple sources, and to distinguish what a user asked for from what theyactually need.
  • Creative and analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills.

Preferred

  • Salesforce Certified Administrator and Salesforce CPQ Specialist; Revenue Cloud Consultant or Billing-specific credentials are a strong plus.
  • Experience with subscription and usage-based billing models in a SaaS business.
  • Exposure to tax engines (e.g., Avalara), payment gateways, and dunning or collections processes.
  • Experience with middleware such as Boomi orCeligo.
  • Experience supporting partner, reseller, or multi-entity billing.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce's Revenue Cloud roadmap and what amove offlegacy CPQ would involve.

BENEFITS

  • Competitive salaries
  • Medical insurance and healthcare benefits for you and your family
  • Fully paid premiums for life insurance
  • Flexible hours and PTO
  • Gym reimbursement
  • Childcare reimbursement
  • Group term life insurance

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

At Egnyte, we celebrate our unique differences and thrive on our diversity for our employees, our products, our customers, our investors, and our communities. Our global Egnyte Employee Communities (EECs) support representation and inclusion across our diverse workplace. Egnyters are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work and to appreciate the many differences that collectively make Egnyte a higher-performing company and a great place to be.

Any employees with questions or concerns about equal employment opportunities in the workplace are encouraged to bring these issues to the attention of . Egnyte will not allow any form of retaliation against employees who raise issues of equal employment opportunity. If employees feel they have been subjected to any such retaliation, they should contact . To ensure the workplace is free of artificial barriers, violation of this policy including any improper retaliatory conduct will lead to discipline, up to and including discharge. All employees must cooperate with all investigations conducted pursuant to this policy.

jobs.excerpt: About UsShorthand exists to empower creative teams to produce and publish beautiful, transformative content radically faster.
jobs.description:
About Us

Shorthand exists to empower creative teams to produce and publish beautiful, transformative content radically faster. We've begun our journey by creating an easy-to-use platform for one of the most creatively and technically demanding use cases on the web — immersive feature stories — and we're proud to count many of the world's best known and most discerning publishers, brands, not-for-profits and universities as loyal customers.

Shorthand is a growing, investor-backed company with customers on every continent (except Antarctica!), and there's never been a more exciting time to join our band of geeks with art and heart.

We're looking for an entrepreneurial Senior Account Executive to join our Sales team, based in North America (Washington DC, NYC, or Boston preferred; other East Coast locations considered) on a fully remote basis.

What you'll be doing

The mission of Shorthand is to create a beautifully informed world. To do that, we need to build a platform that makes it easy to create immersive reading experiences for the web, because it would otherwise be unaffordable and painfully cumbersome for organisations to produce this type of content.

Our Senior Account Executives are a big part of the Shorthand magic. This role is responsible for building pipeline, opening new enterprise relationships, and driving complex consultative sales cycles.

You'll engage both business and technical stakeholders — including marketing, content, editorial, digital experience and web platform teams — and operate autonomously across the full sales cycle, from prospecting through to close. This is an ideal role for someone who thrives in early-stage product commercialisation and enjoys creating structure, messaging and momentum in a new market category.

You'll join our Sales team and report to the Head of Sales.

In this role you'll:

  • Build and manage a disciplined outbound pipeline targeting enterprise organisations.
  • Prospect into marketing, content, communications, digital experience and web platform teams within medium and large enterprises.
  • Develop multi-threaded relationships across both business and technical buying groups.
  • Create and execute strategic account plans for named target accounts.
  • Become a trusted advisor by understanding customer priorities and demonstrating how Shorthand supports their strategic objectives.
  • Build long-term relationships with senior stakeholders while driving new business and expansion opportunities.
  • Develop tailored proposals and presentations that address customer needs and business outcomes.
  • Own commercial negotiations and successfully close complex enterprise opportunities.
  • Forecast pipeline accurately, including expected close date, projected deal size and probability.
  • Work collaboratively with Customer Success, Sales, Channel Partners, Growth, Marketing, Product and Engineering to deliver outstanding customer outcomes and provide valuable market feedback.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has a proven track record of building outbound pipeline and closing enterprise SaaS deals in complex buying environments.
  • Is comfortable prospecting into medium and large enterprises and engaging multiple stakeholder groups across marketing, content, communications, editorial, digital and web platform teams.
  • Can demonstrate success growing strategic accounts through a combination of new business acquisition, expansion and executive relationship building.
  • Has experience selling CMS, digital publishing, martech, DXP or related technology solutions into enterprise organisations.
  • Is commercially driven, highly autonomous, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment with limited structure and high ownership.
  • Is technically credible and confident discussing CMS workflows, integrations and implementation considerations with customer web and platform teams.
  • Can independently run discovery, product demonstrations and commercial conversations without relying heavily on presales or solution engineering support.
  • Has strong consultative selling skills and can connect Shorthand's platform capabilities to strategic customer objectives around content, storytelling, engagement and digital experience.
  • Communicates exceptionally well in both written and verbal formats, and can simplify complex concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Learns quickly, prioritises effectively, and maintains high attention to detail while managing multiple enterprise sales cycles simultaneously.
  • Thrives working remotely and collaboratively across distributed teams and time zones.
  • Brings curiosity, resilience and initiative, and enjoys helping shape go-to-market strategy for emerging products and categories.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Significant experience successfully selling enterprise marketing solutions to CEOs, CMOs, VPs and Directors of Marketing, Content, Communications, Editorial and related functions.
  • Experience selling into organisations using WordPress, Adobe Experience Manager, Sitecore, Contentful, Optimizely, Drupal or similar CMS/DXP platforms.
  • Experience navigating technical validation processes with digital, engineering or web platform teams.
  • Ability to independently deliver product demonstrations and manage technical discovery conversations without dedicated presales support.
  • Experience introducing new products to market.
  • Proven track record of closing large, strategic, high-quality deals.
  • Proven success in both direct and partner-led sales.
  • Technical aptitude or background in technology is highly regarded.
  • A consultative sales style and experience selling solutions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven ability to sell collaboratively across multiple internal stakeholders and teams.

Personality Attributes

  • You are a proactive self-starter who doesn't need to be told what to do and is resourceful in finding solutions.
  • You are collaborative, consultative and not afraid to get your hands dirty.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment and possess a high level of curiosity.
  • You are goal-oriented, resilient and motivated by achieving outstanding results.
  • You are a supportive and proactive team player.
  • You love working remotely.
  • You are tech-savvy and excited to become an expert in the Shorthand platform.

Why work for us

We offer:

  • Fully remote working, flexible hours and a co-working allowance if you'd like one.
  • True autonomy, with the freedom to own and grow your territory.
  • The opportunity to shape our enterprise sales motion as we continue to grow across North America.
  • A category-defining product trusted by leading global brands, publishers, universities and not-for-profits.
  • The opportunity to work in a growing SaaS company that's still small enough for you to make a real impact.
  • A home office allowance, laptop and any peripherals you need to do your best work.
  • An Employee Share Option Plan for all team members.
  • A Health & Wellness Allowance together with access to coaching and counselling services.
  • A 401(k) plan and 100% employer-paid healthcare premiums for US-based team members.
  • Paid parental leave if you're growing your tribe.
  • A proudly carbon-neutral organisation, taking climate action with Trace as part of our broader sustainability strategy.
  • A base salary range of US$110,000–125,000, with additional variable commission. Actual compensation will depend on your skills, experience and local market benchmarks.

Shorthand's interview process

We value direct communication and want to be transparent about how we hire. Our process includes:

  1. An initial Zoom conversation with the hiring manager.
  2. A take-home task using our platform (approximately 2–4 hours).
  3. Panel interviews with members of the team, including our CEO.
  4. Reference and background checks before a formal offer is made.

Our workplace is 100% distributed and all interviews are conducted virtually. Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process.
