jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the roleAt Samsara, we're looking for a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to help turn growing Telematics products into major businesses. Our new product bets include routing and workforce management for physical operations.
The portfolio has paying customers and early traction. You'll help shape what comes next, working directly with customers to understand their operations, test ideas and build solutions they choose to use. You'll stay close to the work through production, customer adoption and scale.
This is a technical leadership role with substantial hands-on engineering. You'll define important problems and make product and technical decisions alongside Product, Design and Engineering partners. You'll bring the judgement to move forward when requirements are incomplete, and the influence to align other teams around a clear direction.

What you will do

  • Work directly with customers and customer-facing teams to understand unmet needs, test assumptions and identify opportunities worth pursuing. Agree on success measures with Product and Design before investing in a solution.
  • Lead ambiguous initiatives end to end, from discovery and prototypes through production rollout, adoption and iteration. Use customer feedback and product data to decide what to improve, expand or stop.
  • Write and ship code on the critical path. Work across services, APIs and customer-facing experiences as the problem requires, combining technical depth with the ability to learn unfamiliar parts of the product.
  • Set technical direction for your area and align the teams needed to deliver it. Make pragmatic architecture choices that support rapid learning today and reliable growth over time.
  • Own the production quality of what you build. Design for correctness, reliability and performance, plan safe rollouts, and use operational evidence to address the constraints that emerge as usage grows.
  • Increase the effectiveness of the engineers around you through design and code reviews, mentoring senior engineers, and removing recurring obstacles to delivery. Share context and decisions so others can move independently.

About the role:

In this role, you will:

  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

What you will bring

  • A track record of shipping customer-facing products and growing them beyond their initial launch. You can explain your contribution to measurable outcomes such as adoption, revenue growth, retention, customer efficiency or cost to serve.
  • Strong product judgement. You have worked directly with customers, clarified poorly defined problems and made decisions using evidence, including changing direction when an initial idea did not work.
  • Deep hands-on software engineering ability, with recent experience designing, implementing and operating production systems. You can move from a prototype to maintainable software and explain the trade-offs along the way.
  • Experience scaling products and the systems behind them. You know how to identify the next constraint, balance speed with reliability, and make technical investments that support customer and business growth.
  • Technical leadership across team boundaries. You have built alignment without formal authority, made other engineers more effective, and communicated difficult choices clearly to technical and business partners.

Experience that could be useful
Experience building B2B software through an early growth stage, or working on routing, workforce management or other software for physical operations. We value evidence of learning a complex customer domain and delivering results; previous industry experience is helpful, rather than essential.


What success looks like
Customers adopt the capabilities you help build and can see the benefit in their day-to-day operations. The products remain dependable as usage grows. Your technical decisions support measurable business progress, and the teams around you can deliver more effectively because of your work.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Here at Hometap, we’re collaborative, passionate, and always ready to roll up our sleeves to create solutions that help people get more out of homeownership — and out of life. Our first product, a home equity investment, gives homeowners the opportunity to quickly access the equity they’ve built in their home to pay for what’s most important to them, from handling debt to finally making much-needed renovations, without taking on debt.

We work hard, and have some fun along the way, too. You don’t have to take our word for it: The Boston Globe and Forbes have recognized us as a great place to work, and we’ve been honored for our commitment to innovation in the fintech space by Inc., HousingWire, and more!

In case you need any more convincing, we also provide competitive compensation, healthcare coverage, generous PTO, a meaningful equity package, and a strong culture with plenty of opportunities for team-building and camaraderie.

Interested in joining us on our mission to make homeownership less stressful and more accessible? We’d love to talk.

Who You Are

We're growing our team and looking for ambitious sales professionals who care about getting it right for the homeowner. In this role, you'll be a homeowner's main point of contact from first call to close: connecting with inbound leads, educating them on Hometap's home equity investment, answering their questions, and guiding them through the application process. You'll own a full pipeline and keep every application moving.

You're a strong fit if you've carried a quota and have a track record of closing, and you pair that drive with empathy in every conversation. You stay organized across a high volume of daily calls, adapt easily when priorities shift, and hold a high bar for ethics and compliance. Remote, North America, Full Time, Individual Contributor, +6 years of experience

Who We Are

Yuno is the AI-native operating system of global commerce, powering the financial infrastructure of enterprise merchants, banks, and wallets. With a single API, Yuno connects them to pay-ins, payouts, fraud prevention, KYC/KYB, and stablecoins globally, so they can operate everywhere with a single integration.
Agnostic by design, Yuno offers connectivity to 1,000+ payment methods and 460+ integrations in 190+ countries, optimizing acceptance rates, reducing costs, and strengthening security through specialized AI agents that learn from every transaction on the network. Global brands run their payments on Yuno, including Arcos Dorados (McDonald's), NetEase Games, GoFundMe, inDrive, and Rappi. Partner Portfolio Management

The Training Specialist owns the training that prepares our customer service associates and leaders to succeed. You will work closely with Customer Service leaders, Quality, Process Improvement, Workforce Management, Product, and other partners to keep training current as products and processes change. You will also measure whether training is working by tracking its impact on readiness, quality, productivity, and customer experience. This role calls for strong facilitation skills, sound independent judgment, reliable follow-through, and the ability to make complicated information easy to understand.

What You Will Do

Training Needs Analysis and Program Planning

  • Analyze quality results, customer feedback, performance data, process changes, and leader input to identify skill and knowledge gaps across customer service teams.

  • Set learning objectives and success measures for each training program.

Curriculum Design and Development

  • Design new hire and ongoing training programs, including deciding on content, sequence, delivery method (classroom, virtual, or blended), practice activities, and assessment approach.

  • Create and maintain facilitator guides, learner materials, job aids, practice exercises, and assessments that meet company standards.

Facilitation and Coaching

  • Lead instructor-led and virtual new hire training for customer service associates on products, systems, policies, and customer workflows.
  • Delivering ongoing skill development, product release, process change, and refresher training for frontline associates and people leaders.
  • Adjust delivery in real time based on learner needs, pace, and understanding.
  • Provide structured coaching during training and the transition to live customer work, partnering with supervisors to create development plans for employees who need extra support.
  • Stay current on the systems and workflows being taught through calibration sessions, process reviews, and regular hands-on practice.

Readiness Assessment and Program Evaluation

  • Evaluate learner knowledge and skills through observation, practice scenarios, knowledge checks, and readiness assessments.
  • Determine whether each learner meets readiness standards and recommend to leaders whether the associate should move into production, receive extended training, or receive additional support.
  • Analyze training results and feedback from learners and stakeholders to judge program effectiveness, and recommend changes to content, delivery, and follow-up reinforcement.

Program Administration

Coordinate training schedules, rosters, system access, training environments, and materials with Workforce Management and leaders.

  • Maintain accurate training records and reports in the learning management system and other approved tools.
  • Protect confidential, proprietary, and health information by following all privacy, security, and records handling requirements.
  • Support other training, knowledge management, and operational readiness priorities as assigned.

  • 4+ years of training experience.

  • Strong facilitation, coaching, and communication skills.
  • Experience developing training materials, job aids, and assessments.
  • Ability to analyze performance gaps and evaluate learner readiness.
  • Strong organizational and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Customer service or contact-center training experience.
  • Healthcare or other regulated-industry experience.
  • Experience with LMS and virtual learning platforms.
  • Experience supporting product, system, or process changes.
  • Experience facilitating and managing training programs for geographically distributed or remote teams.
  • L&D instructional design or related experience.

jobs.title: Risk & Compliance Specialist
jobs.excerpt: We're Proof, a high-growth startup in the legal tech industry, founded in 2017.
jobs.description:
We're Proof, a high-growth startup in the legal tech industry, founded in 2017. We offer a best-in-class legal services platform used by thousands of law firms and property management companies. Our platform enables law firms and collections parties to access efficient, transparent, and accessible legal and document delivery services, traditionally out of reach. We are on a path to double our business this year and are building a team to help us scale rapidly.

We welcome individuals from all backgrounds who are eager to help build a future where legal services are readily accessible, affordable, and efficient. If you have curiosity, passion, and a collaborative spirit to drive change in an outdated industry, we want you on our team.

About the Role:

As a Risk & Compliance Specialist, you’ll review cases, gather evidence, take enforcement action, and keep compliance records accurate. You’ll also communicate with Proof’s users and support other teams across the company.

You’ll follow documented procedures to handle standard cases on your own, document your work thoroughly, and escalate unusual or high-stakes situations. Success in this role means resolving risks quickly, producing accurate, well-documented cases, and applying compliance rules consistently, even at high volume.

What You'll Do:

Investigations & Risk

  • Review incoming cases, decide which need attention first, and take action based on the type of case and the evidence.
  • Gather and document evidence; call, text, or email as needed to gather context and discuss irregularities or recurring patterns.
  • Follow documented procedures to handle standard cases independently, and escalate unusual, unclear, or high-stakes situations.
  • Keep a closer eye on accounts under review: follow up on open cases and record new findings on a regular cadence.
  • Execute compliance actions and assess coverage impact; alert cross-functional stakeholders as needed.
  • Handle escalation calls disputing investigation outcomes; communicate resolution actions clearly and professionally.

Signal Detection & Monitoring

  • Monitor and action daily alerts and signals indicating anomalies.
  • Surface pattern observations within cases and server behavior; escalate larger or recurring trends.

Compliance

  • Process identity document submissions for new applicants and document renewals; ensure documentation is complete and meets eligibility requirements.
  • Support weekly compliance document maintenance: action expired documents and send compliance outreach communications.
  • Support ad hoc internal requests and compliance-related projects.

Server Communications & Enablement

  • Handle inbound account update communications and outbound compliance outreach with contractors.
  • Contribute to the creation and maintenance of external-facing Help Center articles, ensuring content accurately reflects current processes and requirements.

Data, Reporting & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Track personal performance metrics.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally within the Marketplace Supply organization; participate in Product meetings and submit feature requests as needed.
  • Contribute to team process improvement efforts; surface observations and suggestions that support consistency and scalability.
  • Assist with account setup, compliance document collection, and activation processing.
  • Provide ad hoc support and contribute to marketplace projects as needed.

What You'll Bring:

  • 2-3 years of experience in risk and compliance, trust and safety, operations, or contractor management, preferably within a two-sided marketplace or technology platform.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct structured case reviews, including triage, evidence gathering, clear documentation, and sound enforcement judgment, while following established frameworks and playbooks.
  • Familiarity with compliance documentation, credentialing, and eligibility workflows; ability to apply rules consistently across varied cases.
  • Comfortable with data and business intelligence tools (SQL proficiency is a plus); experience tracking and owning personal performance metrics.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage a high volume of cases across multiple case types simultaneously while maintaining thoroughness and quality.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience drafting clear, professional user-facing communications and handling server escalation calls; experience with independent contractor communications preferred.
  • A collaborative, proactive mindset with a genuine interest in platform integrity, compliance, and operational excellence.

Compensation

  • Salary range $53,000 - $55,000 based on experience and location

Benefits

  • Full time, remote, salary position
  • Medical, dental, vision, disability insurance, and 401k available
  • Phone and Internet monthly stipend
  • Flexible time off (paid planned and sick time, and paid holidays)
  • Necessary equipment provided

Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. Cribl Stream provides users a new level of observability, intelligence and control over their real-time data.   • Experience with authorization and authentication standards such as Oauth2, OpenID Connect, LDAP and SAML is a plus.
  • Comfort with significant research and discovery before coding begins.

  • Strong sense of ownership with focus on high quality and high performing deliverables.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written; ability to explain complex technical topics to both internal and external stakeholders with ease and in remote/distributed environments.
  • Insatiable curiosity – one of our core values is a tenet to being a great engineer at Cribl. Be willing and eager to learn new technologies and products built by other companies.

jobs.description:
Join the elite team at QDSS, where our engineers are at the forefront of developing cutting-edge Aerospace, Defense, Space, and Medical Device products. Your work will make a real impact, contributing to the core of engineering solutions that drive technological advancements.

Quest Defense Systems & Solutions (QDSS) is seeking an experienced Systems Engineer to support the design, modernization, and modification of complex nuclear power plant systems. This role will work across multidisciplinary engineering teams to evaluate plant-level requirements, support system and subsystem design, and ensure proposed changes meet applicable safety, regulatory, licensing, and operational requirements.

The ideal candidate will bring strong nuclear power design engineering experience with specific knowledge of GE-designed Boiling Water Reactor (BWR) plants. This position requires a systems-level understanding of how mechanical, electrical, instrumentation and controls (I&C), software, hardware, and FPGA-based systems interact within a nuclear power environment. Experience with reactor protection, nuclear I&C, plant modernization, and legacy GE BWR architectures is highly valued.

This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in the United States. Candidates must be US Citizens or US Permanent Residents.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Translate plant-level, operational, and nuclear safety requirements into allocated system and subsystem requirements.
  • Decompose and allocate requirements across mechanical, electrical, hardware, software, FPGA, instrumentation, and control implementations.
  • Develop, maintain, and review system descriptions, design specifications, interface requirements, Interface Control Documents (ICDs), cabinet drawings, elementary drawings, and connection/route drawings.
  • Evaluate proposed changes to mechanical, electrical, process, instrumentation, control, protection, and safety systems.

  • Safety-related and important-to-safety systems

Engineering Analysis

  • Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA/FMECA)

  • Design-basis evaluations
  • System safety and failure analysis

  • Experience with Reactor Protection Systems (RPS) and Emergency Core Cooling Systems (ECCS).
  • Experience with nuclear digital I&C systems.
  • Experience supporting BWR plant modification, modernization, or life-extension programs.
  • Experience with nuclear system safety, reliability, and failure analysis.
  • Experience working within an NQA-1 and/or 10 CFR 50 Appendix B quality assurance environment.
  • Experience evaluating legacy nuclear designs and translating existing design information into modern system requirements.
  • Systems-level experience spanning mechanical, electrical, I&C, software, hardware, and FPGA disciplines.

The QDSS Advantage:

At QDSS, our advantage is purpose-driven work, collaborative teams, and complex challenges that push boundaries and build lasting impact. You’ll grow your career while contributing to mission-critical programs that demand excellence and shape the future.

What You’ll Find Here

jobs.description:
About Strategic Partnerships at Mercury:

The Strategic Partnerships team drives customer growth, product expansion, and strategic advantage through high-impact partner relationships. We build and manage partnerships across the startup ecosystem: accounting firms, VCs, investors, ecommerce partners, incorporators, platforms, and financial institutions. We work cross-functionally with Product, GTM, Finance, Legal, Risk, and Operations to unlock new distribution channels, expand product capabilities, and strengthen Mercury's position as the leading financial platform for ambitious companies.

About the Role:

This is a ground-floor opportunity to build something that doesn't exist yet at Mercury.

Our team is growing fast and we've built most of our partnerships business bottom-up through accounting firms, VCs, accelerators, and incorporators. That motion works. But the next chapter is different: large-scale platform deals, embedded finance arrangements, and distribution partnerships that put Mercury in front of thousands of businesses through a single signed agreement.

This is a pure hunter role. You'll own Mercury's most ambitious enterprise and platform targets and be measured on deals that create real distribution leverage. The best ones will embed Mercury as the financial layer inside platforms, tools, and ecosystems that thousands or millions of businesses already use. You'll find the right targets, get yourself in the room, and architect deals that go well beyond a simple referral or co-marketing arrangement: embedded finance structures, deep API integrations, and distribution arrangements that neither side has done before.

What You'll Do:

Win platform-distribution deals

  • Identify, target, and pursue the highest-leverage partnership opportunities in Mercury's addressable universe: category leaders across ecommerce (Shopify), social selling (TikTok, Meta), legal (Clio), productivity (Google), and any platform where ambitious businesses already live, then make Mercury the financial layer underneath them.
  • Close deals where Mercury becomes natively embedded in a platform, reaching thousands of potential customers through a single signed agreement.
  • Own outreach and relationship development at the senior executive and C-suite level, leveraging your existing network to open doors and build new ones fast
  • Drive deals through the full lifecycle: from initial outreach and business case development through term negotiation, legal close, integration scoping, and launch

Structure first-of-a-kind deals

  • Architect bespoke partnership structures: embedded finance arrangements, deep API integrations, co-distribution models, and joint product experiences that create strategic lock-in and measurable impact
  • Leverage Mercury's full product suite (banking,* payments, cards, APIs, MCP, CLI tooling) as strategic currency in negotiations, matching the right capabilities to each partner's specific needs
  • Develop and pressure-test the business case for each partnership, modeling deal economics and aligning cross-functional stakeholders at Mercury

Own the channel from day one

  • You will build Mercury's enterprise partnerships motion from scratch, with full ownership over strategy, targeting, deal structure, and execution.
  • Define the playbook: who we pursue, how we position, how we negotiate, and what success looks like a year from now
  • Have a direct line to Mercury's leadership team and cross-functional leadership.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, and GTM to design the infrastructure needed to support large, complex partner integrations

What We're Looking For:

  • 8-10+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, or enterprise sales including meaningful time at a high-growth technology or similar company
  • A track record of closing platform-scale deals. You've closed agreements that unlocked distribution at scale, embedding your product into a platform, ecosystem, or distribution channel that reached far more customers than a direct sales motion ever could.
  • An existing network you can activate immediately. Your relationships are in the right places. You have been actively involved in your industry - speaking at conferences, events, and are regarded as a thought leader in your space.
  • Experience at a high-growth, category-defining technology company. You know what it means to move fast, operate with limited resources, and close deals before the window closes.
  • Deep experience structuring embedded or API-driven deals. You understand how technical integrations create commercial moats, and you know how to negotiate them
  • Strong commercial and financial fluency. You can model deal economics, structure complex incentive arrangements, and align on terms with sophisticated counterparts
  • The ability to operate in ambiguity and build from scratch. Mercury has not had a dedicated enterprise partnerships function. You're energized by this ground floor opportunity and the chance to build it from scratch.
  • Technical credibility. You don't need to write code, but you can hold a substantive conversation about APIs, integration architecture, and what it means to embed financial infrastructure into a third-party platform
  • Strong plus: experience in fintech, payments, embedded finance, or AI-native products

* Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

jobs.description:
At Mitratech, we are a team of innovators focused on building world-class products that simplify operations in the Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR functions. We are a close-knit, globally dispersed team that thrives in an ecosystem that supports individual excellence and takes pride in its diverse and inclusive work culture centered around great people practices, learning opportunities, and having fun! Our culture is the ideal blend of entrepreneurial spirit and enterprise investment, enabling the chance to move at a rapid pace with some of the most complex, leading-edge technologies available.

For over 35 years, the experts at Mitratech have been focused on solving the complex needs. Today, we serve 20,000 client companies of all sizes globally, representing 30% of the Fortune 500 and over 500,000 users in over 160 countries.

As we continue to grow, we’re always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work!

Job Overview

We are building a dedicated finance presence inside each of our business divisions, and this role is one of them. As Director, Operational Finance, you will be the embedded finance partner to a division’s CEO and leadership team: the person who knows the division’s numbers, helps leaders make better decisions with them, and makes sure what happens in the division is reflected accurately in company-wide planning.

You will report to the SVP of Finance, with a dotted-line relationship with your division’s CEO & the Head of FP&A, and you will be working alongside the Corporate Finance team that runs central processes. This is an individual contributor role with significant visibility and a clear path to growth within the organization.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Partner with divisional leadership. Serve as the primary corporate finance and financial operations contact for your assigned division, working closely with the division CEO and the division executive team.
  • Drive consistency across divisions. Translate corporate FP&A reporting standards into division-specific execution, so that definitions and metrics (for example, bookings standardization, ARR-related metrics, and margin expansion) are applied the same way in every division.
  • Shape the plan. Bring divisional context, assumptions, and priorities into the annual budget run by Corporate Finance, and keep the division aligned with company-wide planning cycles.
  • Assist with forecasting. Assist division leadership on forecasting updates, performance tracking, and operational improvement. Act as financial chief of staff to the division CEO while staying closely aligned with Corporate Finance and overall company goals.
  • Flag risks early. Identify and escalate critical items, risks, and variances across bookings, retention, and costs to both divisional leadership and the central FP&A organization and support the work to resolve them.
  • Find the efficiencies. Identify and drive operational efficiencies and develop topline cost-savings and upside ideas in partnership with divisional leaders.
  • Own adjustment tracking. Own tracking of below-the-line (BTL) adjustment realization for your division, and report progress to Corporate Finance to support lender and board reporting.
  • Support the close and reporting cycle. Provide divisional input to the monthly and quarterly close, perform variance analysis, and prepare divisional commentary for management and board reporting. Deliver ad hoc analysis for division and corporate leadership as needs arise.
  • Partner Across the Organization. In addition to working with finance, partner with and influence other shared services roles such as Deal Desk, Operations, AR, Sales Operations, and Sales Compensation to drive the division forward and reduce friction.
  • Support M&A. Lead synergy identification and tracking for acquisitions that land in your division and provide divisional input to Corporate Finance on diligence and integration into company financials.

Requirements & Skills:

  • 7–10 years of progressive experience in FP&A, business finance, or finance partnering, including time in a SaaS business.
  • Working knowledge of SaaS metrics, including ARR, bookings, retention, and margin, and the ability to explain what is driving them.
  • Strong financial modeling and variance analysis skills, with the judgment to know which numbers matter to an executive audience.
  • Experience partnering directly with senior business leaders, such as a CEO, GM, or head of sales, and influencing without direct authority.
  • Superior written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn analysis into recommendations and to use numbers to tell a story.
  • Experience in a private-equity-backed company, including lender or sponsor reporting.
  • Experience with M&A, including synergy tracking or post-acquisition integration.
  • Experience with a modern planning platform (Pigment preferred) or similar tools such as Adaptive, Anaplan, or Planful.
  • Experience with a multi-product or multi-entity software business.

Education:

  • A bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.excerpt: Salary range: $90K to $110K, plus equityAbout BadgeMobile wallets now account for roughly as many in-store purchases as cash, and unlike cash, they're still climbing.
jobs.description:
Salary range: $90K to $110K, plus equity

About Badge

Mobile wallets now account for roughly as many in-store purchases as cash, and unlike cash, they're still climbing. Most brands still treat them as a place to store a card.
Badge is the infrastructure that changes that. We give enterprise brands and platforms one integration to issue and operate passes and cards across Apple, Google, and Samsung Wallet. Loyalty cards, stored value, memberships, IDs, and tickets, all living on the surface customers already carry, updating in real time, with no app download and no new account.
The platform meets teams wherever they work: a no-code UI for marketers, flexible APIs for developers, an embed SDK for platform partners, and an MCP server so AI agents can build on it directly. That powers in-wallet push notifications, location-based messages, offers, tap-to-redeem, and more.
We are a fast-growing team backed by leading investors including TTV Capital, Stripe, Synchrony Ventures, and Infinity Ventures, and trusted by companies like Hoka, Blackhawk Network, Shift4, and Yale University. We value sharp thinking, fast execution, and a real understanding of how customers behave in a mobile-first world.


Position overview

Join Badge as a Brand and Growth Designer to shape how the world sees and experiences Badge. You'll own design for our growth marketing, including the website, content, social, email, and sales materials. You'll also work closely with product to deepen knowledge and accuracy across the Badge product suite.
This role is a great fit for a versatile designer who loves ownership, moves quickly between brand and sales enablement, and gets energized when their work drives pipeline, closes deals, and helps customers succeed.

Questions we're exploring

* How do we make mobile wallets feel like an obvious, must-have channel to enterprise marketers who haven't thought about them before?
* How do we speak to three different audiences (marketers, developers, and platform partners) without our story fragmenting?
* How do we show wallet experiences like push notifications, location-based offers, and tap-to-redeem in ways that are visual and easy to understand?
* How do we give sales and marketing a template system they can use on their own while keeping the brand consistent?
* How can the marketing site and the product feel like one connected experience, from first visit to first pass created?

Core Responsibilities

  • Orchestrate the Badge website. Design, build, and iterate on trybadge.com in Webflow in collaboration with agencies and leadership as needed. Website design includes landing pages, product and solution pages, and campaign/event pages. Work with marketing to test and improve what converts.
  • Enable sales and leadership. Build and refine sales decks, one-pagers, customer case studies, and executive and investor presentations, and maintain a template library the team can use on their own.
  • Power content and social. Create blog visuals, product diagrams, and LinkedIn assets (posts, carousels, event and launch graphics) that make wallet experiences easy to understand.
  • Bring Badge to life at events. Design conference and event collateral, booth graphics, signage, and swag that make Badge stand out in person.
  • Build email that scales. Design reusable email templates for newsletters, product updates, and nurture campaigns.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Maintain and evolve Badge's visual identity across every touchpoint, and contribute to our design system, brand guidelines, and scalable templates, so every new asset is faster to make and stays consistent.
  • Design with AI. Use tools like Claude, Figma AI, and other emerging tools to explore concepts, speed up production, and prototype. AI helps you move faster; your judgment and craft decide what ships.
  • Collaborate across the team. Work with marketing, sales, product, and engineering to understand goals, give and get feedback, and ship work that moves the business.
  • Work closely with product design. Partner with the product team to keep a source of truth for screens, passes, and flows. Dig into how Apple Wallet, Google Wallet, and Badge actually work, so you depict the product accurately and can spot what's off before anyone flags it.

What You Bring To The Table

  • 3–5 years of marketing and brand design experience, ideally on a technical product you had to learn and explain. In-house or agency both work, as long as you’ve owned output end to end and gotten up to speed on a complex product quickly.
  • Expert in Figma, strong in Adobe Creative Suite, and comfortable in Pitch and Webflow (or similar tools).
  • You have a sharp eye for typography, layout, composition, and visual hierarchy
  • You have a strong, defensible point of view on what good looks like, and the editing discipline to strip a design down to its essentials rather than layering more on
  • You're comfortable switching between a landing page, a LinkedIn carousel, a sales deck, and a product flow in the same week
  • You care about results, and you use metrics like conversion, engagement, and sales feedback to improve your work
  • You explain your thought process and trade-offs clearly and concisely
  • You can take projects from brief to launch with limited supervision, and you're comfortable moving fast on ambiguous, time-sensitive requests
  • You have a portfolio (required) that shows range across web, brand identity, marketing collateral, events, and decks, ideally with some UI or product work and a look at your process

Nice To Have

  • Product pitch experience
  • Webflow
  • Prototyping experience, in Figma or with AI coding tools like Claude Code or Cursor
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, plus basic HTML/CSS
  • Motion, animation, or 3D skills (After Effects, Lottie, Rive, Blender, or Cinema 4D)
  • Event, booth, or exhibit design experience
  • Experience with A/B testing or analytics
  • Interest in mobile wallets, fintech/payments, B2B SaaS, loyalty, or retail marketing
We offer a competitive salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package, as well as the opportunity to shape the brand and product experience of a fast-growing startup.
This is a remote position. If you're passionate about great design and want to see your work directly shape how customers discover and use Badge, we'd love to hear from you. Please include a link to your portfolio with your application.

Software Support Engineer

As a Software Support Engineer, you'll provide software support for customers with complex conveyor and robotics systems driven by our in-house and third-party software providers.   • Communicate effectively with customers regarding products, services, and issue resolution.
  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, feedback, project warranties, support contacts, and service discontinuance orders.

  • Follow up on unresolved customer issues, coordinate with appropriate departments, and ensure resolution.

jobs.description:
Habitat Health empowers older adults to experience more good days in their homes and communities. Through the Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE), we provide comprehensive medical care along with support for daily needs such as meals, transportation, and in‑home assistance. We deliver coordinated clinical and social care in our centers and directly in participants’ homes, creating a fully integrated experience that brings peace of mind and a true sense of belonging. As we expand our scalable, affordable PACE model to meet the growing and complex needs of aging populations, our mission‑driven care teams continue to help participants live well on their own terms.

Habitat Health is supported by leading healthcare organizations and investors including New Enterprise Associates, Kaiser Permanente, and Town Hall Ventures. We are entering a period of significant growth and are looking for exceptional teammates to help us scale a better model of care for older adults. To learn more, visit www.habitathealth.com.

Location: Remote; requiring regular travel for onsite go-lives, department rounding and other support activities as needed.

Role Scope:

We are hiring a Product Manager, Strategic Technology Applications to own the product strategy, roadmap, and cross-functional delivery for the technology application portfolio that powers Habitat Health's growing PACE organization. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role sitting within the Strategic Technology Applications team, reporting directly to the Vice President of Product.

As Habitat Health expands into new markets and scales its center operations, the Strategic Technology Applications team functions as the internal “product organization” for the systems that power clinical, operational, growth, and administrative workflows. This role will own the end-to-end product lifecycle — discovery, roadmap prioritization, delivery, adoption, and iteration — for a portfolio of applications spanning call/communications, CRM, core operations, growth, and risk adjustment systems.

The ideal candidate is a product-minded healthcare technology leader who is energized by translating clinical and operational needs into a compelling roadmap, partners naturally with internal developers and vendor teams to ship solutions, and uses data and stakeholder feedback to continuously improve adoption and impact.

Core Responsibilities & Expectations for the Role

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for a portfolio of strategic technology applications, including but not limited to call/communications platforms (TalkDesk), CRM platform (Salesforce), EHR platform (Epic)
  • Translate operational, clinical, and growth stakeholder needs into a prioritized backlog and roadmap, balancing quick wins against longer-term platform investments
  • Define and track success metrics — adoption, utilization, satisfaction, and operational impact — to measure product performance and guide iteration
  • Maintain a clear view of the application portfolio's health, dependencies, and integration points (e.g., Salesforce and ancillary clinical/communications tools) to ensure data integrity and a cohesive experience across platforms

Discovery, Delivery & Execution

  • Run discovery with clinical, operational, and growth stakeholders to surface pain points, validate requirements, and shape well-scoped product requirements and user stories
  • Partner with internal analysts (e.g., CRM Admin, EHR Support Analyst, etc.) and external vendors to scope, prioritize, and deliver configuration changes, integrations, and new features
  • Own backlog grooming, sprint/release planning, and prioritization decisions using tools like Jira
  • Lead or co-lead technology application implementations for new PACE center launches, including configuration, workflow validation, user acceptance testing, and go-live support
  • Build repeatable implementation and product-launch playbooks that support Habitat Health's continued growth

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

  • Own day-to-day vendor relationships for managed applications, including performance management, escalations, contract oversight support, and roadmap alignment
  • Evaluate and recommend new technology solutions in partnership with the Director of Strategic Technology Applications; support build-vs-buy assessments and vendor selection
  • Serve as a trusted product partner for clinical, operational, and growth teams, translating their needs into the roadmap and communicating trade-offs clearly
  • Represent the Strategic Technology Applications product portfolio in cross-functional forums, governance bodies, and project teams

Adoption, Training & Change Management

  • Partner with training and enablement resources to design rollout, onboarding, and training plans for managed applications across clinical, operational, and administrative end users
  • Track adoption metrics and gather user feedback; feed insights back into the roadmap and configuration priorities
  • Own change management planning for major releases, feature rollouts, and workflow redesigns
  • Maintain clear product documentation, including roadmaps, requirements, release notes, and user-facing support materials

Required Qualifications and Competencies

  • 5+ years of experience in product management, with hands-on ownership of the roadmap and lifecycle for enterprise or B2B SaaS applications; healthcare or health IT experience strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated experience managing or launching SaaS/cloud-based applications (experience with call center platforms, CRM, or clinical ancillary systems a plus)
  • Strong command of product management fundamentals: discovery, prioritization frameworks, roadmapping, backlog management, and agile delivery (Jira or similar)
  • Proven ability to translate business and clinical requirements into clear product requirements, user stories, and workflow improvements
  • Comfortable partnering with both technical teams (developers, vendors) and non-technical clinical/operational stakeholders
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear product documentation, roadmaps, and executive-facing updates
  • Experience supporting multi-site healthcare operations or rapid program expansion preferred
  • Familiarity with PACE, Medicare/Medicaid, or other regulated healthcare environments preferred

Nice to Have

  • Experience with TalkDesk, Salesforce, Abridge, Epic or other contact center / CRM / ambient AI documentation /EHR systems
  • Experience with health plan systems (claims, eligibility, encounter submissions) or risk adjustment platforms
  • Background in product delivery or change management methodology

As one of Microsoft’s most recognized global partners, Quisitive sits at the forefront of cloud transformation, enterprise data strategy, cybersecurity, and the emerging frontier of agentic AI. Here, consultants and technologists operate on the edge of innovation—supported by a culture that values craftsmanship, open collaboration, and technical expertise. If you’re looking for a place where you can innovate, solve complex problems, and build solutions that make a measurable impact, join us.

Quisitive is seeking an experienced Azure Coach to join our Azure Management Services team. This role combines deep Azure architecture expertise with hands-on operational leadership to help enterprise clients design, secure, optimize, and manage their cloud environments.

As a trusted technical advisor, you will work directly with customer executives, architects, and engineering teams to define cloud strategy, establish governance frameworks, modernize infrastructure, improve operational maturity, and ensure Azure environments remain secure, reliable, and cost effective. This is a highly technical consulting role requiring expertise in both cloud architecture and cloud operations.

This is a remote position and can be based anywhere in the United States.

What You'll Do

Customer Advisory and Architecture

As an Azure Coach, you will serve as the primary technical advisor for customers leveraging Microsoft Azure to support critical business workloads. You will partner with IT leaders, architects, and engineering teams to design, optimize, secure, and operate enterprise-scale Azure environments while helping customers mature their cloud strategy and operational capabilities.

Azure Architecture and Governance

You will lead architecture discussions across Azure networking, identity, security, governance, and infrastructure services. This includes designing and reviewing solutions built on Azure Virtual Networks, ExpressRoute, VPN connectivity, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, Azure Storage, Virtual Machines, Azure App Services, and other core platform services. You will help customers establish Azure Landing Zones and governance frameworks using Management Groups, Azure Policy, and tagging strategies that support scalability, compliance, and operational consistency.

Azure Operations and Managed Services

Working closely with Quisitive's Azure Management Services team, you will provide technical leadership for managed customer environments by evaluating performance, reliability, security, and cost optimization opportunities. You will guide customers in adopting operational best practices through Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Backup, and Azure Site Recovery to improve visibility, resilience, and business continuity. You will also lead complex troubleshooting efforts, major incident reviews, root cause analysis, and operational improvement initiatives involving networking, identity, infrastructure, security, and platform services.

Security and Identity

A key part of the role is helping customers strengthen their security posture. You will advise on Microsoft Entra ID architecture, role-based access control (RBAC), Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, and Zero Trust principles while helping organizations implement governance and compliance controls across their Azure estate.

Automation and Platform Engineering

You will champion automation and platform engineering practices by promoting Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, ARM Templates, PowerShell, and Azure CLI. You will work with customers to develop automated deployment and operational processes using Azure DevOps and GitHub, enabling greater consistency, efficiency, and scalability across cloud environments.

Cloud Modernization

You will support modernization initiatives involving Azure-native and Platform-as-a-Service technologies such as Azure SQL, Azure Functions, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Container Registry, Azure Data Factory, Azure App Service, Event Grid, and Service Bus. You will help customers select practical modernization approaches that improve scalability, reliability, security, and operational efficiency.

Technical Leadership and Coaching

  • You take ownership of complex technical challenges and work collaboratively across delivery, security, support, and operations teams.
  • You can manage competing priorities while maintaining strong technical quality and customer service.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience architecting enterprise-scale Azure solutions across networking, identity, security, governance, compute, storage, monitoring, and platform services.

Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

A small number of Apollo's partners account for the majority of partner-driven revenue — and how well Apollo manages those relationships has an outsized effect on the business. Apollo has thousands of partners who've raised their hand, and a named-partner motion that's still being built to actually activate and grow the best of them into that tier. As Partner Account Manager (PAM), you'll own a focused, named book of Apollo's highest-value partners (roughly 20–30) once they've proven sustained activity and strategic importance.

That's what makes this such an exciting moment to join: you're not inheriting a mature program, you're helping define what high-touch partner management looks like at Apollo. We're looking for someone with a genuine builder mentality who wants a real hand in shaping the program's future, not just running an existing playbook.

Apollo's ambition goes beyond any single integration or referral channel — we want our partner program to be at the heart of the revolution GTM AI is bringing to outbound sales. Agencies of every kind are core to that, and you're the one turning it into durable growth for our most important partners.

This isn't a maintenance role — it's a growth lever. You'll build joint business plans with each partner, run the operating cadence that keeps both sides accountable, grow managed ARR and customer outcomes alongside Sales, Customer Success, and RevOps, and make the call on when a partner is ready to progress, needs support, or should step back from named coverage.

Key Responsibilities

Own the Named Partner Book

  • Maintain a live account plan for every partner in your book — segment, tier, health status, IPP score, and next milestone
  • Flag at-risk accounts before they become escalations
  • Serve as the system of record for who's in the book and why

Build Joint Business Plans

  • Co-create mutual goals with each partner: target segments, pipeline objectives, managed-customer growth targets
  • Build certification and enablement plans directly into the joint business plan, not as a side conversation
  • Set the co-marketing and executive-alignment agenda for the period

Grow Managed ARR and Customer Outcomes

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and RevOps to find expansion opportunities inside partner-managed accounts
  • Monitor adoption and usage signals closely enough to catch churn or delivery risk before it shows up in retention
  • Bring data — not anecdotes — to internal reviews of what's working across the managed book

Run the Operating Cadence

  • Run regular 1:1 check-ins and formal Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with every named partner
  • For top-tier partners, lead a deeper annual strategic review with a standing recommendation prepared in advance
  • Come to every touchpoint with the latest scorecard pulled and open items tracked

Maintain Standing and Progression

  • Track certification coverage, customer quality, and routing eligibility on an ongoing basis, not just at review time
  • Build promotion, remediation, or downgrade recommendations on consistent criteria, not gut feel
  • Own accountability internally whenever a partner's standing is in question

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in partner/channel account management, customer success, or strategic account management, ideally in B2B SaaS
  • Demonstrated success managing a portfolio of external relationships against mutual growth goals (joint business plans, QBRs, or equivalent)
  • Comfortable owning revenue-adjacent outcomes (managed ARR, NRR, retention) in partnership with Sales, CS, and RevOps
  • Strong executive presence — able to run a quarterly business review and represent Apollo credibly to partner leadership
  • Organized and data-driven, with experience maintaining account plans, scorecards, and health tracking across a named book

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within the HubSpot or Salesforce agency/partner ecosystems
  • Experience managing a tiered partner book (e.g., strategic/named tiers with differentiated cadence and service levels)
  • Familiarity with partner/channel platforms (PartnerStack, Crossbeam, or similar)
  • Background working alongside Partner Marketing on co-marketing, case studies, or joint events
  • Experience in a GTM, sales-engagement, or RevOps ecosystem

Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo

At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we take extreme ownership of our work, move with focus and urgency, and learn voraciously to stay ahead.

We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to own your role and make a real impact. Collaboration is at our core—we’re all for one, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage bold ideas and courageous action, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.

At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Managing Consultant, Nursing

Why We Have This Role

Nursing leadership and clinical workflows directly determine patient outcomes, care connection, and operational performance across health systems. In this leadership role, you will apply deep clinical nursing background and data analytics to guide healthcare organizations through complex system redesign, clinical process improvement, and cultural change. You will lead project teams, direct end-to-end consulting engagements, and partner directly with client stakeholders to solve high-stakes operational and care delivery challenges. Working alongside senior practice leadership, you will coach nursing teams, implement proven patient experience best practices, and build lasting, high-value client relationships. If you are a seasoned nursing leader driven to combine clinical expertise with advanced analytics to elevate care delivery nationwide, this role offers the perfect platform.

How You’ll Find Success

  • Combines Clinical Depth & Data Mastery: Translates complex clinical and operational data assets into actionable system designs and nursing strategies.
  • Leads and Empowers Teams: Effectively manages project teams, coordinates resources, and delegates efficiently to achieve high-quality engagement outcomes.
  • Designs Connection-Focused Strategies: Leverages nursing expertise to implement processes that help nurses connect deeply with patients and improve care delivery.
  • Communicates with Influence: Builds immediate credibility across all levels of client management, effectively conveying risks, strategies, and solutions.

jobs.description:
Position Summary...

What you'll do...

What you'll do:

  • Design, build, test, and deploy scalable, intelligent data solutions that support millions of Sam’s Club customers—while laying the groundwork for Agentic AI systems that consume and act on this data.

  • Partner with engineering, AI/ML, and product teams to ensure data services are discoverable, trustworthy, and consumable by next-gen AI agents and LLM-based systems.

  • Collaborate across Sam’s Club engineering teams to contribute to a data-first, agent-aware architecture and foster a culture of innovation around intelligent automation.

  • Engage with Product Management and Business teams to prioritize data products that will drive autonomous decision-making and context-rich recommendations.

  • Build features that enable seamless integration between structured/unstructured data and downstream AI agents, enabling smarter responses, faster insights, and automation.

  • Deploy and monitor products on cloud platforms with agent observability, telemetry, and auditability in mind.

  • Develop and implement best-in-class data health monitoring, traceability, and context enrichment processes to ensure data used by agents is reliable and governed.

  • Lead technical solutioning for full-lifecycle projects, with an eye on how data will power autonomous workflows, co-pilots, and multi-agent systems.


What you'll bring:

  • 4–6 years of experience in Big Data development with a focus on scalable, fault-tolerant architectures.

  • 2–3 years of hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as GCP or Azure, including services like BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, or equivalent.

  • Strong foundation in data engineering best practices and experience building complex data pipelines optimized for agent consumption.

  • Experience designing and implementing semantic layers or knowledge graphs that could power data-aware AI agents.

  • Proven experience in data modeling and architecture, with awareness of how data structures affect retrieval quality and contextual relevance for agents.

  • Exposure to LLM-driven workflows, prompt templating, or orchestration tools (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI) is beneficial but not required.

  • Understanding of data governance, including quality, access control, and lineage—especially in the context of agent auditability and trust.

  • Experience writing clean, testable code in Python, Java, or Scala; experience with PySpark/Spark for distributed data processing.

  • Demonstrated ability to write optimized, scalable SQL and to work with large datasets across cloud-native and open-source platforms.

  • Familiarity with tools like Kafka, Spark Streaming, Druid, and Presto, and how they interact in real-time or hybrid data systems.

  • Solid software engineering experience across backend and frontend development.

  • Advanced experience with Java and Spring Boot, along with strong experience using modern frontend frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.

  • Experience working with SQL (Azure SQL) and NoSQL (Cosmos, Cassandra, MongoDB) databases in both backend services and Full Stack systems.

  • Hands-on experience with Kafka, Docker/Kubernetes, and cloud platforms such as Azure, and GCP.

  • A strong understanding of DevOps principles, CI/CD pipelines, system observability, and deployment patterns for applications with both frontend and backend components.

  • A demonstrated ability to design and maintain scalable, reliable, high-performing Full Stack applications.

  • Success building enterprise-level systems that include both user-facing interfaces and backend services.

  • Strong experience with API design, performance optimization, and scalable solution development across the full stack.

jobs.excerpt: About TelnyxTelnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it.
jobs.description:
About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network, to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

The Role

We're looking for a highly technical Product Manager to own how developers discover, build on and grow with Telnyx.

Telnyx operates a global infrastructure platform spanning communications, AI inference, GPUs, edge compute, databases and real-time applications. We've invested heavily in building the underlying infrastructure. Now we want to make it dramatically easier for developers to understand what's possible, build useful applications and get into production.

This is a hands-on product role leading a small team of six engineers across Developer Relations and Product-Led Growth. We aren't looking for a traditional DevRel leader or someone whose primary skill is managing people. We want a strong engineer with excellent product judgment who understands developer experience, builds things personally and knows how to turn developer adoption into revenue.

The Team

You'll lead a team of six: three DevRel engineers (sample apps, open source, technical content and demos) and three PLG engineers (activation, AI agents and automation, self-service conversion and expansion). You'll report to the Chief Operating Officer.

What you'll own

  • Build applications developers actually want to use — Lead the DevRel team in building production-quality sample applications, integrations, templates and reference implementations on Telnyx. Publish them on GitHub, maintain them and make them easy for developers to deploy and extend. Turn those applications into compelling technical content, live demos and developer distribution.
  • Drive product-led growth — Own the PLG operation responsible for moving developers from signup to meaningful usage and revenue. Use product telemetry, behavioral signals, AI agents and human intervention to identify friction, accelerate onboarding, improve conversion and expand self-service usage.
  • Make the developer experience better — Get hands-on with our APIs, SDKs, documentation and infrastructure. Work directly with product engineering to identify and resolve the issues that make products difficult to use. Our reference applications should continuously test whether our products are genuinely ready for developers.
  • Build AI-native growth systems — Work with Growth Engineering and RevOps to develop automated workflows for developer acquisition, onboarding, account intelligence, technical assistance and expansion. We believe small teams of excellent technical people supervising powerful automation can outperform much larger traditional GTM organizations.
  • Connect the entire developer journey — Applications attract developers. Developers experiment with the platform. PLG helps them succeed. Production usage generates revenue. The feedback from that process improves our products and informs what we build next. You'll be accountable for making that system work. .

What we're looking for

  • A strong software engineering background. You should be comfortable building and debugging real applications, working with APIs, reading code and understanding complex infrastructure.
  • Experience as a Technical Product Manager, founding engineer, technical founder or similar role with substantial personal responsibility for shipping software.
  • Exceptional product judgment, particularly around developer tools, APIs, documentation, onboarding and usability.
  • Familiarity with AI infrastructure, LLMs, inference, cloud platforms, real-time systems or developer infrastructure.
  • Understanding of product-led growth, including developer acquisition, activation, conversion, retention and monetization.
  • Ability to work with AI coding agents, automation frameworks, product analytics and modern developer tooling.
  • Strong technical communication skills. You can explain complicated technologies clearly and recognize what makes a useful demonstration or reference application.
  • Comfortable leading a small technical team while remaining deeply involved in the actual work.

Experience at a developer infrastructure company is valuable. Experience personally building and growing something developers love is more important.

How we'll measure success

Your primary objective is growing developer-led revenue on Telnyx.

We'll look at activated developers, production applications deployed, self-service conversion, usage expansion and retention. We'll also measure the adoption of our reference applications, how effectively our developer content attracts users and how quickly developers can get from signup to a working application.

We care about applications developers actually use, not demos shipped for the sake of demos. We care about developers reaching production, not just generating signups. And we care about revenue, not vanity metrics.

Who will thrive here

Someone who would rather build a working prototype than spend a week debating a roadmap. Someone who notices a broken onboarding experience and immediately starts fixing it. Someone who understands both what makes infrastructure technically excellent and what makes developers want to use it.

You should be capable of leading six very technical people because you have the engineering ability, product instincts and judgment to make everyone around you more effective.

This is a builder's job, not a professional management job.

We're looking for someone who can make Telnyx a platform developers genuinely love building on, and turn that into a meaningful business.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Popmenu helps restaurants grow with a full digital platform: website, online ordering, marketing, and AI-powered guest engagement. Our Sales and Marketing teams depend on CRM data to find the right restaurants, reach the right decision-makers, and have relevant conversations. We are hiring a detail-obsessed Revenue Operations Analyst to own the accuracy, completeness and intelligence of that data.

You will clean and standardize tens of thousands of restaurant accounts and contacts, and enrich them with insight our reps can act on: who owns the restaurant, which ordering and POS platforms it runs, how many locations it has. You will not do it one record at a time. You will use enrichment platforms, automation and AI tools to clean, research and enrich data at scale, then build the processes that keep it clean.

If you like turning data into a reliable sales asset, and finding smarter ways to do it, this is the job.

What You'll Do

  • Clean up the CRM. Audit, enhance, merge and standardize account and contact records in Salesforce. Fix names, titles, roles, emails, phone numbers, addresses and account hierarchies across single-location, multi-unit and franchise groups.
  • Automate the work with AI. Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude and Clay research agents, plus automation platforms, to standardize titles, normalize records, sort contacts into buying roles and research restaurant websites at scale. Build repeatable workflows instead of one-off fixes, and check the output so accuracy stays high.
  • Verify contacts and roles. Confirm who the owners, operators, GMs and marketing leads are. Retire stale contacts and map buying roles so reps reach the right person.
  • Research restaurant technology. Identify the online ordering, POS, reservation, website and delivery platforms each restaurant runs, for example Toast, Square, Olo, ChowNow, BentoBox or DoorDash Storefront. Use a mix of automated website research, technographic data and manual checks, and capture the results in structured CRM fields that drive targeting and competitive plays.
  • Manage data providers. Run and optimize enrichment and technographic tools such as ZoomInfo and Restaurantology. Own field mapping, sync rules, match rates and credit usage, and evaluate how accurate each vendor actually is.
  • Build processes that keep data clean. Define data standards, required fields, validation rules and naming conventions. Set up recurring hygiene routines and dedupe automation, and give reps a clear way to flag bad data.
  • Measure and report on data health. Build dashboards that track completeness, accuracy, duplicate rates and enrichment coverage, and show progress to Sales and Marketing leadership.
  • Support go-to-market work. Partner with Sales, Marketing and Sales Ops on territory alignment, list builds, segmentation and campaign targeting, all running on trusted data.
  • Document everything. Keep a data dictionary and clear playbooks so these standards outlast any one person.

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days: audit

  • Complete a full audit of contact and firmographic data across the CRM, covering completeness, accuracy, duplicates, stale contacts and gaps in key fields such as location count, cuisine and segment, ownership group, and ordering or POS platform
  • Deliver a baseline data-health scorecard and a prioritized remediation plan by segment

By 90 days: acquire and enrich

  • Assess our current data sources, including ZoomInfo and Restaurantology, for coverage and accuracy in our segments, and recommend where to add, cut or renegotiate
  • Fill the priority contact and firmographic gaps through vendor enrichment, AI-assisted website research and targeted manual checks
  • Set up field mapping and sync rules so enriched data lands cleanly and does not overwrite good data

By 6 months: clean, verify and merge

  • Own a repeatable process for cleaning, verifying and merging records: dedupe rules, merge logic for multi-location and franchise hierarchies, email and phone verification, and contact role confirmation
  • Measurably reduce duplicate rates, bounce rates and records missing key fields
  • Accurately capture ordering platform and core firmographics for target accounts

Ongoing: keep it clean

  • Run the hygiene routines, validation rules and automation that stop bad data at the point of entry
  • Report on data health monthly to Sales and Marketing leadership
  • The result: reps trust the CRM and spend their time selling, not researching

Requirements

Non-Negotiables

  • 2 to 4 years in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations or CRM data management
  • 2+ years of hands-on Salesforce, including data imports and mass updates with Data Loader or Data Import Wizard, duplicate and matching rules, merging accounts and contacts, validation rules, account hierarchies, and building reports and dashboards
  • Experience with B2B data and enrichment platforms such as ZoomInfo, Apollo or Clay, including setting up how they sync to Salesforce
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to clean, classify or enrich data
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills: XLOOKUP, pivots, cleanup formulas
  • Workflow and automation experience with Clay, Zapier, Make or similar
  • An investigative mindset and obsessive attention to detail, with the judgment to automate a task once it starts repeating

Nice to Have

  • SQL
  • Salesforce Administrator certification
  • Salesforce dedupe and data quality tools such as DemandTools, Cloudingo or RingLead
  • Restaurant, hospitality or restaurant-tech experience
  • Familiarity with Restaurantology or other technographic data sources
  • Exposure to territory design or account scoring

Benefits

Who We Are

Popmenu is a fast-growing, venture-backed SaaS company transforming the restaurant industry. We started with our patented dynamic menu technology, unleashing the power of a restaurant's most important marketing tool, the menu. Since then, we have continued innovating to solve existing and emerging challenges for restaurant operators. We do not just sell software. We partner with restaurants to help them win. Our mission is to empower owners and operators with the technology tools they need to succeed long into the future. We hire exceptionally bright, motivated people who are passionate about helping great restaurants reach their full potential.

  • Visible Growth and Development in a scaling SaaS company where your impact is seen and rewarded
