jobs.excerpt: Grow our AI image service. Before you apply, spend ten minutes on our website and LinkedIn.
jobs.description:
Grow our AI image service.

Before you apply, spend ten minutes on our website and LinkedIn. In your Loom we will ask what we do, where you found out about us, and why you want to work at Drop Zero Digital. Answers that could be about any company will not pass.

The role

We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.

You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

  1. The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.
  2. Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.

Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.

This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.

We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.

What we are looking for

  1. You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.
  2. You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.
  3. You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.
  4. You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.
  5. You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience

We do not ask for a number of years. We check your work history against what you tell us, and a false answer ends the application.

Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application with a short Loom video. Research us first.
  2. A short test by email: one real decision task, your internet speed, your computer, and a paragraph on your work history.
  3. A 15 minute call with the founder.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. Aptitude tests. These inform us, they do not decide.
  6. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Requirements

    1. Based in Czech Republic.

Benefits

2100 USD per month from day one, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus.
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.

jobs.excerpt: About usHighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale.
jobs.description:
About usHighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our peopleWith over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impactEvery month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer, Design Systems to shape the design system behind HighLevel's product experience, used by product teams across the company and by our developer community. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products and evolving design systems used by multiple teams.

Speed has always been a core HighLevel virtue, and AI-assisted building by designers, product managers and engineers is making us faster still. Our design system must keep pace: beyond tokens and components, it needs primitives, templates and guidance that help every AI-assisted build start from strong defaults.

As a lead individual contributor on the Design Systems team, you will treat the system as a product with its own customers, roadmap and success measures, partnering closely with design leadership, front-end engineers and product teams.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate advanced visual and interaction design judgment, deep systems thinking and the ability to raise quality through standards, documentation, critique and mentorship.

You should embrace AI as central to how you work, not an add-on. This role is based in India, with flexibility for candidates in the United States or the United Kingdom. Experience designing B2B SaaS, platform, CRM, workflow-heavy or SMB software experiences is highly valuable. Applications without a portfolio that includes design system work will not be considered.

What You'll Do

  • Lead strategy and execution for one or more areas of the design system, grounded in product needs, usage data and technical constraints

  • Define and evolve visual foundations, including tokens, theming, color, typography, spacing, iconography and motion

  • Design and refine components and patterns, including anatomy, states, variants, responsive behavior, edge cases and failure states

  • Create primitives, templates and starter kits that help teams build quickly with AI tools while staying on-system

  • Encode visual, interaction, content and accessibility rules as documentation and machine-readable guidance that AI coding tools and agents can follow

  • Partner with front-end engineers on token architecture, component APIs and implementation fidelity so Figma, documentation and code stay in sync

  • Shape contribution, versioning, deprecation and governance models that let the system grow without fragmentation

  • Guide product teams onto the system, study how it's used in what ships and feed what you learn back into it

  • Drive innovation by staying ahead of emerging trends in design and technology

  • Set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality and visual consistency, and mentor designers through critique and system reviews

  • Collaborate effectively across US, UK and India time zones in a 100% remote environment


What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of relevant product design experience, including building or leading a multi-team design system

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio with at least one system-level case study that covers your role, architecture, governance and measurable impact

  • Advanced visual and interaction design craft, with strong care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality

  • Expert command of Figma libraries, variables, modes, component properties and token pipelines, with a record of architecting scalable systems across teams and connecting them to AI tools

  • Deep fluency in front-end development, including HTML, CSS and component frameworks such as React or Vue, with the ability to review implementations for fidelity

  • Hands-on experience vibe coding prototypes with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor to test primitives, templates and patterns before production

  • Deep knowledge of WCAG and hands-on experience designing and testing accessible components

  • A clear point of view on how design systems should support AI-assisted development, plus experience designing AI-driven or intelligent interfaces

  • Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade engineers, product managers, designers and senior stakeholders through rationale, evidence and craft

How You Work

  • You raise the bar for consistency, craft and product quality across the teams that build with the system

  • You thrive at high shipping velocity and see the design system as what makes speed and quality compatible

  • You know when a problem needs a new primitive or component and when it needs better guidance

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people

  • You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design

This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.

jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

The Staff Supplier Quality Engineer operates with a high degree of independence to determine methodologies, audit frameworks, quality systems, and procedural controls across the global supply chain ecosystem, reporting to the Director, Global Supply Chain Audits.

This role is responsible for the technical execution, continuous improvement, strategic projects, and global harmonization of Third-Party Logistics (3PL) quality management, distribution center controls, and service supplier qualification processes worldwide. The Staff SQE leads risk-based lead audit programs, ensures conformance to applicable global regulatory standards (21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485, EU MDR 2017/745, Good Distribution Practice / GDP), and serves as a subject matter expert (SME) in regulatory body inspections. S/he partners with cross-functional global operations, logistics, and regional RAQA organizations to drive critical process improvement projects, resolve systemic quality issues, ensure CAPA effectiveness, and advance 3PL supply chain compliance maturity.

Essential Job Duties

· 3PL Quality Management & Worldwide Oversight

· Design, own, and continuously improve a global 3PL Quality Management Program encompassing third-party logistics providers, global distribution hubs, forward stocking locations, cold chain/temperature-controlled storage facilities, and fulfillment partners across all global regions.

· Establish and maintain qualification frameworks, quality agreements (QAs), and re-evaluation controls specific to 3PL providers and logistics vendors supporting GxP-regulated distribution processes in alignment with 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485 (Clause 7.5.5), EU MDR, and GDP requirements.

· Drive global harmonization of 3PL quality controls, distribution oversight, and logistics quality standards across regional entities: ISJ, ISK, IS India, IS Aubonne, ISE, ISB, and IST.

· Maintain quality oversight of 3PL operational execution, including ambient/cold-chain storage validation, environmental monitoring, product handling, serialized inventory controls, localized labeling/repackaging, and transportation controls.

· Lead Audits & Supplier / Service Qualification

· Lead and execute comprehensive risk-based audits as Lead Auditor for worldwide 3PL providers, distribution hubs, and service suppliers (sterilization, calibration, test laboratories, software/IT GxP service vendors).

· Design, own, and update 3PL audit master schedules, audit risk models, protocols, checklists, and reporting templates tailored to third-party logistics and service supplier activities.

· Conduct Lead Audits against applicable global regulatory standards including Good Distribution Practice (GDP), ISO 13485, ISO 17025, ISO 11135/11137, and 21 CFR Part 820 subpart requirements.

· Evaluate audit findings, issue formal audit reports, drive root cause analysis rigor with 3PL leadership, and manage SCAR / CAPA phase gate reviews and effectiveness verifications.

· Projects & Process Improvements

· Lead strategic quality engineering projects and continuous process improvement initiatives to optimize supply chain workflows, streamline 3PL quality oversight, and elevate supplier scorecards.

· Partner with IT and Supply Chain teams to drive continuous improvement of QMS software platforms (Trackwise, SAP, Agile) supporting 3PL quality workflows, audit scheduling, and SCAR tracking.

· Establish and analyze quality metrics, trends, and KPIs regarding 3PL performance, supplier corrective actions, and audit program effectiveness.

· Own Process Nonconformances (NCs) and CAPAs related to 3PL, logistics, and supply chain audit processes, ensuring root cause rigor (6M / 5-Why) and sustainable corrective actions.

· Supplier Controls & QMS Administration

· Manage 3PL Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs) end-to-end: issuance, aging tracking, phase gate reviews, effectiveness verification, and closure.

· Support Approved Supplier List (ASL) governance regarding 3PL status maintenance, including promotions, conditional approvals, and demotions.

· Administer and maintain 3PL and service supplier records in Trackwise, SAP, and Agile, including audit files, ISO/GDP certifications, quality agreements, and ARFs.

· Regulatory Audit Support & Leadership

· Serve as SME during FDA inspections, Notified Body audits (e.g., BSI, TÜV), and internal QMS audits for all matters related to 3PL Controls, GDP compliance, Service Supplier qualification, and Supply Chain Audits.

· Operate independently to determine methods and procedures on new, complex, or special assignments with minimal supervision.

· Mentor, coach, and guide junior compliance and supplier quality engineering staff.

· May supervise or mentor the activities of junior compliance and supplier quality staff.

Required Skills and Experience

  • ISO 13485 Lead Auditor with demonstrated experience leading multi-site external audits worldwide.

  • Expert-level knowledge of 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485:2016, EU MDR 2017/745, and Good Distribution Practice (GDP / GMP) requirements applicable to 3PL, logistics, and service supplier controls.

  • Proven experience leading quality oversight and audits of global 3PLs, cold chain storage, distribution networks, and service suppliers.

  • Expert proficiency with QMS platforms including Trackwise, SAP, and Agile for supplier file management, SCAR tracking, and audit scheduling.

  • Strong understanding of risk management principles (ISO 14971) as applied to 3PL risk stratification, logistics risk assessments, and audit frequency determination.

Required Education and Training

  • Education: BS/BA degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Supply Chain Management, or a related technical discipline preferred.

  • Experience Level: Typically requires a minimum of 12 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 8 years with a Master's degree; or a PhD with 5 years of experience; or equivalent demonstrated experience.

  • Industry Experience: Significant experience in a high-volume, globally distributed medical device or GxP-regulated company is required.

Working Conditions

  • Travel 50% Internationally

Preferred Skills and Experience

· Direct experience auditing and managing worldwide 3PL providers, temperature-controlled distribution, and global supply chain logistics in a regulated medical device environment.

· Exposure to auditing service suppliers and distributors in a regulated medical device environment.

jobs.excerpt: About OSSOxbridge Summer Scholars(OSS) runs two-week residential summer and winter programmes in Oxford and Cambridge colleges for students aged 14 to 18.
jobs.description:
About OSS

Oxbridge Summer Scholars(OSS) runs two-week residential summer and winter programmes in Oxford and Cambridge colleges for students aged 14 to 18. Students explore their chosen stream, build university-study skills and experience Oxbridge life through rigorous lectures, seminars and tutorials. Each student writes an essay and receives detailed individual feedback from a subject specialist; the strongest essays earn Excellence Awards.

Role Purpose

We are seeking a Science, Innovation & Technology Academic Consultant to join our team. This is a subject-matter specialist who provides expert academic input into the OSS Science, Innovation & Technology Stream. This stream focuses specifically on Maths, Physics, Engineering and Computer Science.

Working alongside the Academic Curriculum Manager and Head of Programme, the Consultant supports the development, review and continuous improvement of Stream content. The Consultant does not own curriculum development; their role is to provide specialist expertise, quality assurance and assessment support to ensure that the programme reflects appropriate academic standards, current subject developments and expectations relevant to pre-university study.

A key responsibility is to assess student essays and provide detailed, individualised academic feedback, contributing to both the educational value of the programme and the quality of the student experience.

Engagement

Location: Fully remote. No travel to Oxford or Cambridge is required.

  • Outside programme dates: Up to 10 hours per week, on an on-demand basis, depending on programme development requirements.

  • During programme dates and the following week: Up to 30 hours in total, primarily dedicated to student essay assessment and feedback. Essay submission deadlines and expected workload will be communicated in advance.

OSS Programme Dates for 2026/27

  • December 6-19, 2026

  • July 4-17, 2027

  • July 18-31, 2027

  • August 1-14, 2027

Responsibilities

1. Subject-Matter Consultation & Content Development

  • Provide expert advice to the Academic Curriculum Manager and Head of Programme on the academic content of the Science, Innovation & Technology Stream.

  • Advise on appropriate topics, concepts, theories, practical applications and emerging developments across areas such as mathematics, physics, engineering, computer science and technology.

  • Recommend subject-specific approaches and academic skills that would be valuable for students preparing for university-level study.

  • Review proposed content and suggest improvements where specialist expertise would strengthen the programme.

2. Academic Quality Assurance

  • Review selected lectures, seminars, tutorials, learning materials and other academic content from a subject-specialist perspective.

  • Check content for academic accuracy, relevance, appropriate depth and level.

  • Identify gaps, inaccuracies or areas requiring clarification or further development.

  • Support the Academic Curriculum Manager and Head of Programme in maintaining a high and consistent academic standard across the Stream.

3. Essay & Assessment Framework

  • Provide subject-specific input into the development of essay questions and prompts.

  • Advise on the academic skills and competencies students should demonstrate in their written work, including scientific reasoning, analytical thinking, evidence-based argument and application of concepts.

  • Contribute to Stream-specific assessment criteria and feedback guidelines.

  • Help establish a clear standard for strong pre-university academic work within the Stream.

4. Essay Assessment & Individualised Feedback

  • Assess student essays according to the agreed Stream-specific criteria.

  • Within 24 hours of the essay submission deadline (2pm on Wednesday of the second week for each programme), review all essays and nominate those that merit an Excellence Award. Expected workload will be communicated in advance.

  • Provide detailed, constructive and individualised written feedback, highlighting strengths, areas for development and practical recommendations for improvement. Return this within five working days of the programme finishing.

  • Maintain consistency in applying the agreed assessment criteria across students and programme intakes.

For example, our first July programme next year runs 4-17 July 2027. Students must submit their essay by 2pm (UK time) on Wednesday 14 July. Consultants complete a first review of essays, nominating those that merit an Excellence Award, by 2pm on Thursday 15 July. Their full written feedback for each essay is due by 5pm Friday 23 July.

5. Programme Improvement & Collaboration

  • Identify recurring strengths, challenges or learning needs emerging from student work and share relevant observations with the Academic Curriculum Manager.

  • Collaborate with Academic Consultants from other Streams to improve OSS's overall essay assessment and feedback process.

  • Contribute subject-specific recommendations to the continuous improvement of the Programme.

What we’re looking for

Essential

  • A relevant degree (e.g. Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field) at Master’s level or above, either currently being undertaken or completed, or confirmed acceptance onto a relevant Master’s programme.

  • Deep subject knowledge in at least one area covered by the stream, with a broad grasp of adjacent areas.

  • Excellent written communication, with the ability to give detailed, individual feedback that is encouraging but honest.

Desirable

  • Experience teaching, lecturing, supervising or assessing students at university or sixth-form level.

  • Experience marking written work against set criteria and giving clear, constructive feedback.

  • Active research, publications or industry experience that brings real-world perspective to the stream.

jobs.description:
Full-time

Remote, some travel

$125,000-$147,970

About Us

The Ammortal Chamber brings together multiple scientifically backed technologies into one experience. It is a healing technology that can be utilized by wellness clinics and inside the home. Our clients include specialty spas and clinics, sports teams, and individuals who are biohackers or athletes.

We are a small team with a startup culture. After our first full year shipping a finished product on the market, we’ve shown strong growth. Our team is made up of engineers, health professionals, and startup entrepreneurs.

As we continue expanding, this role offers hands-on experience, opportunities to grow into leadership, and the chance to make a tangible impact by developing and delivering cutting-edge wellness technology. You’ll collaborate across disciplines to innovate and shape technologies that enhance well-being for our clients.

What is this role and why does it exist?

The Ammortal Chamber is a complex electromechanical product, and we are scaling production significantly. Getting from engineering development to repeatable, high-quality production takes a dedicated owner who keeps design, manufacturing, and quality moving in step.

The NPI Engineer owns that transition. This role is the primary technical interface between Product Engineering and our contract manufacturing partners, driving manufacturing readiness from early design through prototype, validation, pilot, and production builds. Every Chamber that ships well-built and on time is a person or a community that gets to experience what we've made.

Responsibilities

  • Contract Manufacturer Interface: Serve as the primary engineering interface with contract manufacturers and key manufacturing suppliers. Coordinate prototype, pilot, and production builds with internal engineering teams and external manufacturing partners.
  • NPI Planning and Build Control: Develop and maintain the NPI plan from prototype builds through production launch and ramp. Coordinate engineering builds and ensure build objectives, configurations, materials, documentation, and issues are controlled.
  • DFM/DFA Leadership: Lead DFM/DFA reviews with Mechanical, Electrical, Firmware, suppliers, and manufacturing partners. Identify manufacturing risks early and drive resolution before production release.
  • Manufacturing Requirements and Test Strategy: Develop manufacturing requirements for assembly processes, fixtures, tooling, programming, calibration, and production testing. Develop manufacturing-test strategy in collaboration with Electrical and Firmware Engineering.
  • Documentation and Configuration Control: Coordinate BOM readiness, approved components, manufacturing documentation, drawings, work instructions, and engineering changes with appropriate owners. Ensure engineering changes are properly communicated and implemented by manufacturing partners.
  • Quality Systems and Readiness: Establish production acceptance criteria and manufacturing quality controls with the contract manufacturer. Support PFMEA, control plans, process validation, first-article activities, and production-readiness reviews. Support supplier qualification and technical evaluation of manufacturing processes.
  • Issue Resolution and Ramp Metrics: Maintain build issue lists and drive root-cause and corrective-action closure. Track yield, defects, rework, cycle time, and manufacturing issues during ramp.
  • Serviceability and Configuration Consistency: Drive serviceability, replaceable-assembly strategy, service disconnects, component identification, maintenance, and field-replacement considerations into product design. Coordinate with Verification, Compliance, and Quality functions to ensure production configurations remain consistent with validated product configurations.

Skills to Excel

  • Ownership Across the Handoff
    • You keep engineering intent intact from design through production, and you drive problems to closure rather than just tracking them.
  • Manufacturing Fluency
    • You understand DFM/DFA, assembly processes, fixtures, tooling, production testing, and configuration control well enough to guide design decisions.
  • Structured Problem Solving
    • You use root-cause analysis, 8D-style problem solving, PFMEA, and control plans to resolve issues systematically.
  • Partner Communication
    • You build trusted relationships with contract manufacturers and suppliers while holding a clear line on quality.
  • Cross-Functional Range
    • You move comfortably across Mechanical, Electrical, Firmware, Systems, Quality, Operations, and Supply Chain.

Requirements

What Technical Knowledge Do You Need to Perform in This Role?

Required

  • DFM/DFA
  • BOM management, ECOs, and configuration control
  • Engineering drawings and manufacturing documentation
  • Assembly processes, fixtures, tooling, and production testing
  • PFMEA, control plans, and process validation
  • Root-cause analysis and 8D-style problem solving
  • First-article inspection and production-readiness reviews

Preferred

  • Manufacturing-test strategy and programming/calibration processes
  • Supplier qualification
  • Yield, defect, and cycle-time tracking during ramp
  • Regulated-product quality practices

Qualifications (Must haves)

  • BS in Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline
  • 4+ years of NPI, manufacturing, or product-development experience with complex electromechanical products
  • Demonstrated experience taking physical products from engineering prototypes through production launch
  • Experience working directly with contract manufacturers and external suppliers
  • Strong understanding of DFM/DFA, BOMs, ECOs, drawings, assembly processes, fixtures, tooling, production testing, and configuration control
  • Experience supporting engineering validation, design validation, pilot, and production builds
  • Working knowledge of PFMEA, control plans, root-cause analysis, 8D-style problem solving, and manufacturing quality methods
  • Comfortable working across Mechanical, Electrical, Firmware, Systems, Quality, Operations, and Supply Chain

Qualifications (Nice to haves)

  • Experience with low-to-medium-volume complex electromechanical equipment (particularly relevant)

  • Regulated-product experience

Benefits

Pay, Location, Hours

  • Pay Range: $125,000-$147,970
  • Benefits: 80% of health, dental, and vision insurance covered
  • Equity: 15,000 options vesting over 4 years with a 1 year cliff
  • Location: Remote, some travel

Depuis 2020, Job Traveler place des talents multilingues auprès d'entreprises en Europe. Notre cœur de métier : le service client / BPO à Lisbonne et Athènes, et de plus en plus des postes spécialisés et commerciaux. Équipe : environ 10 personnes, entièrement en remote.

Comment se passe la collaboration

  • Vous générez vos leads vous-même. Nous cherchons des personnes francophones qui souhaitent quitter la France pour travailler dans le service client au Portugal, en Grèce ou ailleurs en Europe. Où vous les trouvez, c'est vous qui décidez – groupes Facebook et communautés d'expatriés, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, forums, associations ou votre propre entourage.

  • Pas besoin de présélection par entretien. Vous garantissez la qualité de vos leads grâce à un ciblage précis et, si possible, à des questionnaires préalables (niveau de langue, disponibilité pour déménager, date de disponibilité).

  • Nos recruteurs prennent le relais : premier entretien, processus de sélection chez nos entreprises partenaires, accompagnement jusqu'à la prise de poste. Vous voyez où en sont « vos » candidats.

  • Vous sourcez aussi pour d'autres langues ? C'est bienvenu. Les candidats d'autres profils linguistiques nous intéressent également – parlons-en lors de l'entretien.

  • De notre côté : les offres ouvertes et les profils recherchés, des modèles de messages, un interlocuteur dédié dans l'équipe et un onboarding au démarrage.

Votre rémunération

  • Uniquement à la commission.

  • Les montants et les conditions de commission sont fixés par écrit avant le début de la collaboration. Vous savez dès le départ ce que vous rapporte chaque placement.

  • Votre revenu dépend uniquement du nombre de candidats qualifiés que vous trouvez. Il n'y a pas de plafond.

  • Versement à l'issue de la période de garantie.

Pourquoi le freelance chez nous

  • Transparence : vous savez à tout moment où en sont vos candidats, et nous vous informons directement de chaque changement de statut.

  • Des règles claires : commissions, conditions de versement et attribution des candidats sont convenues par écrit dès le départ. Pas de surprises.

  • Sans exclusivité – nous partons du principe que nous ne sommes pas votre seul client.

  • Vous organisez votre temps comme vous l'entendez. Pas d'horaires imposés, pas de présence, pas de volume horaire minimum.

  • Depuis n'importe où en Europe (UTC−1 à +3).

  • Vous aidez des personnes à trouver un emploi à l'étranger – souvent un vrai nouveau départ.

Votre profil

  • Français langue maternelle. Aisance en anglais.

  • Une expérience confirmée du sourcing ou du recrutement dans le BPO / les centres de contact : vous connaissez les profils recherchés, les exigences linguistiques et les attentes des candidats.

  • Un réseau et un pipeline existants de candidats francophones pour le service client / BPO, prêts à partir de France pour travailler au Portugal, en Grèce ou ailleurs en Europe.

  • Une bonne connaissance des cibles et des canaux : vous savez où se trouvent les francophones qui veulent s'expatrier et comment les atteindre.

  • Un statut de freelance (vous pouvez facturer, par ex. micro-entreprise) ou la possibilité de le mettre en place rapidement.

  • Un traitement rigoureux des données personnelles (RGPD).

  • Un plus : une expérience personnelle de la vie ou du travail à l'étranger – cela vous rend crédible auprès de votre cible.

Les prochaines étapes

  • Vous postulez avec vos coordonnées et un CV à jour.

  • Si cela correspond, nous organisons un entretien avec notre directeur.

  • Décision sous quelques jours, onboarding à la date convenue.

jobs.description:
About the Role

This is not a posting for one job. It's an open door for builders who want in on what we're doing.

Every hire crosses a line. Before the offer, the work is finding the right person. After the offer, the work has to be right: identity, work authorization, background checks, tax forms, union agreements, credentials. Someone's name is on every one of them. AI agents are taking over the first half. Nobody is taking the accountability for the second. That's us.

Onboarded is the API for the workflows that have to be right. We never built I-9 as a feature. We built primitives: an ontology of the worker, the job, the client and the employer, forms written as code, policies kept current, automations that react when a fact changes. More than six million workers have become eligible for work on that engine. Some of the largest HR tech platforms in the world run on it under their own brand. And it's starting to run work that has nothing to do with onboarding at all.

An agent can decide. An agent cannot be liable. Every hiring agent being built right now needs a deterministic, auditable layer underneath it. We're building that layer, and we're a small team doing it. If you've read this far and thought "I want to build that," we want to hear from you, even if no role on our careers page fits.

What You'll Do

We hire for the person first and shape the seat around what you're great at. Here's the work that needs doing:

  • Build the engine. Extend the ontology, the policy engine and the automations framework. Make agents first-class callers through our APIs and MCP server.
  • Build the agent that writes configuration. Turn a policy, a union contract or a customer request into config a human reviews and ships. This is how a small team serves a big market.
  • Deploy into the field. Embed with customers and partners and build their compliance workflows as code. Everyone here gets close to the people who use what we build.
  • Grow the ecosystem. Open doors with the hiring platforms, staffing systems and HR software companies that distribute Onboarded, and turn signed partnerships into live customers.
  • Tell the story. Define a category in public. Write, ship, film and teach how the work that has to be right gets done in the agent era.
  • Make developers love it. Build the sandbox, the quickstart, the docs and the open-source packages that let a developer ship compliant onboarding in ten minutes.

What We're Looking For

Titles and pedigree matter less here than how you work. Every person at Onboarded shares a few things:

  • You build. Code, systems, partnerships, stories, whatever your craft is. You'd rather ship something real this week than plan something perfect next quarter.
  • AI is how you work. You use AI tools as a force multiplier every day, whatever your role. This is non-negotiable.
  • You care about getting it right. Our work decides whether a real person starts their job on time and compliantly. You know the difference between fast and right, and you deliver both.
  • You own outcomes, not tasks. If you see it, you own it. Nobody routes it to you.
  • You get close to the customer. You'd rather sit with the people using the product than guess what they need.
  • You say it plainly. Short sentences. Conviction first. Clearly wrong and corrected beats vaguely right.

Experience in HR tech, staffing, payroll, developer platforms or employment compliance is a strong signal but not required. Learning velocity counts just as much.

This is not a fit for someone who wants a defined lane, a long ramp, or a big company's structure. It is for builders who want to own something that matters, early.

Why Onboarded

  • The timing is now. Agents are rewriting how hiring works, and every one of them needs a layer it can trust underneath. We're already that layer for millions of workers. The next few years decide who owns it.
  • Your work ships and it matters. A small team means everything you build reaches production and real people. No layers between you and the outcome.
  • You'll build next to the founders. A direct line to our CEO, co-founder and CTO, who are in customer accounts and code every week. You'll shape the company, not just a feature.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and equity in a fast-growing startup
  • Health, dental, vision, and retirement benefits
  • Remote-first culture with optional in-person collaboration
  • A chance to build the layer every hiring agent depends on

How to Apply

Send a short introduction + your resume, LinkedIn or GitHub to with "Open Role" in the subject. Tell us three things: what you'd want to build here, one thing you've built that you're proud of, and how AI tools fit into your work. Skip the cover letter. Show us.

Director, AP Engineering

College Board — New Course Design

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role: This is a full-time, term position that will last one year from the start date. This role has the potential to convert to a full-time, permanent position, depending on the course’s final approval for release, business need, and individual performance.

Preferred Application Deadline: Friday, November 13th. Please keep in mind that College Board offices will be closed November 26th – November 27th and December 25th – January 1st so it is better to apply sooner than later. We are targeting a January start date.


About the Team

The New Course Design (NCD) department leads the research, design, development, and launch of new courses and their associated exams, instructional resources, and teacher professional learning programs, ensuring consistency across these inter-related AP Program components and that they are engaging, feasible, and grounded in evidence. After launching a new course, the NCD department focuses on continuous improvement of new courses, exams, instructional interventions, and teacher professional learning programs. NCD partners closely with the Learning and Assessment division to design and validate new item types for use in new, career-focused AP exams, and then integrates with AP Program Enablement to produce the annual exam versions within the Bluebook digital testing platform (copyright, editorial, layout, design), and to develop annual rubrics and training materials necessary to conduct the annual AP Reading of student responses.


About the Opportunity

This is a one-year term role. Your work will be split between two streams: building the course's framework in partnership with the AP Engineering Advisory Committee and the Senior Director, Instructional Design and developing assessment items aligned to that framework in partnership with the Senior Director, Assessment Design. The time spent on each aspect of the role will shift as the course moves through the design process.

If AP Engineering receives final approval for release, this role has the potential to convert to a full-time employee Director position with expanded, ongoing responsibility for the course's curriculum, assessment development, and annual AP Reading.


In this role, you will:

Course Framework and Advisory Committee Development (50-60%)

  • Serve as the content lead for AP Engineering, with primary responsibility for drafting the course framework, skill progressions, and learning objectives.
  • Partner with the Senior Director, Instructional Design and Director, Project Management to manage the AP Engineering Advisory Committee including industry practitioners, college faculty, and secondary school teachers by setting milestones, tracking deliverables, and driving the framework development process to on-time completion.
  • Facilitate meetings — in person and virtual, which may fall during the work week, evenings, or weekends — with the Advisory Committee to review and refine framework drafts.
  • Resolve conflicting Advisory Committee and field-test feedback with a documented recommendation to SD/ED.
  • Conduct outreach to teachers and organizations to engage them in feedback opportunities.

Assessment Item Development (30-40%)

  • In partnership with the Senior Director, Assessment, manage the development timeline for assessment items and early scoring materials for AP Engineering, ensuring alignment to the course framework as it's built — including sequencing stimulus selection, drafting rubrics, and tracking deliverables against framework milestones.
  • Author and revise item content in coordination with the Senior Director, Assessment, ensuring items reflect both the emerging framework and AP's assessment quality standards.
  • Incorporate Advisory Committee, Test Development Committee and small-scale field testing feedback into iterative revisions of the framework and assessment items, keeping the two in alignment as both evolve.
  • Coordinate with psychometrics colleagues, via the Senior Director, Assessment, to check for viability of early item design against AP's validity and fairness standards.

Instructional Resources and Professional Learning (10%)

  • Provide feedback on content-specific elements of instructional and professional resources developed by the Senior Director, Instructional Design and Director, Professional Learning.

About You

You have:

  • Master's degree in Engineering or a directly related discipline, and knowledge of current trends in the field (required); doctorate or significant industry credential preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in professional learning, curriculum design, or standardized assessment development.
  • Experience translating research or standards (labor-market, postsecondary, or state CTE) into instructional or assessment design decisions.
  • Experience with digital assessment and/or classroom teaching (preferred).
  • Superior oral and written communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and maintain close attention to detail, including proofreading.
  • Skill in process and procedure implementation, including adhering to project plans and schedules and maintaining tracking documentation.
  • Technical acumen; proficiency with Microsoft Office and browser-based tools.
  • Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills, including the ability to work with staff, SMEs, and industry partners at all levels.
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity — this course is still being designed, and priorities will shift as field test data comes in.
  • Willingness to travel up to 8 times a year, plus possible additional time for field test site visits or advisory committee meetings.

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work.
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal.
  • A learner's mindset: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and improving through iteration.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, and prioritizing what matters most.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences and contributing to a culture of shared success.
  • Authorization to work in the United States.

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and continue until the position is filled. This role will be posted for a minimum of 5 business days. The preferred application deadline isFriday, November 13th. Please keep in mind that College Board offices will be closed November 26th – November 27th and December 25th – January 1st so it is better to apply sooner than later. We are targeting a January start date.
  • The hiring process generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, a performance exercise (e.g., a curricular analysis memo and prototype sketch), a panel interview, a conversation with leadership, and reference checks.

What We Offer

  • At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck — a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We're a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.
  • The hiring range for this role is $96,000 - $135,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

jobs.title: Sketch Quality Control Reviewer
jobs.excerpt: The Sketch Quality Control Reviewer is responsible for ensuring the visual quality, consistency, and accuracy of sketch-based assets used in in-app videos, promotional content, and storytelling experiences.
jobs.description:
The Sketch Quality Control Reviewer is responsible for ensuring the visual quality, consistency, and accuracy of sketch-based assets used in in-app videos, promotional content, and storytelling experiences.

The role reviews sketches against approved scripts, briefs, and creative guidelines, identifies visual and continuity issues, provides clear and actionable feedback, and documents approval readiness before assets move to final production and integration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review sketches used in in-app videos and promotional assets to ensure visual quality, clarity, and alignment with approved creative briefs and scripts.

  • Assess visual consistency across episodes and assets, including character design, scene continuity, composition, proportions, and storytelling flow.

  • Verify that sketches follow brand guidelines, content standards, and the approved visual direction.

  • Identify and document visual inconsistencies, missing elements, continuity gaps, and deviations from the approved script or brief.

  • Provide clear, specific, and actionable written feedback to support efficient revisions by artists and editors.

  • Coordinate with Client representatives, sketch artists, and video editors to clarify requirements, resolve issues, and follow up on corrections when needed.

  • Maintain an up-to-date QC tracker documenting review status, identified issues, recommended corrections, revision outcomes, and completion dates.

  • Confirm whether assets meet the required quality standards and are ready for approval and integration into final video assets.

  • Identify recurring quality issues and recommend improvements to QC checklists, review guidelines, and production workflows.

Required Deliverables

1. Sketch QC Report

A structured report for each asset or batch, covering visual clarity, script and brief alignment, character consistency, storytelling accuracy, identified issues, and recommended corrections.

2. Approval Summary Sheet

A consolidated summary by approved episode or batch, including the number of sketches reviewed, issue categories and frequency, revision rounds, and final QC approval status.

3. QC Tracker

An up-to-date record of review status, identified deficiencies, recommendations, revision outcomes, pending actions, and relevant completion dates.

What Success Looks Like

  • Visual issues are identified early and documented clearly, enabling artists and editors to make corrections efficiently.

  • Sketches accurately reflect the approved scripts, creative briefs, brand guidelines, and intended storytelling.

  • Character designs, scene details, and visual elements remain consistent across episodes and assets.

  • QC reports and tracking records are accurate, complete, and easy for the Client and production team to use.

  • Approved sketches consistently meet quality standards and are ready for final video production and integration.

  • Recurring issues are identified and translated into practical improvements to the QC process.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience in visual quality control, creative production, or reviewing visual storytelling assets.

  • Strong understanding of visual storytelling principles, storyboarding, sketch composition, and narrative clarity.

  • Excellent visual judgment and attention to detail, particularly regarding character consistency, scene continuity, composition, and visual accuracy.

  • Ability to compare visual assets against scripts, creative briefs, and established guidelines.

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, constructive, and actionable feedback.

  • Strong organizational skills and experience maintaining trackers, review logs, and structured approval documentation.

  • Ability to manage multiple assets, revision rounds, and deadlines in a fast-paced content production environment.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with artists, editors, vendors, and other stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience reviewing storyboards, sketches, animatics, illustrations, short-form videos, or other visual storytelling assets.

  • Experience with episodic storytelling, branded content, animation, or digital media production.

  • Bachelor's degree in Design, Visual Arts, Animation, Media, or a related field.

  • Familiarity with creative tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, or similar software.

  • Experience working with creative vendors, illustrators, sketch artists, or animation teams.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

The SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center. This position reports to the SOC Lead. The role goes beyond acknowledging alerts: the focus is on understanding what each alert means, investigating suspicious activity end to end, responding to real threats, and handing over cleanly between regions so that nothing is lost across shifts. The ideal candidate has solid SOC experience, a strong investigative mindset, and thrives in a fast-paced, fully remote setting where accuracy, discipline, and security are essential. Hands-on engineering experience with core security platforms is a big plus.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor, triage, and analyze security alerts and events from the organization's security stack, including SIEM, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Security Service Edge (SSE), and Web Application Firewall (WAF) platforms.

  • Investigate security incidents end to end, from initial triage through analysis, containment, eradication, and post-incident documentation, coordinating with relevant teams throughout.

  • Determine the scope, severity, and impact of security events, separating true positives from false positives and escalating confirmed incidents according to defined procedures.

  • Execute response actions within the security platforms, such as isolating endpoints, blocking indicators, disabling compromised accounts, and enforcing access restrictions.

  • Ensure structured, high-quality shift handovers across regions in the follow-the-sun model, so that open investigations, ongoing incidents, and pending actions continue seamlessly around the clock.

  • Proactively threat hunt across endpoint, network, and log data to uncover suspicious activity that existing detections may have missed, mapping findings to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Provide feedback on detection quality and contribute to the tuning of SIEM correlation rules, EDR custom detections, and WAF rules to reduce noise and improve coverage.

  • Enrich investigations with threat intelligence, including indicators of compromise, attacker techniques, and emerging campaigns relevant to the organization.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and incident response playbooks.

  • Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, application, and security engineering teams to resolve incidents and support day-to-day operations.

  • Support vulnerability management and drive continuous improvement of the organization's overall security posture.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst, triaging alerts and investigating security incidents in a production environment.

  • Solid working knowledge of core security technologies such as EDR, SSE, SIEM, and WAF, and of how to use them to investigate and respond to threats.

  • Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and tuning these platforms, or writing and tuning detection content, is a big plus.

  • Experience with incident response and threat hunting, ideally with familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

  • Excellent understanding of network security, endpoint security, cloud security, and Zero Trust principles.

  • Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, BTL1, or vendor-specific credentials are a plus.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.

  • Ability to handle sensitive information responsibly and securely.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English, and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams and across time zones.

About You

You are a hands-on security analyst who wants to understand what is really happening behind an alert, rather than only closing tickets. You dig into the data, follow the evidence, and know when and how to escalate. If you have also stood up or tuned the tools you work with, or written your own detections, even better. You are structured, reliable, and comfortable working independently in a remote, follow-the-sun team, and you take pride in leaving a clear handover for the next shift. You are curious about new threats and technologies, and you enjoy working closely with both technical teams and end users to raise the security bar across the environment.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.excerpt: Our client is an IT company seeking an experienced Cloud and Infrastructure Security Engineer to assess and strengthen the security posture of a complex, multi-cloud infrastructure.
jobs.description:
Our client is an IT company seeking an experienced Cloud and Infrastructure Security Engineer to assess and strengthen the security posture of a complex, multi-cloud infrastructure.
The client is building a dedicated security team for a US-based SaaS provider whose platform serves hundreds of public-sector agencies across North America. The programme covers a large, varied estate of around a dozen product lines, running on Java, .NET, Node/TypeScript, Ruby and PHP across Azure and AWS, including legacy systems that need framework upgrades rather than quick patches. The work starts with a short phase where senior engineers do threat modelling and map the estate. A larger team then fixes vulnerabilities, hardens cloud infrastructure, builds security gates into CI/CD pipelines and consolidates identity services. Engineers work hands-on with modern AI coding tools and learn security from experienced tower leads. It’s a strong fit for good software, cloud and DevOps engineers who want to grow into application security. The team works in English, with partial overlap with US Eastern time.

The Project

The project focuses on mapping the existing infrastructure attack surface, identifying security vulnerabilities and configuration gaps, and establishing a prioritized remediation roadmap.

The engineer will work alongside other senior security specialists responsible for application security assessments, focusing specifically on cloud, edge, network, and virtual machine infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assess the Azure environment, including AKS with Istio, API Management, Application Gateway, Front Door, Azure Firewall, hub-and-spoke networking, and Key Vault.

  • Review the AWS infrastructure supporting one product line, including ECS, EC2, Lambda, API Gateway, and VPC.

  • Evaluate edge security across Cloudflare, Azure Front Door, and Application Gateway, covering WAF configurations, TLS, and security headers.

  • Assess the VM estate, including 500+ SQL Server databases and legacy applications running on static VMs without infrastructure-as-code.

  • Review infrastructure-as-code and configuration management practices using Terraform, OpenTofu, Ansible, and Chef.

  • Define security hardening baselines and prioritize remediation activities for cloud and infrastructure engineering teams in the next project phase.

The Needs

Must-Have Requirements:

  • Approximately 8+ years of experience in cloud or infrastructure engineering, with a strong background in security.

  • Deep expertise in Azure security and practical working knowledge of AWS.

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes security.

  • Proficiency in Terraform or OpenTofu.

  • Practical experience using AI assistants to review infrastructure code and configurations.

  • Ability to identify infrastructure security risks and translate findings into actionable remediation priorities.

Nice-to-Have Skills:

  • Experience securing Istio service mesh environments.

  • Ability to review Ansible and Chef configurations.

  • Relevant certifications such as AZ-500, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, or CCSP.

  • Experience with cloud security posture management tools such as Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Wiz, or similar.

  • Previous experience securing and modernizing legacy infrastructure environments without established infrastructure-as-code practices.

Additional Info

  • Location: Lithuania/Poland

  • Start date: ASAP

  • Contract duration: 12 months

jobs.excerpt: Role PurposeLevelTen Energy's mission is to accelerate the energy transition by facilitating frictionless transactions.
jobs.description:
Role Purpose

LevelTen Energy's mission is to accelerate the energy transition by facilitating frictionless transactions. As the leading provider of renewable transaction infrastructure, we deliver the cloud based software, centralized supply, automated analytics, and transaction expertise required to power the renewable energy economy. The LevelTen Platform is the world's largest online hub for renewable energy buyers, sellers, advisors, asset owners and financiers, and delivers the online tools and expertise they need to buy, sell and finance assets quickly.

The Account Manager owns a portfolio of roughly 40 of LevelTen's existing North American client accounts — primarily renewable project developers, plus a set of energy buyers. Reporting to a Director of Account Management, the Account Manager manages day-to-day relationships for their accounts, keeps clients engaged with the LevelTen Platform, and supports the team's RFPs and bilateral engagements, market updates and renewals. The Account Manager ensures buyers and sellers are successful on the LevelTen Platform by guiding them and providing value through market insights. The role is focused on growing and retaining current accounts rather than new-logo prospecting.

This is a learning-and-growth role for someone early/mid in their renewable energy career. Over time, the Account Manager will take on direct ownership of more accounts and more complex engagements. As a fast-growing company in a quickly evolving industry, we are always learning and improving how we support our customers, and this role will help shape how the team delivers for both sides of the LevelTen Marketplace.

Duties and Responsibilities

Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Account Management

  • Nurture and expand relationships with a portfolio of renewable energy developers and energy buyers
  • Act as a day-to-day point of contact for client questions, routing requests to Transactions, Product and Client Services as needed
  • Run regular check-ins, market update calls and project pipeline discussions with clients
  • Collaborate with buyers to scope and launch demand signals (RFPs and bilaterals) across product types, including PPAs, VPPAs, BESS contracts and capacity supply agreements
  • Lead proactive outreach when market or policy changes affect clients' projects (e.g., tariff impacts on project timelines and contract milestones)
  • Drive platform adoption by onboarding new users, explaining LevelTen's offline products and services, and tracking usage
  • Demonstrate the value of LevelTen's services to buyers, developers and asset owners to drive robust participation in LevelTen products and marketplaces
  • Foster engagement by presenting transaction opportunities, leading educational demos and webinars, and attending (and occasionally speaking at) industry conferences
  • Represent buyer and seller perspectives in LevelTen's software and product design
  • Support client engagement KPIs and other leading and lagging indicators of how buyers and sellers use the Platform
  • Support and land renewals by preparing account reviews, usage summaries and renewal materials

Transaction Support

  • Support PPA transactions (RFPs, auctions and bilaterals), including notifying clients, providing updates, and sharing won/lost and report feedback
  • Encourage developer participation in appropriate RFP and bilateral opportunities
  • Guide buyers and sellers through deal execution alongside LevelTen's transaction teams
  • Help coordinate client analyses with the team's leads
  • Keep the team's RFP and market activity trackers current

Business Development

  • Spot and lead upsell and cross-sell opportunities across LevelTen's product portfolio
  • Sell value-based subscriptions for buyer- and seller-focused products and services, including PPA solutions and market intelligence
  • Help clients get full value from LevelTen's market intelligence products (e.g., PPA MarketPulse and market reports) and identify opportunities to expand their subscriptions
  • Work with Marketing and Business Development to keep clients engaged with campaigns, events and market insights
  • Contribute to LevelTen's industry thought leadership, including newsletters, white papers, webinars, social media and events

Operations & Team Support

  • Maintain accurate account, contact and opportunity data in Salesforce
  • Prepare client-facing materials, decks and meeting notes
  • Support team initiatives as roles and responsibilities evolve

Qualifications

The ideal candidate is a self-starter with an innate desire to uncover the ever-changing needs of the industry and flow those insights into the LevelTen Platform. They will also have the following.

Must have

  • 3+ years of relevant work experience in the renewable energy industry, energy consulting, or B2B account management/customer success
  • Experience managing a book of multiple client accounts with overlapping deadlines
  • Clear writing, presentation and verbal communication skills, with attention to detail
  • Experience partnering with other internal teams, such as sales, product or operations
  • Interest and aptitude in building relationships with clients and internal stakeholders
  • Ability to think quickly on your feet, make decisions and work independently with limited supervision
  • Comfort with PowerPoint/Google Slides and Excel
  • Ability to travel domestically up to 20%

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with North American wholesale electricity markets, PPA origination and/or utility-scale renewable project development
  • Experience with Salesforce, Asana or similar tools
  • Business development or enterprise sales experience
  • Project management experience
  • Experience with AI tools such as Claude

Additional Details

  • The estimated compensation for this position is $110,000 – $140,000 per year, (OTE $150,000 - $180,000) based on experience and qualifications.
  • Seattle or Denver-based candidates preferred. Remote candidates will be considered.

Benefits / Perks

  • Full medical, vision and dental coverage
  • Wellness credit
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • 11 paid company holidays
  • 401(k) plan

About LevelTen Energy

LevelTen Energy is the leading provider of transaction infrastructure for the renewable energy economy. Our platform delivers buyers, sellers, advisors, and financiers the automation software, data management, and standardized contracts needed to facilitate faster, safer renewable energy transactions. LevelTen's marketplace of renewable energy power purchase agreements is the world's largest, with more than 4,000 Transaction-Ready Pricing™ offers spanning 21 countries in North America and Europe. LevelTen's CFO-Ready Analytics™ automatically calculate more than a billion data points every day, providing our partners with leading-edge, real-time risk and value insights at modern market scale. Together, LevelTen and our partners share #OneGoal to accelerate the clean energy transition. Visit us at LevelTenEnergy.com to learn more.

Equal Opportunity Employer

LevelTen Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.description:
Locations: US (remote), Boston (hybrid), or New York (hybrid) - EST preferred
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. Toast Tables is Toast's reservations and waitlist product. Thousands of restaurants run their dining room on it: reservations, waitlist, and payments, built into the Toast point of sale. Toast Ticketing is the newest part of it. It lets a restaurant or venue sell tickets to its own events (a wine dinner, a comedy night, a holiday pre-order) on its public booking page, take payment, and check guests in at the door.

About this roll* (Responsibilities)

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to own Toast Ticketing end to end. Ticketing is in open beta: any restaurant on Tables Plus (the paid tier of Toast Tables) can turn it on themselves, guests buy tickets on the restaurant's public booking page, and the host scans them in at the door. The next job is product-market fit, a commercial motion with sales and onboarding, and general availability. This is a senior individual contributor role. You report to the Toast Tables product lead and work day to day with the engineers who build ticketing, a design partner, and go-to-market (GTM) partners in sales, onboarding, and marketing.

You spend a lot of time with customers: on calls, on site, and watching real events get published, sell, and run. The restaurants running events on it talk to us every week, and what they tell us sets the backlog. You have a strong sense for the next right thing to build, and you keep scope tight so the team ships what matters most. You use AI tools every day to prototype, research, analyze data, and check your own thinking.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the ticketing roadmap and strategy from open beta to general availability to scale, including where ticketing fits in Toast's guest platform and how it reaches venues beyond today's restaurants.
  • Run the weekly build loop with engineering: framing problems, deciding what ships each week and why, and measuring results.
  • Learn where early customers get value and where they get stuck, and use that to decide what to double down on and what to drop.
  • Carry commercialization with GTM and leadership: pricing and packaging recommendations, rep enablement, and the funnel from enabled to first event to repeat seller.
  • Keep live customers healthy: enablement, tax configuration edge cases, and payment issues, owning escalations directly until a support motion exists.
  • Own the numbers the business runs on: restaurants selling tickets, ticket sales, and fee revenue. Set the goals, measure them, and let the data change course.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including owning a product or major product area and its results.
  • You've taken an early product from first customers to product-market fit and meaningful growth.
  • You can point to product decisions that came directly from time spent with customers.
  • You've owned a revenue product end to end: pricing conversations, GTM partnership, and executive communication, not just a backlog.
  • You pull your own numbers, set goals up front, and let the data change your mind.
  • You use AI tools regularly in your work and can explain specifically how.
  • You write and speak clearly for technical and non-technical audiences.

Special Sauce (Nice to have)

  • Experience with payments, commerce, ticketing, or marketplace products.
  • Restaurant or hospitality tech experience, or another operationally complex industry.
  • Experience taking a zero-to-one product to market inside a larger company.
  • Experience pricing and packaging a new product.
  • You pull your own data with SQL or similar tools, or you prototype in code today.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at .

Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

About the Role:

 

At TELUS Digital, we help the world’s biggest brands build smarter technology. As an E-commerce Product & Search Relevancy Expert, your mission is to help an AI learn how to suggest the perfect products to online shoppers. You will look at massive catalogs across various industries and decide which items belong together. You act as the "human logic" that ensures a customer sees a matching set or compatible accessories instead of a random, incorrect suggestion.

 

What You’ll Do:

 

·         Create Pairs: Match products based on color, pattern, and style so they are visually consistent.

·         Check Compatibility: Ensure products actually work together for the same use case. (Example: Matching the right technical gear for specific sub-disciplines like gravel biking vs. road cycling).

·         Review Metadata: Look at gender, price segment, and seasonality to ensure recommendations are logically and commercially sound.

·         Maintain Data Integrity: Keep a clean, structured list of matches that follow strict brand and category guidelines.

·         Category Research: Quickly learn the nuances of new product domains to pick the best matches. (Example: Researching technical differences in skiing, cycling, or gym fitness gear).

Qualification path

Mandatory Qualifications:

·         Experience: A proven track record in search relevancy, product categorization, or e-commerce content moderation and annotation.

·         Education: A minimum of a Bachelor's in any field.

·         Analytical Skills: The ability to learn and differentiate between technical product categories quickly.

·         Attention to Detail: High sensitivity to visual aesthetics and the ability to spot subtle mismatches in style or price positioning.

·         Efficiency: Comfortable navigating large datasets and high-volume SKU catalogs while maintaining quality standards.

·         English Proficiency: Minimum B1 (Intermediate) level to navigate technical documentation and product attributes.

 

Professional Experience: Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in one or more of the following:

·         E-commerce product catalog management or product data analysis.

·         Product recommendations, search relevance, or product matching.

·         Online retail merchandising, product categorization, or taxonomy management.

·         Product compatibility analysis or technical product research.

·         Fashion, sporting goods, consumer electronics, or other product-specific retail domains.

Required Skills:

·         Strong analytical and research skills.

·         Ability to assess product similarity, compatibility and relevance.

·         Attention to detail when reviewing product attributes, metadata and categorization.

·         Ability to interpret product specifications and apply category-specific guidelines.

·         Strong written comprehension and decision-making skills.

 

Assessment:
