jobs.excerpt: Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world.
jobs.description:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups.
We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.

You’ll handle Wingtra’s hardest technical cases in the US East region, the ones that need a surveyor’s judgment, not just a troubleshooting script. Most of your time goes to escalated technical support: complex payload, LiDAR and processing issues you work through with our engineers in Zurich. The rest goes to the field: training dealers, running onsite customer sessions, pilot projects and sales support.

You’ll work daily with the US support team, the US East sales reps, our dealer network and the product and engineering teams in Zurich.

Responsibilities

    Most of your time (about 75%) goes to advanced technical support:

    • Own the hardest cases. You take Tier 2 and Tier 3 escalations for US East customers and dealers, the ones the frontline team can’t close on their own.
    • Get to the bottom of it. You investigate issues across drone hardware, payloads (RGB, multispectral, LiDAR), flight planning and post-processing.
    • Work the problem with Zurich. When a sensor or integration issue needs more than a support ticket, you bring in payload partners and Wingtra’s engineers in Zurich to close it out.
    • Check the data, not just the ticket. You review customer datasets for GCPs, PPK, coordinate systems, photogrammetry and LiDAR outputs, and you tell customers exactly what to fix and how.
    • Be the person they can count on. For key accounts with an open or recurring issue, you’re the one technical point of contact, so they always know where things stand.
    • Keep the record straight. You manage cases, customer history and RMA logistics in HubSpot, and you flag upsell signals to the sales team along the way.
    • Turn hard cases into shared knowledge. You write up solved escalations as Knowledge Base articles and internal troubleshooting guides, so the next case goes faster.
    • Close the loop with product. You feed recurring issues back to product and engineering, so they hear what customers keep running into.

      • The rest (about 25%) is professional services and field work:

      • Get our dealers up to speed. You run onboarding and certification trainings for dealers, in person and remote.
      • Get hands-on with customers. You lead onsite trainings, pilot projects and product demos.
      • Back up sales when it counts. Late in a deal, you join sales reps for technical demos, workflow reviews and the survey-specific questions only a surveyor can answer.

Requirements

    • You have a bachelor’s degree in geomatics, surveying, civil engineering, GIS or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
    • You’ve spent 3+ years in the geospatial or surveying industry, with hands-on field and office survey work behind you.
    • You have a working knowledge of survey control, GNSS, RTK/PPK, coordinate systems and accuracy reporting.
    • You’ve processed photogrammetry or LiDAR data in tools like Pix4D, Agisoft Metashape, Trimble Business Center, LiDAR360, QGIS or ArcGIS.
    • You troubleshoot in a structured way, and you have the patience to see a hard case through to root cause.
    • You write and speak English clearly, and you can explain a technical problem to a customer, a dealer or an engineer.
    • You’re based on the US East Coast and ready to travel to customer and dealer sites there, roughly 20-30% of your time.

Plus

    • A Professional Land Surveyor (PLS) license, or working toward one.
    • Hands-on with UAV (drone) mapping workflows and payload integrations.
    • A background in technical support, customer success or pre-sales for a technical product.
    • Comfortable working in HubSpot, Zendesk or a similar CRM and ticketing system.
    • Confident delivering trainings or technical presentations.
    • Time spent at a startup.
If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Gatik, the leader in autonomous middle-mile logistics, is revolutionizing the B2B supply chain with its autonomous transportation-as-a-service (ATaaS) solution and prioritizing safe, consistent deliveries while streamlining freight movement by reducing congestion. The company focuses on short-haul, B2B logistics for Fortune 500 retailers and in 2021 launched the world’s first fully driverless commercial transportation service with Walmart. Gatik's Class 3-7 autonomous trucks are commercially deployed across major markets, including Texas, Arkansas, and Ontario, Canada, driving innovation in freight transportation.

The company's proprietary Level 4 autonomous technology, Gatik Carrier™, is custom-built to transport freight safely and efficiently between pick-up and drop-off locations on the middle mile. With robust capabilities in both highway and urban environments, Gatik Carrier™ serves as an all-encompassing solution that integrates advanced software and hardware powering the fleet, facilitating effortless integration into customers' logistics operations.

About the RoleGatik is looking for a technical, high-performing Sr. Field Service Team Manager to build, empower, and lead a team of Field Service Technicians in maintaining high vehicle availability and operational safety. In this role, you will oversee market technical execution, manage autonomous system upfits and end-of-line improvement initiatives, and validate standard work instructions for vehicle retrofits. Reporting to the Director, Fleet and Maintenance Strategy, you will partner closely with local fleet managers and Techops teams across Hardware, Software, and Autonomous Vehicle Integration to rapidly resolve complex technical issues. You will be instrumental in maintaining rigorous safety and quality standards while driving fleet reliability across field operations.

This role is remote, but travel is necessary to our sites throughout North America.

What You'll Do

  • Team Leadership & Operational Execution: Recruit, manage, and empower a high-performing team of Field Service Technicians, directing daily operations, performance, skill development, and career growth while fostering a culture of accountability and safety.
  • Engineering Liaison & Support Architecture: Establish a field liaison program and tiered escalation framework to bridge communication between frontline technicians and central TechOps, driving rapid root-cause analysis and actionable feedback to engineering.
  • Fleet Maintenance & Optimization: Partner with engineering to diagnose underperforming fleet assets and implement targeted maintenance strategies to maximize uptime, lower MTTR, and resolve recurring issues.
  • Autonomous Upfits & System Validation: Oversee physical upfits and End of Line (EOL) verification for compute, sensor, and hardware suites to ensure vehicles are fully operational before deployment.
  • Campaign Execution & Standard Work Documentation: Execute field vehicle campaigns and retrofits, establish clear standard work instructions, and train new maintenance vendors on operational standards.
  • Quality, Safety & Regulatory Compliance: Enforce safety protocols, PPE usage, and workspace cleanliness while ensuring full compliance with DOT and FMCSA regulatory standards.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in technical field service, commercial fleet maintenance, or automotive/hardware technical operations, with at least 2+ years in direct people management.
  • Team Leadership: Proven track record of hiring, mentoring, and managing technical teams of technicians or diagnostic mechanics.
  • Technical Escalations & Cross-Functional Work: Demonstrated ability to manage complex technical escalations and collaborate effectively with hardware and software engineering teams.
  • Upfit & Campaign Experience: Hands-on experience with vehicle upfits, sensor/hardware integration, end-of-line verification, and technical campaign/retrofit execution.
  • Technical Documentation: Ability to author clear standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and step-by-step technical documentation.
  • Diagnostic Expertise: Deep familiarity with vehicle diagnostics, electrical systems, CAN bus/telematics, and troubleshooting tools.

More about Gatik

Founded in 2017 by experts in autonomous vehicle technology, Gatik has rapidly expanded its presence to Mountain View, Dallas-Fort Worth, Arkansas, and Toronto. As the first and only company to achieve fully driverless middle-mile commercial deliveries, Gatik holds a unique and defensible position in the AV industry, with a clear trajectory toward sustainable growth and profitability.

We have delivered complete, proprietary AV technology - an integration of software and hardware - to enable earlier successes for our clients in constrained Level 4 autonomy. By choosing the middle mile – with defined point-to-point delivery, we have simplified some of the more complex AV challenges, enabling us to achieve full autonomy ahead of competitors. Given extensive knowledge of Gatik’s well-defined, fixed route ODDs and hybrid architecture, we are able to hyper-optimize our models with exponentially less data, establish gate-keeping mechanisms to maintain explainability, and ensure continued safety of the system for unmanned operations.

Visit us at Gatik for more company information and Careers at Gatik for more open roles.

  • Tech Brew:Gatik AI exec unpacks the regulations that could shape the AV industry
  • Business Wire: Gatik Paves the Way for Safe Driverless Operations (‘Freight-Only’) at Scale with Industry-First Third-Party Safety Assessment Framework
  • Auto Futures: Autonomous Trucking Group Gatik Secures Investment From NIPPON EXPRESS HOLDINGS
  • Automotive News: Gatik foresees hundreds of self-driving trucks on road soon, and that's just the beginning
  • Forbes: Isuzu And Gatik Go All In To Scale Up Driverless Freight Services
  • Bloomberg: Autonomous Vehicle Startup Takes Off by Picking Off Easier Routes
  • Reuters: Driverless vehicles on limited routes bump along despite US robotaxi scrutiny

Taking Care of Our Team

At Gatik, we connect people of extraordinary talent and experience to an opportunity to create a more resilient supply chain and contribute to our environment’s sustainability. We are diverse in our backgrounds and perspectives yet united by a bold vision and shared commitment to our values. Our culture emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect and agility.

You act as the "human logic" that ensures a customer sees a matching set or compatible accessories instead of a random, incorrect suggestion.

 

What You’ll Do:

 

·         Create Pairs: Match products based on color, pattern, and style so they are visually consistent.

·         Check Compatibility: Ensure products actually work together for the same use case. (Example: Matching the right technical gear for specific sub-disciplines like gravel biking vs. road cycling).

·         Review Metadata: Look at gender, price segment, and seasonality to ensure recommendations are logically and commercially sound.

·         Maintain Data Integrity: Keep a clean, structured list of matches that follow strict brand and category guidelines.

·         Category Research: Quickly learn the nuances of new product domains to pick the best matches. (Example: Researching technical differences in skiing, cycling, or gym fitness gear).

Qualification path

Mandatory Qualifications:

·         Experience: A proven track record in search relevancy, product categorization, or e-commerce content moderation and annotation.

·         Education: A minimum of a Bachelor's in any field.

·         Analytical Skills: The ability to learn and differentiate between technical product categories quickly.

·         Attention to Detail: High sensitivity to visual aesthetics and the ability to spot subtle mismatches in style or price positioning.

·         Efficiency: Comfortable navigating large datasets and high-volume SKU catalogs while maintaining quality standards.

·         English Proficiency: Minimum B1 (Intermediate) level to navigate technical documentation and product attributes.

 

Professional Experience: Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in one or more of the following:

·         E-commerce product catalog management or product data analysis.

·         Product recommendations, search relevance, or product matching.

·         Online retail merchandising, product categorization, or taxonomy management.

·         Product compatibility analysis or technical product research.

·         Fashion, sporting goods, consumer electronics, or other product-specific retail domains.

Required Skills:

·         Strong analytical and research skills.

·         Ability to assess product similarity, compatibility and relevance.

·         Attention to detail when reviewing product attributes, metadata and categorization.

·         Ability to interpret product specifications and apply category-specific guidelines.

·         Strong written comprehension and decision-making skills.

You will report to the director, ceded reinsurance operations.

This is a primarily home position. However, if candidates reside within 35-50 miles of one of our core office locations (Madison, WI; Boston, MA; Hopkins, MN; Phoenix, AZ; Keene, NH; St Joseph, MO or Denver, CO), this would be a hybrid position.

jobs.description:
This is an exciting opportunity to work for one of the top law firms in the U.S.! Davis Wright Tremaine LLP is looking for a Manager, Modern Workplace Engineeringto join our team in our Seattleoffice.

This position offers the flexibility to be fully remote while working within reasonable commuting distance from any of our offices.

This role is responsible for overseeing and leading the team that designs, supports, secures, and modernizes the firm's End-User Computing (EUC) environment, including desktops, laptops, virtual desktops, mobile devices, application delivery platforms, and user environment technologies. This includes endpoint provisioning, software packaging and deployment, operating system and third-party patching, endpoint policy and security control implementation, virtual desktop services, device lifecycle management, mobile device management, endpoint compliance, monitoring, reporting, and advanced technical escalation response.

The Manager, Endpoint Engineering leads a team of five engineers and collaborates with IT leadership and cross-functional technology teams to ensure a secure, stable, efficient, and user-focused digital workplace. The role is accountable for day-to-day operations, project delivery, personnel leadership, standard operating procedures, service health, budgeting, vendor management, and the endpoint technology roadmap.

A central responsibility of this position is to lead the firm's transition from legacy, on-premises endpoint management toward cloud-native modern management. The manager will guide the adoption and optimization of Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, cloud-based policy and compliance management, cross-platform endpoint administration, automation, and modern patching while maintaining operational continuity across SCCM/MECM, Group Policy, Ivanti, and other existing technologies during the transition.

On a typical day you will:

Endpoint Engineering and Device Management:

  • Oversee the configuration, provisioning, operation, and lifecycle management of all firm-issued desktops, laptops, mobile devices, and virtual desktop environments.
  • Manage endpoint platforms and transitional technologies including Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, SCCM/MECM, Microsoft Group Policy, Ivanti Environment Manager, and related management and reporting tools.
  • Lead endpoint hardware standards, refresh planning, device replacement, secure retirement, inventory governance, and lifecycle forecasting.
  • Develop and maintain monitoring, telemetry, reporting, service-level indicators, and KPIs for endpoint health, compliance, inventory, reliability, and user experience.

Cloud-Native Endpoint Modernization and Strategy:

  • Own and execute the endpoint technology roadmap in alignment with the firm's broader cloud strategy and modern workplace objectives.
  • Lead the phased transition from SCCM/MECM, traditional imaging, Group Policy, and legacy user environment management toward Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, cloud-based configuration, and modern identity-integrated controls.
  • Establish modern management architecture, governance, RBAC, enrollment, configuration, compliance, update, application delivery, and reporting standards for Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android.
  • Drive implementation of cloud-based provisioning, including zero-touch and direct-ship deployment models, while preserving a reliable coexistence and rollback strategy during migration.
  • Build team proficiency in cloud-native endpoint technologies through structured training, knowledge transfer, documentation, and practical ownership.

Software Packaging, Patch Management, Security, and Compliance:

  • Oversee application packaging, compatibility testing, integration, software deployment, version control, and lifecycle management across physical and virtual endpoint platforms.
  • Lead operating system, Microsoft application, and third-party application update and patch cycles, balancing security, testing, change control, business continuity, and user impact.
  • Partner with the Security Office and Identity Services on endpoint hardening, vulnerability remediation, encryption, Microsoft Defender integrations, device compliance, Conditional Access, Application Protection Policies, device trust, and Zero Trust-aligned access controls.
  • Track and remediate endpoint non-compliance, configuration drift, application control exceptions, and security findings using monitoring, alerting, reporting, and automation.
  • Ensure endpoint controls support legal, regulatory, client, information governance, and litigation hold requirements as applicable.

Virtual Desktop Infrastructure, Mobility, and User Experience:

  • Manage the design, configuration, image lifecycle, entitlements, capacity, performance, and operational health of the firm's virtual desktop services, including VMware Horizon and Azure Virtual Desktop or successor platforms.
  • Oversee user profile, personalization, application control, and user environment technologies, including Ivanti and future cloud-based alternatives.
  • Evaluate and implement emerging endpoint, virtualization, mobility, Cloud PC, and modern workplace capabilities that improve flexibility, security, resiliency, and employee experience.

Team Leadership, Personnel Management, and Collaboration:

  • Provide direct guidance, mentorship, technical leadership, and performance management to a team of five Endpoint Engineers.
  • Conduct one-on-one meetings, goal setting, skills development planning, hiring, performance reviews, succession planning, cross-training, and career coaching.
  • Set priorities and balance operational support, project commitments, security remediation, modernization activities, and technical debt reduction across the team.
  • Collaborate with Security, Networking, Infrastructure, Messaging, Identity Services, Digital Collaboration, Service Desk, Application Services, Information Governance, and project teams to deliver integrated solutions.
  • Act as the senior escalation point for endpoint incidents, systemic issues, security events, and technical decisions requiring management oversight.

Processes, Workflows, Documentation, and Service Management:

  • Establish and maintain standard operating procedures, architecture records, configuration baselines, deployment workflows, support documentation, inventories, service ownership, and escalation paths.
  • Ensure team adherence to firmwide change, incident, problem, release, vulnerability, and project management processes.
  • Drive automation-first engineering using PowerShell, APIs, orchestration, and workflow tools to improve consistency, scalability, and supportability.
  • Identify and remediate recurring issues, knowledge gaps, single points of failure, and technical debt.
  • Define and report service health, risk, capacity, roadmap progress, project status, and modernization outcomes to IT leadership and stakeholders.

Budgeting, Vendor, Project, and Resource Management:

  • Participate in annual IT budgeting and multi-year planning for endpoint hardware, software, licensing, professional services, training, and modernization initiatives.
  • Manage vendor relationships for endpoint management, desktop hardware, virtual desktop services, application delivery, and related professional services.
  • Lead or sponsor endpoint projects, develop business cases, coordinate internal and external resources, manage dependencies and risks, and communicate status to stakeholders.
  • Track team capacity and resource utilization and recommend investments that improve security, performance, user experience, resiliency, and cost effectiveness.

Join us if you have:

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • 8+ years enterprise endpoint engineering, end-user computing, modern workplace, device management, or closely related experience in a medium-to-large enterprise environment.
  • 5+ years technical leadership experience with responsibility for endpoint engineering services, production platforms, projects, roadmaps, and operational outcomes; demonstrated ability to motivate and provide meaningful coaching and mentorship to provide top level service within an organization
  • 3+ years direct people-management experience, including hiring, coaching, performance management, skills development, succession planning, and leading teams that support a 24/7 customer base.
  • Demonstrated experience leading or materially contributing to an enterprise transition from traditional endpoint management toward cloud-native modern management while maintaining operational stability and security.
  • Advanced production experience with Microsoft Intune, including enrollment, configuration profiles, compliance policies, endpoint security policies, application deployment, reporting, RBAC, and device lifecycle administration.
  • Strong experience designing, implementing, or operating Windows Autopilot provisioning, including enrollment profiles, deployment profiles, hardware registration, application delivery, and zero-touch or direct-ship scenarios.
  • Strong experience supporting hybrid and cloud-managed endpoint environments that use Microsoft Intune together with SCCM/MECM during phased migration or co-management.
  • Deep knowledge of Windows endpoint engineering, Windows 11, Microsoft 365 Apps, software packaging, application compatibility, software deployment, Windows Update, third-party patching, endpoint telemetry, encryption, and system hardening.
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID device identities and close partnership with identity and security teams on Conditional Access, device compliance, device trust, MFA, Application Protection Policies, and Zero Trust-aligned controls.
  • Experience managing mobile devices and applications across iOS and Android, including enrollment, configuration, compliance, MDM, and MAM or application protection capabilities.
  • Experience managing virtual desktop environments and image lifecycles, such as VMware Horizon, Azure Virtual Desktop, Citrix, Windows 365, or comparable enterprise platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience with user profile management, user environment management, application control, personalization, Group Policy, and migration of legacy controls toward modern cloud-based alternatives.
  • Proficiency with PowerShell and experience using APIs, automation, orchestration, or workflow tools to administer endpoints at scale and reduce manual effort.
  • Experience developing endpoint technology roadmaps, architecture standards, operating procedures, service metrics, budgets, vendor strategies, business cases, and project plans.
  • Strong organizational and project leadership skills with the ability to manage operational work, major incidents, security remediation, concurrent projects, modernization initiatives, and competing priorities.
  • Strong written, verbal, customer interaction, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to translate business, security, and legal requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Experience managing macOS through Microsoft Intune or another enterprise Apple management platform, including enrollment, configuration, compliance, patching, application delivery, and Apple Business Manager integration.
  • Microsoft certifications in Endpoint Administration, Identity and Access, Security, Microsoft 365, Azure, or comparable modern workplace disciplines; ITIL or equivalent service-management training is also preferred.
  • Experience in a law firm, professional services organization, regulated environment, or highly client-service-oriented enterprise, with familiarity supporting confidentiality, information governance, and business continuity requirements.

Who We Are

Davis Wright Tremaine LLP is an AmLaw 100 law firm with 9 offices nationwide. We are relentlessly committed to client service and look for candidates who share that commitment. At DWT, client service means having empathy for each client’s and each lawyer’s work and personal pressures, business objectives, and legal needs; anticipating their needs; and having the capabilities and commitment to deliver what matters most to them.

What’s in it For You?

DWT offers competitive compensation in addition to ample benefits including but not limited to:

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer, Direct
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleOnboarded sells to high-volume, high-complexity employers: staffing firms, franchises, and enterprises that hire thousands of people a month.
jobs.description:
About the Role

Onboarded sells to high-volume, high-complexity employers: staffing firms, franchises, and enterprises that hire thousands of people a month. Some of them will buy through a platform they already live in, like Bullhorn or Salesforce. Others will build directly to our API. Either way, someone has to sit across from them, understand how they actually run HR, prove that Onboarded can handle it, and then make it happen. That someone is you.

This is the person who owns our direct customers from the first demo through a live implementation. You'll run demos for HR audiences, scope what they need, build proof-of-concepts, configure the platform to model their workflows, and drive the implementation through go-live. Unlike our Partnership GTM model, Direct customers only have us, so the work is consultative by design. We teach them to run their own HR stack rather than making them dependent on us.

The role is deliberately varied. One day you're selling the vision, the next you're in the platform making it work, the next you're writing user stories so Product can build the thing that makes the next customer easier.

You'll operate with a lot of autonomy on a small team. That means strong alignment on the company's vision and objectives, high agency and ownership of outcomes, and little tactical guidance on exactly what to do. We want someone who sees a problem, forms an opinion, and moves. Someone comfortable pushing back and challenging how we do things when they see a better way.

You need to come from HR tech. Staffing and high-volume hiring come with unusual requirements, and the people who thrive in this role already understand them. Coming in already fluent in that world means you can add value with customers from day one.

What You'll Do

  • Run demos that land with HR buyers. Lead demos across mid-market and enterprise, for customers on platforms like Bullhorn and Salesforce and for customers building to our API. You read an HR audience well, tie the platform to the problems they came in with, and show value fast. A healthcare staffing prospect should see a credentialing-ready demo within a day, not after three rounds of discovery.

  • Scope, prototype, and prove. Investigate customer systems and third-party service APIs (background checks, tax credits, HRIS, LMS, and more), stand up proof-of-concepts, and show (often live, in a few minutes) how Onboarded would solve a specific request. When someone describes a need, you can say "yes, here's how" and then go build it.

  • Configure the platform to fit the customer. Interpret requirements and set up Onboarded to match how a customer actually runs HR, modeling their workflows in the system instead of forcing them into a template. Configuration is a core part of this role. You'll be hands-on in the platform every week, and you should like that kind of work.

  • Own implementations through go-live. You stay with the customer past the sale. You collect requirements, design the architecture with them, manage the project, and see it through until they're live and successful. The person who sells the vision is the person who makes it happen.

  • Bring a product lens. Translate what you hear from customers into user stories and product requirements so engineers understand what to build, why, for whom, and how it fits the bigger picture. You'll also show Product where the platform should evolve.

  • Use AI as a force multiplier and build your own tools. Use agents, iPaaS tooling, and whatever else gets the job done to move faster, and build your own solutions when it helps (Claude Code, Cloudflare, scrappy internal tools). Solutions is the heaviest user of every agent our engineers ship. We give you the best AI and the freedom to experiment with it.

What We're Looking For

  • HR tech background. You've worked in HR tech or a close adjacent, and you understand the challenges of staffing and high-volume, high-complexity employers. You can be the expert in the room on HR operations, the messy middle between the ATS and the HRIS: E-Verify, I-9, background checks, credentialing, payroll handoffs. You know how to demo to HR audiences because you've done it.

  • Strong grasp of APIs and integrations. You understand how APIs actually work, and you've built integrations between SaaS platforms. This is a requirement. Much of the role is connecting Onboarded to the systems customers already run. Ideally you've done this inside an API-forward SaaS business that sells both software and an API that partners and customers build to.

  • Experience with ATSs and enterprise platforms. You've worked with the systems our customers live in: applicant tracking systems and platforms like Salesforce, Bullhorn, or Microsoft Dynamics. You don't need to be a specialist in any one of them. What matters is that you're comfortable getting into these platforms and understanding how customers build on top of them.

  • A generalist who spans demo through implementation. You're pre-sales-oriented with hands-on implementation chops, or the reverse: a strong implementer who's done pre-sales, or someone who came up through support into pre-sales. What matters is you can do both. You don't think configuration work is beneath you, and you refuse to be a click-and-implement project manager who stops at "the customer asked, so I did it."

  • Fast on your feet. This role rewards creative problem-solving in the moment. You think quickly, respond live, and stay nimble under pressure. If you do your best work only after time to research and get to a perfectly precise answer, this specific role probably isn't the right fit.

  • AI-native, and opinionated about it. You can clearly articulate how agentic AI is changing how businesses buy, how people work, and how you work. This is a baseline expectation for the role, and you'll put it to work every day.

  • A self-starter who challenges the status quo. You have examples of pushing your manager to think differently, articulating a better way, and getting after hard problems without being handed a plan.

This role is not for someone who needs heavy structure, prefers to stay behind the scenes, or wants clean boundaries between "my job" and "not my job." It's for autonomous, quick-thinking operators who like owning a customer from first demo to go-live and everything in between.

Why This Role

  • High ownership, start to finish. Each direct customer you take on is yours from the first technical demo through go-live. You decide how to get them there, and you shape how Onboarded serves direct customers as we grow.

  • Autonomy and access. You choose how you work, you get direct lines to Product and leadership, and your read on customers directly shapes the platform.

  • Ownership that isn't watered down. We keep the team small on purpose, which keeps equity meaningful and concentrated. You're building something you have a stake in.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a fast-growing, deliberately lean startup

  • Health, dental, vision, and 401(k)

  • Remote-first, and you own how and when you work

  • The best AI tools (including Claude Max) and full freedom to experiment with agents and build your own tooling

  • A laid-back, low-ego team that would rather be direct and friendly than formal, where disagreeing, pushing back, and then committing is how we operate

Whats the opportunity:

As a Security Software Engineer on our Security & Trust team, you'll build the systems that help mature Aura's security and compliance commitments. You'll partner with our Security Assurance Manager , who owns our compliance frameworks and audit program, and be responsible for turning those requirements into automated, enforceable technical controls: policy-as-code in our pipelines, continuous monitoring across our cloud environments, and scalable workflows that grow with the business.

This is an engineering role first. You don't need a compliance or security background; we'll teach you the frameworks. What we need is someone who writes solid code, thinks in systems, and wants to apply those skills to one of the most interesting problems in security right now.

Day to Day:

Build & Automate:

  • Translate security and compliance requirements, defined with our Security Assurance Manager , into automated technical controls, using policy-as-code enforced in CI/CD and against infrastructure-as-code.
  • Build pipelines and integrations that collect compliance evidence directly from our internal systems, so audits run on live data rather than screenshots and spreadsheets.
  • Develop continuous monitoring for security controls and cloud environments, integrating with our GRC tooling (e.g., Vanta) and surfacing issues where engineers already work.
  • Apply AI and automation to streamline compliance workflows — from intelligent triage of risk assessments to automated evidence gathering and control validation.

Scale the Program:

  • Help engineer our Common Control Framework, building a unified structure that serves audits, risk assessments, and vendor reviews from a single source of truth.
  • Build the tooling and workflows that let the Security & Trust team operate efficiently as the company grows — automating repetitive processes, improving reporting, and reducing the compliance burden on engineering teams.
  • Support audit readiness across multiple frameworks (SOC 2, SOX, ISO 27001) by ensuring evidence is continuously collected, organized, and accessible.

Collaborate:

  • Work hand in hand with our Security Assurance Manager , who owns frameworks, policy, and audits, providing the technical implementation and evidence behind our compliance program.
  • Partner across business and technical teams to embed security and compliance into existing workflows — our team philosophy is partnership, not mandates.
  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives including vendor risk management, access reviews, and security advisory across the organization.

What you bring to the table:

  • 3-5+ years of software engineering experience, ideally in security, infrastructure, backend, Devops or platform engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Python (or a similar language), including writing production-quality, tested code and working with APIs.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS (or another major cloud provider), including IAM, networking, and security groups.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • An automation-first mindset — you see a manual process and immediately think about how to eliminate it.
  • Genuine curiosity and a builder’s mentality. You’re energized by standing up new systems, not just maintaining existing ones.
  • A self-starter mentality, with the ability to work autonomously, manage competing priorities, and drive projects to completion in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills. You’ll work closely with non-engineers and need to explain technical concepts to non-technical partners.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with policy-as-code tools such as Open Policy Agent.
  • Exposure to ML systems or MLOps tooling, or applying AI to automate business processes.
  • Familiarity with security and privacy frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI, SOX, NIST AI RMF, and EU/US data privacy laws.
  • Experience with GRC and ticketing tools such as Vanta or Jira.
  • Experience building internal tools, developer platforms, or automation frameworks.

CRO Specialist

Location: Remote (US-based) | Type: Full-time, salaried

Salary: $90,000 to $120,000 per year based on experience | Travel: Occasional client visits

About Shero Commerce

Shero Commerce is an ecommerce agency that helps brands grow on Shopify through strategy, design, development, and digital marketing. Our marketing team covers PPC, SEO, CRO, organic social, and email, and works side by side with our design and development teams on every client account.

About the role

Shero is hiring a full-time CRO Specialist to own conversion rate optimization across our Shopify client portfolio. This is a hands-on role for someone who reads data quickly, spots the story behind the numbers, and turns it into clear hypotheses, wireframes, and tests that move revenue.

You will audit stores, find where shoppers drop off and why, sketch the fix, build optimization roadmasp and lead tests and evidence-led improvements. You will be the connective tissue between marketing, design, and development, and we need you contributing from your first week.

What you will do

Audit and diagnose.

  • Combine GA4, Shopify analytics, heatmaps, scroll maps, and session recordings into one clear view of the funnel
  • Identify friction, drop-off points, and missed revenue, and quantify the opportunity behind each finding
  • Run full CRO audits on Shopify stores across the buying journey, including product discovery, product pages, cart, and checkout.

Turn data into hypotheses.

  • Write sharp, testable hypotheses grounded in quantitative and qualitative evidence
  • Prioritize ideas using a consistent framework (such as ICE or PIE) based on impact, confidence, and effort
  • Translate findings into plain language recommendations clients and internal teams can act on

Wireframe the solution.

  • Produce high-level wireframes and annotated concepts that show what to change and why
  • Hand off clear briefs to designers and developers so tests move from idea to launch without rework

Build and run the roadmap.

  • Own a prioritized CRO roadmap for each client. Assess traffic and data quality to determine when A/B testing is viable; for lower-traffic stores, use customer research and other evidence to recommend improvements, and clearly distinguish tested results from directional findings.
  • Set up, QA, and launch A/B and multivariate tests across different testing platforms
  • Define primary, secondary and guardrail metrics, sample size, and test duration before launch.
  • Analyze results with statistical rigor, document learnings, and feed them into the next round of tests

Partner across teams.

  • Work with digital marketing specialists to align landing pages and offers with traffic sources
  • Collaborate with design, solutions, and development to turn recommendations into feasible, effective customer experiences.
  • Identify tracking and measurement issues that could affect CRO decisions, and work with the Marketing Technology Engineer to validate data, resolve issues, and ensure reliable test results.
  • Present findings and test results to clients and leadership in a clear, confident way, including occasional on-site client visits
  • Contribute to various team meetings and share wins and learnings across all Shero teams

Grow the CRO practice

This is initially a hands-on specialist role. As our CRO client base and retainer hours grow, you’ll have opportunities to develop your commercial and leadership skills and help shape the future of the practice.

  • Identify opportunities to expand CRO support for existing clients and introduce the service to clients who don’t currently use it.
  • Partner with account and sales teams to develop recommendations and support proposals, with guidance from the wider team.
  • As demand grows, help develop CRO processes and share your knowledge with future team members, with the potential to take on greater team leadership over time.

What you bring

  • Five or more years of ecommerce experience, preferably at an agency, with at least three years focused on CRO
  • Ecommerce depth matters more than years in CRO alone: candidates who moved into CRO from design, marketing, or solutions roles are encouraged to apply
  • Shopify experience: knowledge of Shopify themes, apps, checkout, and analytics
  • Strong GA4 skills, including funnel exploration, segments, events, and ecommerce reporting
  • Proven experience with heatmapping and session recording tools such as Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or Lucky Orange
  • Experience setting up and running tests on more than one testing platform
  • A track record of audits that led to tests, and tests that led to measurable revenue gains
  • Ability to create clear wireframes in Figma or a similar tool
  • Solid understanding of test statistics: significance, sample size, and when to call a test
  • Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Comfort using AI tools such as Claude to speed up analysis, audits, and test documentation
  • Ability to work remotely with consistent overlap with US business hours, where most Shero clients are based

Nice to have

  • Experience with Google Tag Manager and event tracking setup
  • Background in UX research, user testing, or survey tools
  • Experience with pricing, offer, and shipping threshold tests
  • Familiarity with digital marketing channels and how these affect onsite conversion

Who thrives in this role

  • Fast. You move from data to insight to action quickly, without waiting for perfect information.
  • Resourceful. You find the answer, the workaround, or the right person, and you do not need hand-holding to get started.
  • Curious. You ask why shoppers behave the way they do, and you love proving or disproving a hunch.
  • Collaborative. You make marketers, designers, and developers better at their jobs.
  • Accountable. You tie your work to revenue, and you own the results, good or bad.

What We Offer

We believe that taking care of our team is just as important as taking care of our clients. Here is what you can expect when you join Shero:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including:
    • Paid time off, sick days, flex time, and paid holidays, with options for floating or religious holidays
    • Medical and dental benefits upon eligibility
    • Eligibility for our 401(k) plan after one year of employment, with an employer match up to 3%, because we are invested in your future, not just your present
  • A remote-first company. Our processes, culture, and communication are built to make remote work feel connected and effective.
  • Room to grow, with opportunities for professional growth and development
  • Varied, meaningful work with a diverse portfolio of clients
  • A collaborative, supportive team culture

Our Core Values

At Shero, our culture is built on:

  • Collaboration and Innovation: We foster an environment where great ideas thrive.
  • Professional Vulnerability and Healthy Conflict: We grow by being open, honest, and constructive.
  • Positivity and a Can-Do Spirit: We stay solution-focused and keep moving forward.
  • Continuous Growth: We are always learning and evolving.

Additional duties may be assigned as the role and business needs evolve.

Does this sound like you? If you’re excited about the work and want to grow with a team that values you as a whole person, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today

Diversity and Equal Opportunity Statement

At Shero, we believe that diverse teams build better work, and that an inclusive workplace is not just a policy; it is a practice.

Shero is an at-will, equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, cultures, life experiences, abilities, and identities. True inclusion goes far beyond a statement in a handbook. It takes an intentional, day-to-day commitment in how we hire, lead, communicate, and grow together.

We are dedicated to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination and harassment in all forms. Every member of our team deserves to feel respected, valued, and empowered to do their best work.

Shero does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We are continuously working to build a culture where everyone belongs, not just on paper, but in practice.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

jobs.description:
Role Description

As Director of Pricing and Packaging at Dropbox, you will lead the strategy that determines how we package, price, and monetize our products across product-led growth(PLG) and sales-led growth(SLG) motions. Reporting to Head of Product Marketing, you will lead a small team and partner closely with Product, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Data Science, and senior executives to make pricing and packaging a durable driver of customer value and profitable growth.

This is a highly visible opportunity to help reinvent Dropbox’s monetization approach as we expand our sales-led business and build for the AI era. You will develop a holistic pricing and packaging architecture across products, customer segments, and routes to market—balancing customer adoption, competitive positioning, revenue growth, cost to serve, and margin. You will translate complex analysis into clear strategic choices, build alignment among senior leaders, and establish the capabilities and operating rhythms needed to make consistently strong monetization decisions.

You will have significant exposure to Dropbox’s senior leadership team and the opportunity to shape some of the company’s most consequential growth decisions. Your work will directly influence how customers experience and value Dropbox, how our products go to market, and how the business grows over the long term.

Responsibilities

  • Define and lead Dropbox’s company-wide pricing and packaging strategy across PLG and SLG motions, customer segments, product portfolios, and geographies.
  • Design the next generation of Dropbox’s packaging and monetization architecture, including approaches for AI-powered products and capabilities, while balancing customer value, adoption, revenue, cost to serve, and margin.
  • Build rigorous business cases and financial models to evaluate pricing and packaging opportunities, incorporating demand, willingness to pay, competitive dynamics, usage patterns, unit economics, and potential customer and revenue impacts.
  • Partner with Product, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Data Science, and Operations leaders to translate strategy into executable plans, including research, experimentation, rollout, enablement, measurement, and iteration.
  • Advise senior executives on high-impact monetization decisions by synthesizing complex quantitative and qualitative evidence into clear recommendations, tradeoffs, and decision frameworks.
  • Establish pricing and packaging governance, operating rhythms, performance metrics, and experimentation practices that improve the quality and speed of decision-making across Dropbox.
  • Lead, develop, and inspire a small team of pricing and packaging professionals while expanding the organization’s broader monetization capabilities.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in pricing, packaging, monetization, growth strategy, strategic finance, product strategy, management consulting, or a related discipline, including substantial experience in B2B SaaS.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and implementing pricing or packaging strategies that produced measurable business or customer outcomes.
  • Experience with both product-led and sales-led business models, including an understanding of their distinct customer journeys, routes to market, and monetization considerations.
  • Experience building pricing business cases and financial models that connect customer behavior and willingness to pay with revenue, cost to serve, unit economics, and margin.
  • Working knowledge of SaaS and AI monetization models, including subscription, seat-based, usage-based, consumption-based, and hybrid approaches.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence executive-level decisions and align senior cross-functional stakeholders around complex, high-impact initiatives.
  • People-management experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing team members.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading a major pricing or packaging transformation for a multi-product or global SaaS company.
  • Experience developing monetization strategies for AI-powered products, including evaluating inference or infrastructure costs, usage economics, value metrics, and margin implications.
  • Experience managing the intersection of self-serve, enterprise, and partner-led offerings within a shared product portfolio.
  • Experience with pricing research and experimentation methods such as conjoint analysis, willingness-to-pay research, price elasticity analysis, customer segmentation, or controlled testing.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technologycontinue to evolve:

  • Awareness:Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment:Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability:Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection:Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog postfrom our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

jobs.excerpt: About NutrientAt Nutrient, we're revolutionizing how the world works with documents.
jobs.description:
About Nutrient

At Nutrient, we're revolutionizing how the world works with documents. Our tools transform static files into intelligent, secure workflows, empowering businesses to innovate faster and smarter. Trusted by thousands of organizations across 80 countries, including Fortune 500 companies and public sector leaders, our platform supports nearly a billion end users globally in industries where documents aren't just files, they're mission-critical.

Your Role at Nutrient...

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who likes making things work and keeping them working. You’ll join the Native team, which builds the core document technology behind our .NET SDK, Java SDK and Python SDK. The same code powers Web SDK, Document Engine, AI Document Processor and Document Web Services, so when something breaks in it, every product and customer feels it.

Your focus is keeping a large, mature C# and C++ codebase reliable. You’ll take customer-reported issues and regressions, find the root cause, and ship a fix quickly without breaking anything else. You’ll often work in code you didn’t write, so you learn it on your own and leave it cleaner than you found it.

We’re an AI-first company: we use coding agents like Claude Code or Codex every day, and we expect you to as well.

What You'll Work On...

  • Investigate customer-reported bugs and regressions down to the root cause, capture each one in a failing test, and ship fixes that hold
  • Maintain a large C# and C++ codebase across Windows, Linux and macOS, keeping builds, tests and releases green
  • Turn recurring problems into tests, tooling or small refactors so they don’t come back
  • Work with Support and other teams to reproduce hard issues and unblock customers fast
  • Review teammates’ changes with an eye for correctness and side effects

What You'll Bring...

  • You've solved hard problems in production C# or C++, including memory, threading and performance issues
  • You're an AI-native engineer: coding agents like Claude Code or Codex are the major part of how you work, and you drive them, not the other way around
  • Rigor and a test-driven approach: you write a failing test that reproduces the bug before you fix it, and check for side effects
  • Strong problem solving in unfamiliar code, and the ability to learn a new area quickly on your own
  • Speed of execution: you close issues fast and keep several moving at once without losing track
  • Clear written communication in an async team, with customers and during incidents: precise bug analyses, pull request descriptions and status updates customers can trust
  • Bonus: experience with document formats (PDF, TIFF, Office), imaging, OCR. Data Extraction

Who Thrives Here...

At Nutrient, we’re not just hiring for skills. We’re hiring for mindset. The people who thrive here are:

  • Collaborators: You work openly, listen actively, and put team success first.
  • Hungry Learners: Rapid learning fuels your progress and career growth.
  • Curious Thinkers: You dig into the ‘why,’ valuing understanding over simply being right.
  • Self-Starters: You take action without waiting for direction, turning obstacles into opportunities.
  • Owners: You take responsibility for outcomes and always look for ways to improve what's in your control.
  • Doers: You're energized by progress and motivated to create meaningful impact.

Why You'll Love Working Here...

At Nutrient, we build tools that reshape how businesses and developers work with documents. Our culture is centered on continuous growth and collaboration. Every team member has room to learn, innovate, and drive meaningful impact.

  • Fully remote and async-first: minimal meetings, strong writing culture, and the independence to manage your own work.
  • Mission-critical product: Nutrient’s platform is trusted by 15%+ of the Global 500 across 80+ countries.
  • Strong growth trajectory: having more than doubled revenue over the past three years, backed by Insight Partners.

Nutrient believes in equal opportunity. We employ people from many cultures and countries, celebrate diversity, and are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, skill sets, and perspectives. jobs.title: Chief Experience Officer (CXO)
jobs.excerpt: 1.  Role SummaryThe Chief Experience Officer (CXO) is responsible for developing and executing the organization's overall experience strategy across customer, client, employee, and stakeholder touchpoints.
jobs.description:
1. Role Summary

The Chief Experience Officer (CXO) is responsible for developing and executing the organization's overall experience strategy across customer, client, employee, and stakeholder touchpoints. The role focuses on building a customer-centric culture, improving service quality, strengthening customer relationships, and ensuring consistent, seamless, and positive experiences across all insurance and investment products and services.

The CXO will lead customer experience (CX), service delivery, customer engagement, and experience transformation initiatives. The position will work closely with business, operations, technology, sales, marketing, claims, underwriting, and investment teams to improve satisfaction, loyalty, retention, and long-term business performance.

2. Key Responsibilities

Customer Experience Strategy

  • Develop and implement an enterprise-wide customer experience strategy aligned with the organization's business objectives.
  • Establish a customer-first culture across insurance, investment, and financial service operations.
  • Define customer experience standards, service principles, and performance benchmarks.
  • Identify opportunities to differentiate the organization through superior customer service and engagement.

Customer Journey Management

  • Map and optimize end-to-end customer journeys across product discovery, onboarding, policy issuance, premium payments, claims, renewals, investment services, and account management.
  • Identify service gaps, customer pain points, and process inefficiencies.
  • Simplify customer interactions and reduce friction across digital and traditional service channels.
  • Ensure consistent experiences across branches, call centres, websites, mobile applications, and relationship management teams.

Customer Satisfaction and Retention

  • Develop initiatives to improve customer satisfaction, loyalty, retention, and lifetime value.
  • Monitor customer feedback, complaints, service requests, and customer sentiment.
  • Establish customer feedback mechanisms, including surveys, NPS, CSAT, and customer interviews.
  • Lead initiatives to reduce customer attrition and improve policy renewal and investment account retention rates.

Digital Experience and Innovation

  • Collaborate with technology and digital teams to improve online platforms, mobile applications, customer portals, and self-service solutions.
  • Drive digital adoption and improve accessibility of insurance and investment services.
  • Leverage customer analytics, automation, AI, and CRM platforms to personalize customer interactions.
  • Champion innovative solutions that improve customer convenience and operational efficiency.

Customer Service and Relationship Management

  • Oversee customer service standards and service excellence initiatives.
  • Ensure timely resolution of customer inquiries, complaints, claims-related concerns, and investment service requests.
  • Strengthen relationship management practices for individual, corporate, institutional, and high-net-worth clients.
  • Establish service-level agreements (SLAs) and escalation procedures across customer-facing departments.

Employee Experience and Organizational Culture

  • Develop initiatives that improve employee engagement and internal service culture.
  • Promote collaboration between departments to deliver consistent customer experiences.
  • Support employee training and development in customer service, communication, relationship management, and service excellence.
  • Align employee experience initiatives with customer experience objectives.

Governance, Risk and Compliance

  • Ensure customer experience practices comply with applicable insurance, investment, consumer protection, data privacy, and financial services regulations.
  • Work with compliance and risk teams to address customer-related regulatory concerns.
  • Promote transparent communication, fair treatment, responsible product information, and ethical customer engagement.
  • Establish processes for monitoring and resolving customer complaints and service-related risks.

Leadership and Performance Management

  • Lead and develop customer experience, customer service, and service transformation teams.
  • Establish departmental objectives, budgets, KPIs, and performance management frameworks.
  • Present customer experience performance reports and strategic recommendations to the CEO and Board.
  • Collaborate with senior executives to integrate customer experience priorities into business strategy.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, Management, Customer Experience, or a related field.
  • Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA) or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 10–15+ years of progressive experience in customer experience, customer service, operations, client relationship management, or business transformation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior leadership or executive management position.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, wealth management, financial services, or other regulated service industries.
  • Demonstrated success in developing and implementing customer experience strategies.
  • Strong knowledge of customer journey mapping, CRM platforms, customer analytics, NPS, CSAT, and service quality management.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and large-scale service improvement initiatives.
  • Strong strategic thinking, communication, stakeholder management, and leadership capabilities.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT).

- Net Promoter Score (NPS).

  • Customer retention and policy renewal rates.
  • Customer attrition and churn reduction.
  • Customer complaint resolution time and satisfaction.

- First Contact Resolution (FCR) rate.

  • Digital channel adoption and self-service utilization.
  • Customer onboarding and service turnaround time.
  • Customer lifetime value and relationship growth.
  • Employee engagement and service culture improvement.
  • Compliance with customer service standards and regulatory requirements.

About Neo4j:

Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.

Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.

Our Vision:

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

At Neo4j, our Solution Engineers are pivotal to our company’s success. As a member of our regional go-to-market team, you will partner with our sales executives, working closely with clients to showcase how the Neo4j Graph Intelligence Platform addresses their critical business needs. Neo4j Solution Engineers play a central, hands-on role as clients consider and evaluate Neo4j technology, and support customers in an advisory capacity throughout their journey to value realization. SE’s work with organizations across industries such as Financial Services, Telecommunications, Technology and Life Sciences understand the business and technical value of representing data using Neo4j graph database and analytics technology. You will grow as a thought leader in graphs and solve our customers’ high-value problems beyond traditional data solutions.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Developing and honing subject matter expertise to effectively discern and understand the true needs of our customers, present technology solutions that target those needs, and all in all, demonstrate thought leadership and the value of Neo4j through platform and use case demonstrations, solution architecting, workshops, and conferences.
  • Meeting and exceeding regional revenue goals, as a result of helping Sales to qualify and validate opportunities from a technical perspective and accelerate the sales cycle and adoption of Neo4j.
  • Collaborating effectively with Sales, Professional Services, Partners, Product Management, etc to deliver continuous value to customers and ensure a seamless customer experience as they embark on the graph journey.

What You’ll Do:

  • Confidently articulate the business and technical value of Neo4j to customers and prospects as a key technical advisor and advocate for our products and services
  • Actively drive and run the technology evaluation stage of the sales cycles.
  • Work across a number of opportunities in parallel and manage day-to-day activities such as opportunity qualification, technical discovery, presentations, platform and use case demonstrations, proof of value, sizing, and documentation of technical decision criteria.
  • Build and nurture rapport with customer stakeholders at all levels and be the trusted advisor to them to help them understand what they can achieve with Neo4j.
  • Co-create reference and solution architectures with our customers, including integrating Neo4j with their existing architecture and applications within a public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP) or on-premise environment.
  • Stay current on latest Neo4j capabilities, including but not limited to usage and integration with third-party tools and services.
  • Distill and communicate customer needs and product feedback to Product Management, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales.
  • Help drive demand through the participation in account-based marketing events as well as industry-known conferences and trade shows.
  • Lead by example and actively foster an environment of teamwork, transparency, creativity, and continuous improvement.
  • Travel as needed to assist in deal creation and closure, and provide support to your team as required.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of customer-facing experience in a similar capacity (Sales/Presales/Solutions Engineer, Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant, etc), ideally in a similar high-growth, scaling environment.
  • Experience working with different data technologies in either of the following areas: enterprise data architecture, data analytics, data science or cloud data architecture.
  • Familiarity with graph data technology is essential. Working knowledge of Neo4j is a strong plus!
  • Hands-on experience and proficiency with relational (SQL) and/or NoSQL databases, and at least one of the following languages: Python, Java, JavaScript, Go, C#.
  • Successful track record in designing, developing, and implementing data solutions in the public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP) or on-premise.
  • Ability to engage and communicate ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences at all levels through presentations, whiteboarding, and platform demonstrations.
  • Technical savviness and business acumen to translate technical concepts and patterns into valuable business outcomes.
  • Passion for learning new technologies (especially graphs!), developing new ways of data modeling, and spearheading change management.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to prioritize, pivot, and problem-solve.

Overview

LMI is seeking a Lead Full Stack Developer to lead the design, development, integration, and sustainment of a secure, web-based mission data and digital asset management application supporting a SOCOM Mission Partner. The application enables authorized users to ingest, organize, discover, preview, share, and reuse mission-relevant files, datasets, software, models, and technical knowledge. It combines a modern user experience with scalable backend services, governed data access, project-based collaboration, and integration with a secure cloud-hosted delivery environment.

This is a hands-on engineering lead position. The selected candidate will contribute production code, guide technical design, perform code reviews, mentor developers, and coordinate directly with product, platform, security, and mission stakeholders. The ideal candidate has demonstrated success building full-stack applications that handle large files and complex data, enforce user permissions, and deliver dependable performance in secure government environments.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors, helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

This position is remote within the United States and requires an active Secret security clearance. Periodic travel to mission partner locations, including the Fort Bragg area, may be required for technical planning, user engagements, and integration activities. Classified work must be performed in approved facilities.

Responsibilities

  • Lead hands-on development of a secure, user-facing application for the ingestion, management, discovery, sharing, and reuse of large mission datasets and digital assets.
  • Design, build, review, test, and maintain full-stack features across responsive web interfaces, backend services, application programming interfaces (APIs), data stores, and cloud integrations.
  • Guide implementation of project-based organization, asset metadata, user profiles, file and dataset versioning, activity history, and collaboration capabilities such as comments, saved items, and feedback.
  • Engineer scalable file upload, ingestion, transfer, processing, and download workflows that reliably accommodate large volumes of images, video, documents, technical files, and structured or unstructured data.
  • Implement and optimize search, filtering, content previews, indexing, and data discovery workflows that help users identify relevant assets without unnecessary downloads.
  • Develop secure API contracts and integrations with object storage, metadata catalogs, search services, identity providers, mission applications, and other approved enterprise systems.
  • Apply authentication, authorization, role- or attribute-based access controls, audit logging, data handling rules, and secure file access throughout the application.
  • Coordinate with data engineering, platform, and cybersecurity teams to preserve data provenance, metadata, version history, security markings, and authorized handling of sensitive content.
  • Improve application performance, reliability, scalability, and observability; diagnose issues involving databases, backend services, object storage, web interfaces, networks, and deployment environments.
  • Work with product managers and UI/UX designers to translate user requirements into technical designs, refined backlog items, acceptance criteria, and production-quality releases.
