jobs.excerpt: Ready to be a Titan? At ServiceTitan, we are transforming product security into a core part of how engineering delivers software.
jobs.description:
Ready to be a Titan?

At ServiceTitan, we are transforming product security into a core part of how engineering delivers software. We are looking for a Staff Product Security Engineer to embed with one of our engineering portfolios and own its security outcomes end to end, across application security and cloud security, so that our 80 plus R&D teams build securely by default without slowing down innovation.

In this role, you will sit alongside engineering leaders in planning and design, threat model systems before they are built, own the portfolio's risk picture, and bring secure-by-default patterns to each team's architecture and workflow. You will be the security expert engineers know by name and the voice that carries their real-world context back into the program's strategy. This is an opportunity to shape how security is practiced where software actually gets built, turning security into an enabler of engineering velocity rather than a constraint.


What you'll do

Design Partnership

  • Standing Seat in Planning and Design: Join the portfolio's planning and design cadences as a permanent participant. Review roadmaps, architecture proposals, and technical designs early enough to shape them rather than gate them.
  • Threat Modeling: Lead and scale threat modeling across the portfolio using the program's standard and tooling. Prioritize top-tier systems, coach squads to run their own models, and make sure identified threats become tracked requirements in the findings flow.
  • Architecture Review: Provide secure architecture guidance for cloud-native services, microservices, multi-tenant data access, identity and secrets handling, and AI-enabled features. Translate the program's security requirements into concrete design decisions the squads can implement.

Portfolio Risk Ownership

  • Own the Risk Picture: Maintain a current, evidence-backed view of the portfolio's security risk across application findings, cloud posture, identity, and data exposure. Know what each squad builds, the data it touches, and where it is heading.
  • Drive Priorities with Engineering Leaders: Partner directly with the portfolio VP and their leaders to set remediation priorities, negotiate tradeoffs, and drive adherence to vulnerability remediation SLAs. Bring the data, own the follow through, and escalate with judgment.
  • Risk Acceptance and Exceptions: Guide squads through the program's risk acceptance process. Make sure exceptions are documented, time-bound, and visible to the right decision makers.

Paved-Road Adoption

  • Fit Central Patterns to Local Architecture: Take the paved roads built by the Platform and Programs team, including secure service templates, secrets management patterns, secure cloud configuration templates, CI/CD guardrails, and IaC policy sets, and adapt them to each squad's stack and workflow.
  • Drive Adoption in the Field: Get squads onto SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, IaC scanning, container scanning, and CSPM coverage, and keep them there. Tune signal quality with squads so findings are actionable, and close the loop on what is noise versus real risk.
  • Hands-On Remediation Support: Read the code, review the Terraform, and pair with engineers on fixes for the hard findings. Write reference implementations and fixes when that is the fastest way to unblock a squad.

Champion Coaching

  • Develop the Portfolio's Champions: Recruit, coach, and support the security champions across your squads. Be the technical expert they bring the hard questions to, and build them into the portfolio's first line of security response.
  • Contextual Enablement: Deliver just-in-time training, design reviews, and office hours tuned to what the portfolio is actually building. Help squads learn to fix their own code and configuration.

Strategy Feedback

  • Feed the Program Roadmap: Bring real engineering context back to the Director and the Platform and Programs team. Identify where central tooling, patterns, or standards fall short of what squads need, and shape what gets built next.
  • Metrics and Reporting: Contribute portfolio-level data to the program's metrics rhythm. Report on coverage, remediation velocity, and risk trends for your portfolio to security and engineering leadership.
  • Incident Support: Support triage and investigation of security incidents touching your portfolio, and turn lessons learned into design changes and paved-road improvements.

What you'll bring

  • Experience: 7-10+ years in product security, application security, cloud security, or a closely related security engineering role, with a strong software engineering foundation. Prior experience embedded with or partnering directly with engineering teams is strongly preferred.
  • Breadth Across AppSec and CloudSec: Demonstrated ability to work across the full stack of a modern SaaS product: secure code review, threat modeling, secure design, CI/CD and supply chain security, cloud identity and least privilege, IaC security, container and Kubernetes security, and cloud posture management. You do not need to be the deepest specialist in every area, but you must be credible in all of them.
  • Coding and Cloud Fluency: Proficiency reading and writing code in C#/.NET (preferred), Go, Java, or Python, and hands-on experience with Azure and/or AWS security services and IaC tooling such as Terraform or Bicep. You can review a pull request and a Terraform module with equal comfort.
  • Threat Modeling and Secure Design: Track record of leading threat modeling and architecture review at scale, and of turning the results into requirements engineering teams actually deliver.
  • Influence Without Authority: Proven ability to build trust with VP level engineering leaders and senior engineers, drive priorities through partnership rather than mandate, and hold the line on risk when it matters.
  • Automation Mindset: Preference for building repeatable patterns over one-off fixes. Comfortable scripting and automating security tasks, and comfortable using AI-assisted tooling to scale your own work.
  • AI Forward: Familiarity with securing AI-enabled features and AI coding agents, and with the emerging risks around non-human identities, MCP integrations, and data exposure in AI systems.
  • Certifications: CISSP, CCSP, CSSLP, AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, OSCP, or similar are a plus, not a requirement.

Why this role?

Be in the Room: Most security engineers review what has already been decided. You will sit in portfolio planning and design as a standing member and shape what gets built before it is built.

Own a Portfolio, Not a Queue: You are accountable for the security posture of a defined set of squads and a named engineering leaders. Your success is measured in risk reduced, remediation velocity, and paved-road adoption across that portfolio, not in tickets closed.

Full-Stack Security Scope: This role deliberately spans application and cloud security. You will work across code, pipelines, identity, infrastructure, data, and AI systems, backed by specialists on the central team when you need depth.

Shape How Security Is Practiced: You will help define what embedded security partnership looks like at ServiceTitan, from how you engage with engineering leaders to how field learnings become platform patterns that scale across every team.

High Ownership, High Leverage: You will have the autonomy to identify problems, design solutions, and drive them to completion with your portfolio, and the backing of a central team that turns what you learn into patterns for everyone.

Be Human With Us:
Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.


Use of AI Technology:

We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.


What We Offer:

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

  • Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer-nominated awards, and more.

At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there.

You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.

If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Vision & Strategy

  • Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users.

  • Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it.

  • Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction.

Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage.

Technical Product Leadership

  • Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions.

  • Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile.

  • Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet and Zoom.

  • Define clear feature tiers with explicit labels for stable versus experimental functionality.

Rapid Prototyping with AI

  • Use AI coding and design tools to build working prototypes and demos that prove concepts before committing engineering resources.

  • Turn ideas into something the team, users and the board can see and touch within days.

Execution & Team Leadership

  • Lead the product team and run the sprint cadence end to end, covering planning, prioritization, standups, reviews and retrospectives.

  • Own deliverables from conception through release, testing and post-launch iteration, ensuring core functionality works reliably every time.

  • Maintain issue trackers and roadmaps that accurately reflect priorities and sprint commitments.

  • Coordinate across engineering, QA, design, marketing and business stakeholders, and manage cross-team dependencies across the Holepunch and Tether ecosystem.

  • Provide transparent updates on status, risks and timeline changes, and hold direct conversations about accountability when needed.

Mobile & Distribution

  • Own the mobile release process across iOS and Android. This includes App Store and Google Play submissions, review guidelines, compliance, store listings, ratings and release management.

  • Oversee desktop distribution and installers across macOS, Windows and Linux.

  • Build crash reporting, debugging and analytics systems, privacy-preserving by design, that turn user reports into actionable engineering data.

Requirements

Mandatory:

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including significant time in a senior or lead role owning a consumer product end to end.

  • Strong product sense, with a proven track record of setting product vision and driving it to measurable outcomes at scale (tens of millions of users or more).

  • Experience leading engineers who ship products, including running sprint cadences with predictable delivery across cross-functional teams.

  • Deep JavaScript and React skills. You can read and write production code, review pull requests, and build working prototypes yourself.

  • Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. You don't need P2P expertise, because our core abstracts it away, but you should be able to reason about sync, offline behavior and consistency trade-offs.

  • Hands-on experience shipping and scaling mobile apps on iOS and Android, with deep familiarity with App Store and Google Play logistics, review processes and release management.

  • Experience with real-time voice and video calling products (such as Google Meet, Zoom, FaceTime or WhatsApp calls) and the quality, latency and reliability trade-offs involved.

  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to rapidly prototype and demonstrate product concepts.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting vision and strategy to boards, executives and investors.

  • A strong understanding of urgency versus importance, and the judgment to make fast, high-quality decisions with incomplete information.

  • You thrive in a high-intensity, fast-moving environment, set an exceptionally high bar, and are willing to go above and beyond, including extended hours, when the mission demands it.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have:

  • Product leadership experience at a major messaging app such as WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, Signal, Viber or KakaoTalk.

  • Experience with peer-to-peer technologies, distributed systems or decentralized protocols. Prior exposure to Holepunch, Pear or Hypercore is a strong plus.

  • Experience growing a product in emerging markets or across multiple regions and languages.

  • A background in privacy, encryption or security-focused products.

  • Familiarity with Electron, React Native or similar cross-platform frameworks, as well as installer systems, boot performance and Linux packaging (Snap, AppImage, Flatpak).

  • A solid understanding of testing approaches (unit, integration, end-to-end), test automation and performance testing.

  • An engineering background or computer science degree.

  • Experience with Git, issue trackers and modern collaboration tools.

Why this role:

The next billion-user communication app will not run on someone else's servers. If you want to be the person who defines it, presents it to the board, prototypes it yourself, and then leads the team that ships it, we want to hear from you.

In your application, include a link to a product you have shipped or a prototype you have built, along with a few sentences on how you would take Keet to 1 billion users.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

About Us

Foundever® is a global leader in the customer experience (CX) industry. About the role

The Senior Linux Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, administration, security, and optimization of enterprise Linux infrastructure supporting business-critical applications and services. This role provides advanced technical expertise in Linux systems engineering, infrastructure operations, automation, performance tuning, and incident resolution to ensure the availability, reliability, scalability, and security of production environments.

The Senior Linux Engineer serves as a technical escalation point for complex infrastructure issues, leads root-cause analysis and remediation efforts, and drives continuous improvement through automation, standardization, and operational best practices. This position works closely with infrastructure, security, network, application, and operations teams to maintain resilient platforms and support strategic technology initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Linux Systems Engineering and Administration

  • Design, build, configure, deploy, and maintain enterprise Linux servers and infrastructure across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
  • Administer and support Linux distributions, including Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), CentOS Stream, Ubuntu Server, and other enterprise Linux platforms as required.
  • Manage system services, processes, filesystems, storage, user and group permissions, package repositories, system initialization, and kernel-level configurations.
  • Perform advanced troubleshooting of operating system, hardware, storage, networking, and application-related issues.
  • Manage system lifecycle activities, including provisioning, upgrades, migrations, decommissioning, and platform standardization.
  • Optimize system performance, resource utilization, availability, and capacity to meet business and application requirements.

Infrastructure Operations and Reliability

  • Monitor system health, availability, resource utilization, and operational performance using enterprise monitoring and logging tools.
  • Lead the investigation and resolution of complex incidents, recurring failures, and service degradation.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions to reduce recurring incidents and improve platform stability.
  • Support high-availability architectures, system redundancy, backup and recovery, business continuity, and disaster recovery initiatives.
  • Participate in change management, maintenance planning, production deployments, and infrastructure upgrades while minimizing service disruption.
  • Develop and maintain operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, runbooks, and technical documentation.

Security, Compliance, and Vulnerability Management

  • Implement and maintain Linux security standards, configuration baselines, access controls, and system hardening practices.
  • Coordinate operating system patching, security updates, vulnerability remediation, and compliance-related activities.
  • Apply security best practices for SSH, sudo, authentication, file permissions, service configurations, and privileged access.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity and compliance teams to investigate findings, remediate risks, and maintain audit readiness.
  • Review system configurations and identify opportunities to improve security posture and reduce operational risk.

Automation and Configuration Management

  • Develop and maintain automation using Bash, Python, and other scripting technologies to improve operational efficiency and consistency.
  • Implement configuration management and infrastructure automation using tools such as Ansible or comparable platforms.
  • Automate routine administration, system provisioning, patching, health checks, reporting, and operational maintenance tasks.
  • Establish repeatable deployment procedures and standardized configurations across Linux environments.
  • Identify opportunities to eliminate manual processes, reduce human error, and improve service delivery through automation.

Technical Leadership and Collaboration

  • Serve as a senior technical resource and escalation point for Linux infrastructure issues.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and knowledge transfer to Linux administrators, engineers, and operations personnel.
  • Collaborate with application, database, network, security, cloud, and infrastructure teams to resolve cross-platform issues.
  • Contribute to infrastructure architecture reviews, technical design decisions, capacity planning, and platform modernization initiatives.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to infrastructure reliability, security, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation and communicate technical risks, incident findings, and remediation plans to relevant stakeholders.

Required Qualifications and Experience

  • 5 + years professional experience in Linux systems administration, systems engineering, or enterprise infrastructure operations.
  • Strong hands-on experience supporting enterprise Linux environments, preferably Red Hat Enterprise Linux.
  • Advanced knowledge of Linux operating system architecture, system services, process management, filesystems, storage, permissions, and system performance.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across operating system, networking, DNS, SSH, storage, resource utilization, and service availability issues.
  • Experience with Linux patch management, vulnerability remediation, system hardening, access management, and security best practices.
  • Proficiency in Bash scripting and working knowledge of Python or another scripting language.
  • Experience with system monitoring, log analysis, incident management, root-cause analysis, and problem resolution.
  • Practical understanding of backup and recovery, high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
  • Experience planning and executing production changes, system upgrades, migrations, and infrastructure maintenance.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize competing operational demands, and lead complex technical investigations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an emphasis on documentation, collaboration, and knowledge sharing.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Red Hat Satellite, Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, or comparable enterprise management and automation solutions.
  • Familiarity with virtualization platforms, containers, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience with enterprise monitoring, centralized logging, configuration compliance, and vulnerability management platforms.
  • Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code practices, Git-based workflows, and automated deployment pipelines.
  • Experience supporting large-scale, distributed, or highly available production environments.
  • Familiarity with ITIL processes, formal change management, incident response, and problem management.
  • Relevant Linux, Red Hat, cloud, or infrastructure certifications.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring technical staff and leading infrastructure engineering initiatives.

Success Criteria

  • High availability, reliability, and performance of enterprise Linux platforms.
  • Timely completion of security patching, vulnerability remediation, and compliance activities.
  • Reduced recurring incidents through effective root-cause analysis and permanent corrective actions.
  • Increased operational efficiency through automation and standardized processes.
  • Accurate, current technical documentation and effective operational handoffs.
  • Successful delivery of infrastructure upgrades, migrations, and improvement initiatives with minimal business disruption.

Core Competencies

  • Enterprise infrastructure operations
  • Automation and configuration management
  • Security hardening and vulnerability remediation
  • Incident management and root-cause analysis
  • Performance optimization and capacity planning
  • Technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration
  • Documentation and continuous improvement

jobs.excerpt: With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.
jobs.description:
With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.

Position Purpose:

The Machine Learning Engineer II is responsible for joining a product team and contributing to the software design, algorithm design, and overall product lifecycle for a product that our users love. The engineering process is highly collaborative. ML Engineers are expected to pair daily as they work through user stories and support products as they evolve.
ML Engineers may be involved in designing and implementing AI/ML algorithms to embed directly into software products. Activities may include using specific HD process techniques, integration, design, and development. The role could interface with Business Stakeholders, Technology Infrastructure teams, and Development teams to ensure that business requirements are properly met within a machine learning solution. The role may also be involved in performance tuning, testing, and product monitoring. Other responsibilities may include performing customer outreach, designing ML educational material, and data engineering.
ML Engineers should be able to operate independently with minimum guidance from others, although will typically work as part of a team with varying skill levels to create, support, and deploy production applications. This role will review submitted code and provide feedback to improve, based on best practices.


Key Responsibilities:
  • 65% Delivery and Execution - Collaborates and pairs with other product team members (UX, engineering, and product management) to create secure, reliable, scalable machine learning solutions; Documents, reviews, and ensures that all quality and change control standards are met; Works with Product Team to ensure user stories that are developer-ready, easy to understand, and testable; Writes custom code or scripts to automate infrastructure, monitoring services, and test cases; Writes custom code or scripts to do "destructive testing" to ensure adequate resiliency in production; Program configuration/modification and setup activities on large projects using HD approved methodology; Configures commercial off the shelf solutions to align with evolving business needs; Creates meaningful dashboards, logging, alerting, and responses to ensure that issues are captured and addressed proactively
  • 15% Learning - Participates in learning activities around modern software design, machine learning, and development core practices (communities of practice); Proactively views articles, tutorials, and videos to learn about new technologies and best practices being used within other technology organizations
  • 20% Support and Enablement - Fields questions from other product teams or support teams; Monitors tools and participates in conversations to encourage collaboration across product teams; Provides application support for software running in production; Proactively monitors production Service Level Objectives for products; Proactively reviews the Performance and Capacity of all aspects of production: code, infrastructure, data, message processing, and prediction quality

Direct Manager/Direct Reports:
  • This Position typically reports to Software Engineer Manager or Sr Software Engineer Manager
  • This Position has 0 Direct Reports

Travel Requirements:
  • Typically requires overnight travel 5% to 20% of the time.

Physical Requirements:
  • Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions there may be a need to move or lift light articles.

Working Conditions:
  • Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.

Minimum Qualifications:
  • Must be eighteen years of age or older.
  • Must be legally permitted to work in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications:
  • 1 - 3 years of relevant work experience
  • Experience in a modern scripting language (preferably Python)
  • Experience in effective data engineering practices and big data platforms such as BigQuery, Data Store, etc
  • Experience in modern web application framework such as Node.js
  • Experience in a front-end technology and framework such as HTML, CCS, JavaScript, ReactJS, D3
  • Experience in writing SQL queries against a relational database
  • Experience in version control systems (preferable Git)
  • Familiarity with algorithms such as clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, and neural networks.
  • Familiarity with basic statistics and regression algorithms
  • Familiarity with advanced statistics such as bayesian statistics
  • Familiarity with Data Analysis and Machine Learning Tools and Libraries like Jupyter Notebooks, Pandas, SciPy, Scikit-learn, Gensim, tensorflow, pytorch, etc.
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform and AI/ML related components such as Vertex AI, BigQueryML, and AutoML
  • Familiarity with a Linux or Unix based environment
  • Familiarity with a CI/CD toolchain
  • Familiarity with REST and effective web service design
  • Familiarity with production systems design including High Availability, Disaster Recovery, Performance, Efficiency, and Security

jobs.title: GTM Data Operations Engineer
jobs.excerpt: MPLC provides a legal way to show movies and TV in public or commercial spaces across the globe.
jobs.description:
MPLC provides a legal way to show movies and TV in public or commercial spaces across the globe. Our business has been running for over 30 years, and we are the number one trusted partner to studios and producers for public performance licensing. We work with every major Hollywood studio and hundreds of independents, and we are a key player in the entertainment and intellectual property ecosystem.

We are on a truly exciting journey as a company. We're growing quickly, investing in our teams, and have bold plans for the future. To support that growth, we're looking for a GTM Data Operations Engineer to join our Data team.

The Role in Two Bullet Points
  • Own the US Mid-Market and Enterprise data pipeline: build net-new account detection with Python web scraping and Clay, qualify accounts against our ideal customer profile, and deliver sales-ready batches every week.
  • Keep the pipeline sharp and the data trusted: manage enrichment logic, re-score existing accounts, and work closely with sales and demand generation to close the loop when quality falls short.

Let's be honest!

This is an individual contributor role with real ownership, but not a blank page. You will work to the quality standard and playbooks set by the Principal and Senior, and you are expected to improve them, not just maintain them. You will deliver rep-ready batches on a consistent weekly cadence, and the quality bar is one sales teams have to trust.

If you need a bit more information

We are hiring a GTM Data Operations Engineer to run the data pipeline that sources, enriches and qualifies US accounts, using sources such as ZoomInfo, Dun & Bradstreet, SEC/EDGAR and industry registries. This is an individual contributor role with real ownership of your pipeline.

You'll love this role if...
  • Clay experience: enrichment tables, waterfall logic and AI agents in production, without burning credits.
  • Python: you can read, write and debug pipeline and web scraping scripts without a developer.
  • Quality bias: you know what "sales-ready" means and close the loop before sales has to tell you.
  • Salesforce fluency: object model, field mapping and CRM hygiene.
  • AI-first: you have shipped at least one AI workflow in a GTM context and can describe what it produced.
  • Collaboration: you work well with sales, demand generation, RevOps and IT, and explain data logic in plain language.
Experience we are looking for
  • 2+ years building GTM data workflows or B2B data pipelines with demonstrable results, such as accounts sourced, acceptance rates improved or manual steps removed.
  • Familiarity with US B2B data sources (ZoomInfo, Dun & Bradstreet, SEC/EDGAR or similar) is preferred.

Benefits

  • Base Salary: $85,000 to $100,000 per year depending on experience
  • Remote Working: from anywhere in the US with occasional paid travel
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and sick pay package
  • Retirement: 401(k) retirement plan
  • Time Off: 15 days paid vacation
